GAA devices Published nanosheet results are TCAD so far; no silicon data was found. Jeong et al. IEEE Access 2021 (abstract only) compared sub-5 nm NSFETs with FinFETs and reached three conclusions: TSV stress shifts Ion more in NSFETs than in FinFETs, mainly through the stress component along the channel length. Outside the KOZ, the stress impact is negligible. Judged by an analog criterion (coupling current below 0.5% of Ion), conventional structures fail on noise coupling; the authors recommend a bottom oxide under source/drain and an undoped punch-through stopper. How 3D structures differ As TSVs shrink from micrometers to nanometers, the local stress KOZ shrinks with the square of the diameter, but global effects from thinning, backside metal and the loss of the substrate take over. On a GAA process with backside power, looking only at zones around TSVs is not enough. Structure Typical size Effect on devices Source Via-middle Cu TSV 3–5 µm diameter, about 40–50 µm deep Sees a 420 °C anneal and several 350–400 °C BEOL steps, so residual stress and mobility shift are largest; Cu pumping thins M1 and raises its resistance by about 35% Guo et al. ECTC 2015 Backside via-last TSV Same order Sees a single ramp to 300 °C, so residual stress and KOZ are smaller and pumping is insignificant; a ~3 µm polymer liner cuts coupling by about another 20 dB Same; Rack et al. ECTC 2015 Nano-TSV (backside power) Under 1 µm diameter, W fill; Si thinned to 20–370 nm imec measured FinFETs with Lg ≥ 20 nm: no negative impact apart from a slight pMOS drive-current loss, and up to 15% higher nMOS mobility. The shift comes from wafer-level thinning and backside processing, not from a local zone around one TSV imec VLSI 2021 ; Semiconductor Engineering Direct backside contact Reported Si thinning below 100 nm, about 10 nm left for direct contact A Lam virtual-fabrication study found backside direct connection adds noticeably more stress to GAA channels than frontside connection, directly changing mobility and drive current Semiconductor Engineering Pass-through TSV in a base die Not published Public process pages for 3DIC base dies list pass-through TSVs, die-to-die TSVs and hybrid bonding interfaces without sizes or KOZ values; the PDK is the reference Intel 18A process page Microbumps plus underfill Not given in the abstract Stress from backside microbumps passes through the thinned Si to the devices; imec measured FET current shifts above 40%. Bumps need keep-out zones too Ivankovic et al. 3DIC 2011 (abstract) Two global costs of thinning Worse heat spreading. Si conducts about 140 W/(m·K), SiO₂ about 1.4. Thinning or removing the substrate reduces lateral spreading; imec simulations put backside-power peak temperature about 14 °C above frontside power, and another simulation shows self-heating rising sharply below 300 nm of Si. Source: Semiconductor Engineering . Weaker substrate-dependent devices. When imec thinned Si from 700 µm to 300 nm, ESD failure current It2 dropped 20–40%, with STI diodes down about 36% under 100 ns TLP. Source: imec, IEDM 2023 results . Analog device behavior in GAA Published data says GAA itself helps analog: higher gain, lower 1/f noise, less sensitivity to substrate noise. Four things need watching: a stress response unlike FinFET, heavier self-heating, weaker substrate-dependent devices after thinning, and stronger layout-dependent effects. Property Published GAA findings What to watch with 3D Source Stress response Nanosheet conduction is dominated by (100) surfaces, where hole mobility is lower; wider sheets add more (110) sidewall contribution. TCAD shows TSV stress shifts Ion more in NSFETs than in FinFETs FinFET KOZ data cannot be reused directly. TSV stress adds to stress from backside metal, backside contacts and wafer thinning Mukesh & Zhang 2022 ; Jeong et al. 2021 (abstract) Matching Random mismatch comes from line-edge roughness, gate-edge roughness, non-uniform work-function metal deposition and random dopants; sheet thickness is set by epitaxy and is uniform. Another study reports notable VT variation from metal thickness differences between sheets The TSV stress field has a gradient and flips sign with orientation, adding systematic mismatch that does not average out with larger device area Mukesh & Zhang 2022 ; TED 2019 (abstract) Gain and efficiency imec double-nanosheet nMOS reach about 46 dB intrinsic gain versus about 34 dB for FinFETs under similar conditions; gain rises with L and barely changes up to 200 °C. gm/ID peaks in weak inversion and fT in strong inversion, with the best trade-off near an inversion coefficient of 10. A clear zero-temperature-coefficient bias point exists Stress shifts mobility, so bias points, gm and current-mirror ratios drift; gain itself changes little Simoen et al. JICS 2022 Low-frequency noise 1/f noise is dominated by carrier-number fluctuation, i.e. trapping and release in gate-oxide traps; normalized noise beats FinFETs and other architectures. Work-function metal choice changes trap density Self-heating raises channel temperature and thermal noise; TSV substrate coupling is another noise injection path Simoen et al. JICS 2022 Self-heating Stacked sheets dissipate heat poorly: more and wider sheets mean higher temperature rise and larger sheet-to-sheet gradients. Below 10 nm channel length the rise can exceed 100 K. Correcting for self-heating changes end-of-life HCD Idsat shift by 10–35% Self-heating worsens below 300 nm of Si; simulations put backside-power peak temperature about 14 °C above frontside power. A temperature gradient across a matched pair turns directly into mismatch (this last point is an inference) Zhou 2025 ; Semiconductor Engineering Substrate-dependent devices ESD diodes and GGNMOS rely on a thick substrate to conduct current and spread heat. At 300 nm of Si, It2 drops 20–40%; STI diodes suffer most, gated diodes less, and channel-conducting power-rail clamps least imec proposes vertical diodes with the anode moved to the backside, cutting layout area by 67% with more uniform current imec 2024 ; ESDA 2025 Substrate noise isolation FinFET body transconductance is small, so TSV-to-device coupling is about 20 dB lower than planar at 1 GHz and 4–8 dB lower at 40 GHz; what remains is mostly capacitive coupling to the drain. TCAD shows even less back-bias coupling for NSFETs than FinFETs Bottom dielectric isolation cuts the parasitic channel under the sheets and isolates best. Fast-edge signal TSVs should still stay away from high-impedance nodes Rack et al. ECTC 2015 ; Jeong et al. 2021 (abstract) Parasitics and layout-dependent effects Nanosheet LDEs must be included in analog simulation. Synopsys benchmarks report up to 140% series-resistance error and 25% total-capacitance error when advanced-node LDEs are ignored (vendor data, not independently verified) TSVs add coupling capacitance to routes within 10 µm, which belongs in parasitic extraction Synopsys ; Peng et al. DAC 2014 imec's analog data comes from sub-7 nm research devices (two sheets, L of 28–200 nm), not production PDK devices, so the numbers indicate trends only. Measurement methods The most reliable basis for a KOZ is the device's electrical response, not a stress map. Stress metrology calibrates simulation; device- and circuit-level test structures set the rules. Stress and deformation Method What it measures Capability Limits Source Micro-Raman Near-surface stress in Si around the TSV About 0.8 µm spot, about 200 nm probe depth (442 nm laser), about 10 MPa resolution; lab tool Gives only the sum of radial and tangential stress, not individual components; signal degrades next to the TSV interface; needs a reference point assumed stress-free Ryu et al. JAP 2012 Synchrotron X-ray microdiffraction Stress inside Cu TSVs and the surrounding Si Full stress tensor, depth-resolved; penetrates hundreds of µm of Si without cross-sectioning; in-situ at 150 °C Needs synchrotron beam time; not for routine monitoring Okoro et al. TED 2014 ; Liu et al. CPMT 2016 TEM nanobeam or precession electron diffraction Strain inside channels and source/drain nm spatial resolution, strain precision better than 0.1% Destructive; imec has reported specific difficulties and limits on released GAA nanowires EDFA 2019 ; Favia et al. IMC19 2018 Cu pumping height and M1 resistance Protrusion of the TSV top and the dielectric above it; resistance change of M1 over the TSV Maps directly to back-end risk; M1 resistance can be measured inline Captures axial extrusion only, not front-end stress Liu et al. CPMT 2016 ; Guo et al. ECTC 2015 One easily missed problem with Raman: it reports only the sum of radial and tangential stress, and these two components are similar in size and opposite in sign, so they largely cancel. A quiet Raman map does not mean the individual stress components seen by devices are small (a judgment based on the measurement principle). Devices and circuits Method What it measures Key practice Source Distance-ladder test structures Idsat versus distance to the TSV Place the same device at several distances (imec used 1.7–20.7 µm), with single, row and array TSV layouts; fit the figure of merit K imec IEDM 2010 ; Guo et al. IEDM 2013 Four-point bending The device's own piezoresistive coefficients Apply known uniaxial stress to wafer strips and measure current change. The coefficients then predict any layout without TSVs and validate TCAD Guo et al. IEDM 2013 DAC or current-source arrays Circuit-level current mismatch imec resolved 0.5% changes with a 45 nm DAC test chip; suited to setting KOZs directly with analog criteria imec IEDM 2010 ; Semiconductor Engineering Well resistors next to TSVs Sensitivity to proximity effects Sony placed Si well resistors next to 6 µm-pitch TSVs Semiconductor Engineering Two-port S-parameters TSV-to-device noise coupling VNA from TSV to drain up to 40 GHz; sweep TSV bias (−15 to 10 V) and device on/off state; compare substrate-contact distances Rack et al. ECTC 2015 TSV C-V Liner capacitance and depletion TSV, liner and Si form a MOS structure whose capacitance varies with TSV voltage; capacitance peaks with the TSV at ground, the worst case for coupling Peng et al. ICCAD 2013 Low-frequency noise 1/f spectra and gate-oxide trap density On-wafer, with a parameter analyzer and low-frequency noise analyzer, at least 5 devices per wafer; identify the mechanism from normalized current noise versus (gm/ID)², and extract trap density from input-referred noise at 10 Hz Simoen et al. JICS 2022 Gate resistance thermometry Self-heating temperature rise and thermal resistance Four-terminal gate structures; calibrate the gate metal's temperature coefficient of resistance on a temperature-controlled chuck, then read temperature in operation with a probe voltage of tens of mV. It reports the average gate-metal temperature, which can be below the channel peak NIST (method described on GaN HEMTs) TLP and VF-TLP ESD failure current It2 100 ns TLP corresponds to HBM, VF-TLP to CDM; compare before and after thinning imec 2024 Reliability tests near TSVs BTI, HCI, gate-oxide breakdown; back-end TDDB, EM, SM Voltage-ramp and constant-voltage stress at 25 °C and 125 °C, with dedicated structures for low metal and via levels above the TSV 14 nm FinFET study (abstract) One more caution on self-heating: a paper (abstract only) notes that thermal time constants of advanced devices are too short for pulsed-IV and AC-conductance methods, leaving gate-resistance and RF methods; four-terminal gate structures also change heat paths and series resistance, so layout differences must be accounted for in extraction. Recommended approach These recommendations build on the literature above; they are not the conclusion of any single paper. The core idea: fit K from the device's own stress response plus distance-ladder data, then derive the KOZ from the drift each circuit class can tolerate. Split the KOZ into three rules. Set the front-end stress KOZ by device class (digital, general analog, precision matching); set the noise KOZ by TSV type, stricter for fast-edge signal TSVs than for power and ground; keep back-end via and routing rules separate. Measure piezoresistive coefficients on GAA analog devices first. Use four-point bending across n and p, short and long L, and several sheet widths. Conduction surfaces differ from FinFET, so FinFET coefficients do not carry over. Fit K with distance-ladder structures. Cover single TSVs, rows and arrays at the product pitch; cover channels pointing toward and perpendicular to the TSV; put reference devices more than 200 µm from any array. Verify matched pairs separately. Lay out pairs both equidistant with the same orientation to the TSV and asymmetric, and compare mean offsets. Use enough samples to separate systematic offset from random mismatch. Cover temperature, lifetime and packaging. Stress scales with the difference from the stress-free reference temperature, so measure hot and cold; re-measure after thermal cycling; measure again after stacking and packaging, since microbump effects can exceed those of TSVs. Set noise rules with S-parameter structures. Split on substrate-contact distance, with and without guard rings, and with and without bottom dielectric isolation. Treat substrate-dependent devices as a separate check. Compare ESD diodes and GGNMOS with TLP before and after thinning; do the same for bandgap diodes or BJTs and well resistors. Add four-terminal gate structures to key analog devices to measure self-heating. Compare thermal resistance before and after thinning and stacking. Setting the KOZ criterion Work back from circuit specs. First decide how much systematic mismatch a circuit class can give to TSVs, for example 0.5% current error in a current mirror; then compute the single-TSV radius from measured K; enlarge it for array superposition and add margin for thermal cycling and via-to-via variation. For precision matching, symmetric placement saves more area than simply moving farther away. Gaps in public data No public data was found for the following; the PDK or your own measurements are the reference. Silicon data for GAA devices near TSVs. Only TCAD results were found; measured data stops at FinFET. Sizes and KOZ values for pass-through and die-to-die TSVs. Public process pages do not give them. Impact of hybrid bonding pads on front-end devices. No public KOZ data was found. How bandgap diodes and BJTs, temperature sensors and well resistors change after substrate thinning. Public data covers ESD devices only. These devices also depend on the substrate, so similar degradation is likely, but no data supports it. The finding that backside direct connection adds stress to GAA channels. It comes from Lam's virtual-fabrication simulation, not silicon. records.text: 服务器市场与 Intel Foundry｜Server & Foundry Outlook 2026–2030 跳至正文 / Skip to report TIMEMEMO RESEARCH 打印报告 Print report 中文 EN RESEARCH NOTE  /  2026.10.02 服务器市场 与 Intel Foundry Server silicon & Intel Foundry 2026–2030 产品路线、制造地域与先进封装。 从公开证据，判断可争取的业务。 2026–2030 roadmaps, manufacturing geography and advanced packaging. A public-evidence assessment of attainable business. 研究范围：CPU · GPU · 定制 ASIC · 封装 SCOPE: CPU · GPU · CUSTOM ASIC · PACKAGING 45 项来源 · 中英双语 45 SOURCES · CHINESE / ENGLISH 报告目录 CONTENTS 01 核心结论 Decision 02 市场规模 Market size 03 产品路线 Roadmaps 04 制造地域 Geography 05 封装需求 Packaging 06 机会排序 Priorities 07 收入测算 Economics 08 行动建议 Actions 09 方法与来源 Sources 01 给 Intel Foundry 的结论 The decision for Intel Foundry 优先争取封装与特定芯粒；用客户验证推动先进制程订单。 Lead with packaging and selected chiplets. Earn leading-edge wafer orders through customer qualification. 2026–2030 年的机会不只来自 x86 与 Arm 的份额变化，更来自加速器、定制 ASIC 和互连把更多价值放进一个封装。Intel 可以服务采用 Arm 指令集、由其他公司设计、甚至由 TSMC 制造计算裸片的产品。关键是把可制造、可测试、可盈利的交付方案做出来。 The 2026–2030 opportunity extends beyond x86 versus Arm share. Accelerators, custom ASICs and interconnect put more value inside each package. Intel can serve Arm designs and packages containing compute dies made elsewhere. The commercial test is a manufacturable, testable and profitable delivery model. 01 / 优先级 PRIORITY 封装可单独获客 Packaging can win independently Intel 明确提供跨代工厂芯粒集成及纯封装服务。建议先做有付费客户支持的 HBM／多芯粒验证，而不是把封装合同绑定到逻辑晶圆转单。 Intel explicitly offers cross-foundry integration and packaging-only services. Prioritize paid HBM and multi-chiplet qualification programmes without requiring a simultaneous logic-wafer transfer. [40] 02 / 竞争现实 COMPETITIVE REALITY TSMC 的优势是整套生态 TSMC competes as an ecosystem 领先逻辑、堆叠、HBM 合作和客户设计流程相互强化。EMIB 的技术指标必须转化为客户实测的成本、良率与交期优势；扩大封装面积本身不等于赢单。 Leading-edge logic, stacking, HBM partnerships and design flows reinforce each other. EMIB specifications must translate into measured customer cost, yield and delivery advantages; package size alone does not win contracts. [31] [43] 03 / 资本纪律 CAPITAL DISCIPLINE 按承诺订单扩产 Expand against committed demand 把设计合作、流片、认证、预付款和量产收入分开统计。对 18A-P／14A 设置客户 IP、良率、容量与长期供货门槛，避免把合作意向计作可兑现收入。 Track design engagement, tape-out, qualification, prepayment and production revenue separately. Gate 18A-P and 14A investments on customer IP, yield, capacity and supply commitments; expressions of interest are not bankable revenue. 本文为公开资料研究，非 Intel 官方材料。以下建议与优先级均为研究判断；不代表已有客户订单或内部产能信息。 Independent public-source research, not an Intel publication. Recommendations and priorities are analytical judgments, not evidence of customer orders or internal capacity. 02 规模：先把市场口径分清 Size the right market 服务器整机收入 Server-system revenue 单位：十亿美元；全球；IDC 2026 年 7 月预测版本 US$ billion, worldwide; IDC July 2026 forecast vintage [01] 2025 已发生 Actual $453.5B 2026 预测 Forecast $647.0B 2027 预测 Forecast $930.6B Q2 2026 $166.3B 季度整机收入；同比增长 52.0%。GPU 与其他加速服务器合计占约 69.1% 的收入。 Quarterly system revenue, up 52.0% year over year. GPU and other accelerated servers together represented approximately 69.1% of revenue. [02] 69.1% =（874 亿美元 GPU 服务器 + 275 亿美元其他加速服务器）÷ 1,663 亿美元。它是整机收入占比，不是芯片出货占比。同期 non-x86 收入占比 44.8%，也不能直接当成 Arm CPU 销量份额。 69.1% = ($87.4B GPU servers + $27.5B other accelerated servers) / $166.3B. This is a system-revenue share, not a chip-unit share. Likewise, the 44.8% non-x86 revenue share is not Arm CPU unit share. [02] 统计层级 Market layer 公开参照 Public reference 对本研究的用途 How to use it 整机市场 Server systems 2025：$453.5B；2026E：$647.0B 2025: $453.5B; 2026E: $647.0B [01] 包括处理器、内存、板卡及整机价值；不能乘一个假定份额就得到晶圆代工收入。 Includes processors, memory, boards and system value. [08] [32] [43] 这是潜在逻辑代工机会，区别于 DRAM 制造；需要存储厂和终端 ASIC 双方共同导入，不能假设 Intel 已赢单。 Potential logic-foundry work, distinct from DRAM manufacturing. Requires memory-vendor and end-ASIC qualification; no Intel win is assumed. 网络／光互连 Networking / optical I/O TSMC COUPE 与 NVIDIA 光网络路线构成长期方向。 TSMC COUPE and NVIDIA optical-networking roadmaps establish a longer-term direction. [25] [38] 先区分交换芯片 CPO、封装光 I/O 与计算芯片本身。可服务市场、热预算和认证不同。 Distinguish switch CPO, package optical I/O and compute silicon. Addressable services, thermal budgets and qualification differ. 良率比封装报价更能改变客户总成本 Yield can outweigh the quoted packaging fee 示例假设：一套待装配裸片与 HBM 成本 $10,000，装配／测试成本 $1,000，失败不可回收。合格封装成本 = $11,000 ÷ 最终装配良率。良率从 95% 降到 85%，成本从 $11,579 升至 $12,941，增加约 $1,362（11.8%）。这不是任何厂商的实际成本或良率。 Illustrative assumptions: dies and HBM cost $10,000, assembly/test cost $1,000, and failed assemblies have no salvage value. Cost per good package = $11,000 / final assembly yield. Moving from 95% to 85% raises cost from $11,579 to $12,941, about $1,362 or 11.8%. These are not any vendor’s actual costs or yields. 采购验收建议：对同一设计索取 die map、凸点／键合规则、HBM 供应资格、SI／PI 仿真与硅验证、翘曲及热循环结果、known-good-die 测试覆盖、系统级测试、失效责任与良率赔付条款。CoWoS 转 EMIB 不是无需工程改动的“换供应商”。 Procurement acceptance: request die maps, bump/bond rules, qualified HBM supply, SI/PI simulations and silicon results, warpage and thermal-cycle results, known-good-die coverage, system-level test, failure ownership and yield-liability terms. A CoWoS-to-EMIB move entails engineering work, not just a supplier-name change. 06 机会排序与竞争障碍 Opportunity priorities & barriers 以下排序按“技术切入可行性 × 客户关系 × 新项目设计空间”评估，不是赢单概率，也不代表 Intel 已与所列公司开展未公开项目。 Priorities reflect technical entry feasibility, customer relationships and scope for new designs. They are neither win probabilities nor evidence of undisclosed Intel programmes. 优先级／目标 Priority / target 建议争取的项目 Recommended pursuit 机会依据 Rationale 主要挑战／停止条件 Challenge / stop condition A · Socionext 及 ASIC 设计渠道 A · Socionext and ASIC design channels 18A-P 计算芯粒，配套封装与测试；可复用的客户参考设计。 18A-P compute chiplet with packaging/test and reusable reference designs. Socionext 有明确开发公告；比仅有生态名单更接近真实设计工作。 Socionext has an explicit development announcement, stronger evidence than an ecosystem logo. [30] 仍需真实 tape-out、客户产品及付费量产承诺；不能将开发意向折算为订单。 Require tape-out, an end-customer product and paid production commitments; development intent is not an order. A · Google／AWS 已有合作周边 A · Adjacent Google / AWS programmes IPU、AI fabric、I/O／网络芯粒；建立可延展至未来平台的制造记录。 IPUs, AI fabrics and I/O/network chiplets; build a delivery record for later platforms. 公开合作范围比 TPU／Trainium 转厂传闻更可靠。 Publicly announced scopes are more reliable than TPU/Trainium migration speculation. [17] [22] 先进 PHY、软件／系统验证与价格竞争；没有追加合同就不预建专用大产能。 Advanced PHYs, system/software validation and pricing; avoid large dedicated expansion without incremental commitments. A/B · 云 ASIC 的独立封装 A/B · Packaging-only cloud ASICs 接受外部计算裸片，验证 EMIB-T／3D 方案；优先下一代新设计。 Accept external compute dies and qualify EMIB-T/3D options, prioritising new generations. 客户可保留已验证逻辑节点，同时评估第二封装来源。 Customers can retain a qualified logic process while evaluating another packaging source. HBM、基板、封装共同设计及成本责任；应比较总合格产品成本，不能只比装配费。 HBM, substrate, co-design and cost ownership; compare cost per good package, not just assembly fees. B · Arm／区域 HPC CPU B · Arm / regional HPC CPUs 18A-P／14A 新 CPU 或局部芯粒；美国制造选项。 New 18A-P/14A CPUs or selected chiplets; US manufacturing options. ISA 与制造可分离；客户在能效、供应链和差异化上有选择空间。 ISA and manufacturing are separable; customers have efficiency, supply-chain and differentiation choices. DDR／PCIe／SerDes IP、软件成熟度及较小规模经济；普通 CPU 封装价值可能有限。 DDR/PCIe/SerDes IP, software maturity and smaller economies of scale; ordinary CPU packaging value may be limited. B/C · NVIDIA／AMD 主计算芯片 B/C · NVIDIA / AMD main compute dies 争取下一代限定范围设计、独立封装或非主计算芯粒。 Pursue bounded next-generation designs, independent packaging or non-core compute chiplets. 规模可观，但深度绑定既有制造与封装流程。 Large potential volume, but established manufacturing and packaging flows are deeply integrated. 完整逻辑转厂设计成本高、时程敏感；应以客户技术尽调和合同为先，不预测确定转单年份。 Full logic migration is costly and schedule-sensitive; require diligence and contracts rather than forecast a certain transfer year. C · HBM 底座／光 I/O 长线 C · HBM bases / optical I/O 与存储厂、IP 商共同做测试载具与下一代平台。 Joint test vehicles and next-generation platforms with memory and IP suppliers. 可增加每套封装中的逻辑和集成价值。 Can increase logic and integration value per assembly. 既有供应关系强，技术与商业认证周期长；不将试验平台计作服务收入。 Strong incumbent relationships and lengthy technical/commercial qualification; test vehicles are not service revenue. 先进制程的差异化：需要系统级证明 Process differentiation needs system-level proof 18A 结合 RibbonFET 与 PowerVia 背面供电；14A 路线采用 RibbonFET 2／PowerDirect。潜在价值是功耗与供电布线，而不是节点名称本身。TSMC A16 也规划背面供电，因此 Intel 要证明的是客户具体设计上的优势，并把 SRAM、接口 IP、良率和封装一起交付。 18A combines RibbonFET with PowerVia backside power; 14A plans RibbonFET 2/PowerDirect. Potential value lies in power and routing, not node names. TSMC A16 also plans backside power, so Intel must demonstrate an advantage on customer designs and deliver SRAM, interface IP, yield and packaging together. [37] [40] Intel 必须同时解决的五个问题 Five issues Intel must close together 外部客户信任：独立保护 IP、透明排产，且不因与 Intel 产品部门竞争而受到影响。 External-customer trust: IP protection and transparent scheduling independent of competition with Intel Products. 设计可用性：不仅有晶体管性能，还要有生产验证过的 SRAM、DDR、HBM、SerDes、EDA 流程和封装设计套件。 Design readiness: production-qualified SRAM, DDR, HBM, SerDes, EDA flows and package design kits, beyond transistor metrics. 制造经济性：在客户裸片面积和产品组合上验证良率、周期时间、可交付产量与成本。 Manufacturing economics: demonstrate yield, cycle time, deliverable output and cost on customer die sizes and product mixes. 供货完整性：晶圆、HBM、基板、装配、测试、散热及返修要形成可执行的交付责任。 Complete supply responsibility: wafer, HBM, substrate, assembly, test, cooling and failure handling need executable ownership. 现金与时间：在产品设计窗口内兑现路线；用客户承诺分阶段投资，避免规模不足与闲置产能相互放大。 Cash and timing: deliver within design windows and stage investment against commitments, avoiding a feedback loop of low scale and idle capacity. 07 收入机会：用可审计的假设测算 Revenue opportunity: auditable assumptions 以下全部价格、数量均为人为设定的敏感性假设，不是报价、实际订单、产能预测或 Intel 指引。用途是反推“要形成有意义的收入，需要多少合格交付”。 Every price and volume below is an explicit illustrative assumption, not a quote, order, capacity forecast or Intel guidance. Use it to work backwards from a revenue objective to required qualified deliveries. 年度收入 = 收费晶圆交付量 × 每片晶圆收入 + 合格封装交付量 × 每套封装服务收入。晶圆与封装是不同收费服务，可属于同一芯片，但封装费用必须排除已经计入的逻辑裸片、HBM 转售和其他重复项。这里只测收入，不估利润、投资回报或市场份额。 Annual revenue = billable wafer deliveries × revenue per wafer + qualified packaged units × packaging service revenue per unit. Wafers and packaging are distinct services and may serve the same chip, but packaging fees must exclude logic dies, HBM resale and other already-counted items. This models revenue, not profit, investment returns or market share. 情景标签 Scenario label 封装假设 Packaging assumptions 晶圆假设 Wafer assumptions 合计收入 Combined revenue 小规模导入 Limited adoption 0.25M × $400 = $0.10B 20k × $15,000 = $0.30B $0.40B 示例中档 Illustrative middle 0.75M × $800 = $0.60B 60k × $20,000 = $1.20B $1.80B 较大规模导入 Larger adoption 1.50M × $1,200 = $1.80B 120k × $25,000 = $3.00B $4.80B 调整假设，观察所需规模 Adjust assumptions, see the scale 按稳定年度计；不指定达到年份。允许零订单情景。 A steady annual run rate; no target year. Zero-order scenarios are allowed. 合格封装数量（千套） Qualified packages (thousands) 封装服务单价（美元） Packaging service fee (US$) 收费晶圆数量（千片） Billable wafers (thousands) 每片晶圆收入（美元） Revenue per wafer (US$) 恢复示例 Reset example 年度服务收入 ANNUAL SERVICE REVENUE $1.80B 总收入 ≠ 毛利 ≠ 现金流 Revenue ≠ gross profit ≠ cash flow 如何使用：先以 NDA 数据核实客户量、面积、良率和价格，再替换假设。若认证延迟、单位价格下降或客户不采购，收入可能显著低于示例，甚至为零。不能把 $1.8B 中档示例称作“Intel 未来市场规模”。 How to use it: replace assumptions with NDA-validated customer volume, area, yield and pricing. Delayed qualification, lower pricing or no customer adoption can reduce revenue sharply, including to zero. The $1.8B middle example is not a forecast of Intel’s future market. 08 建议执行路径与尽调清单 Execution path & diligence priorities 时间窗口 Window 建议动作 Recommended action 交付／决策门槛 Deliverable / decision gate 现在起 90 天 Next 90 days 建立按客户与芯粒拆分的机会清单；同时推进一个封装载具与一个明确的外部逻辑项目；核实 HBM／基板伙伴。 Build a customer-and-chiplet opportunity register; pursue one packaging vehicle and one defined external logic programme; validate HBM/substrate partners. 具名客户问题、设计范围、负责团队、NRE 预算、验收规格、客户资料授权。 Named customer problem, design scope, owner, NRE budget, acceptance specification and authorised customer data. 2026–2027：验证窗口 2026–2027: qualification window 围绕真实设计验证供电、散热、测试和良率；为客户提供跨代工封装的总成本比较。 Validate power, thermal, test and yield on real designs; deliver cross-foundry packaging cost comparisons. 付费验证合同、测试数据、可靠性结果、量产前提与失效责任。未通过即缩小或停止专项扩产。 Paid qualification contract, test data, reliability results, production conditions and liability. Narrow or stop dedicated expansion if gates fail. 2027–2028：设计导入 2027–2028: design adoption 利用下一代产品设计窗口导入 18A-P／14A 或局部 I/O／底座芯粒；将封装服务客户转为更深合作。 Use next-generation design windows for 18A-P/14A or selected I/O/base dies; deepen relationships with packaging customers. 客户 tape-out、完整 IP、明确出货产品、可验证订单与付款安排。 Customer tape-out, complete IP, identified shipping product, verifiable orders and payment structure. 2028–2030：有条件扩张 2028–2030: conditional expansion 按客户实际采购与合格产出复制产线；评估大封装、HBM 底座及光互连的新增价值。 Replicate capacity against purchases and qualified output; assess incremental value in large packages, HBM bases and optical I/O. 多客户复购、稳定成本／良率、产能利用率和现金回收；不以路线图展示替代商业回报。 Repeat business, stable cost/yield, utilisation and cash recovery; roadmap demonstrations are not commercial returns. 下一轮尽调必须拿到的数据 Data required for the next diligence round 01 客户下一代芯片的设计冻结日、量产日、裸片尺寸、预计数量和供货地域要求。 Next-generation design freeze, production date, die sizes, unit forecasts and geographic sourcing requirements. 02 分工序的良率与周期时间：晶圆、键合、HBM 装配、最终测试；不能只给整厂平均值。 Yield and cycle time by wafer fabrication, bonding, HBM assembly and final test, not just fab-wide averages. 03 客户可获得产能、可用设备与基板规格；光罩倍数与实际每月良品数量应分开。 Customer-available capacity, tools and substrate specifications; separate reticle multiples from monthly good units. 04 谁拥有设计、谁采购 HBM、谁承担报废及延期、谁向 Intel 支付晶圆和封装费用。 Who owns the design, buys HBM, bears scrap/delay liability and pays Intel for wafers and assembly. 05 与 TSMC／Samsung／OSAT 同口径的良品成本、交期、IP 成熟度及长期供应条款。 Comparable cost per good unit, lead time, IP readiness and supply terms versus TSMC, Samsung and OSAT options. 06 18A-P／14A 外部客户的 tape-out、认证与付费订单证据；剔除内部业务和会计重分类。 External 18A-P/14A tape-out, qualification and paid-order evidence, excluding internal business and accounting reclassification. 决策建议：将“封装独立获客”与“先进制程导入”设为两条可分别验收的业务路径。前者以良品交付建立信任，后者以客户产品和订单验证技术价值。两条路径都必须接受没有订单就不扩产的约束。 Decision recommendation: treat independent packaging acquisition and leading-edge process adoption as separately gated businesses. The first builds trust through qualified delivery; the second validates technology through customer products and orders. Both must tie expansion to real demand. 09 方法、证据边界与来源 Method, evidence boundaries & sources 检索与核对截至 2026 年 10 月 2 日。研究分三轮：第一轮建立市场与产品清单；第二轮回到公司技术资料、财报和监管披露核实制造／封装；第三轮检查时间、统计口径、合作范围与数字运算。未进行供应链访谈，未使用非公开 Intel 数据。 Research cutoff: October 2, 2026. Three passes established market/product coverage, checked manufacturing and packaging against company technical/financial disclosures, then reconciled dates, definitions, agreement scopes and arithmetic. No supply-chain interviews or non-public Intel data were used. 证据类别 Evidence class 本文如何处理 Treatment 公司已经公布的事实 Disclosed fact 说明发布时间与产品状态；公司称量产不等于所有客户已经部署。 Record announcement date and product status; a production claim does not imply deployment by every customer. 公司路线图 Company roadmap 使用“目标／计划”；风险生产、平台可用、产品上市分别处理。 Use target/plan language; distinguish risk production, platform availability and product launch. 第三方市场预测 Third-party forecast 记录数据版本与口径；2026／2027 整年 IDC 数字为预测，非已实现收入。 Identify vintage and scope; IDC full-year 2026/2027 values are forecasts, not realised revenue. 研究推断 Analytical inference 客户优先级、地域基线和未来切入方式均为判断，不代表合同。 Customer priorities, geographic baselines and entry strategies are judgments, not contracts. 未披露／未核实 Undisclosed / unverified Google／Meta 等逐代 foundry、封装分配及产量不强行填数；网络传闻不进入基准测算。 Do not invent per-generation Google/Meta foundries, package allocations or volumes; rumours are excluded from baseline calculations. 重要更新处理：Intel Q2 2026 文件明确 18A-P 于 6 月进入风险生产，并承诺为未来 Intel 产品完成 14A 开发，同时按承诺需求安排扩张。因此不能继续把年初“可能暂停 14A”的条件表述当成当前完整结论。Socionext 采用 18A-P 的公告也属于新证据，但还不能推导收入规模。 Important update: Intel’s Q2 2026 filing reports June risk production for 18A-P and a commitment to complete 14A development for future Intel products, with expansion paced to committed demand. Earlier conditional pause language is therefore not a complete current assessment. Socionext’s 18A-P announcement adds evidence, but does not establish revenue scale. [03] [30] 来源阅读提示：部分网页会更新，PDF 路径中的年份不一定是内容版本。例如 Intel HPC／AI brief 的路径含 2025-11，但正文版本为 2026 年 6 月。保留来源原名，避免把旧公告的计划误当成今天的交付结果。 Source note: live pages may change, and a PDF path is not necessarily its revision date. Intel’s HPC/AI brief has a 2025-11 URL but a June 2026 document revision. TIMEMEMO EDUCATION NOTES / 教育资料 NO. 01 / FAMILY GUIDE 核查 / Verified 07 SEP 2026 项目与费用 Programs 申请资格 Eligibility 课程与线上 Courses 报名时间 Dates 官方来源 Sources 中英 中文 English A SUMMER OF POSSIBILITY / 夏日探索 哈佛大学夏校指南 Harvard Summer School 为高中生与家长整理：选什么课、能否在线上、何时申请，以及需要准备多少预算。 A practical guide for high-school students and families: what to study, how to learn online, when to apply, and what to budget. 从项目比较开始 Compare the programs ↘ 打印 / 存为 PDF Print / Save as PDF PLANNING EDITION 2027 下一轮完整简章待公布 Full next-cycle details pending 2 周 / WEEKS 4 周 / WEEKS 7 周 / WEEKS 校园住宿 · 走读 · 在线 Residential · Commuting · Online 先分清年份 Read the year first 2027 年的毕业年份资格已公布；截至核查日，完整报名日期、年龄截止日、课程和费用仍待更新。本页所有具体金额、上课日期和课程实例均为 2026 年参考，2026 年申请已结束。 Graduation-year eligibility for 2027 is published. As of verification, the full application calendar, age cutoffs, courses and fees for 2027 remain pending. All prices, session dates and course examples below refer to 2026; applications for that cycle have closed. 项目官网 / Program overview ↗ 01 选项目，也选一种夏天 Choose your summer 正式高中生项目分为 Pre-College 与 Secondary School Program（SSP）。所有金额为美元。 The two high-school programs are Pre-College and the Secondary School Program (SSP). All prices are in USD. 左右滑动查看完整比较 → Swipe horizontally for the full comparison → 项目 / 形式 Program / format 时长 Duration 课程与学分 Courses and credits 2026 项目费 2026 program cost 含 $75 申请费 Including $75 application Pre-College 校园住宿 Residential 2 周 2 weeks 1 门课 · 无大学学分 1 course · noncredit $6,100 $6,175 SSP 校园住宿 Residential 4 周 4 weeks 1 门课 · 4 学分 1 course · 4 credits $9,100 $9,175 SSP 校园住宿 Residential 7 周 7 weeks 通常 2 门课 · 共 8 学分 Usually 2 courses · 8 credits $15,735 $15,810 SSP Online 完全线上 Fully online 7 周 7 weeks 通常 1–2 门课 · 4 或 8 学分 Usually 1–2 courses · 4 or 8 credits $4,180 / $8,160 $4,255 / $8,235 SSP Commuting 校外居住走读 Commuting 7 周 7 weeks 通常 1–2 门课 · 4 或 8 学分 Usually 1–2 courses · 4 or 8 credits $4,180 / $8,160 $4,255 / $8,235 想完全远程参加，选择 7 周 SSP Online。2 周 Pre-College 与 4 周 SSP 仅提供住宿形式。7 周住宿须修满 8 学分，某些安排可以是一门 8 学分课。 For fully remote study, choose the 7-week SSP Online option. The 2-week Pre-College and 4-week SSP are residential only. Seven-week residential students take 8 credits; some schedules may use one 8-credit course. SSP 项目 / SSP program ↗ · Pre-College 项目 / Pre-College program ↗ · SSP 费用 / SSP costs ↗ · Pre-College 费用 / Pre-College costs ↗ 费用包含什么？ What is included? 住宿项目包括学费、住宿、餐饮及项目费；Pre-College 还包括两周意外与疾病保险。线上／走读的标价已含 $200 项目费，不需重复加收。$75 申请费不退。 Residential prices include tuition, housing, meals and the program fee. Pre-College also includes two weeks of accident and sickness insurance. Online/commuting prices already include the $200 program fee. The $75 application fee is nonrefundable. 另外预算：书本、学习用品、交通、个人开销及适用的保险或签证费用。走读学生自行安排校外住宿和交通。 Budget separately for books, supplies, travel, personal spending and any applicable insurance or visa costs. Commuters arrange their own off-campus accommodation and transportation. 有没有助学金？ Is financial aid available? 有数量有限、按经济需要评估的奖学金，通常覆盖部分费用。官网资格包括美国公民、永久居民或 DACA 身份；一般国际学生不符合该校内资助资格。需在项目申请中同步申请资助并按时提交材料。 Limited need-based scholarships are available and usually cover only part of the cost. Eligibility includes U.S. citizens, permanent residents and students with DACA status; other international students generally do not qualify for this institutional aid. Request aid within the program application and meet its deadlines. Pre-College 资助 / Pre-College aid ↗ · SSP 资助 / SSP aid ↗ 02 高中生，什么时候可以申请？ Eligibility comes first 毕业年份与年龄需要同时满足。线上形式也要符合正式高中生项目资格。 Both graduation-year and age requirements matter. Online students must also meet the high-school program eligibility rules. 已公布：2027 年毕业年份资格 Published: graduation-year eligibility for summer 2027 Pre-College 2028 / 2029 在以上年份高中毕业并进入大学；按常规美高进度，2027 年暑假完成 10 或 11 年级。 Graduate from high school and enter college in one of these years; normally completing grade 10 or 11 in summer 2027. SSP · Online included 2027 / 2028 / 2029 在以上年份高中毕业并进入大学；按常规美高进度，2027 年暑假完成 10、11 或 12 年级。 Graduate from high school and enter college in one of these years; normally completing grade 10, 11 or 12 in summer 2027. 2027 资格来源 / 2027 eligibility source ↗ 年龄：目前只有 2026 年细则 Age: detailed rules are still for 2026 2026 年要求截至 6 月 20 日已满 16 岁，且不能在 7 月 31 日之前满 19 岁。2027 年的具体生日截止日期要等新简章，不能直接平移一年。 For 2026, applicants had to be at least 16 by June 20 and not turn 19 before July 31. The precise birthday cutoffs for 2027 must be confirmed in the new rules; do not simply move the dates forward one year. 如果 2026 年秋刚进入美高 9 年级、预计 2030 年毕业，则不符合以上 2027 年项目的毕业年份条件。可先规划后续年份或尝试开放课程。 A student entering U.S. grade 9 in fall 2026 and expecting to graduate in 2030 falls outside these 2027 graduation-year requirements. Plan for a later summer or explore open courses first. 申请材料清单 Application checklist 学生本人完成申请与短文 The student completes the application and short essays. 9 年级起至最新学期的成绩单 Transcripts from grade 9 through the most recent term. 学校 counselor 报告 A report from the school counselor. 家长／监护人规则与媒体授权表 Parent or guardian rules and media-release form. 适用的英语成绩及 $75 申请费 English-test scores when required, plus the $75 application fee. 官网没有最低 GPA 硬性线；PSAT、SAT、ACT 可交但不是必需。录取综合评估学业、学习动机与成熟度。每年只能申请 Pre-College 或 SSP 其中一类。 There is no published minimum GPA. PSAT, SAT and ACT scores are optional. Admission considers academic readiness, motivation and maturity. Apply to only one of Pre-College or SSP per summer. 申请与选拔 / Admissions and selection ↗ 英语准备 English preparation 非英语母语申请人通常需提交英语成绩。下表是官网描述的成功学生常见水平，并非达到分数就保证录取。 Non-native English speakers generally submit English-test scores. These are typical levels described for successful students, not a guarantee of admission. 考试 Test 官网参考水平 Official reference level TOEFL 旧制总分通常高于 103、写作 ≥25；官网也列出新版总分 5。 Typically above 103 on the older scale, writing ≥25; the page also lists an overall 5 on the new scale. IELTS 总分 ≥7.5；写作 ≥7.0 Overall ≥7.5; writing ≥7.0 Duolingo ≥135 在美国就读不应被自行理解为自动免考；如适用，请向招生办公室确认是否可以豁免。 Do not assume that attending school in the U.S. automatically waives testing. Confirm any applicable waiver with admissions. 英语要求 / English requirements ↗ 03 从兴趣，走进一门大学课程 Find a subject worth exploring 这里的“专业”指学科探索与课程选修，并非申请一个本科学位。SSP 介绍有 200 多门课；并非每门都可线上修读。 These are fields to explore through individual courses, not applications to a degree major. SSP advertises over 200 courses; availability depends on the program and delivery format. FIELD 01 计算机与人工智能 Computer science & AI Python、数据结构、人工智能、自然语言处理 Python, data structures, artificial intelligence, natural language processing FIELD 02 数学、统计与工程 Math, statistics & engineering 概率、数据分析、数学建模、环境工程 Probability, data analysis, mathematical modeling, environmental engineering FIELD 03 心理与神经科学 Psychology & neuroscience 认知、学习与大脑、行为、亲密关系 Cognition, learning and the brain, behavior, close relationships FIELD 04 生物、医学与公卫 Biology, medicine & public health 分子生物、免疫、流行病、生物医学伦理 Molecular biology, immunology, epidemiology, biomedical ethics FIELD 05 经济、商科与领导力 Economics, business & leadership 经济学、会计、公共财政、创业、领导力 Economics, accounting, public finance, entrepreneurship, leadership FIELD 06 法律、政治与国际关系 Law, politics & global affairs 人权、全球治理、国际合作、法律哲学 Human rights, global governance, international cooperation, philosophy of law FIELD 07 写作、艺术与设计 Writing, arts & design 小说、剧本、电影、视觉艺术、用户体验 Fiction, screenwriting, film, visual arts, user experience FIELD 08 人文、社会与语言 Humanities, society & languages 历史、哲学、社会学、人类学、文学、外语 History, philosophy, sociology, anthropology, literature, languages 方向及课程实例来自官网当前资料。Pre-College 每期约 30 门课、每人选一门。2027 年实际开课以新目录为准。 Fields and examples reflect currently published information. Pre-College offers roughly 30 courses per session, with one course per student. Confirm 2027 offerings in the new catalog. SSP 学科方向 / SSP subjects ↗ · Pre-College 课程 / Pre-College courses ↗ 已查到的线上课程实例 · 2026 Verified online-course examples · 2026 以下课程出现在 2026 年 SSP 异步线上筛选结果中，核查时未标记取消。它们用于规划参考，不代表现在可以报名，也不保证 2027 年继续开设。 These courses appeared in the 2026 SSP asynchronous-online search without a cancellation flag when checked. They are planning examples, not currently open applications or guaranteed 2027 offerings. 课程 Course 课程代码 Course code 学习方向 Area Python 计算机科学入门 Introduction to Computer Science with Python CSCI S-7 编程起步 Programming foundations Python 人工智能入门 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python CSCI S-80 已有编程基础 Prior programming background 计算机科学强化导论 Intensive Introduction to Computer Science CSCI S-50 计算机科学 Computer science 数据结构 Data Structures CSCI S-22 算法与编程 Algorithms and programming 微观经济学原理 Principles of Economics: Microeconomics ECON S-10A 经济学 Economics 统计与应用数据分析导论 Introduction to Statistics and Applied Data Analysis STAT S-100 统计与数据 Statistics and data 认知神经科学 Cognitive Neuroscience PSYC S-1310 心理与大脑 Psychology and the brain 亲密关系心理学 The Psychology of Close Relationships PSYC S-1503 社会与行为 Social behavior 流行病学与生物统计导论 Introduction to Epidemiology and Biostatistics STAT S-103 公共卫生 Public health 社会学导论 Introduction to Sociology SOCI S-11 社会研究 Social sciences 查看官方筛选结果 / Open official filtered catalog ↗ 从零开始：Python 入门 Starting out: introductory Python CSCI S-7 面向没有编程经验的学生，先修为高中代数。2026 年支持直播、异步录像或到校学习。直播为周二／周四美国东部 15:15–18:15，即波特兰 12:15–15:15。 CSCI S-7 is designed for students without prior programming experience; high-school algebra is the prerequisite. In 2026 it offered live online, recorded or on-campus attendance. Live sessions were Tuesday/Thursday, 3:15–6:15 p.m. Eastern, or 12:15–3:15 p.m. in Portland. 核对课程详情 ↗ Check course details ↗ 已有基础：Python 与 AI With experience: Python and AI CSCI S-80 的先修为 CSCI S-50、CS50x，或至少一年 Python 经验。2026 年为异步线上，但仍有必须参加、另行安排时间的 sections。选课时应逐门核查先修与出勤要求。 CSCI S-80 requires CSCI S-50, CS50x, or at least one year of Python experience. Its 2026 asynchronous format still included required sections scheduled separately. Check each course’s prerequisites and attendance rules. 核对课程详情 ↗ Check course details ↗ 14–18 h/wk 7 周 SSP 一门常见 4 学分课的每周规划估算：约 6 小时课堂，另加 8–12 小时课外学习。 Planning estimate for one typical 4-credit, 7-week SSP course: about 6 class hours plus 8–12 hours of work outside class each week. 3 + 2–4 h Pre-College 上课日通常有 3 小时课堂，另加 2–4 小时作业。 Pre-College class days typically involve 3 hours in class plus 2–4 hours of homework. 4 × 2.5 h 4 周 SSP 每周 4 天、每天 2.5 小时课堂，另有作业。具体课程可能要求更多时间。 Four-week SSP courses meet 4 days a week for 2.5 hours a day, plus assignments. Actual workload can be higher. SSP 课外投入 / SSP workload ↗ · Pre-College 课堂 / Pre-College classes ↗ · 课堂时数 / Class hours ↗ 04 申请项目，再注册课程 Apply first. Register for courses after admission. 以下均为已结束的 2026 周期。2027 年正式开放日、截止日和上课日期尚待公布。 All dates below belong to the completed 2026 cycle. Official 2027 opening dates, deadlines and sessions are still pending. 2026 周期 · 申请与选课 2026 cycle · applications and registration 环节 Milestone 历史日期 Historical date 项目申请开放 Applications open 2025 / 12 / 01 Dec 1, 2025 提前申请／优先资助截止 Early application / priority aid 2026 / 01 / 07 Jan 7, 2026 常规申请／资助截止 Regular application / aid 2026 / 02 / 11 Feb 11, 2026 最晚申请截止 Late application deadline 2026 / 04 / 01 Apr 1, 2026 Pre-College 选课开放 Pre-College course registration 2026 / 02 / 26 Feb 26, 2026 SSP 选课开放 SSP course registration 2026 / 03 / 02 Mar 2, 2026 住宿项目缴费截止 Residential payment deadline 2026 / 04 / 07 Apr 7, 2026 线上／走读缴费截止 Online / commuting payment 2026 / 05 / 11 May 11, 2026 晚申请可能因候补满额而提前结束。申请截止通常为东部时间 23:59，波特兰为同日 20:59。缴费截止后录取者按注册时即时缴费规定办理。 Late applications may close earlier when waitlists fill. Application deadlines are generally 11:59 p.m. Eastern, or 8:59 p.m. in Portland. Students admitted after the payment deadline follow immediate-payment rules when registering. 2026 年 · 项目举办时间 Summer 2026 · program sessions Pre-College 第一期 Pre-College Session I 6月21日—7月2日 Jun 21 – Jul 2 Pre-College 第二期 Pre-College Session II 7月5日—7月17日 Jul 5 – Jul 17 Pre-College 第三期 Pre-College Session III 7月19日—7月31日 Jul 19 – Jul 31 4 周 SSP 住宿 4-week SSP Residential 7月12日—8月8日 Jul 12 – Aug 8 7 周 SSP 各形式 All 7-week SSP formats 6月20日—8月8日 Jun 20 – Aug 8 以上为项目时间；迎新、入住和具体课程授课日期可能不同。例如核查的 Python 课授课期间为 6 月 22 日—8 月 7 日。 These are program dates. Orientation, move-in and individual class dates may differ; the Python listing, for example, covered June 22–August 7. 为 2027 年准备 Preparing for 2027 今年秋季先核对资格、成绩和英语准备；11—12 月重点留意官网更新。这是参照上一届节奏的建议，并非已公布的下一轮开放日期。 Use the fall to check eligibility, academic records and English readiness. Watch for official updates in November–December. This is planning advice based on the previous cycle, not an announced opening date. 查看官方更新入口 ↗ Visit the official updates page ↗ 国际学生：2026 年需要学校签发 I-20、来美参加 SSP 住宿／走读者，申请截止为 2 月 11 日；海外 SSP Online 学生可按一般晚申请截止。实际入境与学习要求应按身份和学校当年指引确认。 International students: the 2026 application deadline was February 11 for SSP residential/commuting applicants needing an I-20. Overseas SSP Online applicants could use the general late deadline. Confirm current requirements for your status with the school. 官方日历 / Official calendar ↗ · 申请截止 / Application deadlines ↗ · 两周项目日期 / Two-week dates ↗ · SSP 日期 / SSP dates ↗ 05 怎样选，更适合孩子？ Choose for the student 先选学习目标，再比较预算和时间投入。 Start with the learning goal, then compare budget and time commitment. Pre-College 只有两周，想体验校园住宿和大学课堂：优先了解 Pre-College。项目无大学学分，仍需认真参与课堂与活动。 With two weeks available and an interest in campus living, explore Pre-College. It is noncredit, while still requiring serious participation in classes and activities. SSP Online 希望在家修读大学课程并获得成绩／学分：优先比较 7 周线上项目。第一次可考虑一门基础匹配的 4 学分课。 To study a college course from home for grades and credit, compare the 7-week online option. A first-time student might start with one 4-credit course that fits their preparation. SSP Residential 希望住校并修学分：4 周适合集中读一门课；7 周适合安排更完整的学术体验与 8 学分课程。 For campus living plus credit, four weeks allows a focused single-course experience; seven weeks provides a longer academic stay with an 8-credit course load. 夏校对大学录取和学分有什么意义？ What does it mean for college admission and credit? 参加夏校不保证哈佛本科录取。SSP 提供大学课程字母成绩，可申请成绩单；学分能否转入未来大学由接收学校决定。Pre-College 不给大学学分，采用完成要求与否的评价。 Summer-school participation does not guarantee admission to Harvard College. SSP provides letter-graded college coursework and transcripts on request; the receiving institution decides whether credits transfer. Pre-College is noncredit and evaluates whether requirements were met. SSP 成绩与录取说明 / SSP outcomes ↗ · 转学分说明 / Credit transfer ↗ · Pre-College 评价 / Pre-College evaluation ↗ 刚进入高中，或想先低成本尝试呢？ What if the student is younger or wants to try first? 如果还不符合正式夏校资格，可先探索 Harvard 的 CS50x 免费开放课程。官网提供 11 个学习单元及期末项目，适合自行安排进度。这种开放学习本身不等于获得 SSP 录取或大学学分。 Students who do not yet qualify can explore Harvard’s free CS50x OpenCourseWare. It offers eleven units of material and a final project for independent study. Taking the open course alone does not provide SSP admission or college credit. 免费开放课程 / Free OpenCourseWare ↗ 06 资料可追溯，申请看官网 Check the official source 核查于 2026 年 9 月 7 日。费用采用专门的 Cost & Aid 页面；具体线上课程通过 Harvard DCE 目录核对。 Verified September 7, 2026. records.text: AI 转型策略 R3 · AI Transformation Strategy · Timememo ☰ T Timememo AI Strategy · R3 00 执行摘要 Executive Summary 01 为什么做 AI Why AI 02 能力演进 Capability Evolution 03 位置与数据基础 Position & Data 04 路线图 Roadmap 05 数字分身 Digital Agents 06 工作方式与讲法 Workstyle & Narrative 07 成本与提效 Cost & ROI 中文 EN ← Timememo Home 数字世界 · AI 优先 · 内部策略 Digital-first · AI Strategy · Internal 先 用起来 ， 再把它做深。 Use it first. Then go deep. 先把回答做实、把行动做稳，最后接数据、上验证。AI 不替代人——它放大人。 Master the answers, govern the actions, then wire the data and validate. AI doesn't replace people — it multiplies them. 版本 R3 Version R3 范围：数字世界优先 Scope: digital-first 更新：2026-06 Updated: 2026-06 01 更快 Faster 已知工作压缩到分钟级。 Collapse known work into minutes. 02 更强 Stronger 一个人即可跨越职能边界。 One person, cross-functional reach. 03 当下 Now 从回答问题走向数字行动。 From answers to digital action. 04 边界 Boundary 物理世界须验证、审计、人负责。 Physical world needs validation and human ownership. 00 执行摘要 Executive Summary 先问对问题，让答案可追溯，再让 AI 替你执行。 Ask sharper questions. Trace every answer. Then let AI execute. 转型第一步不是买工具，是改习惯：敢问、会问、答案必须溯源。中期让 agent 处理低风险的数字事务；长期接入关键数据、建立单一可信源（SSOT），进入受控的工程问题解决。窗口已经打开，胜负取决于采用率、数据质量和信任。 Transformation starts as a habit, not a purchase: ask boldly, ask well, and demand sourced answers. Mid-term, let agents handle low-risk digital tasks. Long-term, connect critical data, build a single source of truth, and move into governed engineering problem-solving. The window is open — speed depends on adoption, data quality, and trust. 外部在加速 Market moving TSMC 用 NVIDIA 加速制程仿真与计算光刻；三星与 NVIDIA 共建 AI factory、数字孪生与制造优化。大企业仍处早期。 TSMC accelerates process simulation and computational lithography with NVIDIA; Samsung and NVIDIA build AI factories, digital twins, and manufacturing optimization. Large enterprises remain early. 内部先取价值 Value inside 从 M365 已授权的数据起步：会议、邮件、文档、recap、培训材料——合规、现成、足够启动。 Start with the M365-authorized layer: meetings, email, documents, recaps, training materials — compliant, available, enough to begin. 底线是可信 Trust is the gate 无来源不给答案；信息冲突时列出处让人判断；关键 spec 只认 SSOT。 No source, no answer. Surface conflicts for human judgment. Critical specs come from the SSOT only. 一句话： 先交付一个可用、可信、答案可追溯的 Knowledge Check Agent ，在真实工作流里迭代，再扩展到 Logistics、Product/Customer、Yield/ET。 In one line: ship one trusted, sourced Knowledge Check Agent first , iterate on real workflows, then expand into Logistics, Product/Customer, and Yield/ET. 01 为什么做 AI Why AI 更快，也更强。 Faster — and stronger. AI 做两件事：把已有工作提速，把原本做不到的事变得可做。结论很简单——AI 不是替代品，是放大器。 AI delivers two gains: it compresses work you already do, and unlocks work that was previously out of reach. The frame is simple — not a replacement, a multiplier. 提速 · Acceleration Acceleration 已有工作提速 Compress existing work 搜索、总结、写代码、准备报告、整理会议、分析资料——原本几小时甚至几天的数字工作，压缩到分钟。 Search, summarize, draft code, prep reviews, organize meetings, analyze data — hours or days of digital work collapsed into minutes. 扩展 · Expansion Expansion 打开新的可能 Unlock new reach 一个人同时获得研究、编程、编辑、数据分析、项目管理的部分能力，跨越原有的专业边界。 One person borrows partial capability from a researcher, programmer, editor, analyst, and coordinator at once — crossing old skill boundaries. 互联网时代，工具帮我们 找信息 ；AI 时代，工具帮我们 形成答案、采取行动 ，直到解决问题。 In the internet era, tools helped us find information . In the AI era, tools help us form answers and take action — through to solving the problem. 02 能力演进 Capability Evolution 信息 → 答案 → 行动 → 解决。 Information → Answers → Action → Solving. 数字世界里，AI 已能稳定回答问题，并开始执行代码、文档、邮件和数据整理。边界同样清晰：还不能普遍解决端到端问题，物理世界更需要验证、审计与人负责。 In the digital world, AI reliably answers questions and is beginning to act across code, documents, email, and data. The boundary is equally clear: end-to-end problem-solving isn't reliable at scale, and the physical world demands validation, audit, and human ownership. 互联网 Internet 提供信息 Provide info 搜索、数据库、Wiki 把信息交给人，判断仍由人做。 Search, databases, wikis hand information to people; judgment stays human. 当下 Now 回答问题 Answer LLM、RAG、企业 Copilot 把分散信息整合成答案——最该先做扎实的阶段。 LLMs, RAG, copilots synthesize scattered info into answers — the stage to nail first. 正在出现 Emerging 采取行动 Act Agent 写代码、整理文档、触发流程，但仍需权限、审计与人工确认。 Agents code, organize docs, trigger steps — but need permissions, audit, confirmation. 下一步 Next 解决问题 Solve AI 拆解目标、选工具、验证结果并迭代。少数数字场景已有案例。 AI decomposes goals, picks tools, verifies, iterates. Emerging in select digital domains. 长期方向 Horizon 自我优化 Self-improve AI 从成败中改进方法，参与研发优化。长期愿景。 AI refines its own methods and feeds R&D optimization. A long-term vision. 03 位置与数据基础 Position & Data Foundation 我们还在早期；数据没连起来，是真正的瓶颈。 Still early — and disconnected data is the real bottleneck. M365 已经提供合规入口：邮件、会议、文档、recap、协同数据，足以启动早期 agent。短板也明确：使用率不深、模型与工具链受限、工厂关键数据尚未安全接入。瓶颈不是模型能力，是数据散落、缺少单一可信源。 M365 already provides a compliant entry point — email, meetings, documents, recaps, collaboration data — enough for early agents. The gaps are equally clear: shallow adoption, limited models and toolchains, and no safe access to factory-level data. The bottleneck isn't model capability; it's fragmented data and the absence of a single source of truth. 数据不是没有，是没连起来 The data exists — it just isn't connected 工程数据、spec、process flow、实验记录、历史问题都在，但散落在不同系统。过去这是数字化问题，现在是 AI 能不能工作的前提。先让关键数据可读、可搜索，再打通关系，最后让 AI 成为统一入口。 Engineering data, specs, process flows, experiment records, and historical issues all exist — scattered across systems. Once a digitization problem, now a prerequisite for useful AI. First make key data readable and searchable, then connect the relationships, then let AI become the unified interface. 关键数字必须唯一 Critical numbers must be singular AI 可以广读信息，但 process flow、工艺 spec、ET spec 不能模糊——差 0.1 nm 就可能改变判断。同一时刻一个关键 spec 只有一个权威来源，AI 必须引用它，不能在冲突系统间平均或猜测。SSOT 不只是 IT 项目，是 AI 进入严肃工程判断的前提。 AI can read broadly, but process flows and process/ET specs cannot be fuzzy — a 0.1 nm delta can change the call. At any moment a critical spec has exactly one authoritative source; AI must cite it, never average across conflicting systems or guess. SSOT isn't just an IT project — it's the precondition for serious engineering judgment with AI. 可访问 · 可连接 Accessible · Connected AI 能读到核心数据，而非只有外围文档；数据源之间有关系、上下文和统一 ID。 AI reaches core data, not just peripheral docs; sources share relationships, context, and unified IDs. 唯一正确 · 可追溯 Authoritative · Traceable 关键 spec 和 flow 有唯一权威源；每个答案都能回溯到来源、版本和时间点。 Critical specs and flows resolve to one source; every answer traces back to source, version, and timestamp. 04 路线图 Roadmap 6 个月打基础，3 年解问题，5 年做研发。 Six months for answers. Three years for problems. Five for R&D. 不从"全自动 AI 工厂"开始。先让团队会问、会用、会验证；再做可审计的数字行动；最后接入关键数据与验证机制，解决受控的工程问题。验收看任务覆盖和答案质量，不看部署了几个工具。 Don't start with a fully autonomous AI factory. First build habits — asking, using, validating. Then auditable digital actions. Then connect deeper data and validation loops. Measure task coverage and answer quality, not how many tools got deployed. 0–6 个月 · 把回答做好 mo · Nail the answers 建团队级 prompt 模板、问题库、案例库和 Copilot 使用流程。 Build team prompt templates, a question library, case examples, and Copilot workflows. 验收：周活跃用户、有效问题数、节省时间、答案出处可信度。 Validate on weekly active users, useful questions, time saved, and source credibility. 6–12 个月 · 从答案走向行动 mo · Answers to action AI 整理行动项、生成 follow-up、准备 review 包、更新知识库、跑固定分析。 AI drafts action items and follow-ups, preps review packages, updates knowledge bases, runs fixed analyses. 验收：每个 action 有触发条件、数据来源、人工确认和日志。先做低风险数字任务，不碰物理控制。 Validate on auditable loops: every action has triggers, sources, confirmation, logs. Low-risk digital tasks only. 1–3 年 · 解决重复工程问题 yr · Recurring problems 围绕良率异常、defect pattern、process drift、review preparation，把数据、历史案例、推理与验证串起来。 Around yield excursions, defect patterns, process drift, and review prep — link data, history, reasoning, validation. 验收：AI 提候选根因、推荐检查顺序、调用分析工具，靠历史对比或小规模验证降低不确定性。 Validate the shift from suggestion to verification: candidate causes, check order, tool calls, validated against history. 3–5 年 · 参与研发与优化 yr · R&D & optimization 受控范围内参与 DOE 设计、工艺窗口分析、参数敏感性、知识沉淀与 R&D-to-HVM 转移。 Within bounds: DOE design, process-window analysis, parameter sensitivity, knowledge capture, R&D-to-HVM transfer. 验收：成功案例系统记录，失败进反例库，人和 AI 都从反馈中改进。 Validate on shared learning: wins recorded, failures into a counter-example library, both human and AI improving. 05 数字分身 Digital Agents 不是一个万能分身，是一组分工明确的 agent。 Not one universal twin — a portfolio of agents. "数字分身"是一套分工系统：查知识、做执行、看客户/产品、分析良率/ET。起点要小，边界要硬——守住 M365 已授权数据，不碰生产控制，不替代人的判断。先做能用的，再接数据，最后进入问题解决。每个知识库必须有部门或人对准确性负责。 A "digital double" is a division of labor: knowledge check, execution, product/customer context, yield/ET analysis. Start small, keep boundaries hard — stay within M365-authorized data, don't touch production control, don't replace human judgment. Ship the usable one first, connect data next, tackle problem-solving last. Every knowledge base needs a named owner accountable for accuracy. 现在 Now Knowledge Check 基于 M365 数据回答常见问题，每个答案标出处。阻力最低、见效最快、建立信任。 Answers common questions from M365 data, every answer cited. Lowest friction, fastest value, builds trust. 近期 Near Logistics Executor 排会、follow-up、状态更新等低风险执行，动作可审计，关键步骤人确认。 Scheduling, follow-ups, status updates — low-risk, auditable, human-confirmed at key steps. 中期 Mid Product / Customer 打通客户、产品、项目、lot 与制造状态，用于 meeting prep 和风险预警。 Bridges customer, product, program, lot, and manufacturing context for prep and risk visibility. 长期 Long Yield / ET Analyst 接入良率、ET、inline spec、flow 与分析工具，找相关性、候选根因、split plan。依赖 SSOT 与人工验证。 Links yield, ET, inline specs, flows, analysis tools for correlations, causes, split plans. Depends on SSOT and human validation. ownership 谁来负责 Who owns what Yield / MTS inline spec → Integration； Reliability 数据 → Reliability team； Logistics / planning → Planning / Manufacturing。每个部门对自己库里的信息准确性负责。 Yield / MTS inline spec → Integration; Reliability data → Reliability team; Logistics / planning → Planning / Manufacturing. Each team owns the accuracy of its own base. 四条铁律 Four rules Trust 附出处、可追溯、允许说"不知道"。 Boundary 只用已授权数据。 Ownership 每个库有人负责。 KPI 看任务覆盖率和"30 秒附出处答案"，不看 prompt 数。 Trust — sourced, traceable, free to say "I don't know." Boundary — authorized data only. Ownership — every base has an owner. KPI — task coverage and sourced-answer speed, not prompt count. 外部参考：MIT NANDA 2025 指出多数企业 GenAI pilot 卡在 workflow 集成而非模型本身；HBS 强调 AI ROI 取决于 people / processes / politics。 MIT NANDA · HBS External: MIT NANDA 2025 finds most enterprise GenAI pilots stall on workflow integration, not the model; HBS argues AI ROI turns on people, processes, and politics. MIT NANDA · HBS 06 工作方式与讲法 Workstyle & Narrative 别喊"组织变革"，先让会议短下来。 Skip the org-change memo. Shorten the meeting first. AI 会改变对齐方式、会议形态和知识流动。但在成果出现之前，别把它包装成"组织架构调整"——那只会触发恐惧。正确的讲法是：降低同步成本，让人把时间花在判断上。用场景说话，不用概念。 AI will reshape alignment, meetings, and how knowledge flows. But before the wins are visible, don't frame it as org redesign — that only triggers fear. Frame it as lower sync cost and more time for judgment. Lead with scenarios, not concepts. 人的价值： AI 传递信息，建立不了信任。 客户愿意合作，不只因为这次数据好，而是相信下次数据不好时你也会全力以赴。AI 处理信息，人承担判断、关系与责任。 The human moat: AI moves information; it can't build trust. Customers stay not because this run looks good, but because they trust you'll fight to make it right when it doesn't. AI handles information; people carry judgment, relationships, and accountability. 场景一 · 定会议 Scenario 1 · Scheduling 低风险开场 Low-risk opener 昨天 Yesterday 开 Outlook，手动找空档、找会议室，一个个试。 Open Outlook, hunt for a slot and a room, try options one by one. 今天 Today 语音说"约下周三 30 分钟并订房间"，系统给选项，人点确认。 Say "book 30 min next Wed and a room"; it offers options; you tap to confirm. 明天 Tomorrow 双方 agent 直接协商时间和资源，人只收到"已约好"。 Both agents settle time and room; you just get a "done." 从"我去安排"到"我去确认"，再到"我被告知"。 From "I arrange it" to "I confirm it" to "I'm informed." 场景二 · 开会被追问数据 Scenario 2 · Data questions in review 工程师核心痛点 Core pain point 昨天 Yesterday 连环追问：厚了多少片、还能厚多久、影不影响交货。准备到的能答，没准备到的回去查、下次再说。 Rapid-fire questions. Prepared answers land; the rest is "I'll check and get back" — next meeting. 今天 / 短期 Today / near Meeting Prep Agent 会前给出 Top 5 高概率问题；能答的附答案，不能答的指出找谁、查哪个系统。 A prep agent gives the likely Top-5 questions, answers what it can, and points to who or which system for the rest. 中长期 Mid–long 会上临时问题由 agent 实时检索附出处回答；进一步，备好 split plan 和候选方案，人当场拍板。 Live, sourced retrieval in the room; later, prepped split plans and candidates — decide on the spot. 从"发生 → 追查 → 下次再答 → 再排实验"，压缩成"当场答、当场判、当场定"。 Collapse "ask → check → answer next time → plan experiment" into "answer, judge, decide — now." 场景三 · 周报 / 信息同步 Scenario 3 · Weekly status 已落地，最有说服力 Already live 昨天 Yesterday 开大量会，手记 minutes，PM 凭记忆或手动整理成表格再沟通。 Many meetings, manual minutes, a PM assembling a table from memory. 今天 Today 固定格式 Excel，Copilot 每周读 recap，不改原表，加一列本周更新，变动标蓝。 A fixed Excel; Copilot reads recaps weekly, adds one column, flags changes in blue — base table untouched. 明天 Tomorrow 会后 agent 自动按客户、项目分类更新，人只维护想看的视图。 Agents auto-sort and update by customer and project after each meeting; you keep just the views you want. 从"人追信息、整理信息"变成"信息自己流到你面前"。 From chasing information to information flowing to you. 对上要讲 Say to leadership 会议成本：会前自动对齐，会上只做判断 知识检索：常见问题 30 秒附出处 数据安全访问：在现有权限内打通 Meeting cost: pre-align before, judge during Knowledge: sourced answers in 30 seconds Safe data access within existing permissions 先别讲 Don't say yet 数字分身代理你沟通、agent 间谈判 "系统为 AI 重新设计""对 AI 开放所有数据" 组织架构调整、岗位重组 Digital twins negotiating on your behalf "Redesign systems for AI" / "open all data to AI" Org restructuring, role consolidation 两条措辞红线。 ① 中期的部门维护，包装成"升级已有的 SharePoint / spec owner 机制"，不是新增没人愿干的活。② 长期讲"SSOT 提供确定性、防止错误信息扩散"，走数据治理与质量，不讲"对 AI 开放访问"。 Two wording red lines. ① Frame mid-term maintenance as "upgrading the SharePoint / spec-owner mechanism you already keep," not a new chore nobody wants. ② Frame the long term as "SSOT gives certainty and stops bad info spreading" — governance and quality, never "open access to AI." 外部参考：微软已将 agents / workflows 与 Teams、M365 深度集成；MCP 连接 agent 与工具数据，A2A 提供 agent 间通信；企业 agent 治理正从逐条审批走向"人设边界 + 升级路径"。 External: Microsoft integrates agents and workflows into Teams and M365; MCP connects agents to tools and data, A2A handles agent-to-agent communication; enterprise agent governance is shifting from per-action approval to human-set boundaries with escalation paths. 07 成本与提效 Cost & ROI 花 7 分钟的钱，买回 90 分钟。 Seven minutes to break even. Ninety is the prize. 内部测算备忘，不建议原样进 deck。对上只讲三句话：日常活快 2–3 倍；每人每年省回约 1.5 个月；$30/月成本，每天省 7 分钟就打平。细节留备查。 Internal working memo — not deck copy. The leadership version is three lines: daily work runs 2–3× faster; each engineer saves ~1.5 months a year; at $30/month, seven minutes saved per day breaks even. Details stay on file. 2–3× 日常活提速 faster daily 查找/纪要可达 5–10× search/recaps 5–10× ~1.5 月 mo 每人每年省回 saved / person / yr ≈ 45 个工作日 ≈ 45 workdays $30 每人每月成本 per person / mo 省 7 分钟/天即打平 breaks even at 7 min/day 13× 性价比口径 value ratio 7 分钟成本换 90 分钟 7 min in, 90 min back 花 7 分钟的钱，买回 90 分钟，约 13 倍。 这是整份测算最该记住的一句。 Spend seven minutes of cost, get back ninety — about 13×. The one line worth remembering. 工作流 Workflow 原来 Before 现在 After 提速 Speed-up 节省 Saved 信息查找 Information lookup 翻库/问人 ~20 分 ~20 min Copilot 检索 ~5 分 ~5 min 3–4× ~1h / day 邮件 Email 读/分类/起草 ~10 分 ~10 min 摘要+起草 ~3 分 ~3 min 2–3× ~0.5h / day 会议纪要 Meeting recaps 看回放整理 ~30 分 ~30 min recap+摘要 ~4 分 ~4 min 5–10× 计入会议 in meetings 周报 / 状态同步 Weekly status 手记+人工汇总 manual 读 recap 增量更新 auto-updated 3–4× 1–2h / week 文档 / PPT / 杂务 Docs / slides / chores 从零写、手动排程 from scratch AI 起草、语音指令 AI draft + voice ~2× 零散 scattered 10 人试点 10-person pilot 成本 ~$5.6K/年；每人日省 1.5h，年收益 ~$189K，回本不到半个月。 ROI > 30× 。 ~$5.6K/yr cost; 1.5h/day saved → ~$189K/yr value; payback under two weeks. ROI > 30× . 安全垫 Safety margin 即使砍到三分之一（日省 30 分），10 人年收益仍 ~$63K，对 $5.6K 投入仍约 11× 。 Even at one-third (30 min/day), 10-person value is still ~$63K vs. $5.6K — about 11× . 外部基线 External baseline Forrester TEI：三年 ROI 116%、10 个月回本；Teams+Copilot 122–408%。我们的数字落在或低于这些区间，保守可辩护。 Forrester TEI: 116% three-year ROI, 10-month payback; Teams+Copilot 122–408%. Our figures sit in or below these — conservative, defensible. 短期 0–6 月 Short · 0–6 mo 主要成本：Copilot license + 推广培训。纯增量、回本最快，关键是让人真的用起来。 Mainly Copilot licenses + enablement. Pure upside, fastest payback — the real challenge is getting people to use it. 中期 6–18 月 Mid · 6–18 mo 主要成本：知识库维护人力 + Copilot Studio（$200/月起/租户，非按人头）。大头是人的时间，不是软件。 Mainly knowledge-base maintenance + Copilot Studio ($200/mo per tenant, not per seat). The big cost is people's time, not software. 长期 18 月+ Long · 18 mo+ 主要成本：数据打通、SSOT、集成与治理。这笔钱做不做 AI 都迟早要花，本质是质量投资。 Mainly data integration, SSOT, governance. A bill the org pays regardless of AI — fundamentally a quality investment. 你的直觉成立：模型更强、价格更低 → 今天的账是"下限"。 今天 7 分钟回本，几年后可能 3–4 分钟；今天做不到的，明年同价就能做。所以不该"等降价再上"——早期真正的成本是学习曲线和采用习惯，不是 license。投入买的是组织的 AI 熟练度（会升值），不是软件（会贬值）。但正式汇报一律用今天价格做基线，不写降价预测。 Your instinct holds: stronger models, lower prices → today's numbers are a floor. Seven-minute break-even today may be three or four in a few years; what's impossible now becomes possible at the same price next year. So don't "wait for prices to drop" — the real early cost is the learning curve and adoption habit, not the license. The investment buys organizational AI fluency (appreciates), not software (depreciates). But in formal reporting, always baseline on today's price; don't forecast discounts. 口径说明：工作流用时、日省 1.5h、$50/h 均为内部假设，按公司真实数据替换。$30/人/月来自 Forrester TEI 与 Microsoft licensing 企业模型，实际因协议而异。 Assumptions: workflow times, 1.5h/day savings, and $50/hr are internal estimates — replace with real company data. $30/user/month reflects Forrester TEI and Microsoft enterprise licensing; actual pricing varies by agreement.
