records.text: Real AI pilot: results and review flow · Domic Home Passport Domic Home Passport Receipt workspace · English / 中文 12 September 2026 · OpenRouter / Gemini Real AI pilot: results and review flow Download this report as a Chinese PDF This report combines several test rounds, including re-reading the same originals and retaking selected summary, confirmation, incomplete-document and replacement-warning dialogs to avoid screenshot stitching defects. It is not a single uninterrupted screen recording. Captions record the observed outcomes and retakes; the incomplete slip also showed document-type variation between Unknown and Other. Default: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite The cloud service now reads images and PDFs. Model output is a draft: inspect the original, edit details, and explicitly confirm before saving. A separate pilot access code is required. Records and attachments still stay in this browser. Shared customer accounts and a shared property database are not implemented. What the comparison actually tested The same three fictional originals—clear plumbing PDF, roofing estimate image and gardener receipt image—were sent once to each model using the same revised prompt. Times include the complete direct API request and response. These are small-sample observations, not guaranteed accuracy or response times. Model Samples Mean time Mean cost / document 10k equivalent* Gemini 2.5-flash-lite 3 4.30 s $0.000773 $7.73 Gemini 3.1-flash-lite 3 3.35 s $0.002132 $21.32 Gemini 3.5-flash-lite 3 3.07 s $0.003286 $32.86 *Illustrative extrapolation from these three files, in USD; it excludes retries, payment fees, storage and hosting. Page count and output length change cost. 3.1 preserved the critical fields in the clear PDF and gardener receipt. With the cheaper 2.5, evidence validation removed the clear PDF issue date, while the gardener service date was already missing from the raw model output. 3.5 also missed the gardener service date and added a heading to an estimate company name. 3.8 read the same simulated phone photo successfully, but its one-call cost ($0.006761) was about 2.8 times the 3.1 call ($0.002432), with similar observed time. Findings and limits Fixed an actual Gemini 400 error: the provider receives a compatible structural schema; the service still validates the full bounds after generation. Quotes no longer establish an actual worker, completed service date or payment. Quote totals stay explicitly attached to an estimate. Early API tests of unreadable blur and landscape controls generated no maintenance details. The restaurant receipt was classified as unrelated in both the revised API run and the deployed cloud run. These API observations are separate from the browser checks documented below. One incomplete electrical slip still shortened the company name to SOUTHMERE SPARK. Users can correct it; this is a remaining model limitation. The minimal schema separates total and payment status; VAT, paid deposit and outstanding balance do not yet have dedicated structured fields. 85 frontend and 12 service automated checks passed. Live API calls and the browser screenshots below are separate evidence. An actual extracted draft This comes from the deployed cloud API reading uk-01.pdf. It is not a prefilled demo. The downloadable API draft is captured before the application adds uploader, property IDs and attachment metadata, so those fields are still null. The application supplies those associations when preparing the record for user confirmation. Service date 2026-09-10 Service company BRAMBLEFORD PLUMBING TEST LTD Actual worker Toby Wren Work address 22 Fictional Orchard Close, Exampleford, ZZ1 2BB Work summary Replace leaking kitchen mixer tap cartridge Document / issue date invoice / 2026-09-10 Total / currency 264 GBP Payment / completion paid / completed Download the structured JSON draft · Stored-record schema Confirmed browser export and verification The confirmed export below contains two records actually exported from this browser after explicit confirmation. Both passed validation against the stored-record schema using JSON Schema Draft 2020-12. The downloaded original attachments also matched the corresponding fixture files by SHA-256. These checks cover the confirmed local records and their originals, separately from the API draft above. Download the two confirmed browser records · Read the automated verification log · Cloud source access information · private sharing Automated application checks use mocked AI transport; their passing results do not replace live model calls or browser interaction checks. The log states its scope. Actual English website: step by step 01 · Enable the cloud reader The website reports AI service available. A separate pilot code enables this tab. The OpenRouter API key is kept on the server. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 02 · Upload the real PDF uk-01.pdf was selected through the file chooser. While the cloud reader works, the page states that nothing is saved yet and offers Cancel. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 03 · Inspect the extracted summary The modal names the actual model, uploader and property and displays extracted facts. The full scrollable summary includes company, Toby Wren, date, address, GBP 264 and paid status. In the first round this was an unsaved draft. This screenshot was retaken while re-reading the same original after two records already existed, to avoid full-page stitching defects. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 04 · Inspect the company and actual worker This is another viewport of the same scrollable AI summary. The company is kept separately from worker Toby Wren and the work address. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 05 · Edit before confirming The original-document access and preview area appear beside the editable fields. The embedded PDF preview is blank in this screenshot; the original PDF can be opened for inspection. We deliberately appended a review note to the work summary to verify that user edits are saved. This was a test edit, not an AI correction. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 06 · Explicit final confirmation The final modal contains the edited summary. Confirm and save is disabled until the review checkbox is checked; Back to edit remains available. This screenshot was retaken during the later update pass. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 07 · The unchecked confirmation gate At the bottom of the same confirmation dialog, the review checkbox is unchecked and Confirm and save is disabled. Back to edit is available. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 08 · Save one confirmed record After checking the box and confirming, the history shows one confirmed invoice with the edited summary, GBP 264, paid status and an original-document action. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 09 · Reload and check persistence After reloading, the confirmed record and edited summary are still present. This verifies storage in this browser; it does not establish cross-device cloud storage. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 10 · Keep readable parts; leave unknowns The incomplete electrical slip shows Some details need your help. Date, worker and amount remain unknown. The model shortened the company name to SOUTHMERE SPARK. The screenshot was retaken on re-reading the same slip; document type varied between Unknown and Other across the two calls. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 11 · Missing amount remains unknown The incomplete slip has readable work information, but no supported amount, payment status or dates. The window leaves these facts unknown. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 12 · Correct an actual model omission We corrected both company and display name to SOUTHMERE SPARK TEST SERVICES from the original, then reopened confirmation. Unknown date and amount remained unknown. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 13 · Save a reviewed incomplete record After explicit confirmation, the second property record is saved with its corrected company name and unknown amount. Unknown is not converted to zero or a guessed date. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 14 · Unreadable image recovery The uploaded severely blurred image produced No usable receipt text found. The page offers a replacement file, retry or manual entry. No receipt form was auto-filled and the saved-record count stayed at two. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 15 · Manual entry is an explicit choice Choosing Enter details manually opens blank fields. Property and work summary are required; the page states that missing values remain unknown. We did not save this empty form. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 16 · Protect unsaved work Change document asks whether to replace unsaved work. Keep editing returns to the form; Replace document clears only the current unsaved document. Existing saved property records remain. This dialog was retaken during a later restaurant-receipt round to demonstrate the same unsaved-work protection. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 17 · An unrelated landscape photo The landscape photo also produced No usable receipt text found, without a fabricated service, company or amount. It used the generic no-readable-receipt message, rather than the unrelated-service message. Detail view; the full original screenshot is preserved. Download the full original 18 · Reject an unrelated service receipt A readable restaurant receipt produces This appears to be an unrelated service and states Nothing was saved. It does not establish a home-maintenance event. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 19 · Re-reading does not overwrite saved edits The electrical original was re-read and again proposed the shortened company name. Before confirming that proposal, history still retained SOUTHMERE SPARK TEST SERVICES. The record count remained two. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 20 · Update the same saved record The plumbing summary was changed again after re-reading and explicitly confirmed. History displays the new summary, the same property and GBP 264, with two total records rather than a duplicate third record. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 21 · Management sees confirmed local records The management console lists two real confirmed test records from this browser, with uploader Alice Morgan, company, worker, total and attachment status. This is not an all-customer cloud dashboard. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original 22 · Follow the record into its property history Selecting 22 Fictional Orchard Close shows its plumbing record, actual worker, corrected summary, GBP 264 and Original attached. The unrelated photos were not added. Full viewport screenshot. Download the full original Download recorded model results · Download fictional receipt fixtures · Earlier OCR/manual interaction guide The JSON retains earlier tests and failed requests as well as current results. Its batch field distinguishes early_api (initial tests), parameter_diagnostic (setup checks), revised_prompt (final-*), revised_prompt_comparison (compare-*) and deployed_cloud (cloud-final-*). The comparison table uses only the revised clear-PDF, estimate and roles runs. Browser verification is documented separately in the step-by-step screenshots. All document identities, addresses and amounts used in these experiments are fictional. Supporting quotes are model-supplied and are not independent verification. No API key or pilot access code is included in this report.

records.text: Domic Home Passport · Cloud workspace handoff D Domic HOME PASSPORT EN 中文 Cloud workspace · Implementation handoff · 12 September 2026 A permanent home record. Access you can control. Each home keeps one permanent ID. Originals, reviewed maintenance records and revision history stay in the cloud, with separate access for owners, contributors, buyers and the administrator. Open cloud management ↗ View the schema 1.2 contract Source access · private sharing Verification status 47 automated checks passed. Six live cloud API cases have now been verified. Browser visual acceptance remains pending. No new browser screenshots are included. The browser-control connection timed out, so a fresh visual acceptance run has not been completed. Access Records & storage Fixed fields AI settings Verification Next phase One home, clearly separated permissions The property UUID and passport ID stay unchanged when its name, address or owner label is corrected. Access is tied to that home. A contributor or buyer link cannot be used to open a different property. Role Visible records Allowed actions Cloud originals Administrator All properties and records Create homes, manage access, review records and configure AI. Only admin can issue or revoke owner access. View and download Owner Records for the linked home Upload, edit, confirm, export and review revisions. Issue or revoke buyer and contributor links for this home. This home only Contributor Only their own uploads and associated records Upload and review, edit or confirm their own records. No access management or full-property export. No cloud-original access Buyer Confirmed history for the linked home, through a restricted field view Read only. No editing, originals, private notes, access list, revision history or full-record export. Not available There is no Domic account login or registration in this release. A private property link carries that link’s permissions; the separate admin management code unlocks administration. Display names and owner labels are not verified identities or proof of ownership. Treat each access link as a secret. Revocation blocks subsequent access, but cannot recall material someone has already viewed or copied. An original first. A reviewed record next. R2 Private original documents Uploaded images and PDFs are retained in private cloud object storage. The backend checks file type and size, calculates the SHA256 hash and links the file to its property. There is no anonymous original-file URL. D1 Records, permissions and revisions Property IDs, structured records, access grants, versions, usage and audit events live in the cloud database. Browser storage is not the source of truth for the product’s records. Open the correct property Use the private link issued for the home. The server determines your role and property scope. Upload and retain the original Choose a supported image or PDF. The original is stored before extraction. A repeated upload to the same home is detected. Read with AI, or enter details manually AI returns a proposal. An unreadable, unrelated or failed response leaves the original available to the owner/admin, with retry or manual review available. Edit, then explicitly confirm Save an unfinished draft or check the confirmation box to save a confirmed version. “Confirmed” means a person reviewed this version; it is not an authenticity certificate or admin approval. If two people edit the same version, the second save receives a version conflict. Reload the latest record and reconcile the changes; the service does not silently overwrite the other person’s work. Re-running AI also does not overwrite an already confirmed record. A fixed, editable record contract Full saved records follow schema 1.2. People edit the business facts; the server controls property linkage, original metadata, record identity and confirmation history. Buyer views are a restricted projection, not the complete export schema. Field or group Meaning Editing property.id , property.uid Property passport reference and permanent cloud UUID Server-managed property.service_address Where this work took place; separate from the provider’s office User-editable service.summary , service.date What was done and the actual service date User-editable service.category , service.change_type Home system and kind of work, such as plumbing and repair Fixed choices; user-editable service.location , service.completion_status Room or area; completed, planned or unknown User-editable provider.name , provider.organization_name , provider.person_name Display name, service company and actual attending worker, kept separate User-editable provider.phone , provider.address Provider contact details and business address User-editable amount.total , amount.currency , amount.payment_status Document total, explicit currency and supported payment state User-editable document.type , document.number , document.issue_date Receipt, invoice, estimate or other document; reference and issue date User-editable items[].description , items[].amount Individual line-item descriptions and amounts User-editable details.asset_model , details.asset_serial Equipment model and serial number, when supplied User-editable details.warranty , details.permit_number , notes Warranty, permit and private record notes User-editable source Original filename, MIME type, SHA256 and processing mode From the stored original extraction , evidence Extraction metadata and supporting source quotations Preserved separately from human edits review Draft/confirmed state, missing fields, warnings and edited field paths Derived from validation and confirmation schema_version , id , created_at , updated_at , confirmed_at , account Version, identifiers and timestamps. Account remains null until real account integration; the acting access grant is recorded in the server audit. Server-managed Unknown stays unknown. Blank factual values are stored as null; categorical fields use unknown. Zero remains a valid amount. An unknown service date is not replaced by the invoice or upload date. An estimate does not establish actual payment or completed work. Keep estimates labelled, preserve their uncertainty, and do not combine different currencies into one spending total. The linked JSON Schema is the complete machine-readable contract → AI settings: save, test, activate Only the administrator can change provider settings. A saved draft does not replace the active configuration. API keys stay on the server; the dashboard shows only a masked hint. Save a configuration draft Choose the provider, supported endpoint and model. Supply a new key when changing provider or endpoint; the existing key is never silently forwarded to a different host. Test this exact draft Run the fixed synthetic receipt PNG through the extraction flow and check the expected GBP 264 result. A real provider test may incur a small charge. This checks the configuration, not accuracy on every receipt. Activate only after a successful test Activation applies to the same tested draft. A new draft needs its own test. Failed requests do not trigger automatic provider or model failover. 6 MiB Maximum file size: 6,291,456 bytes. JPG, PNG, WebP and PDF are accepted; model PDF support is checked separately. 100 attempts / day Default service-wide limit per UTC day. Pending and failed provider attempts, including configuration tests, count toward the limit. Deployment settings may change it. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Default model through OpenRouter. The administrator may select another tested configuration; this is not a fixed price or accuracy guarantee. Native PDF support is limited to the previously verified OpenRouter default-model path. A successful PNG test does not prove PDF support for an arbitrary new model. Generic OpenAI-compatible configurations are image-only until specifically verified. What has been checked, and what remains Automated checks PASS Property isolation, role restrictions, private originals, hashes, revocation, schema 1.2, confirmation versions, conflicts, configuration secrets, duplicate calls and daily limits are covered by automated checks. Live cloud API 6 CASES VERIFIED Real HTTP requests exercised the deployed service, cloud originals, AI extraction, record versions and access restrictions. These are API acceptance results, not browser screenshots. New screenshots NOT PRODUCED The browser-control connection timed out. This handoff does not claim a new screenshot review or a completed visual acceptance run. Six live acceptance cases The run used two fictional QA homes, referred to here as Home A and Home B. Every downloaded original matched its SHA256 hash. Outcomes below are the actual results of this run, not assumptions based on filenames. Input Actual outcome Reviewed result / persistence Original hash Clear receipt PNG review · GBP 264 Company name corrected manually; confirmed as v1. A later location edit created v2, with v1 retained. A stale version was rejected with HTTP 409. Matched Receipt PDF review · GBP 185 Returned a reviewable proposal. Original retained; no additional confirmed record was saved. Matched Severely blurred image unreadable Classified as unreadable. Original retained; no automatic record was created. Matched Restaurant receipt unrelated Classified as unrelated to home maintenance. Original retained; no automatic record was created. Matched Photographed receipt sample 08 review · AED 420 This run read the expected information, including AED 420. The actual outcome was review, not partial. Original retained; proposal only. Matched Incomplete electrical record · uk03 partial Service date and total remained null. Saved as a draft, preserving the missing information. Matched Final cloud state: 6 originals, 1 confirmed record with 2 versions, and 1 draft. Cross-property access returned HTTP 403. The buyer saw confirmed history only; original access and full-record export returned 403. Revoking the buyer link immediately made subsequent access return 403. Read live acceptance results · JSON Source access · private sharing View project on GitHub ↗ Remaining visual acceptance: complete the owner/contributor/buyer browser journeys and a fresh screenshot review after the browser-control connection is restored. The completed HTTP checks do not imply that this visual review has already happened. The next integration phase Domic SSO and permission bridge. Bind trusted Domic user IDs to property memberships while preserving permanent property IDs and historical attribution. Ownership verification and handover. Define how control of a property is verified and transferred. A display label or shared link alone does not establish ownership. Retention and deletion policy. Agree how long originals, revisions and audit records are retained, who may request removal, and how deletion is completed across storage. Backups and operations. Establish backup and restore tests, monitoring, quota reviews, access recovery, secret rotation and an operational owner. Domic Home Passport Implementation handoff · 12 September 2026 · Live API verified; visual acceptance pending

records.text: Amy Project R2 | MindSpark Box Lab S Sky Portal ☰ 中文 EN 原版页面 Original Page 打印 / PDF Print / PDF 素材池导航 摘要 00 执行摘要 01 为什么做 02 三盒系统 03 学习路线 04 导师地图 05 反馈系统 06 安全合作 07 90 天路线图 08 打样计划 09 对外讲法 10 来源与下一步 Source Navigation Summary 00 Executive Summary 01 Why This 02 Three Boxes 03 Learning Path 04 Mentor Map 05 Feedback System 06 Safety Partners 07 90-Day Roadmap 08 Prototype Plan 09 Public Narrative 10 Sources & Next R2 草稿 · 双语报告页 Amy Project 行为激活 设计实验 把逻辑、心理学和高质感触觉艺术，组织成一个学生主导的支持性活动礼盒项目：先做三个原型，再用安全、匿名、低风险的反馈验证它是否真的让孩子更容易开始行动、表达和连接。 版本：R2 展示稿 定位：非临床支持性活动设计 更新时间：2026-06-08 核心判断 1 先做小：一个孩子愿意打开、愿意完成的一盒。 2 再做准：用匿名反馈判断哪个活动、哪个环境更有效。 3 最后做大：学校、医院 donation 或 nonprofit 都要建立在安全试点之后。 4 底线清楚：不是治疗，不收敏感医疗数据，不绕过家长和专业人员。 R2 draft · bilingual report page Amy Project Behavioral Activation Design A student-led supportive activity-kit project that combines logic, psychology, and high-quality tactile art. The first goal is to build three prototypes, then use safe, anonymous, low-risk feedback to see whether the boxes help teens start small actions, express themselves, and connect. Version: R2 presentation draft Positioning: non-clinical supportive design Updated: 2026-06-08 Core thesis 1 Start small: one box a teen actually wants to open and finish. 2 Then get precise: use anonymous feedback to learn which activity and setting work best. 3 Then scale: school, hospital donation, or nonprofit paths should follow a safe pilot. 4 Keep the boundary: not therapy, no sensitive medical data, no bypassing parents or professionals. 00 摘要 01 为什么 02 三盒 03 学习 04 导师 05 反馈 06 合作 07 路线 08 打样 09 讲法 10 来源 00 执行摘要 先把低落里的“第一步”设计出来。 Amy Project R2 不是把旧页重写成商业计划，而是把想法升级成一个可展示、可试点、可被家长和导师理解的项目框架。核心产品是三款活动礼盒；核心研究问题是不同活动和社交环境怎样影响青少年的开始行动、表达和连接。 3 Boxes 独立完成、亲子协作、社区拼接，分别测试三种支持环境。 学习线 心理学、逻辑、行为改变、设计和反馈问卷。 产品线 从手作原型到高质感礼盒，再到小规模 pilot。 合作线 先家庭和学校，再考虑医院 donation 和 nonprofit。 Logic 结构清楚 把手作步骤做成低错误率算法，让孩子不用猜下一步。 Psychology 门槛很低 把行为激活变成一个 5-20 分钟能完成的小行动。 Art 表达安全 用颜色、触感、形状和故事表达，而不是强迫讲话。 一句话：先做一个孩子真的愿意打开的盒子，再用安全反馈判断它是否值得扩大。 01 为什么做 很多孩子不是不想变好，是第一步太重。 低落状态里的困难常常不是“不懂道理”，而是缺少足够小、足够安全、足够可完成的行动入口。Amy 的优势是从孩子视角理解这种入口应该长什么样。 痛点 1 传统材料太像作业 很多心理健康 worksheet 对孩子来说像任务和审查，打开之前已经有压力。 痛点 2 表达不总能靠语言 孩子可能愿意做、愿意画、愿意拼，但不一定愿意马上解释自己的感受。 行为激活 先做小行动，让行动带回一点能量和完成感。 触觉艺术 用丝带、木质、磁吸、纸艺等材料降低进入门槛。 逻辑结构 每一步清楚、可验证、可完成，减少焦虑和放弃。 项目的价值不是宣称“治好抑郁”，而是设计一个更容易开始、更容易完成、更容易被理解的支持性活动入口。 02 三盒系统 同一个目标，三种社交环境。 三款礼盒不是随机产品，而是三个变量：一个人做、两个人做、很多人各自完成后拼接。这样才能看出“环境”本身对开始行动和情绪支持的影响。 01 独立掌控礼盒 真丝丝带玫瑰、植物花艺、低压力折叠。目标：安全感、掌控感、完成感。 02 家庭之桥礼盒 磁吸结构、几何拼图、双人协作和低压力对话卡。目标：共同专注和自然连接。 03 协作网格礼盒 每个人独立完成一个模块，再加入集体墙。目标：低压力归属感和社区连接。 20 x 20 x 20 规则 R2 设计约束 20 分钟 一个阶段可以在 20 分钟内完成，不拖成大工程。 20 个零件 核心零件尽量少，避免打开后就被复杂度压倒。 20 秒第一步 第一步必须一眼看懂，先开始，再慢慢深入。 规则不是为了限制创意，而是为了让低能量状态下的孩子也有机会开始。 03 学习路线 课程不是装饰，是每张活动卡背后的设计依据。 R2 把夏天学习拆成四条线：心理学大图谱、逻辑结构、行为改变、设计反馈。每周至少把一个概念转化成一张 activity card。 Week 1 心理学入门 Yale Intro Psychology，建立行为、记忆、情绪和社交的基础词汇。 Week 2 逻辑推理 Duke Think Again 和 Brilliant Logic，把说明书写成清楚步骤。 Week 3 行为改变 Wesleyan Behavioral Change，学习 action loop、动机和 behavioral activation。 Week 4 认知偏差 Blind spots、attention bias、attribution bias，做 assumption check 卡片。 Ongoing 设计迭代 每学一个概念，转化成一个盒子任务、说明页或问卷问题。 报名判断：Yale Science of Well-Being Yale Online 页面 显示这门课可通过 Coursera 免费学习、YouTube 看视频或付费拿 Coursera certificate。Amy 如果已满 13 岁，可以在家长同意和监督下按 Coursera 规则学习；如果未满 13 岁，不应自己注册 Coursera，可以先用家长账号/YouTube 方式学习。 报名判断：Harvard PSYC S-1609 Harvard DCE course page 显示这是 4-credit Harvard Summer School 课程。Harvard Secondary School Program 2026 要求学生至少 16 岁并将在 2026、2027 或 2028 年高中毕业后入大学。Amy 现在升 8 年级，年纪/年级不够，不能现在报名；可把它作为 Wyzant tutor syllabus target。 学习目标不是拿一堆证书，而是让每个盒子的每一步都有理由。 04 导师地图 Wyzant 导师要找三类，不是一类。 R2 里的导师不是“替 Amy 做项目”，而是把高级概念拆成适合 8 年级理解、可以转化成设计的课程。 1 心理学 / 神经科学导师 教 neuroplasticity、学习科学、青少年社交连接和情绪支持。 边界：教育辅导，不做诊断或治疗。 2 逻辑 / 系统导师 把手工步骤转成 deductive logic、checklist 和 error-proof algorithm。 输出：清楚说明书和结构化任务卡。 3 统计 / 行为经济导师 教 present bias、choice architecture 和匿名 QR 反馈问卷设计。 只收产品反馈，不收临床数据。 给导师的标准说明：这是 student-led supportive activity-kit design，不是 therapy practice，也不是 medical study。 05 反馈系统 测设计体验，不测医疗结果。 R2 把“问卷调查系统”改成安全的产品反馈系统。它帮助判断盒子有没有被打开、说明是否清楚、完成后孩子是否更愿意继续，而不是判断病情。 问题 可问 不要问 用途 开始门槛 第一步是否容易看懂？ 你是否有抑郁诊断？ 改说明书 即时感受 完成后是否更平静 / 更清楚？ 病情有没有改善？ 改任务难度 环境匹配 更喜欢独自、双人还是集体？ 家庭冲突细节是什么？ 选择下一盒 继续意愿 愿不愿意做第二张卡？ 治疗效果几分？ 判断产品吸引力 1-2 min 问卷必须极短。 匿名 不收姓名、诊断、病史。 可选 孩子可以不填。 家长 / 学校 未成年人反馈需要批准。 06 安全合作 先让可信成年人看懂，再让项目走出去。 R2 的合作顺序是：家庭小试点、学校 counselor / teacher review、合规 donation、再考虑 nonprofit。不要一开始直接进入医院互动或公开 Amy 的个人经历。 学校路线 先让 counselor 或 trusted teacher 看项目定位。 可做 advisory activity、student showcase 或 wellness club。 优点是反馈快、风险低、可以保护隐私。 医院路线 先找 Child Life / donation office，不直接联系病人。 只送全新、可清洁、符合 wish list 的材料。 任何现场活动都需要医院 staff 审核。 隐私 不公开个人经历，除非 Amy 明确愿意且知道后果。 安全 材料无尖锐、无污染、无医疗承诺。 边界 不治疗、不诊断、不做临床研究。 07 90 天路线图 三天能开始，三个月要有可展示 pilot。 R2 把项目拆成可以执行的节奏：先整理、再打样、再试用、再总结。每一阶段都有交付物。 0-3 天 目标 确定 R2 页面、三盒定义、第一批课程和导师搜索词。 交付 项目页、Wyzant 消息、材料清单 v1。 1-2 周 目标 做出每盒一个纸面 / 材料 prototype。 交付 3 个 box mockup，3 张 activity card，1 份反馈表。 3-6 周 目标 让 3-5 个可信试用者体验，记录匿名产品反馈。 交付 问题清单、改版方向、照片记录和版本日志。 7-12 周 目标 做 10-20 个 sample boxes，准备 school / mentor review。 交付 展示页、1 页 summary、下一步合作邮件。 08 打样计划 先做高质感小批量，不急着做公司。 在中国打样的优势是材料和手工供应链丰富，但第一批不要追求复杂包装。最重要的是安全、清楚、可重复和可反馈。 10-20 第一批 sample boxes。数量够看出问题，又不会把预算压到太重。 材料 丝带、纸艺、磁吸木件、无尖锐工具、独立包装。 说明 一张 start card、一张 step card、一张 reflection card。 质量 每盒检查缺件、尖锐边缘、说明是否能独立看懂。 Box 01 低成本优先 纸艺和丝带适合快速测试说明清晰度。 Box 02 结构风险最高 磁吸和双人协作要重点测试安全与耐用。 Box 03 展示效果最好 模块墙适合学校展示和社区 pilot。 09 对外讲法 讲成一个清楚的学生项目，不讲成医疗承诺。 R2 的对外叙事要成熟，但不能夸大。最好的说法是：Amy 用自己的兴趣和学习，设计一套支持青少年情绪健康的活动礼盒，并用安全反馈改进。 30 秒 pitch 中文 Amy Project 是一个学生主导的支持性活动礼盒项目，把逻辑、心理学和高质感手作结合起来，帮助青少年从一个很小、很具体、可完成的行动开始。它不是治疗，也不收集医疗数据；第一阶段只做产品体验和安全反馈。 不要这样说 风险表达 不要 治疗青少年抑郁症。 不要 临床试验、医疗研究、疗效证明。 不要 让孩子提供诊断、病史或私人危机细节。 10 来源与下一步 资料够用，下一步是做出来。 R2 不是把所有资料都堆进来，而是保留行动需要的来源：课程、心理健康边界、行为激活、医院 donation、非营利要求。 Yale Online · The Science of Well-Being Yale 公开课入口，页面列出 Coursera 免费学习、YouTube 视频和可选付费证书。 Coursera · Terms of Use Coursera 使用条款说明 13 岁以下不能使用服务；Amy 未满 13 岁时应走家长监督 / YouTube 路线。 Coursera · Introduction to Psychology Paul Bloom 的心理学入门课，覆盖 perception、memory、decision-making、social behavior 等。 Duke / Coursera · Think Again Duke logic and critical-thinking sequence，适合练 informal logic 和 argument analysis。 Brilliant · Logic 交互式逻辑练习，可作为 daily puzzle habit，不等同大学证书。 Brilliant · Computer Science Brilliant 的 CS pathway 覆盖 algorithms、data structures 和 logic-oriented problem solving。 Open Yale Courses · PSYC 110 免费 lecture 版本，适合先试听，看 Amy 是否喜欢这个老师和课程节奏。 Coursera · Overcoming Cognitive Bias Madecraft 课程，适合快速学习常见 cognitive biases 和 everyday decision tools。 Yale / Coursera · Everyday Parenting Alan Kazdin 的行为改变工具课，可借鉴 reinforcement、phrasing 和 step design。 Harvard Online · Psychology of Blind Spots Mahzarin Banaji 课程，聚焦 hidden bias 和 intuitive decision-making。 Wesleyan / Coursera · Creating Behavioral Change 覆盖 motivational interviewing、behavioral activation 和 SMART goals；页面提示不能替代临床训练。 Harvard DCE · PSYC S-1609 Neuroscience of Learning course page；这是 4-credit Harvard Summer School 课程，现在适合作为 Wyzant syllabus target，不是 8 年级可直接报名的课。 Harvard DCE · PHIL S-12 Deductive Logic course page；可借鉴 argument structure、symbolic logic 和 formal deduction。 Harvard DCE · ECON S-1915 Neuroscience and Economic Decision-Making course page；2026 listing shows on-campus format and prerequisites. Harvard SSP · Eligibility Harvard Secondary School Program 2026 要求 2026/2027/2028 进入大学且 2026-06-20 前满 16 岁；Amy 现在升 8 年级，不符合。 Harvard EdCast · Crisis of Connection 关于 adolescent social connection 的 research discussion / interview，不是课程报名页面。 Wyzant · Find a Tutor Wyzant 搜索 / 请求导师说明；未成年人默认应由家长参与。 NIMH · Depression 严肃理解 depression 的基础资料，提醒项目不要替代专业治疗。 Kids Mental Health Foundation · Behavioral Activation 支持“小而有价值的活动”这个方向，但具体内容仍需专业审核。 OHSU Doernbecher · Wish List Portland 本地儿童医院 donation guideline：通常要求全新、未使用物品。 Oregon DOJ · Starting a Charity 如果未来走 charity / nonprofit 路线，这里是 Oregon charitable registration 的官方入口。 IRS · Responsible Parties and EIN EIN 需要 responsible party；涉及未成年人时不要自己乱填，先让父母或专业人士确认。 下一步：三盒 prototype、三张 activity card、一个匿名反馈表、一个 Wyzant 导师 shortlist。 00 Summary 01 Why 02 Boxes 03 Learning 04 Mentors 05 Feedback 06 Partners 07 Roadmap 08 Prototype 09 Narrative 10 Sources 00 Executive summary Design the first step out of feeling stuck. Amy Project R2 does not turn the original page into a business plan. It upgrades the idea into a report-style project framework that parents, mentors, and school partners can understand. The product is three activity boxes; the research-safe question is how activity type and social setting affect teens' willingness to start, express, and connect. 3 Boxes Solo, parent/teen, and community-grid settings test three different support environments. Learning track Psychology, logic, behavior change, design, and feedback surveys. Product track From craft prototypes to premium boxes and small-scale pilots. Partnership track Start with family and school, then consider hospital donation and nonprofit routes. Logic Clear structure Craft steps become low-error algorithms so teens do not have to guess the next step. Psychology Low barrier Behavioral activation becomes a small action that can be finished in 5-20 minutes. Art Safe expression Color, texture, shape, and story allow expression without forcing speech. One line: build a box teens actually want to open, then use safe feedback to decide whether it deserves to scale. 01 Why this Many teens do not lack insight. The first step is just too heavy. When someone feels low, the problem is often not a lack of advice. It is the absence of a small, safe, finishable entry point. Amy's advantage is understanding what that entry point might feel like from a kid's perspective. Pain point 1 Materials can feel like homework Many mental-health worksheets feel like assignments or evaluation before a teen even starts. Pain point 2 Expression is not always verbal A teen may be willing to make, draw, or assemble before being ready to explain feelings. Behavioral activation Start with a small action so action can bring back some energy and completion. Tactile art Use ribbon, wood, magnets, paper craft, and texture to lower the barrier. Logical structure Every step should be clear, verifiable, and finishable to reduce anxiety and quitting. The value is not claiming to cure depression. The value is designing a more startable, finishable, understandable support activity. 02 Three-box system One goal, three social settings. The boxes are not random products. They test three variables: alone, two-person collaboration, and individual modules joined into a group wall. 01 Solo Mastery Box Silk ribbon roses, botanical craft, and low-pressure folding. Goal: safety, control, completion. 02 Family Bridge Box Magnetic structures, geometric puzzles, two-person collaboration, and low-pressure conversation cards. Goal: shared focus and easier connection. 03 Collaborative Grid Box Each person completes one module, then adds it to a collective wall. Goal: low-pressure belonging and community connection. 20 x 20 x 20 rule R2 design constraint 20 minutes One stage can be completed within 20 minutes. 20 pieces Keep core pieces limited so complexity does not overwhelm the start. 20-second first step The first step must be understandable immediately. The rule does not limit creativity. It makes starting possible when energy is low. 03 Learning path Courses are not decoration. They justify the activity cards. R2 turns the summer into four learning tracks: psychology overview, logical structure, behavior change, and design feedback. Every week, at least one concept should become an activity card. Week 1 Psychology foundation Yale Intro Psychology builds vocabulary for behavior, memory, emotion, and social connection. Week 2 Logic reasoning Duke Think Again and Brilliant Logic help turn instructions into clear steps. Week 3 Behavior change Wesleyan Behavioral Change teaches action loops, motivation, and behavioral activation. Week 4 Cognitive bias Blind spots, attention bias, and attribution bias become assumption-check cards. Ongoing Design iteration Each concept becomes a box task, instruction page, or survey question. Eligibility: Yale Science of Well-Being The Yale Online page lists free Coursera access, YouTube videos, and an optional paid Coursera certificate. If Amy is 13 or older, she can study it with parent consent and supervision under Coursera rules. If she is under 13, she should not create her own Coursera account; use a parent-supervised account or the YouTube route. Eligibility: Harvard PSYC S-1609 The Harvard DCE course page lists this as a 4-credit Harvard Summer School course. Harvard Secondary School Program 2026 eligibility requires students to be at least 16 and entering college in 2026, 2027, or 2028. As a rising 8th grader, Amy is not eligible now; use it as a Wyzant tutor syllabus target or a future high-school option. The goal is not collecting certificates. The goal is giving every box step a reason. 04 Mentor map Use Wyzant for three mentor types, not one. Mentors do not build the project for Amy. They translate advanced ideas into middle-school-friendly lessons and design decisions. 1 Psychology / neuroscience mentor Teach neuroplasticity, learning science, adolescent social connection, and emotional support. Boundary: educational coaching, not diagnosis or treatment. 2 Logic / systems mentor Turn craft steps into deductive logic, checklists, and error-proof algorithms. Output: clear instructions and structured task cards. 3 Statistics / behavioral economics mentor Teach present bias, choice architecture, and anonymous QR feedback design. Collect product feedback only, not clinical data. Standard tutor language: this is student-led supportive activity-kit design, not therapy practice or a medical study. 05 Feedback system Measure design experience, not medical outcomes. R2 reframes the survey as a safe product-feedback system. It helps determine whether the box is opened, whether instructions are clear, and whether the teen is willing to continue. Question Ask Do not ask Use Start barrier Was the first step easy to understand? Do you have a depression diagnosis? Improve instructions Immediate feeling Do you feel calmer or clearer? Did your condition improve? Adjust difficulty Setting fit Do you prefer solo, pair, or group? What are your family conflict details? Choose next box Continuation Would you do a second card? How effective was treatment? Judge product appeal 1-2 min The survey must be very short. Anonymous No names, diagnoses, or medical history. Optional A teen can skip it. Parent / school Minor feedback needs approval. 06 Safety partners Make trusted adults understand it before taking it outside. R2's sequence is family micro-pilot, school counselor / teacher review, compliant donation, then maybe nonprofit. Do not start with direct hospital interaction or public disclosure of Amy's personal experience. School route Ask a counselor or trusted teacher to review positioning. Possible forms: advisory activity, student showcase, wellness club. Fast feedback and lower risk while protecting privacy. Hospital route Start with Child Life / donation office, not patients directly. Donate only new, cleanable, wish-list-compatible materials. Any on-site activity requires hospital staff review. Privacy Do not publicize personal experience unless Amy clearly wants that and understands the consequences. Safety Materials must avoid sharp edges, contamination, and medical promises. Boundary No treatment, diagnosis, or clinical research claims. 07 90-day roadmap Start in three days. Show a pilot in three months. R2 breaks the project into a practical rhythm: organize, prototype, test, summarize. Each phase has a deliverable. 0-3 days Goal Finalize R2 page, three-box definitions, first courses, and tutor search terms. Deliverable Project page, Wyzant message, materials list v1. 1-2 weeks Goal Build one paper / material prototype for each box. Deliverable 3 box mockups, 3 activity cards, 1 feedback form. 3-6 weeks Goal Let 3-5 trusted users try them and record anonymous product feedback. Deliverable Issue list, revision direction, photo record, and version log. 7-12 weeks Goal Make 10-20 sample boxes and prepare for school / mentor review. Deliverable Showcase page, 1-page summary, next-step partner email. 08 Prototype plan Make a high-quality small batch before building an organization. Manufacturing prototypes in China can help with materials and craft supply chains, but the first batch should not overfocus on packaging complexity. Safety, clarity, repeatability, and feedback matter more. 10-20 first sample boxes. Enough to see problems without making budget or logistics too heavy. Materials Ribbon, paper craft, magnetic wood pieces, no sharp tools, individual packaging. Instructions One start card, one step card, one reflection card. Quality Check missing pieces, sharp edges, and whether instructions make sense alone. Box 01 Lowest cost first Paper craft and ribbon are good for quickly testing instruction clarity. Box 02 Highest structure risk Magnetic parts and two-person collaboration need more safety and durability testing. Box 03 Best showcase effect The module wall is strong for school showcase and community pilots. 09 Public narrative Present it as a clear student project, not a medical promise. The R2 narrative should be mature without overclaiming: Amy is using her interests and learning to design supportive activity boxes for teen well-being, then improving them through safe feedback. 30-second pitch English Amy Project is a student-led supportive activity-kit project combining logic, psychology, and high-quality craft. It helps teens begin with a very small, concrete, finishable action. It is not treatment and does not collect medical data; the first stage focuses only on product experience and safe feedback. Do not say this Risk language Do not Treat teen depression. Do not Clinical trial, medical research, proven effect. Do not Ask minors for diagnosis, medical history, or private crisis details. 10 Sources & next steps The source stack is enough. Now build. R2 keeps only the sources needed for action: courses, mental-health boundaries, behavioral activation, hospital donation, and nonprofit requirements. Yale Online · The Science of Well-Being Yale public-course entry point; the page lists free Coursera access, YouTube videos, and an optional paid certificate. Coursera · Terms of Use Coursera's terms prohibit use by anyone under 13; if Amy is under 13, use a parent-supervised or YouTube route. Coursera · Introduction to Psychology Paul Bloom's psychology introduction covering perception, memory, decision-making, social behavior, and more. Duke / Coursera · Think Again Duke's logic and critical-thinking sequence, useful for informal logic and argument analysis. Brilliant · Logic Interactive logic practice that can become a daily puzzle habit; not the same as a university certificate. Brilliant · Computer Science Brilliant's CS pathway covers algorithms, data structures, and logic-oriented problem solving. Open Yale Courses · PSYC 110 Free lecture version, good for previewing whether Amy likes the teacher and course rhythm. Coursera · Overcoming Cognitive Bias Madecraft course for common cognitive biases and everyday decision tools. Yale / Coursera · Everyday Parenting Alan Kazdin's behavior-change tools course; useful for reinforcement, phrasing, and step design. Harvard Online · Psychology of Blind Spots Mahzarin Banaji's course focused on hidden bias and intuitive decision-making. Wesleyan / Coursera · Creating Behavioral Change Covers motivational interviewing, behavioral activation, and SMART goals; the page notes it does not replace clinical training. Harvard DCE · PSYC S-1609 Neuroscience of Learning course page; this is a 4-credit Harvard Summer School course, so use it now as a Wyzant syllabus target, not direct 8th-grade enrollment. Harvard DCE · PHIL S-12 Deductive Logic course page; useful for argument structure, symbolic logic, and formal deduction. Harvard DCE · ECON S-1915 Neuroscience and Economic Decision-Making course page; the 2026 listing shows on-campus format and prerequisites. Harvard SSP · Eligibility For 2026, SSP requires entering college in 2026/2027/2028 and being at least 16 by June 20, 2026; Amy is not eligible as a rising 8th grader. Harvard EdCast · Crisis of Connection Research discussion / interview source for adolescent social connection, not a course enrollment page. Wyzant · Find a Tutor Wyzant support page for searching/requesting tutors; parent involvement is the right default for a minor. NIMH · Depression Foundational material for understanding depression; it helps keep the project from replacing professional treatment. Kids Mental Health Foundation · Behavioral Activation Supports small, valuable activities as a direction; specific kit content still needs professional review. OHSU Doernbecher · Wish List Portland local children's hospital donation guideline; usually requires new, unused items. Oregon DOJ · Starting a Charity If the future path is charity / nonprofit, this is the official Oregon charitable registration entry point. IRS · Responsible Parties and EIN An EIN requires a responsible party; when minors are involved, confirm with parents or professionals first. Next: three box prototypes, three activity cards, one anonymous feedback form, and one Wyzant mentor shortlist. Amy Project R2 · 参考 AI Strategy R2 模板制作 · noindex 保留 · 非临床支持性活动设计页面。 Amy Project R2 · Built from the AI Strategy R2 template · noindex retained · Non-clinical supportive activity design page.

          已测试图片与 PDF，并在已部署网站完成 PDF 识别。
          仍需人工核对确认，记录保留在当前浏览器；共享账户、房屋数据库和正式系统对接留待下一步。 真实 AI 结果与截图 ↗ 本轮上传与测试 01　找回旧项目 02　本轮做到哪里 03　固定输出格式 04　模型与成本 05　交互闭环 06　系统与接口 07　GitHub 参考 08　下一轮与讨论 09　交接资料 01 / CONTEXT Domic Home Passport：从票据整理到房屋履历 项目统一名称为 Domic Home Passport 。这是原房屋护照项目的票据整理模块。合作方是 Daniel Zhu ；目标是持续积累房屋维修、升级、设备和保修档案，并衔接 ProLynk
              服务文件。 历史节点 找回的内容 这轮的继承方式 2026 年 5 月 数字房产护照；接收 ProLynk 文件、邮件和手动
                      PDF；房屋时间线。 以房屋关联和服务历史为核心，避免做成泛用报销工具。 2026 年 6 月 Gemini 2.5 Flash；模型测试、人工确认、Next.js / Supabase /
                      R2 方案。 模型层可替换，保留独立输出契约和后端接口边界。 旧 Receipt Scanner 上传 → 编辑 → 预览 → 保存；实际只有浏览器 localStorage。 新原型明确写本地保存，同时保留原件；真实数据库下一轮接。 旧测试有 13 份 PDF 最终生成可读结果 ：12
              份直接读取 PDF，1 份因 503 改用文本层。多数是空白模板，仅 3
              份有较完整金额，因此不能用它证明真实票据准确率。新格式移除“未知金额
              = 0”、默认 USD 和缺乏证据的房产增值推断。 依据： ProLynk / Domic 历史 · Daniel 工作台 · 旧模型测试 · 旧原型 。独立 Domic Home Passport 线上界面及 Daniel
              现行生产接口尚未找回。 02 / FIRST ITERATION 这轮是可以操作的原型 现在可以做 留给下一轮 拖入或选择 PDF、JPG、PNG、WebP；手机浏览器拍照入口；单文件
                      云端 AI 最大 6 MB，本地／手工模式最大 15 MB。 HEIC 转换、PDF 页数/加密检测、多单据拆分。 通过试用访问码使用云端 AI 读取图片与 PDF；
                      可选择本地英文文字识别或手工填写；核对摘要、不可读／无关资料恢复，以及独立的公司与施工者字段。 扩大准确率与速度评测、按用户配额，以及生产用量和计费控制。 固定字段、空值提示、草稿、修改、勾选确认、记录列表。 用户登录、多房屋权限、多人共同审核、完整审计。 同浏览器同文件去重；本地保存原件与字段；JSON
                      导出、原件下载、确认删除。 云数据库、私有原件存储、跨设备同步、批量导入。 交互演示与实际文件明确分开： 实际上传的文件不会被偷偷替换成示例结果 。
              选择云端 AI 后，原始图片或 PDF 会发送至识别服务，并整理为固定字段草稿，未知值留空。
              本地文字识别仍支持英文图片，也可手工填写。PDF 页面预览由浏览器提供，与云端识别是独立步骤。 本地原型边界 文件与记录保存在当前浏览器。清理站点数据、无痕模式或存储被逐出可能导致丢失。JSON
              不含二进制原件，应另下载原件。云端识别服务已连接；共享客户账户与 Domic Home Passport
              房屋数据库尚未接入，保存确认仍指本地保存。 原型按一份文件、一张逻辑单据、一个房屋活动整理。混合多张发票请先拆分。
              当前房屋选择器使用测试身份与房屋，也可手工输入房屋名称；生产版还需真实登录与物业访问权限。 UPDATED / RECEIPT INTAKE 核对做了什么、由谁完成 面向 Pro
              工人和房主：服务公司与实际施工人员分别保存，记录维修、更换、安装、改造、保养和检查。缺失姓名保持未知，客户或制单人不会自动当成施工者，同名人或公司不会自动合并。 输入／结果 处理方式 可读房屋服务单据 弹出摘要 → 修改核对 → 确认保存。 缺失或部分可读 保留已读字段，缺项留空，可核对后确认不完整记录。 没有可用票据文字 说明不确定，重拍、更换或手工填写，不编造成功结果。 明确无关服务文字 说明相关性问题并更换文件，不自动加入房屋历史。 相关性不确定 上传人先核实是否属于房屋，再手工核对。 失败／超时／取消 45 秒识别上限，可取消／重试，旧结果不覆盖新单据。 早期本地文字识别实验在浏览器处理了六张合成图片：公司收据、个人工人收据、缺字段、极度模糊、餐馆收据和风景照片。
              后续的 真实 Gemini 图片／PDF 评测与已部署网站截图 已单独记录。
              这些都是有限样本实验；大规模准确率、阿拉伯文理解与实体手机验收仍待验证。 完整交互与身份规则 · 实际测试与修复记录 03 / DATA CONTRACT 房屋、服务公司与施工人员的核心信息 最有价值的记录能回答： 哪套房、什么时候、谁、在哪个部位、做了什么、多少钱、处于什么状态 。其他字段不强迫用户填写。 信息 输出位置 没有时 服务公司／实际施工者 provider.organization_name / person_name 分别保存，没有则 null。 房屋变更类型 service.change_type 维修、更换、安装、改造、保养、检查或未知。 归属房屋 property.id 草稿可空，确认前由用户填写；模型不得编造。 实际服务日期 service.date null；开票日期单独保留。 服务项目摘要 service.summary 确认前用户补充，说明实际或计划工作。 房屋系统 / 部位 service.category / location unknown / null。 服务商显示名称（兼容旧记录） provider.name null。 服务地址 property.service_address null；不能拿商家地址填空。 总金额 + 币种 amount.total / currency null，不默认为零或美元。 单据类型 document.type unknown；区分收据、账单、报价与保修文件。 付款 + 施工状态 amount.payment_status / service.completion_status unknown；付款和完工分开。 设备与保修值得保留，但不必展开 更多信息包括开票日期、单号、服务商电话/地址、费用明细、设备品牌型号与序列号、保修原文、施工许可编号及用户备注。将来可增添服务日期区间、税/折扣、维护周期、退款与材料购入状态。 三条语义规则 服务日期 ≠ 开票日期；服务地址 ≠
              商家地址；已付款 ≠
              已完工。报价可以保存为房屋资料，但不能当成已发生支出或已完成施工。 稳定结构，未知保留 null {

  "property": { "id": "用户确认的房屋", "service_address": null },

} 以上为核心字段节选，不是完整导出。完整记录还包含
              items、details、source、evidence、review
              与应用生成的时间信息。下载 完整 JSON Schema 、 完整缺失字段示例 和 字段与空值规范 。 确认保存只强制房屋归属与工作摘要，其余允许未知并标记“待补全”。首次
              AI

              / 看不清 / 歧义”原因。本轮金额用 JSON
              number，生产写入数据库时转换为定点金额。 04 / MODEL DECISION 当前试用版：Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 已部署试用版通过 OpenRouter 使用 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite ，
              依据是与 2.5、3.5 Flash Lite 的小样本对照。请查看 实际费用、耗时和仍存在的错误 。

              候选均支持相关多模态/结构化输出，但文档能力不等于实际提取准确率。 把“免费功能”与“免费 API”分开考虑 面向真实票据建议使用关联结算账户的付费 API
              条件：不要以免费层额度为长期产品容量或数据处理保证。Google
              免费与付费服务的数据使用条款不同，地区也有例外；正式使用前按服务地区核对。 Google API 条款 。 单页实际等待时间需要测量，不承诺“2 秒识别”。建议测
              p50/p95、人工改动率、关键字段编造率、重试率及每条确认记录总成本。后台历史批量导入可考虑
              Batch；不能拿 Batch 折扣与最长周转时间做在线即时体验的承诺。 Batch API 。 完整模型调研、成本计算与非 Gemini 对照 → 05 / END-TO-END FLOW 成功要以用户确认和实际保存为准 添加文件 → 检查与预览 → 提取草稿 → 核对 / 修改 → 确认保存 → 房屋记录 情况 用户应看到什么 格式不支持 / 文件太大 说明允许格式和限制，保留已有工作；HEIC 提示转换。 缺少访问码／AI 服务不可用 说明访问或服务问题，保留原件，可重试或手工填写；失败请求不会变成“成功但为空”的记录。 未知日期 / 地址 / 金额 空值和待补全提示；可核对后保存不完整记录。 识别慢 / 429 / 503 / 超时 AI 识别显示读取阶段，可取消并提供明确恢复操作；不会自动重试，也不会自动保存空结果。 同一文件再次添加 本地 hash
                      匹配后打开已有记录；跨设备与相似票据去重下一轮实现。 保存失败 不显示成功；保留表单，允许重试或导出草稿。 修改 / 退出 / 删除 未保存修改离开时提醒；修改更新原记录；删除需确认并删除对应原件。 原型含完整收据、缺日期发票、施工前报价三个案例，分别展示“信息齐全”“需要补充”“不能误判已完成”。
              验证涵盖字段规则、原型流程、持久化与失败恢复；真实模型评测和已部署网站 PDF 流程已记录在 AI 实测报告 ，手机相机实机验收仍待完成。 06 / IMPLEMENTATION 把识别、确认和保存分开 未来可以延续旧方案 Next.js + Supabase + 私有 R2 ，也可以接 Daniel
              现有系统。当前为 TimeMemo
              静态子页面，已连接部署的云端识别服务；前端模块已经分开，输出结构不依赖某家模型。
              试用访问码用于限制 AI 请求，不等于客户账号登录。下图是目标生产架构，当前数据保存仍在浏览器内。 网页 / 手机 → 上传与鉴权 → 模型适配器 → 结构校验 → 人工审核 → 数据库 + 原件 生产保留
              properties、documents、activities、activity_documents、extraction_jobs、extractions、review_revisions。原件私有保存、短时授权访问。多个活动关联同一单据时，总金额只放单据一次，不能重复计入每项活动。 建议 API
              按上传、创建识别任务、查询状态、保存草稿、确认、查看历史和删除拆开。确认请求带版本号与幂等键，服务端检查物业权限后事务保存，避免重试重复创建、并发覆盖或“成功但没入库”。 每张票据不需要运行多个自主 Agent；一个多模态提取服务、明确
              schema、确定性校验与人审即可。多 Agent
              本轮用于历史检索、模型研究和代码复核。 完整架构、接口草案、状态表与实施计划 → · 提取提示词草案 → 07 / REFERENCE PROJECTS 借鉴成熟部分，自行实现领域逻辑 资源 借鉴点 采用边界 bookkeeping-skills MIT receipt-processing 技能、固定输出、异常和审核文档。 参考组织方式；商业 Receiptor 服务不等于免费 OCR
                      引擎，房屋字段需要自定义。 invoice2data MIT 已知格式的 PDF / OCR 与模板提取。 未来针对高频固定供应商；首版不建立大量模板。 Docling 主代码 MIT 复杂 PDF、布局、表格与 OCR。 未来预处理备选；各模型许可另核对。 Instructor MIT Python 结构化输出、校验与重试。 若后端用 Python 可引入；TypeScript 可用原生 JSON + schema
                      验证。 receipt-parser 未见许可证 上传 → Gemini → 双栏人审 → 保存，交互最接近。 只参考公开交互说明，本轮没有复制其代码。 本轮原型自行实现，没有把上述仓库作为运行依赖，也没有安装记账技能。采用代码前必须锁定版本、保留对应许可并验证依赖。完整研究保留了核对提交和来源： 参考研究备忘录 。 08 / NEXT ITERATION 下周和伙伴先确定这些事情 系统与接口： 已有后端仓库、物业
                ID、用户鉴权、Daniel 接受的字段格式。 服务范围： 主要面向英国英文客户；软件默认英文，中文用于核对与协作。下一轮优先验证英国服务单据、英镑金额和当地日期格式，当前解析器尚不能处理所有英国格式。币种仍依据原件或用户确认。再确定是否同时收录材料购置、保修、检查与退款。 样本评测： 约 100
                份经授权或合成票据，覆盖照片/PDF/多页/缺失/模糊/报价，人工建立答案；不要只跑空白模板。 模型与额度： 用同一批样本对照 Lite
                模型；根据人工修改率、耗时和总成本定默认模型与免费配额。 真实闭环： 在已部署的识别服务基础上，接入私有文件存储、物业权限和事务保存，再做小范围真实用户试用。 后续再决定手机 App、邮件入口、ProLynk
              自动传入、多人共享、房屋交接报告与维护提醒。这些都能沿用同一文档和活动结构，首轮先把上传到确认做好。 09 / HANDOFF PACK 可分享、可继续开发的资料 测试样本与核对指南 八份可下载原件、实测结果及截图完成情况 交互原型 添加单据 → 核对 → 保存 → 导出 GitHub 项目目录 原型源文件、规范、样本、研究与测试 下载独立源码包 只包含本项目，便于伙伴导入自己的仓库 固定 JSON Schema 本轮唯一导出契约 字段规范 核心字段、空值、枚举与扩展边界 开发交接说明 接口草案、数据对象、异常处理与待讨论项 完整模型研究 官方来源、价格假设与评测方案 历史恢复档案 旧项目定位、样本结果与已知缺口 这个公开 GitHub
              目录可供伙伴查看和下载；共同提交代码需要仓库协作权限。本轮没有邀请任何人或发送消息。
              云端 AI 识别已部署；资料中的共享账户、物业权限和数据库保存仍是待实现与验证的生产方案。 Domic Home Passport 项目记录 · 2026.09.12 返回票据工作台 ↗

records.text: Domic Home Passport · Samples & review guide D Domic HOME PASSPORT Project brief EN 中文 DOMIC HOME PASSPORT / DEMO MATERIALS See the inputs. Understand the decisions. Eight fictional documents for reviewing receipt intake with Daniel. The product defaults to English for UK customers; this guide also has a Chinese version. Download all 8 samples · ZIP Download the Chinese guide · PDF Open English workspace ↗ September 10 update: actual browser screenshots are complete This page preserves the September 9 samples and test results. Mac lock is no longer a current blocker. Open ten new receipts, step-by-step screenshots and management demo → 01 Sample library 02 Review & recovery 03 What was tested 01 / SAMPLE LIBRARY Start with the UK examples Use one file at a time. The first PDF and PNG contain the same fictional details; the simulated phone photo is a separate receipt. The AED examples remain useful for format variety and failure cases. 01 / Input document — not an interface screenshot UK service receipt — clear PDF Primary UK example: a fictional kitchen mixer tap replacement by Cedar Home Services, with technician James Turner, a Bristol service address and a GBP 240 total. Download original · PDF ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: preview the PDF and clearly offer manual entry in the current prototype. Review any manually entered fields before confirmation; save only after the user confirms. Do not describe the PDF as automatically recognised. How this sample was made: Original program-generated fictional PDF. Names, address and prices are invented for software testing; it is not a real customer document. 02 / Input document — not an interface screenshot UK service receipt — clear PNG Image version of the clear UK PDF, suitable for comparing the image-upload path with the PDF path. It contains the same fictional GBP 240 service details. Download original · PNG ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: show readable service details for review, keep the company, technician and customer roles separate, and distinguish service date from issue date. Allow corrections and save only after explicit confirmation. How this sample was made: PNG rendered from the fictional UK PDF. This is a digital test document, not a scan or a phone photograph of a real receipt. 03 / Input document — not an interface screenshot UK receipt — simulated phone photo Primary UK photo example: a fictional GBP 240 receipt on a wooden table, with slight perspective, creases and shadows. This simulates a phone snapshot; it is not an actual phone photograph. Download original · PNG ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: retain whatever details are readable in this image, flag uncertain or missing fields, and let the uploader compare and correct the result before confirming. Do not fill fields from the clean sample automatically. How this sample was made: AI-generated with the built-in image_gen tool, using a fictional receipt reference. The image visibly states FICTIONAL TEST DATA; no real client document was photographed. 04 / Input document — not an interface screenshot Partly blurred simulated phone photo — AED example Supplementary international sample for capture-quality and format diversity: motion blur and glare affect a fictional AED receipt. Some large text remains visible. It is an AI simulation, not a real phone photo. Download original · PNG ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: preserve any usable partial result and mark uncertain fields for review. If too little is readable, offer a clearer upload or manual entry. The blurred appearance does not predict which fields OCR will recover, and no result should be saved automatically. How this sample was made: AI-generated degraded variant of an earlier fictional AED receipt photo simulation. Retained as a supplementary format example; the UK examples remain the main audience reference. 05 / Input document — not an interface screenshot Readable receipt with missing fields A fictional electrical repair receipt with visible company, address and work details, but no service date, total, currency or named worker. This earlier international fixture adds a different incomplete-document format. Download original · PNG ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: retain the readable details, leave absent values blank and show what is missing. Do not invent a date, set the amount to zero, infer currency from the address or treat the customer as the worker. Allow review and explicit confirmation. How this sample was made: Original fictional SVG partial-copy document rendered to PNG. It contains no actual customer information and is not a photograph. 06 / Input document — not an interface screenshot Severely blurred receipt A synthetic receipt image deliberately rendered with severe blur and low contrast to test the recovery path when no reliable details are readable. Download original · PNG ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: explain that no usable receipt details were found and offer a clearer file or manual entry. Do not show preset details, claim successful recognition or create a saved record automatically. How this sample was made: Original fictional SVG receipt rendered with an SVG blur filter and reduced contrast. No real photograph or private document was used. 07 / Input document — not an interface screenshot Unrelated restaurant receipt — AED example A clear fictional restaurant receipt with food items and an AED 124 total. This international format example tests relevance to property-service history, rather than image clarity. Download original · PNG ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: explain that the readable document appears unrelated to property work, or ask the uploader to clarify its relevance if uncertain. Do not call it blurry, treat the restaurant address as a serviced home or save it automatically as a home repair. How this sample was made: Original fictional restaurant-receipt SVG rendered to PNG. Retained only as a supplementary international format and relevance test; it is not a real purchase record. 08 / Input document — not an interface screenshot Unrelated landscape image A clear synthetic landscape with hills, trees and a lake, containing no receipt text or transaction details. Download original · PNG ↧ What to check Expected, to verify: state that no usable receipt details were found and offer a relevant document upload or manual entry. Do not invent a service or claim the image is blurry. A no-text OCR result alone must not be presented as proof that the system recognised a landscape. How this sample was made: New synthetic landscape generated with the built-in image_gen tool. It is not a photograph from a real customer or a verified real location. 02 / REVIEW & RECOVERY The confirmation loop These are the current workflow rules. The next screenshot round must verify each relevant window for the new files, including failure recovery. A finished OCR job is not a saved record. 01 Open and preview Select a PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP file. The prototype opens it locally. PDFs use manual entry; English images can use experimental OCR. 02 Review what was recovered Useful or partial image results open a summary. Compare company, actual worker, work, service date, address and total with the original. Unknown facts stay blank. 03 Correct the full form Choose Review / edit details. Correct mistakes and assign the property. A property and work summary are required to confirm; optional missing facts may remain unknown. 04 Confirm the latest details Review the final summary. The save button remains disabled until the confirmation checkbox is ticked. Return to editing if anything is wrong. 05 Save and check Only a successful local write creates a confirmed record. The history lets you reopen, correct or export JSON. The record is stored in this browser, without cloud or partner synchronisation. When the input is unsuitable Unreadable or no useful text Explain that no usable receipt details were found. Offer another file, retry or manual entry. A no-text result does not prove that the image is blurred. Readable, unrelated document A restaurant receipt may be readable but outside home-service scope. Explain the relevance issue; let the uploader choose a relevant file or manually clarify the property connection. Some information is missing Keep usable facts and show missing fields. Do not fill a date with today, infer the currency from the address, or substitute a customer for the worker. The result is uncertain Keep the original available and request verification. Do not present a confident success or add an empty record automatically. 03 / EVIDENCE Measured results, with their limits Three new images were processed through the actual local OCR engine and field parser in Node. This tests recognition and extraction only. It does not test browser upload, dialogs, storage, phone capture or Gemini. Engine test — not browser screenshots Clear UK PNG Recovered Cedar Home Services, James Turner, service date 2026-09-01, issue date 2026-09-02 and GBP 240. Work summary: Replace kitchen mixer tap. Home-system category remains unknown. Engine test — not browser screenshots UK simulated phone photo Only document type and receipt number were retained. Company, worker, dates, address, work and amount remain blank. OCR misread dates and the postcode; the strict parser rejected them. This is not a successful receipt extraction. Engine test — not browser screenshots Partly blurred AED photo The first parser result included OCR symbols in the work summary. A fix now rejects that noisy field entirely, while retaining the raw OCR text for inspection. Company, worker, dates and amount remain blank; a clearer file or manual entry is needed. Single-run engine times were about 0.48, 0.79 and 0.52 seconds on this Mac, including worker initialisation. They exclude browser loading and user interaction and are not customer latency targets. OCR confidence is not field accuracy. Raw engine evidence and before/after results ↗ Earlier browser test report: six synthetic images ↗ Unverified at the time of this September 9 report (see the September 10 update above): the new sample upload/dialog screenshots, real UK customer documents, £ amounts, day/month/year dates, unfamiliar layouts, physical-phone camera capture, automatic PDF extraction, Gemini quality/cost/latency, shared storage and account permissions. 04 / FIXED OUTPUT What the output contains A confirmed property-history record uses fixed JSON keys. Missing facts are null; unknown categories use unknown. Users choose the property. The model or OCR must not invent it. Assigned property property.id Work and property change service.summary / change_type Actual service date service.date Service company provider.organization_name Actual worker provider.person_name Where the work took place property.service_address Document total and currency amount.total / currency Confirmation and edited fields review.status / edited_fields Read the full field specification ↗ Domic Home Passport Fictional test data · Updated 9 September 2026 Open English workspace ↗

records.text: Domic Home Passport · Test report & handoff Domic HOME PASSPORT Receipt workspace Management EN 中文 10 SEPTEMBER 2026 / ROUND 02 One document. A reviewed record. A home’s history. Ten new UK fixtures, real English interface screenshots, saved-data verification and a management scaffold for reviewing with Daniel. Four interaction cases · step-by-step PDF Download 10 receipts · PDF + PNG Chinese illustrated report · PDF Actual saved table · CSV Review workflow verified; recognition remains experimental. The Mac is now accessible and actual browser actions succeeded. These are genuine UI screenshots, captured against the local development build. Nine home documents were saved after human review; one restaurant receipt was not saved. Gemini, automatic PDF extraction and shared customer accounts are not connected. 10 New fictional documents 9 / 9 Reviewed records persisted 216 Form values match 54 / 54 Automated tests passed 01 Output 02 Review flow 03 Ten cases 04 Bad photos 05 Management 06 Handoff 01 / OUTPUT CONTRACT · SCHEMA 1.2 The confirmation table and saved format The user sees a labelled summary table, with the original alongside the editable form. Property and work summary are required for confirmation. All other unknown facts may stay blank. The examples below explain the contract; the downloadable JSON is the exact UI-read saved record. Visible field JSON Example Rule Uploaded by account.id / display_name Alice Morgan Provided by the application; demo identity is not sign-in. Property property.uid / id round2-uk-01 / 22 Fictional Orchard Close User chooses a property; name is required, stable ID is never guessed. Work summary service.summary Replace leaking kitchen mixer tap cartridge… Required for confirmation; describes the actual work. Type / system / area service.change_type / category / location repair / plumbing / kitchen Unknown enums use unknown; missing location uses null. Service date service.date 2026-09-10 Never replaced by issue or upload date. Company & worker provider.organization_name / person_name Brambleford Plumbing Test Ltd / Toby Wren Separate fields; customer/preparer is not the worker. Service address property.service_address 22 Fictional Orchard Close, Exampleford, ZZ1 2BB Separate from the company address; editable. Document total / currency amount.total / currency 264 / GBP Missing is null; explicit zero stays zero; balance is not automatically total. Payment / completion amount.payment_status / service.completion_status paid / completed Independent; an estimate is planned, not completed spending. Document details document.type / number / issue_date invoice / null / 2026-09-10 Number and issue date may be unknown. Optional information items[] / details.* / provider.phone,address / notes Equipment, warranty, VAT line, notes Filled values appear in final confirmation and full JSON. Original & review source / evidence[] / review / timestamps uk-01.png / confirmed Original stored separately; hash and edited paths are retained. Missing text, dates and amounts are null; unknown enums use unknown. An explicit zero is distinct from missing. CSV has 20 flat columns; full JSON also includes line items, warranty, evidence and edit metadata. Original image/PDF bytes are stored separately and linked to the record. View one saved JSON All nine saved records JSON Schema 02 / REVIEW BEFORE SAVE What happens after upload 1. Add document Choose uploader context and a property, then upload one PDF or image. 2. Inspect result A readable image opens a review summary. Partial or unrelated content gets a specific recovery message. PDF stays manual. 3. Edit details Review every field against the original. Missing data stays unknown. All business fields can be edited. 4. Confirm and save The final table includes optional details you filled. Tick the review checkbox, then save. Saved records remain editable. Actual final confirmation; the checkbox is initially unchecked The summary includes uploader, property, work, company, actual worker, dates, location, amount and statuses. It does not save simply because OCR finished. 03 / TEN REAL UPLOAD FLOWS Inputs, observed results and every captured step All receipts are visibly fictional, created for this test. The first nine concern homes; the tenth is a negative restaurant case. Four browser cases use PDFs, six use PNGs. The embedded PDF panel was blank in this in-app browser; an Open original link is available above the panel. PDF preview compatibility remains open. Click a screenshot to see it at full size. The separate engine experiment used all ten PNGs. 01 · Partial image extraction Paid plumbing invoice: company and attending technician OCR recovered Toby Wren, service date and GBP264. Company, full address and work description were added after human review. Customer Harriet Moss was not used as the worker. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-01.png Show all captured UI steps · 6 01 / Choose file and context 02 / Result shown after upload 03 / Review and edit fields 04 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 05 / Checked; ready to save 06 / Saved record appears in history 02 · PDF manual entry Individual joiner receipt with no company The PDF opened in manual mode. Elliot Vale, door repair and GBP185 were entered. No company is stated; it remains blank. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-02.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / PDF manual mode 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history PDF manual mode, recaptured in a clean local browser origin; no record saved The PDF preview is blank in this browser. The original-file link is now above it. 03 · Needs relevance review Electrical job slip missing date, price and worker Relevance required human review. Company, socket work and property were entered. Missing date, worker, amount and currency remain unknown. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-03.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 04 · PDF manual entry Roofing quotation for future work, no payment Manual estimate. Planned work and unknown service date/actual worker were retained. The operator initially omitted the quote amount, then edited it to GBP1,440 via management and reconfirmed the same record. Count stayed nine. A quotation is not paid spending. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-04.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 7 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history Management: reopen the saved quote Reconfirm GBP1,440 on the same record 05 · Partial image extraction Annual boiler service thermal receipt with UK date OCR recovered Nia Fenwick and GBP96, but only the first address line. Company, work, full address and boiler model were reviewed manually. Generic Date was manually interpreted using the fixture notes, not automatically proven to be a service date. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-05.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 06 · Partial image extraction Window replacement VAT invoice with different balance OCR recovered Leo Arden and GBP1,620, not the GBP1,120 balance. Review added company, work, address, net GBP1,350 and VAT GBP270 line items. Payment status is partial. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-06.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 07 · PDF manual entry Decorator invoice: work completed but unpaid Manual PDF. Service date 9 September and issue date 10 September remain separate. Work is completed and unpaid. The operator reviewed GBP420 in this case; the parser does not generally assume Amount due is the invoice total. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-07.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 08 · Needs relevance review Gardening receipt separating worker, customer and preparer Human relevance review preceded entry of gardening work, GBP75 and actual worker Mila Brook. Customer Lydia Kent and preparer Owen Reed were not treated as workers. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-08.png Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 09 · PDF manual entry Appliance repair with long wrapped property address and work lines Manual PDF tested the full long address and multi-sentence work summary; UI-read saved values are complete. The separate PNG OCR returned £1 80 00, so its parser conservatively left total unknown. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-09.pdf Show all captured UI steps · 5 01 / Result shown after upload 02 / Review and edit fields 03 / Final summary; save disabled until checked 04 / Checked; ready to save 05 / Saved record appears in history 10 · Unrelated service; not saved Unrelated restaurant receipt for rejection Restaurant spending was marked unrelated. Count stayed nine. Choose another file opens an unsaved-work warning; cancel preserves the result and replace returns to upload. PDF · PNG · Browser input: uk-10.png Show all captured UI steps · 3 01 / Unrelated-service result 02 / Keep or replace current work 03 / Back to upload 04 / PHOTOS & RECOVERY Poor images must not silently become records Two extra AI-generated phone-style images supplement the ten source documents. They simulate a camera image; they were not taken with a physical phone. Severe blur and a landscape are additional older negative fixtures. All four remained unsaved. Phone-style image Soft phone-style image Severe blur Landscape Phone-style plumbing image: partial details Soft boiler photo: incomplete address Severe blur: no usable receipt text Landscape: no usable receipt text Retry first protects unsaved work Retry still cannot read; count stays nine 05 / MANAGEMENT SCAFFOLD People → properties → history → original Open the management console. Saved in this browser shows only local records. Example portfolio shows twelve fictional records across nine properties, separate from uploads, so Daniel can explore repeat jobs on a home without entering anything. The public site cannot see records saved during localhost testing. Open management console Actual nine-record management table Uploaders: two homeowners and one Pro test identity Properties filtered for Alice History belonging to the explicitly linked home Open record and its attached original Fictional portfolio: two jobs on the same home Search actual worker Toby Wren Actual CSV preview; select all as a download fallback This is the navigation and data-relationship scaffold. It is not a live administrator backend and cannot collect all customers yet. Next phase needs authenticated accounts, property permissions, shared database and private file storage. No production access control is simulated by the uploader selector. Mobile layout and language checks 390 × 844 responsive viewport in the in-app browser, not a physical phone or Safari test. English mobile navigation Scrollable confirmation Checkbox and save controls reachable Chinese interface switch 06 / EVIDENCE & NEXT ITERATION What passed, what still needs work Layer Evidence and conclusion Browser workflow 9 confirmed records saved and reopened; 216 final form values match. 80 blanks remain null; 14 unknown enums remain unknown. All nine file SHA256 values match the uploaded fixtures. Original previews were opened; stored-blob byte equality is covered by a separate controlled storage test, not a second independent browser byte download. Recognition quality All ten PNGs: 5 partial, 4 uncertain, 1 unrelated; zero fully extracted. For 72 primary fields across nine home documents: 15 correct nonempty, 9 correctly blank, 47 missing stated facts and 1 incomplete address. Company names and full work summaries often need human entry. Automated checks 54 repository tests passed, plus 11 context/persistence checks and a management loading-failure probe. These include controlled failure tests, not observations of a live service outage. Export The actual UI CSV preview was read and made available above. Select all works. Browser file-download completion was not verified; the report provides a static CSV and full saved JSON. Not yet measured Gemini model accuracy/cost/latency; automated PDFs and multi-document files; physical-phone capture; Chrome/Safari compatibility; real multi-user authorization, cloud backups and production load. Bugs addressed in this iteration Explicit UK dates and £ totals; reject conflicting totals, OCR garbage and impossible dates. Keep customers, preparers and proposed workers out of actual-worker fields. Changing a property name clears and refreshes its old association. Slow original loads cannot replace another record’s attachment; data-load failures clear previous results and disable export. Filled optional details and line items appear in final confirmation. Mobile navigation no longer overlaps. New uploads clear old success notices; CSV contents are visible and selectable. Recommended next build with Daniel Keep this schema and confirmation flow. Add server-side structured extraction behind a provider adapter, benchmark candidate Gemini Flash models on these fixtures plus consented real UK documents, and record field accuracy, latency and cost. Add authenticated users, property memberships and private original storage before any real customer pilot. Decide Pro/owner approval rights, quote/invoice deduplication, payment/VAT fields and the minimum acceptable completion rate together. Current runtime: Tesseract.js 7.0.0 . Fixtures: ReportLab + Poppler; supplemental photos: ImageGen. Existing research and architecture references: Project brief . Browser observations Persistence checks OCR engine report Fixture ground truth GitHub Domic Home Passport Fictional test data · Actual English UI screenshots · Chinese/English handoff · 10 September 2026

records.text: Domic Home Passport · 实测与交接说明 Domic HOME PASSPORT 英文工作台 管理控制台 EN 中文 10 SEPTEMBER 2026 / ROUND 02 从一张票据，到经确认的房屋历史。 10 份全新英国票据、英文界面真实截图、保存数据逐项核对，以及可以和 Daniel 一起查看的管理端架子。 四个情境 · 逐步截图与 PDF Four actual user journeys and 32 fresh screenshots. The Chinese PDF explains every action, message, dialog and save state. Download Chinese PDF · 39 pages Open PDF The interface screenshots are English. All input documents are fictional. These journeys were run in clean local browser storage on build 2f827f5, matching the published application at test time. Case D deliberately simulates a human typo (185 entered as 158); it is not an OCR error or automatic error detection. A / Unreadable image: retry, cancel and replace No usable receipt text → retry warning → still unreadable → cancel/replace → back to upload. No record saved. PDF starts on page 3 B / Partial extraction: fill missing fields and confirm Partial-result dialog → editable form → final confirmation → checkbox → save. PDF starts on page 11 C / Spot an incomplete address: go back and edit Actual truncated address → confirmation → Back to edit → corrected address → confirm again → save. PDF starts on page 18 D / After saving: correct an amount through management Manual typo saved → management detail → edit workspace → change 158 to 185 → reconfirm → reload. Same record, same original. PDF starts on page 26 Saved-data check: three records remain. The corrected amount is GBP185; the record ID, creation time and original hash are unchanged.
