paragraphs.zh: 目标：研究表面电子状态、吸附、晶面或材料变化。手段：UPS、Kelvin Probe、KPFM。证据：二次电子截止（表面功函数）、接触电势差（表面电势）、空间分布（表面不均匀性）。图中标注 E_vac、V_CPD、信号强度与动能。
paragraphs.en: Goal: study surface electronic states, adsorption, crystal planes, or material changes. Methods: UPS, Kelvin probe, KPFM. Evidence: secondary-electron cutoff (surface work function), contact-potential difference (surface potential), spatial distributions (surface nonuniformity). Diagram labels include E_vac, V_CPD, intensity, kinetic energy.

paragraphs.zh: 边界：半导体结果还包含表面态与能带弯曲，不等同于孤立材料的功函数。
paragraphs.en: Limit: semiconductor results include surface-state and band-bending effects and do not equal an isolated-material work function.

paragraphs.zh: 目标：优化势垒与接触电阻。结构：金属、经清洁/钝化的界面层、掺杂可调的半导体。手段：金属选择（图示 Ti、Ta、W、Co）、界面清洁或钝化、掺杂工程、退火协同。
paragraphs.en: Goal: optimize barrier and contact resistance. Structure: metal, cleaned/passivated interface, semiconductor with adjustable doping. Methods: metal choice (Ti, Ta, W, Co illustrated), interface cleaning/passivation, doping engineering, coordinated annealing.

paragraphs.zh: 证据：I–V（接触电阻与势垒）、温度依赖（热激发/隧穿机制）、TLM（传输线法，提取接触电阻）、界面成分（XPS/TEM-EDS 等）。边界：功函数只是输入之一，界面钉扎与化学反应可能主导实际势垒高度与接触电阻。
paragraphs.en: Evidence: I–V (contact resistance/barrier), temperature dependence (thermal activation/tunneling), TLM for contact resistance, and interface composition (XPS/TEM-EDS). Limit: work function is one input; interface pinning and chemistry can dominate actual barrier height/contact resistance.

一张图看懂 SADP
SADP at a glance
从 Mandrel、Spacer 倍频到 Pitch Walk 与工艺选择
Self-aligned double patterning: mandrels, spacers, pitch walk, and route selection
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
01 工艺位置与 02 核心结构
01 Process position and 02 structure
SADP 位于光刻与最终图形转移之间：光刻形成稀疏 Mandrel → SADP 形成高密度 Spacer → 转移到目标层得到更密图形。结构标注：Spacer（侧墙）、Mandrel（牺牲层）、硬掩膜、目标层（硅或介质等）。
SADP sits between lithography and final pattern transfer: lithography forms sparse mandrels → SADP creates dense spacers → transfer produces a denser target-layer pattern. Labels: spacer, sacrificial mandrel, hard mask, target layer such as silicon/dielectric.
03 倍频机制与 04 完整流程
03 Doubling and 04 full flow
一条 Mandrel 的两侧形成 Spacer，拉除 Mandrel 后留下两条 Spacer。完整链：形成 Mandrel（光刻）→ Spacer 成核/沉积（原图称“各向同性”）→ Spacer 各向异性刻蚀（仅保留侧墙）→ 拉除 Mandrel → Cut/Block 图形编辑 → 转移到目标层。
Spacers form on both sides of one mandrel; removing it leaves two spacers. Full chain: lithographic mandrel formation → spacer nucleation/deposition (called “isotropic” in the source) → anisotropic spacer etch retaining sidewalls → mandrel removal → cut/block editing → target-layer transfer.
05 关键窗口与 06 异常诊断
05 Process window and 06 diagnosis
Mandrel 与 Spacer 必须联动控制：Mandrel CD 与侧壁形貌；Spacer 厚度与包覆一致性；Spacer 刻蚀偏差（线宽/斜率）；材料选择性与刻蚀止点。
Control mandrel and spacer together: mandrel CD/profile; spacer thickness/coverage consistency; spacer etch bias in width/slope; material selectivity and etch endpoint.
从晶圆 CD 分布、Pitch Walk（交替间距偏移）、断线（Spacer 不连续）、桥连（残留或刻蚀不足）追查根因。
Trace causes using wafer CD distribution, pitch walk (alternating spacing shifts), breaks (discontinuous spacers), and bridges (residue or insufficient etch).
07 整合影响与 08 工艺选择
07 Integration and 08 route selection
SADP 先形成连续规则线网，再通过 Cut/Block 定义保留/去除区域，得到非连续线段的目标图形。LELE：二维图形较灵活、overlay 更敏感；SADP：规则线网倍频、需 Cut 与 Block；SAQP：更高线密度，流程与误差传播更复杂。
SADP first forms a continuous regular grid; cut/block then defines retained/removed areas to create discrete target line segments. LELE: more flexible 2D patterns, greater overlay sensitivity. SADP: doubles regular grids, requires cut/block. SAQP: higher line density with more complex flow and error propagation.

paragraphs.zh: SADP 位于光刻与最终图形转移之间：光刻形成稀疏 Mandrel → SADP 形成高密度 Spacer → 转移到目标层得到更密图形。结构标注：Spacer（侧墙）、Mandrel（牺牲层）、硬掩膜、目标层（硅或介质等）。
paragraphs.en: SADP sits between lithography and final pattern transfer: lithography forms sparse mandrels → SADP creates dense spacers → transfer produces a denser target-layer pattern. Labels: spacer, sacrificial mandrel, hard mask, target layer such as silicon/dielectric.

paragraphs.zh: 一条 Mandrel 的两侧形成 Spacer，拉除 Mandrel 后留下两条 Spacer。完整链：形成 Mandrel（光刻）→ Spacer 成核/沉积（原图称“各向同性”）→ Spacer 各向异性刻蚀（仅保留侧墙）→ 拉除 Mandrel → Cut/Block 图形编辑 → 转移到目标层。
paragraphs.en: Spacers form on both sides of one mandrel; removing it leaves two spacers. Full chain: lithographic mandrel formation → spacer nucleation/deposition (called “isotropic” in the source) → anisotropic spacer etch retaining sidewalls → mandrel removal → cut/block editing → target-layer transfer.

paragraphs.zh: Mandrel 与 Spacer 必须联动控制：Mandrel CD 与侧壁形貌；Spacer 厚度与包覆一致性；Spacer 刻蚀偏差（线宽/斜率）；材料选择性与刻蚀止点。
paragraphs.en: Control mandrel and spacer together: mandrel CD/profile; spacer thickness/coverage consistency; spacer etch bias in width/slope; material selectivity and etch endpoint.

paragraphs.zh: 从晶圆 CD 分布、Pitch Walk（交替间距偏移）、断线（Spacer 不连续）、桥连（残留或刻蚀不足）追查根因。
paragraphs.en: Trace causes using wafer CD distribution, pitch walk (alternating spacing shifts), breaks (discontinuous spacers), and bridges (residue or insufficient etch).

paragraphs.zh: SADP 先形成连续规则线网，再通过 Cut/Block 定义保留/去除区域，得到非连续线段的目标图形。LELE：二维图形较灵活、overlay 更敏感；SADP：规则线网倍频、需 Cut 与 Block；SAQP：更高线密度，流程与误差传播更复杂。
paragraphs.en: SADP first forms a continuous regular grid; cut/block then defines retained/removed areas to create discrete target line segments. LELE: more flexible 2D patterns, greater overlay sensitivity. SADP: doubles regular grids, requires cut/block. SAQP: higher line density with more complex flow and error propagation.

判断与误区
Judgment and misconceptions
SADP 不是两次相同线图形曝光，也不只是多沉积一层 Spacer。它位于初始光刻与最终目标层之间，把部分分辨率压力转移给薄膜与刻蚀控制。
SADP is neither two identical line-pattern exposures nor merely an extra spacer deposition. Between initial lithography and final target layer, it transfers part of the resolution burden to film and etch control.
量测反馈
Metrology feedback
量测 Mandrel CD、Pitch、侧壁、CDU。使用顶视图 CD-SEM、截面轮廓与晶圆 CD 分布（红色 CD 大、蓝色 CD 小）。反馈流程：复测 → Hold → 判断是否进入 Spacer 模块。
Measure mandrel CD, pitch, sidewalls, and CDU using top-down CD-SEM, cross-sectional profiles, and wafer CD maps (red large, blue small). Feedback: remeasure → hold → decide whether to enter the spacer module.
补充说明
Additional scope
Fin、存储结构与 BEOL 金属层的材料堆栈可能不同。
Material stacks may differ for fins, memory structures, and BEOL metal layers.

title.en: Structure: the mandrel is the mold; spacers remain

records.text:
核心结构：Mandrel 是模具，Spacer 才留下
Structure: the mandrel is the mold; spacers remain
牺牲核心 / 侧墙间隔层 / 硬掩膜 / 目标材料
Sacrificial core / sidewall spacer / hard mask / target material
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
各层职责
Layer roles
Mandrel 提供侧壁位置，后续移除。Spacer 复制 Mandrel 边缘，形成倍频图形。Hard Mask 承接图形，支持后续转移。Target Layer 形成最终线、沟槽或器件结构。
The mandrel sets sidewall positions and is later removed. Spacers copy its edges to form a doubled pattern. The hard mask receives the pattern for later transfer. The target layer becomes final lines, trenches, or device structures.
Cut/Block 材料用于删除多余线段或定义线端，不负责产生倍频。
Cut/block material removes unwanted segments or defines line ends; it does not create density doubling.
材料关系与失配
Material relationships and mismatches
材料关系链：沉积选择 → Spacer 刻蚀选择性 → Mandrel 拉除选择性 → 硬掩膜转移。材料分工失配可表现为 Mandrel 残留、Spacer 受损、界面残留、硬掩膜转移失真。
Material chain: deposition choice → spacer-etch selectivity → mandrel-removal selectivity → hard-mask transfer. Mismatches can leave mandrel/interface residue, damage spacers, or distort hard-mask transfer.
核心判断与量测反馈
Judgment and feedback
Mandrel 负责定义位置，Spacer 负责保留倍频边缘，二者不能互换。量测膜厚、侧壁轮廓、选择性、残留；工具包括 OCD 侧壁轮廓、截面 SEM、沉积/刻蚀/拉除选择性评估、残留检查。反馈：复测 → Hold → 联查沉积、刻蚀与拉除。
Mandrels define positions; spacers retain doubled edges; their roles are not interchangeable. Measure thickness, profile, selectivity, and residue using OCD profiles, cross-sectional SEM, deposition/etch/removal-selectivity assessment, and residue inspection. Feedback: remeasure → hold → investigate deposition, etch, and removal together.
补充说明
Additional scope
Spacer-is-mask、Spacer-is-dielectric 等语境的材料职责可能不同。
Material roles may differ in spacer-is-mask and spacer-is-dielectric contexts.

title.zh: 倍频机制：一条核心留下两条侧墙
title.en: Doubling mechanism: one core leaves two sidewalls

records.text:
倍频机制：一条核心留下两条侧墙
Doubling mechanism: one core leaves two sidewalls
共形沉积 / 各向异性刻蚀 / 自对准边缘
Conformal deposition / anisotropic etch / self-aligned edges
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
形成两条 Spacer
Forming two spacers
01 形成 Mandrel → 02 共形沉积 Spacer → 03 各向异性刻蚀 → 04 移除 Mandrel。规则线网中，一条 Mandrel 左右侧壁各留下一个 Spacer，线密度约增加一倍。
01 Form mandrel → 02 conformally deposit spacer → 03 anisotropically etch → 04 remove mandrel. Each sidewall leaves one spacer, approximately doubling line density in a regular grid.
自对准的边界
Limits of self-alignment
两条 Spacer 相对同一 Mandrel 定位；Mandrel 对前层、Cut/Block 对线网仍需 overlay 控制。P1 在图中称“Mandrel 内部间距”，P2 为相邻 Mandrel 之间间距。P1 与 P2 失衡表现为 Pitch Walk。
Both spacers are positioned relative to the same mandrel; mandrel-to-previous-layer and cut/block-to-grid overlay still need control. The source calls P1 the internal mandrel spacing and P2 the spacing between adjacent mandrels. P1/P2 imbalance appears as pitch walk.
风险与判断
Risks and judgment
常见风险：Pitch Walk、Even–Odd 间距偏差、左右 Spacer 不对称。SADP 靠侧墙复制完成倍频，自对准不等于全流程无 overlay。
Risks: pitch walk, even–odd spacing errors, left/right spacer asymmetry. SADP doubles density by sidewall replication; self-alignment does not remove overlay requirements from the entire flow.
量测反馈
Metrology feedback
量测 P1、P2、Spacer CD 与左右对称性，使用顶视 CD-SEM、截面轮廓及晶圆 CD 分布（红大、蓝小）。反馈：复测 → Hold → 区分 Mandrel、沉积与刻蚀贡献。
Measure P1, P2, spacer CD, and left/right symmetry with top-down CD-SEM, cross-sections, and wafer CD maps (red large, blue small). Feedback: remeasure → hold → separate mandrel, deposition, and etch contributions.

paragraphs.en: Measure P1, P2, spacer CD, and left/right symmetry with top-down CD-SEM, cross-sections, and wafer CD maps (red large, blue small). Feedback: remeasure → hold → separate mandrel, deposition, and etch contributions.

records.text:
完整流程：成核只是第一步
Full process: nucleation is only the first step
Mandrel 形成 / Spacer 沉积 / 拉除 / Cut 与转移
Mandrel formation / spacer deposition / removal / cut and transfer
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
六步流程
Six-step flow
01 光刻定义 Mandrel：以光刻胶或可刻蚀材料形成图形。02 Mandrel 刻蚀：去除多余材料。03 共形沉积 Spacer：覆盖顶面、两侧壁及暴露水平面。
01 Lithographically define mandrels in resist or etchable material. 02 Etch mandrels, removing excess material. 03 Conformally deposit spacer over tops, both sidewalls, and exposed horizontal surfaces.
04 各向异性 Spacer 刻蚀：去除水平向 Spacer，保留侧墙。05 选择性移除 Mandrel：留下两条 Spacer，形成双倍频图形。06 Cut/Block 删除多余线段或定义线端，并转移到硬掩膜/目标层。
04 Anisotropically etch horizontal spacer material while retaining sidewalls. 05 Selectively remove mandrels, leaving two spacers and a doubled pattern. 06 Use cut/block to remove unwanted segments or define line ends, then transfer to hard mask/target.
关键控制
Key controls
Mandrel 侧壁轮廓决定后续 Spacer 厚度与位置。Spacer 要良好共形，均匀覆盖顶面与侧壁。Spacer 刻蚀需清除水平膜并保证侧墙形貌与尺寸。Mandrel 拉除需选择性移除核心，不损伤 Spacer 与下层。
Mandrel sidewall profile sets subsequent spacer thickness/position. Spacer deposition must conformally and uniformly cover tops/sidewalls. Etching must clear horizontal film while preserving sidewall shape/dimensions. Mandrel removal must protect spacer and underlying layers.
工艺取舍与风险
Trade-offs and risks
水平膜去除充分 ↔ 侧墙损失：清除不足会有顶部残留，过刻会损失侧墙。Mandrel 完全拉除 ↔ 保护 Spacer 与下层：拉除不完全会残留，过度氧化/刻蚀会损伤 Spacer 或下层。
Complete horizontal-film removal ↔ sidewall loss: insufficient clearing leaves top residue; overetch removes sidewall material. Complete mandrel removal ↔ spacer/underlayer protection: incomplete removal leaves residue; excess oxidation/etch damages spacer or lower layers.
风险表现包括顶帽或残留、Footing、Mandrel 残留、Spacer 变薄与转移偏差。
Risk signatures include top caps/residue, footing, mandrel residue, spacer thinning, and transfer bias.
判断、量测与边界
Judgment, metrology, and scope
SADP 是连续整合链，前段轮廓误差会带入后续转移。量测 Mandrel CD、Spacer 轮廓、拉除残留、最终 CD，以截面检查各阶段。反馈：分段复测 → Hold → 锁定误差首次出现节点。Cut/Block 插入顺序与硬掩膜堆栈随整合方案变化。
SADP is a continuous integration chain; early profile errors propagate into later transfer. Measure mandrel CD, spacer profiles, removal residue, and final CD with stage-by-stage cross-sections. Feedback: remeasure stages → hold → identify the first appearance of error. Cut/block sequence and hard-mask stack depend on integration.

关键窗口：CD 不是一个旋钮决定的
Process window: CD is not set by one control
Mandrel CDU / Spacer 厚度 / 刻蚀偏差 / 选择比
Mandrel CDU / spacer thickness / etch bias / selectivity
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
四类关键控制
Four key controls
01 Mandrel CD 与侧壁轮廓决定侧墙起始位置：需看 CD/CDU、侧壁斜率与粗糙度。02 Spacer 厚度与共形性决定保留线宽及左右一致性：控制沉积厚度、侧壁/顶部共形性、左右厚度一致性。
01 Mandrel CD/profile determines the starting sidewall positions: assess CD/CDU, slope, roughness. 02 Spacer thickness/conformality determines retained linewidth and left/right consistency: control thickness, top/sidewall conformality, and symmetry.
03 Spacer 刻蚀方向性与偏差决定水平膜清除、底部 Footing、侧墙损失；刻蚀偏差导致 CD 变化。04 选择比与图形转移决定拉除、硬掩膜和目标层的 CD 保真；控制 Spacer/硬掩膜/目标层（硅或介质）的刻蚀选择比，选择比不足会引入 CD 偏差。
03 Spacer etch directionality/bias determines horizontal clearing, bottom footing, and sidewall loss; etch bias changes CD. 04 Selectivity/transfer controls CD fidelity through removal, hard mask, and target. Control selectivity among spacer/hard mask/Si or dielectric target; inadequate selectivity introduces CD error.
参数耦合与风险
Coupling and risks
Mandrel CD/CDU + Spacer 厚度/均匀性 + 刻蚀偏差/选择比 → 最终 Spacer CD、P1/P2 平衡、最终图形 CD。常见表现：Pitch Walk、Even–Odd CD 偏差、Footing、线宽漂移、Line Wiggling。
Mandrel CD/CDU + spacer thickness/uniformity + etch bias/selectivity → final spacer CD, P1/P2 balance, final-pattern CD. Typical signatures: pitch walk, even–odd CD errors, footing, linewidth shifts, and line wiggling.
不要单点调参
Avoid isolated parameter tuning
先确定异常首次出现的节点，再区分来料、沉积、刻蚀与转移贡献。最终 CD 与节距平衡由多步共同决定，单看终点 CD 无法定位根因。
Identify where the abnormality first appears, then separate incoming-material, deposition, etch, and transfer contributions. Multiple steps determine final CD/pitch balance; endpoint CD alone cannot locate the cause.
量测反馈与边界
Feedback and scope
量测：顶视 CD-SEM、OCD（光学 CD）、截面轮廓、晶圆空间分布。动作：复测 → Hold → 前后节点相关性 → 小范围分片验证。量产窗口必须依据材料堆栈、设计规则与设备能力建立，不套用通用数值。
Measurements: top-down CD-SEM, OCD, cross-sections, wafer spatial distributions. Actions: remeasure → hold → correlate preceding/following stages → small-scale split validation. Production windows must reflect stack, design rules, and equipment capability rather than generic numerical values.

title.en: Diagnosis: where pitch walk comes from

records.text:
异常诊断：Pitch Walk 从哪里来
Diagnosis: where pitch walk comes from
交替间距 / 线宽粗糙 / 断线桥连 / 拉除残留
Alternating spacing / roughness / breaks and bridges / removal residue
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
01 交替间距与 02 左右不对称
01 Alternating spacing and 02 asymmetry
相邻线间距高低交替（Pitch Walk）：优先检查 Mandrel CD/Pitch、Spacer 厚度、转移偏差。同一条线两侧 Spacer 宽度不一致：优先检查 Mandrel 侧壁、沉积共形性、刻蚀方向性。
Alternating large/small spacing (pitch walk): first check mandrel CD/pitch, spacer thickness, transfer bias. Unequal spacer widths on opposite sides: first check mandrel sidewall, deposition conformality, etch directionality.
03 断线变薄与 04 桥连残留
03 Breaks/thinning and 04 bridges/residue
图形断线或局部明显变薄：优先检查 Spacer 连续性、图形坍塌、过刻。相邻图形桥连或拉除后残留：优先检查水平膜去除、Footing、Mandrel 拉除残留。
Breaks or pronounced local thinning: first check spacer continuity, pattern collapse, overetch. Bridges or post-removal residue: first check horizontal-film clearing, footing, mandrel-removal residue.
05 LER/LWR 与 06 线端/Cut
05 LER/LWR and 06 line-end/cut errors
线边缘或线宽粗糙度恶化：对比 Mandrel 刻蚀、Spacer、硬掩膜、目标层刻蚀与清洗。线端位置偏移或 Cut/Block 尺寸异常：优先检查 Cut/Block 的 overlay、CD 与刻蚀。
Worse line-edge/linewidth roughness: compare mandrel etch, spacer, hard mask, target etch, and cleaning. Line-end shifts or abnormal cut/block size: first check cut/block overlay, CD, and etch.
首次出现节点
First-occurrence tracking
沿流程排查：Mandrel（光刻/刻蚀）→ Spacer 沉积（原图称各向同性）→ Spacer 各向异性刻蚀 → Mandrel 拉除 → 硬掩膜/目标层转移 → Cut/Block。
Trace stages: mandrel lithography/etch → spacer deposition (called isotropic in the source) → anisotropic spacer etch → mandrel removal → hard-mask/target transfer → cut/block.
量测、诊断与处置
Metrology, diagnosis, and actions
工具：顶视 CD-SEM、截面 SEM/TEM、OCD、缺陷图、overlay 与 EPE。反馈项目：P1/P2、Spacer CD、LER/LWR、残留、缺陷位置。Pitch Walk 是图形签名，不对应唯一根因。动作：复测 → Hold → 分节点检查 → 根因分析。未定位根因前，不直接以终点 CD 回调单一配方。
Tools: top-down CD-SEM, cross-sectional SEM/TEM, OCD, defect maps, overlay/EPE. Track P1/P2, spacer CD, LER/LWR, residue, defect locations. Pitch walk is a pattern signature, not a unique root cause. Actions: remeasure → hold → inspect stages → analyze cause. Do not tune one recipe from endpoint CD before locating the cause.

title.en: Integration: a regular grid is not the final pattern

records.text:
整合影响：规则线网还不是最终图形
Integration: a regular grid is not the final pattern
Cut/Block / Line End / EPE / 图形转移
Cut/block / line end / EPE / pattern transfer
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
01 整合流程
01 Integration flow
A：SADP 生成连续等距 Spacer 的规则密集线网。B：通过 Cut/Block 删除多余线段或定义线端。C：得到断开的线段和受控线端，并转移到硬掩膜或目标层。Cut/Block 负责图形编辑，不负责产生倍频。
A: SADP forms a dense regular grid of continuous, equally spaced spacers. B: cut/block removes unwanted segments or defines line ends. C: disconnected segments and controlled ends transfer to hard mask/target. Cut/block edits the pattern; it does not create density doubling.
02 关键控制
02 Key controls
Cut CD 与 Block CD：满足删除效果与线端定义需求。Cut/Block overlay：控制与前层对准偏差。Line-End Bias：保证线端位置与形貌。下层形貌与图形转移：考虑下层形貌影响，保证正确转移到硬掩膜/目标层。
Cut/block CD must satisfy removal and line-end definition. Cut/block overlay controls alignment to prior layers. Line-end bias controls end position/profile. Underlying topography and transfer must support correct hard-mask/target replication.
03 取舍与 04 风险
03 Trade-offs and 04 risks
规则线网与自对准关键边，需要与二维复杂度、Cut 数量、EPE 和设计限制权衡。漏切：应切未切，残留连接。过切：切除过多导致线段缺失。线端回缩：线端后退、尺寸偏小。桥连：相邻线段异常连接。Cut 残留：去除不完全，影响后续工艺。最终 CD 偏差：尺寸偏大或偏小。
Balance regular grids/self-aligned critical edges against 2D complexity, cut count, EPE, and design restrictions. Missed cuts leave connections; overcuts remove segments; end pullback shortens ends; bridges connect neighbors; incomplete cut removal leaves residue affecting later processing; final-CD bias produces oversized/undersized patterns.
05 判断与 06 反馈
05 Judgment and 06 feedback
关键边自对准不会消除 Cut/Block 与前层对准误差。量测 Cut/Block overlay、Tip-to-Tip、Line End、最终硬掩膜 CD、缺陷。反馈动作：图谱对齐 → 相关性判断 → 分片验证。
Self-aligned critical edges do not eliminate cut/block-to-prior-layer overlay error. Measure cut/block overlay, tip-to-tip, line ends, final hard-mask CD, and defects. Actions: align maps → assess correlations → validate splits.
07 边界说明
07 Scope
Cut/Block 曝光次数、插入顺序和材料体系随设计与整合方案变化。
Cut/block exposure count, sequence, and materials depend on design and integration scheme.

records.text:
工艺选择：不是所有密集图形都选 SADP
Route selection: SADP is not for every dense pattern
LELE / SADP / SAQP
LELE / SADP / SAQP
SADP
FEOL BEOL 自对准 Self-aligned 侧墙 Spacer 整合 Integration
01 LELE
01 LELE
两次独立光刻与刻蚀形成交错线条：第一次形成第一组线，第二次形成第二组线，再得到交错图形。二维图形较灵活，对 overlay 更敏感，需要两套光刻/刻蚀图形。
Two independent lithography/etch cycles form interleaved lines: the first forms one set and the second forms the other. LELE is more flexible for 2D patterns, more overlay sensitive, and requires two lithography/etch patterns.
02 SADP
02 SADP
光刻形成 Mandrel → 沉积 Spacer 并各向异性刻蚀 → 去除 Mandrel 得到倍频线网 → Cut/Block 图形编辑。适合规则密集线网倍频，关键边由侧墙自对准，但增加沉积、刻蚀与 Cut/Block 整合。
Lithographically form mandrels → deposit spacers and anisotropically etch → remove mandrels for a doubled grid → cut/block editing. Suited to doubling regular dense grids, with self-aligned sidewall edges, but adds deposition, etch, and cut/block integration.
03 SAQP
03 SAQP
在 SADP 基础上再进行一次自对准循环：第一次形成 Spacer，第二次再次形成 Spacer，得到更高线密度。重复自对准循环使流程更长，误差传播、缺陷与成本更复杂。
Add another self-aligned cycle to SADP: first form spacers, then form spacers again for higher line density. Repeated cycles lengthen the flow and complicate error propagation, defects, and cost.
04 选择轴与 05 选择逻辑
04 Selection axes and 05 logic
综合评估目标 Pitch、一维/二维图形复杂度、Cut/Block 数量、EPE 预算、材料选择性、成本与周期。二维灵活性优先则评估 LELE；规则线网与自对准关键边则评估 SADP；更高线密度且接受更长流程则评估 SAQP。
Assess target pitch, 1D/2D complexity, cut/block count, EPE budget, material selectivity, cost, and cycle time. Evaluate LELE for 2D flexibility; SADP for regular grids/self-aligned edges; SAQP for higher density when a longer flow is acceptable.
06 EUV 边界与 07 判断
06 EUV scope and 07 judgment
EUV 可用于形成 Mandrel 或 Block，路线仍需按层级、图形与成本评估。工艺选择由 Pitch、图形复杂度、EPE、材料窗口与成本共同决定。
EUV can form mandrels or blocks; routes still require layer-, pattern-, and cost-specific assessment. Pitch, complexity, EPE, material window, and cost jointly determine the choice.
08 量测、09 反馈、10 边界
08 Metrology, 09 feedback, 10 scope
反馈项目：最终 EPE/CDU、LER/LWR、缺陷、电性。动作：实验分片 → 图形与电性相关 → 决策评审。不同层级可能采用不同路线，不以单一曝光方式概括整套工艺。
Track final EPE/CDU, LER/LWR, defects, electrical properties. Actions: experimental splits → pattern/electrical correlation → decision review. Different layers may use different routes; one exposure method does not describe the whole process.

paragraphs.zh: 两次独立光刻与刻蚀形成交错线条：第一次形成第一组线，第二次形成第二组线，再得到交错图形。二维图形较灵活，对 overlay 更敏感，需要两套光刻/刻蚀图形。
paragraphs.en: Two independent lithography/etch cycles form interleaved lines: the first forms one set and the second forms the other. LELE is more flexible for 2D patterns, more overlay sensitive, and requires two lithography/etch patterns.

paragraphs.zh: 光刻形成 Mandrel → 沉积 Spacer 并各向异性刻蚀 → 去除 Mandrel 得到倍频线网 → Cut/Block 图形编辑。适合规则密集线网倍频，关键边由侧墙自对准，但增加沉积、刻蚀与 Cut/Block 整合。
paragraphs.en: Lithographically form mandrels → deposit spacers and anisotropically etch → remove mandrels for a doubled grid → cut/block editing. Suited to doubling regular dense grids, with self-aligned sidewall edges, but adds deposition, etch, and cut/block integration.

paragraphs.zh: 在 SADP 基础上再进行一次自对准循环：第一次形成 Spacer，第二次再次形成 Spacer，得到更高线密度。重复自对准循环使流程更长，误差传播、缺陷与成本更复杂。
paragraphs.en: Add another self-aligned cycle to SADP: first form spacers, then form spacers again for higher line density. Repeated cycles lengthen the flow and complicate error propagation, defects, and cost.

paragraphs.zh: 综合评估目标 Pitch、一维/二维图形复杂度、Cut/Block 数量、EPE 预算、材料选择性、成本与周期。二维灵活性优先则评估 LELE；规则线网与自对准关键边则评估 SADP；更高线密度且接受更长流程则评估 SAQP。
paragraphs.en: Assess target pitch, 1D/2D complexity, cut/block count, EPE budget, material selectivity, cost, and cycle time. Evaluate LELE for 2D flexibility; SADP for regular grids/self-aligned edges; SAQP for higher density when a longer flow is acceptable.

paragraphs.zh: EUV 可用于形成 Mandrel 或 Block，路线仍需按层级、图形与成本评估。工艺选择由 Pitch、图形复杂度、EPE、材料窗口与成本共同决定。
paragraphs.en: EUV can form mandrels or blocks; routes still require layer-, pattern-, and cost-specific assessment. Pitch, complexity, EPE, material window, and cost jointly determine the choice.

paragraphs.zh: 反馈项目：最终 EPE/CDU、LER/LWR、缺陷、电性。动作：实验分片 → 图形与电性相关 → 决策评审。不同层级可能采用不同路线，不以单一曝光方式概括整套工艺。
paragraphs.en: Track final EPE/CDU, LER/LWR, defects, electrical properties. Actions: experimental splits → pattern/electrical correlation → decision review. Different layers may use different routes; one exposure method does not describe the whole process.

records.text:
一张图看懂 Gate 工艺发展史
Gate-process development at a glance
从早期金属栅，到自对准、HKMG 与环栅
From early metal gates to self-alignment, HKMG, and gate-all-around
栅极工艺发展
器件 Device HKMG GAA 自对准 Self-aligned
01 栅极起点
01 Starting point
金属隔着介质，用电场控制沟道。结构标注：金属栅、SiO₂ 栅介质、源极、漏极、硅沟道（反型层）；箭头标示栅控电场与沟道电流。时间标记：1960，MOS 公开演示。
A metal gate controls a channel through a dielectric using an electric field. Labels: metal gate, SiO₂ dielectric, source, drain, silicon inversion channel; arrows show gate field and channel current. Timeline: public MOS demonstration in 1960.
02 自对准硅栅
02 Self-aligned silicon gate
让栅成为源漏形成的几何参照。标注：多晶硅栅、源极/源极掺杂、栅下沟道、漏极/漏极掺杂。时间标记：1967–1968，重要阶段。
The gate becomes the geometric reference for source/drain formation. Labels: polysilicon gate, source/doping, channel beneath gate, drain/doping. Timeline: 1967–1968, an important period.
03 栅氧极限与 04 高 k 金属栅
03 Gate-oxide limits and 04 HKMG
栅介质超薄化后，栅漏电与短沟道问题逐渐显现；图中标出金属栅、超薄介质、硅沟道、栅漏电、关断漏电。高 k 金属栅通过介质与电极协同升级：金属栅/高 k 介质/界面层/硅沟道。时间标记：2007，Intel 45 nm 代表节点。
With ultrathin gate dielectrics, gate leakage and short-channel issues emerge. Labels show metal gate, ultrathin dielectric, Si channel, gate leakage, off-state leakage. HKMG upgrades dielectric and electrode together: metal/high-k/interfacial layer/Si channel. Timeline: Intel 45 nm as a representative node in 2007.
05 替换金属栅
05 Replacement metal gate
用假栅衔接高温步骤与最终栅：1. 形成多晶硅假栅；2. 移除假栅形成栅槽，保留栅侧墙；3. 填充最终金属栅。这条流程线与结构演进并行。
Use a dummy gate to bridge high-temperature steps and the final gate: 1. form polysilicon dummy gate; 2. remove it to form a trench while retaining spacers; 3. fill the final metal gate. This process route evolves alongside device structures.
06 FinFET 鳍栅
06 FinFET
从更多侧面控制立起的沟道。标注：三面环绕的金属栅、侧壁与顶面栅介质、硅鳍（沟道）、浅沟槽隔离、硅衬底，以及源极、栅极、漏极。时间标记：2011 公布/2012 相关产品。
Control an upright channel from more sides. Labels: three-sided metal gate, sidewall/top dielectric, silicon fin channel, shallow-trench isolation, Si substrate, source/gate/drain. Timeline: announced in 2011, related products in 2012.
07 GAA 环栅
07 Gate-all-around
让栅围绕纳米片沟道。标注：四面环绕的金属栅、每片四周连续的栅介质、硅纳米片沟道、源极与漏极。时间标记：2022，三星宣布初始生产。
Surround nanosheet channels with a gate. Labels: four-sided metal gate, continuous dielectric around each sheet, silicon nanosheet channels, source/drain. Timeline: Samsung announced initial production in 2022.
08 工艺选择
08 Route selection
平面：成熟工艺、成本友好。FinFET：更强栅控，适合先进节点。GAA：进一步提升栅控，面向更高性能。按“材料 × 流程 × 结构”，根据应用目标、工艺平台和设计需求综合权衡。
Planar: mature and cost-friendly. FinFET: stronger gate control for advanced nodes. GAA: further gate-control improvement for higher performance. Balance materials × process × structure against application, platform, and design requirements.
年份与节点为原图列举的代表性历史标记，本页保持原图表述，不将其扩写为完整产业史。
Dates/nodes are representative milestones listed by the source; they are retained without presenting them as a complete industry history.

records.text:
一张图看懂芯片制造中的 Plasma
Plasma in chip manufacturing at a glance
从粒子分工，到刻蚀、成膜与损伤控制
Particle roles, etching, deposition, and damage control
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
01 认识 Plasma 与 02 粒子分工
01 Plasma and 02 particle roles
把工艺气体（气体分子）送入放电腔，形成等离子体作用于晶圆。电子（能量高）通过碰撞解离气体分子；中性自由基参与多方向化学反应；正离子通过鞘层，沿电场加速轰击晶圆。
Feed process-gas molecules into a discharge chamber to create plasma acting on a wafer. Energetic electrons dissociate gas molecules by collision; neutral radicals react chemically from multiple directions; positive ions accelerate through the sheath along the electric field toward the wafer.
03 图形刻蚀与 04 薄膜沉积
03 Pattern etching and 04 deposition
刻蚀将掩膜图形转移到目标材料中；图中标有掩膜、目标层、衬底、离子轰击与挥发产物。沉积通过活化反应或提供溅射材料成膜，路线包括 PECVD、PEALD、溅射 PVD；后者图示 Ar⁺ 轰击靶材形成溅射原子。
Etching transfers a mask pattern into the target; labels include mask, target, substrate, ion bombardment, volatile products. Deposition activates reactions or supplies sputtered material through PECVD, PEALD, or sputter PVD; the latter shows Ar⁺ bombarding a target to generate sputtered atoms.
05 去胶清洗与 06 表面改性
05 Resist removal and 06 surface modification
去胶去掉有机物，同时保护底层；处理前后的有机胶/目标层/衬底图展示等离子体去除和挥发产物。表面改性调整最表层，为后续界面服务；化学基团、材料表面、衬底的变化用于后续键合。
Resist removal removes organics while protecting underlying layers; before/after resist/target/substrate diagrams show plasma removal and volatile products. Surface modification changes the top surface for later interfaces; chemical groups on material/substrate prepare for bonding.
07 损伤控制与 08 路线选择
07 Damage control and 08 routes
效率、均匀性与损伤一起管理，控制能量、输运、温度，并关注晶圆分布中的工艺窗口与损伤风险。直接路线：等离子体在晶圆附近，用于刻蚀或沉积。远程路线：上游产生等离子体，中性物种到达晶圆。热/湿法：加热或化学反应去除或改性表面。
Manage efficiency, uniformity, and damage together through energy, transport, and temperature, checking wafer distributions and damage risk. Direct plasma forms near the wafer for etch/deposition. Remote plasma forms upstream and delivers neutral species. Thermal/wet routes use heat or chemistry to remove or modify surfaces.

paragraphs.zh: 把工艺气体（气体分子）送入放电腔，形成等离子体作用于晶圆。电子（能量高）通过碰撞解离气体分子；中性自由基参与多方向化学反应；正离子通过鞘层，沿电场加速轰击晶圆。
paragraphs.en: Feed process-gas molecules into a discharge chamber to create plasma acting on a wafer. Energetic electrons dissociate gas molecules by collision; neutral radicals react chemically from multiple directions; positive ions accelerate through the sheath along the electric field toward the wafer.

paragraphs.zh: 刻蚀将掩膜图形转移到目标材料中；图中标有掩膜、目标层、衬底、离子轰击与挥发产物。沉积通过活化反应或提供溅射材料成膜，路线包括 PECVD、PEALD、溅射 PVD；后者图示 Ar⁺ 轰击靶材形成溅射原子。
paragraphs.en: Etching transfers a mask pattern into the target; labels include mask, target, substrate, ion bombardment, volatile products. Deposition activates reactions or supplies sputtered material through PECVD, PEALD, or sputter PVD; the latter shows Ar⁺ bombarding a target to generate sputtered atoms.

paragraphs.zh: 去胶去掉有机物，同时保护底层；处理前后的有机胶/目标层/衬底图展示等离子体去除和挥发产物。表面改性调整最表层，为后续界面服务；化学基团、材料表面、衬底的变化用于后续键合。
paragraphs.en: Resist removal removes organics while protecting underlying layers; before/after resist/target/substrate diagrams show plasma removal and volatile products. Surface modification changes the top surface for later interfaces; chemical groups on material/substrate prepare for bonding.

paragraphs.zh: 效率、均匀性与损伤一起管理，控制能量、输运、温度，并关注晶圆分布中的工艺窗口与损伤风险。直接路线：等离子体在晶圆附近，用于刻蚀或沉积。远程路线：上游产生等离子体，中性物种到达晶圆。热/湿法：加热或化学反应去除或改性表面。
paragraphs.en: Manage efficiency, uniformity, and damage together through energy, transport, and temperature, checking wafer distributions and damage risk. Direct plasma forms near the wafer for etch/deposition. Remote plasma forms upstream and delivers neutral species. Thermal/wet routes use heat or chemistry to remove or modify surfaces.

records.text:
认识 Plasma：让气体参与精密制造
Plasma: making gases useful for precise manufacturing
部分电离的气体，提供活性粒子与能量
Partially ionized gas supplies reactive species and energy
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
产生与作用
Generation and action
具体作用取决于气体、设备与表面反应。工艺气体（中性分子）输入后，能量输入产生中性分子、离子、自由基、电子等物种；晶圆置于加热/控温台，气体与反应产物排出。
The action depends on gas, equipment, and surface reactions. Energy input into neutral process gas generates a mixture of neutral molecules, ions, radicals, and electrons. The wafer rests on a heated/temperature-controlled stage, while gas and reaction products are exhausted.
输入能量产生多种活性粒子；电子能量较高，晶圆仍需控温；等离子体可在多道工艺中反复使用。
Energy generates multiple reactive species. High electron energy does not remove the need for wafer temperature control. Plasma can be used repeatedly across many process steps.
应用
Applications
刻蚀：去除目标材料。成膜：形成所需薄膜。去胶：清除有机胶层。改性：调整表面状态。也用于腔体清洁、等离子体掺杂。
Etch removes target material; deposition forms required films; stripping removes organic resist; modification adjusts surface condition. Plasma is also used for chamber cleaning and plasma doping.
量测反馈与边界
Feedback and scope
比较处理前后膜厚变化及有机胶层残留是否显著减少，用晶圆上的目标变化验证作用。看见发光不足以判定工艺合格。气体、温度与放电方式随工艺路线变化。
Compare film thickness and organic-resist residue before/after treatment to verify the intended wafer change. Visible glow alone does not establish process acceptance. Gases, temperatures, and discharge methods vary with the route.

title.en: Particle roles: chemical activity and directional energy

records.text:
粒子分工：化学活性与定向能量
Particle roles: chemical activity and directional energy
电子帮助产生粒子，自由基参与反应，离子传递能量
Electrons generate species, radicals react, ions transfer energy
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
各类粒子的机制
Particle mechanisms
电子通过碰撞推动气体分子的激发、解离、电离。自由基是中性活性物种，参与表面化学反应。正离子在表面附近的电势过渡区（鞘层）获得能量，促进反应或轰击。光子也可能参与反应或引入损伤。图中层次为材料表面、薄膜层、衬底。
Electron collisions excite, dissociate, and ionize gas molecules. Radicals are reactive neutral species participating in surface chemistry. Positive ions gain energy in the near-surface potential transition (sheath), promoting reactions or bombardment. Photons may also react or cause damage. The stack labels material surface, film, substrate.
协同作用与风险
Synergy and risks
自由基提供化学活性，正离子提供定向能量，共同促成表面反应与材料去除。活性供给与能量输入需要配合；过强轰击、充电或辐射可能损伤材料与器件。
Radicals supply chemical activity and positive ions supply directional energy, together driving surface reaction/removal. Reactive supply and energy input must match; excessive bombardment, charging, or radiation can damage materials/devices.
气体与结构的影响
Effects of gas and geometry
气体种类与压力改变电子碰撞、自由基生成、离子能量分布。结构与几何形貌通过遮蔽和传输效应，使不同位置各类物种的作用占比不同。
Gas species/pressure alter electron collisions, radical generation, and ion-energy distribution. Geometry causes shadowing/transport effects that change relative species contributions at different locations.
量测反馈
Metrology feedback
比较加工前后厚度变化（去除速率），检查截面侧壁、底部和表面形貌。加工结果用于验证效果；机理归因需结合放电诊断。
Compare before/after thickness for removal rate, and inspect sidewall, bottom, and surface profiles. Processed-wafer results verify outcomes; mechanism attribution also requires discharge diagnostics.

records.text:
图形刻蚀：把图形转移到目标层
Pattern etching: transferring into the target layer
去除速率、方向性、选择比和轮廓共同受控
Control removal rate, directionality, selectivity, and profile together
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
流程与 RIE
Flow and RIE
带掩膜晶圆进腔 → 通气与放电 → 表面反应 → 轮廓控制 → 产物排出 → 终点与检查。RIE（反应性离子刻蚀）结合化学反应与离子作用。
Load masked wafer → supply gas/discharge → surface reaction → profile control → product exhaust → endpoint/inspection. Reactive-ion etching (RIE) combines chemistry and ion action.
图示标注：正离子、中性自由基（多方向入射）、挥发产物；掩膜/目标层/停止层；侧壁保护抑制侧向刻蚀；底部去除由离子与化学反应共同完成。
Diagram labels: positive ions, neutral radicals arriving from multiple directions, volatile products; mask/target/stop layer; sidewall protection suppresses lateral etch; ions plus chemistry remove the bottom.
控制与风险
Controls and risks
气体控制反应与钝化，偏压控制离子能量，压力控制输运与碰撞，温度影响反应与挥发。偏压过低可能去除不足，过高可能增加掩膜消耗与底层损伤。
Gas controls reaction/passivation; bias controls ion energy; pressure controls transport/collisions; temperature affects reactions/volatility. Too little bias can under-remove; too much can consume masks and damage lower layers.
常见形貌：侧蚀（侧向去除）、底部残留（去除不完全）、微沟槽（底部两侧深蚀）。侧壁保护随化学体系变化；既有各向异性刻蚀（侧壁受保护），也有各向同性刻蚀（侧向也去除）。
Typical profiles: lateral etching, bottom residue from incomplete removal, and microtrenches deep along bottom corners. Sidewall protection depends on chemistry; etching can be anisotropic with sidewall protection or isotropic with lateral removal.
量测反馈
Metrology feedback
量测 CD（关键尺寸）、截面侧壁角与深度、片内均匀性。异常先复测并检查设备状态。轮廓会影响后续填充与接触形成。
Measure CD, cross-sectional sidewall angle/depth, and wafer uniformity. Remeasure abnormalities and inspect equipment first. Etched profiles affect subsequent fill and contact formation.

paragraphs.zh: 带掩膜晶圆进腔 → 通气与放电 → 表面反应 → 轮廓控制 → 产物排出 → 终点与检查。RIE（反应性离子刻蚀）结合化学反应与离子作用。
paragraphs.en: Load masked wafer → supply gas/discharge → surface reaction → profile control → product exhaust → endpoint/inspection. Reactive-ion etching (RIE) combines chemistry and ion action.

paragraphs.zh: 图示标注：正离子、中性自由基（多方向入射）、挥发产物；掩膜/目标层/停止层；侧壁保护抑制侧向刻蚀；底部去除由离子与化学反应共同完成。
paragraphs.en: Diagram labels: positive ions, neutral radicals arriving from multiple directions, volatile products; mask/target/stop layer; sidewall protection suppresses lateral etch; ions plus chemistry remove the bottom.

paragraphs.zh: 气体控制反应与钝化，偏压控制离子能量，压力控制输运与碰撞，温度影响反应与挥发。偏压过低可能去除不足，过高可能增加掩膜消耗与底层损伤。
paragraphs.en: Gas controls reaction/passivation; bias controls ion energy; pressure controls transport/collisions; temperature affects reactions/volatility. Too little bias can under-remove; too much can consume masks and damage lower layers.

paragraphs.zh: 常见形貌：侧蚀（侧向去除）、底部残留（去除不完全）、微沟槽（底部两侧深蚀）。侧壁保护随化学体系变化；既有各向异性刻蚀（侧壁受保护），也有各向同性刻蚀（侧向也去除）。
paragraphs.en: Typical profiles: lateral etching, bottom residue from incomplete removal, and microtrenches deep along bottom corners. Sidewall protection depends on chemistry; etching can be anisotropic with sidewall protection or isotropic with lateral removal.

paragraphs.zh: 量测 CD（关键尺寸）、截面侧壁角与深度、片内均匀性。异常先复测并检查设备状态。轮廓会影响后续填充与接触形成。
paragraphs.en: Measure CD, cross-sectional sidewall angle/depth, and wafer uniformity. Remeasure abnormalities and inspect equipment first. Etched profiles affect subsequent fill and contact formation.

description.zh: 去除速率、方向性、选择比和轮廓共同受控
description.en: Control removal rate, directionality, selectivity, and profile together

title.zh: 薄膜沉积：等离子体也能帮助长膜
title.en: Deposition: plasma can also grow films

records.text:
薄膜沉积：等离子体也能帮助长膜
Deposition: plasma can also grow films
化学活化与靶材溅射，是不同的成膜路径
Chemical activation and target sputtering are distinct deposition routes
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
成膜或去膜的判断
Growth versus removal
长膜还是去膜，取决于材料供给与表面净反应。
Net growth versus removal depends on material supply and the net surface reaction.
PECVD
PECVD
等离子体增强化学气相沉积：气体前驱体供给 → 等离子体活化 → 晶圆表面长膜 → 挥发副产物排出。在适合体系中，可降低相对热 CVD 的成膜温度。
Plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition: supply gaseous precursor → activate with plasma → grow film on wafer → exhaust volatile byproducts. Suitable systems can lower growth temperature relative to thermal CVD.
PEALD
PEALD
等离子体增强原子层沉积以脉冲供给前驱体，循环执行：前驱体吸附 → 吹扫 → 等离子体表面反应 → 吹扫。通过自限表面反应逐周期控制生长。
Plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition supplies precursor pulses in cycles: adsorption → purge → plasma surface reaction → purge. Self-limiting reactions control growth cycle by cycle.
溅射 PVD
Sputter PVD
物理气相沉积的一类：Ar⁺ 轰击靶材 → 溅出材料飞行 → 到达晶圆表面 → 形成薄膜。供给、等离子体条件、温度、暴露时间需匹配；降低温度后仍要验证杂质、致密性与应力。
A physical vapor deposition route: Ar⁺ bombards target → sputtered material travels → reaches wafer → forms film. Match supply, plasma conditions, temperature, and exposure time; lower temperatures still require impurity, density, and stress validation.
量测与适用边界
Metrology and limits
量测膜厚图、成分或键合状态、应力（晶圆曲率）；按用途追加电阻或漏电验证。三条路线的步骤和覆盖能力不能通用；PEALD 需验证深结构输运与表面饱和。
Measure thickness maps, composition/bonding state, and stress through wafer curvature; add resistance or leakage validation as needed. The three routes do not share interchangeable steps/coverage capabilities; PEALD requires verification of deep-feature transport and surface saturation.

title.zh: 去胶清洗：去掉目标物，也要保护底层
title.en: Stripping and cleaning: remove targets while protecting underlayers

records.text:
去胶清洗：去掉目标物，也要保护底层
Stripping and cleaning: remove targets while protecting underlayers
分清大量去胶、薄残胶清除与刻后残留处理
Distinguish bulk stripping, descum, and post-etch residue removal
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
灰化/去胶与 Descum
Ashing/stripping versus descum
灰化/去胶去除主体有机胶层，将有机物转为挥发性产物并排出。Descum 仅清除显影后开口底部的薄残胶，保留光刻胶图形。图中下层为目标层和衬底。
Ashing/stripping removes bulk organic resist by converting it to volatile products and exhausting them. Descum removes only thin residual resist at developed opening bottoms while retaining the resist pattern. Underlayers are target and substrate.
主机制与典型流程
Mechanism and flow
氧活性物种使有机组分转化为可排出的挥发性产物。流程：辨认胶与底层 → 选择化学体系 → 控制温度与暴露 → 必要后清洗 → 检查残留与膜损失。控制化学体系、温度、处理时间、离子暴露。
Reactive oxygen converts organic material into exhaustible volatile products. Flow: identify resist/underlayer → choose chemistry → control temperature/exposure → post-clean if needed → inspect residue/film loss. Control chemistry, temperature, treatment time, and ion exposure.
风险与边界
Risks and limits
风险：金属氧化、底层材料损失、含碳低 k 介质损伤。刻后残留可能含有机物、无机物或金属组分，需要选择干法、湿法或组合路线。
Risks: metal oxidation, underlayer loss, damage to carbon-containing low-k dielectrics. Post-etch residue can include organics, inorganics, or metals, requiring dry, wet, or combined removal.
量测反馈
Metrology feedback
以表面形貌看残留缺陷、表面成分辨认残留类型、膜厚变化评估底层膜损失。异常先复核残留类型与材料相容性。要同时满足残留去除与材料保护，为后续接触和成膜提供合适表面。
Use surface morphology to inspect residue defects, composition to identify residue type, and thickness change to assess underlayer loss. First recheck residue type and material compatibility when abnormal. Meet both residue removal and material-protection goals to prepare surfaces for contacts/deposition.

title.zh: 表面改性：为下一道界面做好准备
title.en: Surface modification: preparing the next interface

records.text:
表面改性：为下一道界面做好准备
Surface modification: preparing the next interface
调整表面化学状态，关注后续成膜与键合结果
Tune surface chemistry and verify later deposition/bonding
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
核心判断
Core concept
改变最表层反应能力与界面条件。处理前的表面基团，经受控等离子体活化改变反应位点，产生新的表面基团与改性表面，为后续界面服务。结构标注介质材料、衬底。
Change the topmost surface reactivity and interface conditions. Controlled plasma activation modifies reaction sites and surface groups, preparing a modified surface for the next interface. Labels include dielectric material and substrate.
典型流程与参数
Typical flow and parameters
以适用的介质直接键合为例：前清洗 → 受控活化 → 按路线准备表面 → 规定等待时间内贴合 → 热处理与验证。关键参数：气体组成、能量输入、暴露时间、处理后等待时间。
For suitable dielectric direct bonding: preclean → controlled activation → route-specific surface preparation → contact within the specified wait time → thermal treatment/validation. Parameters: gas composition, energy input, exposure time, post-treatment wait.
权衡与风险
Trade-offs and risks
活化需配合颗粒、粗糙度和平坦度控制，保持表面平整洁净。过度处理可能粗糙化或损伤材料。污染与状态漂移可能在上下介质界面形成键合空洞，导致强度不稳。
Activation must accompany particle, roughness, and flatness control for clean, flat surfaces. Overtreatment can roughen or damage materials. Contamination/state drift can create voids at the dielectric interface and unstable bond strength.
量测与最终验证
Metrology and final validation
量测接触角、表面成分、粗糙度，最终验证键合空洞与键合强度。接触角仅表征润湿状态的一部分；不同介质、混合键合与金属界面要求不同。
Measure contact angle, surface composition, and roughness, then validate bond voids/strength. Contact angle captures only part of wetting behavior; requirements differ among dielectrics, hybrid bonding, and metal interfaces.

Contact angle captures only part of the wetting state
Different dielectrics, hybrid bonding and metal interfaces have different requirements

paragraphs.zh: 改变最表层反应能力与界面条件。处理前的表面基团，经受控等离子体活化改变反应位点，产生新的表面基团与改性表面，为后续界面服务。结构标注介质材料、衬底。
paragraphs.en: Change the topmost surface reactivity and interface conditions. Controlled plasma activation modifies reaction sites and surface groups, preparing a modified surface for the next interface. Labels include dielectric material and substrate.

paragraphs.zh: 以适用的介质直接键合为例：前清洗 → 受控活化 → 按路线准备表面 → 规定等待时间内贴合 → 热处理与验证。关键参数：气体组成、能量输入、暴露时间、处理后等待时间。
paragraphs.en: For suitable dielectric direct bonding: preclean → controlled activation → route-specific surface preparation → contact within the specified wait time → thermal treatment/validation. Parameters: gas composition, energy input, exposure time, post-treatment wait.

paragraphs.zh: 活化需配合颗粒、粗糙度和平坦度控制，保持表面平整洁净。过度处理可能粗糙化或损伤材料。污染与状态漂移可能在上下介质界面形成键合空洞，导致强度不稳。
paragraphs.en: Activation must accompany particle, roughness, and flatness control for clean, flat surfaces. Overtreatment can roughen or damage materials. Contamination/state drift can create voids at the dielectric interface and unstable bond strength.

paragraphs.zh: 量测接触角、表面成分、粗糙度，最终验证键合空洞与键合强度。接触角仅表征润湿状态的一部分；不同介质、混合键合与金属界面要求不同。
paragraphs.en: Measure contact angle, surface composition, and roughness, then validate bond voids/strength. Contact angle captures only part of wetting behavior; requirements differ among dielectrics, hybrid bonding, and metal interfaces.

description.zh: 调整表面化学状态，关注后续成膜与键合结果
description.en: Tune surface chemistry and verify later deposition/bonding

title.zh: 损伤控制：把效率与器件结果一起管
title.en: Damage control: manage efficiency and device outcomes together

records.text:
损伤控制：把效率与器件结果一起管
Damage control: manage efficiency and device outcomes together
活性粒子、离子能量、输运和热负荷共同决定窗口
Reactive species, ion energy, transport, and heat load jointly set the window
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
四类控制输入
Four control inputs
气体组成与供给：反应物种、钝化、选择性。源功率与偏压：放电/粒子产生与离子能量，仍可能耦合。压力与输运：碰撞、到达方向、产物排出。晶圆温度与暴露：吸附、反应、累积热负荷；图中标有热传导与热辐射。
Gas composition/supply controls species, passivation, selectivity. Source power/bias controls discharge/species generation and ion energy, which may remain coupled. Pressure/transport controls collisions, arrival direction, exhaust. Wafer temperature/exposure controls adsorption, reactions, accumulated heat; conduction/radiation are illustrated.
损伤机制
Damage mechanisms
物理轰击：高能离子造成表面和近表面缺陷，并产生溅射产物。充电：等离子体使正离子/电子电荷积累，引发电场与薄介质损伤。活性物种与 UV/VUV（紫外/真空紫外）：引发表面反应、键断裂、材料及界面变化。需检查片内分布，关注漏电和可靠性。
Physical bombardment: high-energy ions create surface/near-surface defects and sputtered products. Charging: ion/electron accumulation induces electric fields and thin-dielectric damage. Reactive species and UV/VUV trigger surface reactions, bond breaking, and material/interface changes. Check wafer distributions, leakage, and reliability.
量测反馈与处置
Feedback and actions
过程信号 + 晶圆结果 + 电学验证。速率、形貌、均匀性、材料损失与可靠性需同时满足。OES 用于趋势与适用终点；RF 电压/电流反映放电状态；分布图与监控结构反映实际结果。
Combine process signals, wafer results, and electrical validation. Meet rate, profile, uniformity, material-loss, and reliability requirements together. OES supports trends/applicable endpoint detection; RF voltage/current indicates discharge state; maps/monitor structures show actual results.
复测 → 按风险暂扣 → 设备检查与根因分析 → 验证后恢复。光强不能直接等同于粒子密度；远程放电仍需评估离子、光子与化学损伤。
Remeasure → hold according to risk → inspect equipment/analyze cause → resume after validation. Optical intensity is not directly particle density; remote discharge still requires ion, photon, and chemical-damage assessment.

title.zh: 工艺选择：先看任务，再选等离子体路线
title.en: Route selection: define the task before selecting plasma

records.text:
工艺选择：先看任务，再选等离子体路线
Route selection: define the task before selecting plasma
方向性、材料相容性、热预算和损伤预算一起考虑
Consider directionality, compatibility, thermal budget, and damage budget
Plasma
FEOL BEOL 刻蚀 Etch 沉积 Deposition 表面处理 Surface treatment
核心判断
Core judgment
从目标结构与材料约束出发，由晶圆和器件验证决定路线。
Start from target structure/material constraints and decide using wafer/device validation.
直接等离子体加工
Direct plasma processing
射频电极在晶圆附近放电产生离子与中性物种，正离子定向轰击晶圆。适合需要离子能量或方向性的任务，如典型 RIE；需控制充电、轰击、辐射和材料损失。直接放电也可用于成膜。
An RF electrode generates ions/neutral species near the wafer; positive ions bombard directionally. Suitable for tasks needing ion energy/directionality, such as typical RIE; control charging, bombardment, radiation, material loss. Direct discharge also supports deposition.
远程等离子体处理
Remote plasma treatment
上游远程放电源产生等离子体，经管道输运，使中性活性物种到达表面。适当结构可减少直接离子暴露，利用活性物种反应；输运与复合可能限制到达量。减少离子暴露后仍需验证损伤。
An upstream source generates plasma and transports reactive neutrals through a line to the surface. Suitable geometry reduces direct ion exposure while using reactive chemistry; transport/recombination may limit delivery. Reduced ion exposure still requires damage validation.
热反应/湿法等路线
Thermal/wet alternatives
加热晶圆进行热反应，或使用化学溶液进行湿法处理。化学与热预算适合时，可规避部分等离子体损伤机制，但仍受温度、选择性、形貌与界面条件限制。
Heat wafers for thermal reactions or use chemical solutions for wet processing. When chemistry/thermal budget permit, these avoid some plasma-damage mechanisms but remain constrained by temperature, selectivity, profile, interfaces.
选择流程与量测反馈
Selection and feedback
依次判断：要去除、成膜还是改性？是否需要方向性与离子能量？暴露材料能承受什么？深结构输运和产物排出可行吗？量测与器件验证通过吗？
Ask in sequence: removal, deposition, or modification? Is directionality/ion energy needed? What can exposed materials tolerate? Are deep-feature transport/exhaust feasible? Do metrology/device validation pass?
按任务比较线宽与截面、膜厚与膜质、残留与材料损失、电学或键合结果，同时评价均匀性、重复性与产能。直接/远程描述放电区与晶圆的关系，同一流程可组合多条路线。
Compare linewidth/cross-section, thickness/film quality, residue/material loss, electrical/bonding outcomes, along with uniformity, repeatability, throughput. Direct/remote describe discharge-to-wafer geometry; one flow can combine routes.

title.zh: 一张图看懂 VDMOS
title.en: VDMOS at a glance

records.text:
一张图看懂 VDMOS
VDMOS at a glance
双扩散工艺 → 器件机理 → 功率开关
Double diffusion → device mechanism → power switching
VDMOS
FEOL 垂直器件 Vertical device MOSFET 漂移区 Drift region
适用结构
Structure covered
传统硅基 N 沟道、平面栅结构。栅极控制表面沟道，主导电路径穿过芯片厚度。
Conventional silicon N-channel planar-gate VDMOS: the gate controls a surface channel and the main conduction path crosses the chip thickness.
从工艺看结构形成
How processing forms the structure
1. 衬底与外延：N⁺ 衬底低阻导电，N⁻ 漂移区轻掺杂并支撑耐压。2. 栅氧与栅极：SiO₂ 氧化层绝缘，多晶硅栅极施加电场。3. P 体区形成：注入与扩散形成体区。4. N⁺ 源区形成：两种扩散轮廓共同定义沟道。5. 接触与金属：正面源—体短接，背面漏极；金属分别标 S、D。
1. Substrate/epitaxy: N⁺ substrate gives low-resistance conduction; lightly doped N⁻ drift region supports voltage. 2. Gate oxide/gate: SiO₂ insulates and polysilicon gate applies field. 3. Form P-body by implantation/diffusion. 4. Form N⁺ source; two diffusion profiles jointly define the channel. 5. Contacts/metal: short source to body on top, drain on back; metal labels S/D.
这是代表性流程，实际顺序随工艺平台变化。工艺反馈：外延厚度与掺杂、结深与片阻、栅氧厚度。
This is a representative flow; actual sequence depends on platform. Process feedback: epitaxial thickness/doping, junction depth/sheet resistance, gate-oxide thickness.
各区域作用
Roles of each region
栅极 G：电场控制沟道。栅氧：隔开栅与硅。N⁺ 源区：电子入口。P 体区：沟道形成区。源极 S：连接源区与体区。反型沟道：电子通路。JFET 区：导电路径收窄。N⁻ 漂移区：支撑耐压。N⁺ 衬底：低阻导电基础。漏极 D：背面电极。
Gate G controls channel electrostatically; oxide separates gate and Si. N⁺ source is the electron entry; P-body hosts the channel; source S connects source/body. The inversion channel carries electrons; the JFET region narrows the path; N⁻ drift supports voltage; N⁺ substrate provides low-resistance conduction; drain D is the rear electrode.
橙色箭头表示电子从两侧流入，再向下至漏极。表面形成沟道，内部承担耐压，背面连接漏极。
Orange arrows show electrons entering from both sides and then moving downward to the drain. The channel forms at the surface, the interior supports voltage, and the drain connects at the rear.
导通与关断
On and off states
导通：足够的正栅源电压形成反型沟道，路径为 N⁺ 源区 → 沟道 → JFET 区 → 漂移区 → 漏极。Vth 仅代表开始形成沟道，不等于充分导通。
On: sufficient positive gate–source voltage forms an inversion channel; path: N⁺ source → channel → JFET region → drift → drain. Vth marks channel onset, not full enhancement.
关断：沟道消失，体区—漂移区结反偏，耗尽区主要向轻掺杂 N⁻ 漂移区扩展；边缘终端管理电场，避免提前击穿。漂移区更厚、掺杂更低，通常耐压提高，导通电阻也增加。
Off: channel disappears, body–drift junction is reverse biased, depletion expands mainly into lightly doped N⁻ drift. Edge termination manages field to prevent premature breakdown. Thicker/lower-doped drift usually increases voltage capability and on-resistance.
性能取舍与电性反馈
Performance trade-offs and feedback
R_DS(on) ≈ 沟道电阻 + 积累区电阻 + JFET 区电阻 + 漂移区电阻 + 衬底及接触电阻。导通损耗 ≈ I²R_DS(on)；开关过程电压与电流重叠产生损耗。原图还提示电阻、电容与栅电荷同时受到影响，该条开头小字待复核。
R_DS(on) ≈ channel + accumulation + JFET + drift + substrate/contact resistances. Conduction loss ≈ I²R_DS(on); voltage/current overlap causes switching loss. The source also notes simultaneous effects on resistance, capacitance, and gate charge; the opening small-print words of that item require verification.
电性反馈：Vth、指定栅压与温度下的 R_DS(on)、击穿电压、漏电电流、栅电荷 Q_g。
Electrical feedback: Vth, R_DS(on) at specified gate voltage/temperature, breakdown voltage, leakage current, gate charge Q_g.
寄生效应与用途
Parasitics and applications
体二极管位于源侧阳极与漏侧阴极之间，由 P 体区—N⁻ 漂移区结形成，需关注反向恢复。N⁺ 源区—P 体区—N⁻ 漂移区可形成寄生 NPN，分别对应发射极、基极、集电极；源—体短接有助于抑制触发。
The body diode has its anode at source and cathode at drain, formed by the P-body/N⁻ drift junction; consider reverse recovery. N⁺ source/P-body/N⁻ drift forms a parasitic NPN emitter/base/collector; source–body shorting helps suppress triggering.
驱动器根据控制信号控制栅极 G，VDMOS 通过 D–S 通路开关负载电流。图示负载为电机、灯等，电源正端经负载到 D，S 接电源负端。用途：电机控制、灯光调节、开关电源。
A driver applies control signals to gate G; VDMOS switches load current through D–S. In the diagram the positive supply feeds a motor/lamp load then D, with S tied to negative supply. Uses: motor control, lighting control, switching power supplies.

paragraphs.zh: 传统硅基 N 沟道、平面栅结构。栅极控制表面沟道，主导电路径穿过芯片厚度。
paragraphs.en: Conventional silicon N-channel planar-gate VDMOS: the gate controls a surface channel and the main conduction path crosses the chip thickness.

paragraphs.zh: 1. 衬底与外延：N⁺ 衬底低阻导电，N⁻ 漂移区轻掺杂并支撑耐压。2. 栅氧与栅极：SiO₂ 氧化层绝缘，多晶硅栅极施加电场。3. P 体区形成：注入与扩散形成体区。4. N⁺ 源区形成：两种扩散轮廓共同定义沟道。5. 接触与金属：正面源—体短接，背面漏极；金属分别标 S、D。
paragraphs.en: 1. Substrate/epitaxy: N⁺ substrate gives low-resistance conduction; lightly doped N⁻ drift region supports voltage. 2. Gate oxide/gate: SiO₂ insulates and polysilicon gate applies field. 3. Form P-body by implantation/diffusion. 4. Form N⁺ source; two diffusion profiles jointly define the channel. 5. Contacts/metal: short source to body on top, drain on back; metal labels S/D.

paragraphs.zh: 这是代表性流程，实际顺序随工艺平台变化。工艺反馈：外延厚度与掺杂、结深与片阻、栅氧厚度。
paragraphs.en: This is a representative flow; actual sequence depends on platform. Process feedback: epitaxial thickness/doping, junction depth/sheet resistance, gate-oxide thickness.

paragraphs.zh: 栅极 G：电场控制沟道。栅氧：隔开栅与硅。N⁺ 源区：电子入口。P 体区：沟道形成区。源极 S：连接源区与体区。反型沟道：电子通路。JFET 区：导电路径收窄。N⁻ 漂移区：支撑耐压。N⁺ 衬底：低阻导电基础。漏极 D：背面电极。
paragraphs.en: Gate G controls channel electrostatically; oxide separates gate and Si. N⁺ source is the electron entry; P-body hosts the channel; source S connects source/body. The inversion channel carries electrons; the JFET region narrows the path; N⁻ drift supports voltage; N⁺ substrate provides low-resistance conduction; drain D is the rear electrode.

paragraphs.zh: 橙色箭头表示电子从两侧流入，再向下至漏极。表面形成沟道，内部承担耐压，背面连接漏极。
paragraphs.en: Orange arrows show electrons entering from both sides and then moving downward to the drain. The channel forms at the surface, the interior supports voltage, and the drain connects at the rear.

paragraphs.zh: 导通：足够的正栅源电压形成反型沟道，路径为 N⁺ 源区 → 沟道 → JFET 区 → 漂移区 → 漏极。Vth 仅代表开始形成沟道，不等于充分导通。

一张图看懂 OCD 量测
OCD metrology at a glance
从光学响应到模型反演与工艺选择
From optical response to model inversion and method selection
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
01 量测定位与 02 光学机理
01 Position and 02 optical mechanism
先测光学响应，再反演结构：晶圆周期测试图形 → 实测光谱（反射率—波长）→ 模型反演截面。结构与材料共同改变光响应；入射光产生镜面反射与可选级次的衍射光。
Measure optical response first, then infer structure: periodic wafer target → measured reflectance-versus-wavelength spectrum → model-inverted cross-section. Structure and materials jointly alter optical response, including specular reflection and selectable diffraction orders.
03 目标结构与 04 模型建立
03 Targets and 04 models
测试图形要匹配模型与光斑。图示匹配光栅的完整光斑，以及边缘混入周边结构的非理想情况。几何与材料假设决定解释方式，模型包含 CD、高度、侧壁角、层堆栈。
Targets must match model and optical spot. The figure contrasts a matched grating/spot with unwanted neighboring structures entering the spot edge. Geometry/material assumptions define interpretation, including CD, height, sidewall angle, and stack.
05 参数反演与 06 可信验证
05 Inversion and 06 validation
找到匹配不等于找到唯一答案：不同模型 A/B 与参数组合可能产生相似实测光谱。重复性、偏差和不确定度要分开看；图示一种重复好但偏离参考，另一种重复好且接近参考，坐标为参考值和量测结果。
A match is not necessarily unique: different models A/B and parameter combinations may yield similar spectra. Separate repeatability, bias, uncertainty; plots compare repeatable-but-biased results with repeatable results near the reference, using reference and measured axes.
07 异常诊断与 08 方法选择
07 Diagnosis and 08 selection
异常要区分定位/设备问题、模型问题、真实工艺变化。按控制问题组合 OCD（光学量测）、CD-SEM（电子显微镜）、AFM/截面方法（形貌量测）。
Distinguish positioning/equipment issues, model issues, and true process changes. Combine OCD (optical), CD-SEM (electron microscopy), and AFM/cross-section morphology methods according to the control problem.

paragraphs.zh: 先测光学响应，再反演结构：晶圆周期测试图形 → 实测光谱（反射率—波长）→ 模型反演截面。结构与材料共同改变光响应；入射光产生镜面反射与可选级次的衍射光。
paragraphs.en: Measure optical response first, then infer structure: periodic wafer target → measured reflectance-versus-wavelength spectrum → model-inverted cross-section. Structure and materials jointly alter optical response, including specular reflection and selectable diffraction orders.

paragraphs.zh: 测试图形要匹配模型与光斑。图示匹配光栅的完整光斑，以及边缘混入周边结构的非理想情况。几何与材料假设决定解释方式，模型包含 CD、高度、侧壁角、层堆栈。
paragraphs.en: Targets must match model and optical spot. The figure contrasts a matched grating/spot with unwanted neighboring structures entering the spot edge. Geometry/material assumptions define interpretation, including CD, height, sidewall angle, and stack.

paragraphs.zh: 找到匹配不等于找到唯一答案：不同模型 A/B 与参数组合可能产生相似实测光谱。重复性、偏差和不确定度要分开看；图示一种重复好但偏离参考，另一种重复好且接近参考，坐标为参考值和量测结果。
paragraphs.en: A match is not necessarily unique: different models A/B and parameter combinations may yield similar spectra. Separate repeatability, bias, uncertainty; plots compare repeatable-but-biased results with repeatable results near the reference, using reference and measured axes.

paragraphs.zh: 异常要区分定位/设备问题、模型问题、真实工艺变化。按控制问题组合 OCD（光学量测）、CD-SEM（电子显微镜）、AFM/截面方法（形貌量测）。
paragraphs.en: Distinguish positioning/equipment issues, model issues, and true process changes. Combine OCD (optical), CD-SEM (electron microscopy), and AFM/cross-section morphology methods according to the control problem.

title.en: Positioning OCD: measure optical response, then infer structure

records.text:
量测定位：先测光学响应，再反演结构
Positioning OCD: measure optical response, then infer structure
分清直接观测量与模型提取量
Distinguish direct observations from model-extracted quantities
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
核心判断
Core judgment
仪器采集光学响应；CD、高度等是模型提取结果。通用晶圆周期图形 → 实测光学响应随波长变化的曲线 → 模型 → 反演截面（CD、高度）。
The instrument collects optical response; CD/height are model-extracted results. Periodic wafer target → measured response versus wavelength → model → inverted cross-section/CD/height.
流程位置与完整流程
Process position and complete flow
用于光刻、刻蚀等图形控制节点，并连接后续工艺。流程：明确需要解决的图形控制问题 → 选择量测位置与目标结构 → 仪器采集光学响应 → 模型反演结构参数 → 验证结果并反馈图形控制。
Used at lithography/etch pattern-control nodes and linked to subsequent processing. Flow: define pattern-control issue → select position/target → collect optical response → invert structural parameters → validate and feed back to pattern control.
关键控制
Key controls
目标位置需准确并匹配图形；响应需有足够信号质量；模型需在适用范围内；CD、高度等需有明确尺寸定义。
Locate the correct target accurately; ensure adequate signal quality; remain within model applicability; explicitly define CD, height, and other dimensions.
耦合与失效
Coupling and failure
结构与材料共同影响入射光的反射/散射响应。量测位置错位、目标区域污染、实际结构与模型失配，都可能造成异常。
Structure and materials jointly affect reflected/scattered response. Mispositioning, target contamination, and mismatch between actual structure/model can cause anomalies.
量测反馈与边界
Feedback and scope
综合原始响应、拟合残差（随波长）、提取参数判断可靠性。异常先复测并核查定位、目标状态、模型是否匹配。输出参数支持工艺监控、图形优化与异常分析，但 CD、高度等必须经过可识别性与准确性验证。
Assess reliability using raw response, wavelength-dependent fit residuals, and extracted parameters. Remeasure anomalies and check location, target condition, model match. Outputs support process monitoring, pattern optimization, anomaly analysis, but CD/height require identifiability and accuracy validation.

title.zh: 光学机理：结构与材料共同改变光响应
title.en: Optical mechanism: geometry and materials change the response

records.text:
光学机理：结构与材料共同改变光响应
Optical mechanism: geometry and materials change the response
波长、角度与偏振提供不同信息
Wavelength, angle, and polarization provide different information
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
周期光栅的光响应
Optical response of periodic gratings
几何和材料改变电磁响应，是尺寸反演的基础。斜入射光对平行周期光栅作用，入射角与镜面反射角相对法线均为 θ；还有其他衍射方向。较大与较小高宽比结构呈现不同光学响应—波长曲线，响应形式依设备配置而变。
Geometry/materials alter electromagnetic response, enabling dimensional inversion. Oblique light interacts with a periodic parallel grating; incident/specular angles are θ relative to normal, with other diffraction directions. High/low aspect-ratio structures show different response-versus-wavelength curves; response type depends on equipment configuration.
配置选择与灵敏度分析
Configuration and sensitivity analysis
照明条件（波长、角度、偏振）→ 结构相互作用（几何与材料改变电磁响应）→ 收集不同方向光信号 → 形成随条件变化的响应数据 → 评估对结构参数的灵敏度。
Illumination wavelength/angle/polarization → geometry/material interaction → collect signals from different directions → response data across conditions → assess structural-parameter sensitivity.
关键控制与权衡
Controls and trade-offs
波长范围提供不同信息；入射角改变相互作用；偏振激发不同响应；材料光学常数影响电磁响应。增加数据维度可能改善参数区分，但不保证全部可识别。弱灵敏度、校准偏差、材料误差都会影响结果。
Wavelength range provides different information; angle changes interaction; polarization excites different responses; optical constants affect electromagnetic behavior. More data dimensions can improve parameter separation without guaranteeing identifiability. Weak sensitivity, calibration bias, and material errors affect results.
量测反馈与边界
Feedback and scope
检查响应稳定性、噪声与灵敏度，判断配置是否提供有效信息，并影响模型能力。不同设备响应形式不同，不能把所有 OCD 都描述为只测高阶衍射。
Check response stability, noise, and sensitivity to judge useful information and model capability. Equipment configurations differ; OCD cannot universally be described as measuring only higher diffraction orders.

title.zh: 目标结构：测试图形要匹配模型与光斑
title.en: Targets: matching test patterns to model and optical spot

records.text:
目标结构：测试图形要匹配模型与光斑
Targets: matching test patterns to model and optical spot
位置、尺寸、周期性与代表性共同决定可测性
Position, size, periodicity, and representativeness determine measurability
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
核心判断
Core judgment
常见 OCD 目标采用周期结构，目标需可测且能代表关注的工艺。图示规则矩形光栅，比较光斑完整在目标内部与边缘混入周边结构。
Common OCD targets are periodic and must be measurable and representative of the relevant process. Rectangular gratings illustrate a spot fully inside the target versus contamination by neighboring structures at the edge.
流程与控制
Flow and controls
用于测试结构设计、版图整合与选点。流程：结构问题 → 设计目标 → 光斑覆盖 → 对应模型 → 代表性验证。关键控制：目标面积、节距与方向、周边结构、与产品结构的对应关系。
Used in target design, layout integration, and site selection. Flow: structural issue → target design → spot coverage → matching model → representativeness validation. Control target area, pitch/orientation, surroundings, and correspondence to product structures.
权衡与失效
Trade-offs and failure
规整目标便于建模，但可能与产品环境不同。风险包括边缘混入、定位偏差、目标损伤、代表性不足。
Regular targets simplify modeling but can differ from product environments. Risks include edge contamination, positioning error, target damage, inadequate representativeness.
反馈与边界
Feedback and scope
核查目标位置、重复测量、目标间相关性；必要时与产品结构表征比较。目标代表性决定工艺判断能否迁移到产品，测试光栅不等于产品全部结构。
Check location, repeated measurements, inter-target correlation; compare with product characterization when needed. Representativeness determines whether process conclusions transfer to products; a test grating is not the entire product structure.

records.text:
模型建立：几何与材料假设决定解释方式
Model building: geometry and material assumptions define interpretation
将真实结构转为可计算、可验证的参数模型
Turn real structures into computable, verifiable parameter models
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
模型核心
Model essentials
保留影响响应的关键特征，避免无依据增加自由参数。图示顶部 CD、底部 CD、高度、侧壁角、层堆栈与材料光学常数 n/k（随波长变化）。几何存在约束关系，不应全部独立拟合。
Retain response-relevant features without unjustified free parameters. Labels include top/bottom CD, height, sidewall angle, stack, wavelength-dependent optical constants n/k. Geometric constraints mean these should not all be fitted independently.
开发与维护
Development and maintenance
堆栈与形貌 → 几何参数 → 材料 n/k → 电磁计算 → 灵敏度与参考验证。关键控制为层堆栈、几何参数化、光学常数 n/k、参数约束。
Stack/profile → geometry parameters → material n/k → electromagnetic calculation → sensitivity/reference validation. Control stack, geometric parameterization, n/k, and parameter constraints.
权衡与失效
Trade-offs and failure
过简会遗漏形貌而无法正确解释响应；过复杂会增加参数相关性，降低稳定性。漏层、错误 n/k、不合理参数约束都可能造成偏差。
Oversimplification omits profile features and misinterprets response; excessive complexity increases parameter correlation and reduces stability. Missing layers, wrong n/k, or unreasonable constraints can cause bias.
反馈与边界
Feedback and scope
检查残差形态、参考偏差和不同模型版本的参数稳定性，支持修订与重新验证。模型适用性影响跨批次可比性；结构或材料变化时，需评估旧模型是否仍适用。
Inspect residual shape, reference bias, and parameter stability across model versions to support revisions/revalidation. Applicability affects cross-lot comparability; reevaluate old models after structure/material changes.

title.zh: 参数反演：找到匹配，不等于找到唯一答案
title.en: Parameter inversion: a match is not necessarily unique

records.text:
参数反演：找到匹配，不等于找到唯一答案
Parameter inversion: a match is not necessarily unique
看拟合质量、参数相关性与物理合理性
Assess fit quality, correlation, and physical plausibility
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
核心判断与图示
Core judgment and diagrams
相似响应可能对应不同参数组合，低残差不能单独证明结构正确。图示较高结构与较低结构通过不同高度/CD 组合产生相似光学响应；紫色实线和橙色虚线为几何一/二，横轴为波长。CD—高度参数空间中的倾斜长椭圆表示相关性。
Similar responses may correspond to different parameter combinations; low residual alone does not prove structural correctness. Taller/shorter geometries with different height/CD combinations yield similar spectra: purple solid/orange dashed denote geometry 1/2 versus wavelength. Tilted elongated ellipses in CD–height space show correlation.
反演流程与控制
Inversion flow and controls
载入数据 → 范围与约束 → 搜索匹配 → 相关性与稳定性 → 验证报告。控制参数范围、噪声权重、初始条件与搜索策略、参数相关性。
Load data → ranges/constraints → search matches → correlation/stability → validation report. Control parameter ranges, noise weighting, initialization/search strategy, and correlation.
风险与反馈
Risks and feedback
参数可能相互补偿；局部最优、边界解、过度拟合、多解均是风险。综合残差、多起点结果、相关性与不确定度，判断参数是否值得报告。反演影响趋势与决策，库匹配、回归等实现都需验证。
Parameters may compensate for each other; local optima, boundary solutions, overfitting, multiple solutions are risks. Combine residuals, multi-start results, correlation, and uncertainty to decide whether a parameter should be reported. Inversion affects trends/decisions; library matching, regression, and other implementations require validation.

title.zh: 可信验证：重复性、偏差与不确定度分开看
title.en: Validation: separate repeatability, bias, and uncertainty

records.text:
可信验证：重复性、偏差与不确定度分开看
Validation: separate repeatability, bias, and uncertainty
测得稳定，还要证明接近可信参考
Stable measurements must also agree with a credible reference
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
核心判断与图示
Core judgment and diagram
高重复性不等于高准确度，模型与系统误差仍需评估。图示橙色结果重复好但有偏，蓝色结果重复好且接近参考；参考值本身也有不确定度。
High repeatability does not imply high accuracy; model/systematic errors need assessment. Orange results are repeatable but biased, blue results repeatable and close to reference; the reference itself has uncertainty.
流程位置与验证
Position and validation flow
用于方法导入、设备匹配与模型变更验收。流程：统一定义 → 重复性测试 → 参考比较 → 偏差与不确定度 → 适用范围。关键控制：重复性、系统偏差、参考不确定度、机台间匹配。
Used for method introduction, tool matching, model-change acceptance. Flow: unify definitions → repeatability tests → reference comparison → bias/uncertainty → applicability range. Control repeatability, systematic bias, reference uncertainty, tool matching.
权衡与反馈
Trade-offs and feedback
参考方法也有误差；位置、CD 高度定义、采样范围不同会产生不一致。根据残差、偏差趋势、不确定度决定通过、限制使用或重新验证。验证影响规格可信度，CD-SEM、AFM、截面需明确各自定义。
References also have error; differences in position, CD measurement-height definition, or sampling can cause disagreement. Use residuals, bias trends, uncertainty to accept, restrict use, or revalidate. Validation affects specification credibility; define CD-SEM, AFM, and cross-section measurements explicitly.

title.zh: 异常诊断：区分工艺变化与量测问题
title.en: Diagnosis: distinguish process changes from metrology problems

records.text:
异常诊断：区分工艺变化与量测问题
Diagnosis: distinguish process changes from metrology problems
连接原始信号、模型状态与工艺记录
Connect raw signals, model state, and process records
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
三条证据分支
Three evidence branches
尺寸漂移可能来自工艺，也可能来自定位、光学系统或模型。定位/设备分支检查定位、光学系统、设备状态；模型分支检查模型状态、模型与参考、残差形态；真实工艺分支检查工艺变化、材料变化、工艺记录。三方证据交叉判断。
Dimensional drift may arise from process, positioning, optical system, or model. Position/equipment branch: location, optics, tool state. Model branch: model state, reference agreement, residual shape. Process branch: actual process/material changes and records. Cross-check all three.
异常处置流程
Anomaly handling
用于在线监控异常后的判断与处置。按规则 Hold → 复测 → 根因分析。具体链路：发现异常 → 复测与定位 → 信号与设备 → 模型与参考 → 工艺记录，定位根因。
For anomalies in online monitoring: hold according to rules → remeasure → analyze cause. Detailed chain: detect anomaly → repeat/location check → signals/equipment → model/reference → process records to locate root cause.
关键控制与风险
Controls and risks
关注信号稳定性、残差形态、参数是否触边、空间与时间趋势（片内、片间、时间）。材料变化可能被误解为尺寸变化；污染、设备漂移、模型失配可能同时出现。
Monitor signal stability, residual shape, parameters hitting bounds, spatial/time trends within/across wafers and over time. Material changes may masquerade as dimension changes; contamination, equipment drift, and model mismatch may coexist.
量测反馈与边界
Feedback and scope
结合原始响应、晶圆分布、复测与交叉量测，按规则 Hold 并分析根因。目标是避免错误放行和调参；量测异常不直接等于改工艺配方。
Combine raw response, wafer maps, repeats, cross-metrology; hold by rules and investigate. Avoid incorrect release or tuning; a metrology anomaly does not automatically justify changing the process recipe.

records.text:
工艺选择：按控制问题组合量测方法
Method selection: combine metrology for the control problem
量测能力匹配结构、节拍与风险
Match capability to structure, throughput, and risk
OCD量测
FEOL BEOL 光刻 Lithography 刻蚀 Etch 散射测量 Scatterometry
核心判断与方法分工
Judgment and method roles
OCD 用于经过验证的模型化监控，其他方法补充局部图像、表面与截面信息。OCD 依赖光学灵敏度与模型，输出光谱及反演截面；图示强度—波长曲线和反演结构。
OCD provides validated model-based monitoring; other methods add local images, surface, cross-section data. OCD depends on optical sensitivity/model and yields spectra/inverted cross-sections; diagrams show intensity versus wavelength and inferred structure.
CD-SEM 提供局部图像与尺寸信息，需考虑边缘定义与电子束影响。AFM/截面补充形貌，需评估探针可达性、制样与采样限制；图示 AFM 表面轮廓和截面形貌。
CD-SEM provides local images/dimensions, with edge definition and electron-beam effects considered. AFM/cross-sections add morphology, requiring probe-access, preparation, sampling-limit assessment; diagrams show surface profiles and cross-sections.
流程位置与流程
Position and flow
用于量测方案、工艺开发与在线控制：控制问题 → 结构与指标 → 比较方法 → 交叉验证 → 采样反馈规则。
Used in metrology planning, process development, online control: control problem → structure/metrics → compare methods → cross-validate → sampling/feedback rules.
控制、风险与反馈
Controls, risks, and feedback
控制结构适用性、准确度与不确定度、采样范围、节拍与样品影响。覆盖不足、定义不一致、代表性不足可能误导控制。使用尺寸趋势、形貌证据与不确定度支持工艺验收与异常定位。
Control structural applicability, accuracy/uncertainty, sampling range, throughput/sample impact. Insufficient coverage, inconsistent definitions, poor representativeness can mislead control. Use dimension trends, morphology evidence, uncertainty for process acceptance and diagnosis.
下游与边界
Scope
按结构和风险组合方法；通用规则不能替代具体方法验证。
Combine methods according to structure/risk; generic rules cannot replace validation of the specific method.

title.en: Light and heavy doping at a glance

records.text:
一张图看懂轻掺杂与重掺杂
Light and heavy doping at a glance
从浓度、电阻到电场与工艺选择
From concentration and resistance to electric fields and process choice
轻重掺杂
FEOL 器件 Device 离子注入 Ion implantation 激活 Activation 载流子 Carrier
01 浓度定义
01 Concentration
轻重看程度，N/P看类型。N型与P型都可以轻掺杂（浓度低）或重掺杂（浓度高）；晶格图中的粒子密度仅为示意。
Light/heavy describes degree; N/P describes type. Either N-type or P-type material may be lightly or heavily doped. Particle densities in the lattice drawings are illustrative.
02 导电差异
02 Conductivity
载流子增多，也要看迁移率：σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ)。定性曲线显示，掺杂浓度增加时，载流子浓度通常增加，而杂质散射会影响迁移率。
More carriers must be considered together with mobility: σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ). The qualitative curves show carrier concentration generally increasing with doping, while impurity scattering affects mobility.
03 电场分布
03 Electric-field distribution
耗尽区宽度改变电压分布。图示重掺杂P型与轻掺杂N型结，耗尽区向轻掺杂侧伸展；下图以位置为横轴、电场强度为纵轴，均为定性示意。
Depletion width changes the voltage distribution. In the illustrated heavily doped P/lightly doped N junction, depletion extends toward the lightly doped side. The lower plot shows qualitative field strength versus position.
04 器件分工
04 Regions within a device
同一器件需要不同掺杂区：P型衬底上有重掺杂源区、重掺杂漏区、两侧轻掺杂扩展区，以及源极、漏极、栅极和栅氧化层。
A device requires different doped regions: heavily doped source/drain and lightly doped extensions in a P-type substrate, with source, drain, gate and gate oxide.
05 剂量与浓度
05 Dose and concentration
注入多少不等于最终浓度。离子束决定注入剂量；注入后与退火后的浓度—深度定性曲线不同，热处理可改变分布。
Implanted amount does not equal final concentration. The ion beam supplies the implant dose; the qualitative concentration–depth profiles differ before and after annealing because thermal treatment can change the distribution.
06 激活与退火
06 Activation and annealing
掺进去，还要形成电学作用。注入后存在晶格损伤、杂质未激活；退火后晶格修复，杂质得到电学激活。
Dopants must become electrically active. Implantation leaves lattice damage and inactive dopants; annealing repairs the lattice and activates dopants.
07 风险权衡
07 Trade-offs
电阻、电场（耐压）与漏电相互牵制，需要在多重目标间权衡。
Resistance, electric field (voltage withstand) and leakage are coupled and require trade-offs.
08 工艺选择
08 Process selection
按区域职责选择掺杂路线。离子注入控制剂量与区域，但需处理损伤；热扩散依赖源与热历程，要关注横向扩散；原位掺杂外延在生长中形成掺杂层，要控制生长与界面。
Select the doping route for each region’s role. Implantation controls dose and location but requires damage treatment. Thermal diffusion depends on the source and thermal history and requires attention to lateral diffusion. In-situ doped epitaxy forms a doped layer during growth and requires growth/interface control.

paragraphs.en: A device requires different doped regions: heavily doped source/drain and lightly doped extensions in a P-type substrate, with source, drain, gate and gate oxide.

paragraphs.zh: 注入多少不等于最终浓度。离子束决定注入剂量；注入后与退火后的浓度—深度定性曲线不同，热处理可改变分布。
paragraphs.en: Implanted amount does not equal final concentration. The ion beam supplies the implant dose; the qualitative concentration–depth profiles differ before and after annealing because thermal treatment can change the distribution.

paragraphs.zh: 掺进去，还要形成电学作用。注入后存在晶格损伤、杂质未激活；退火后晶格修复，杂质得到电学激活。
paragraphs.en: Dopants must become electrically active. Implantation leaves lattice damage and inactive dopants; annealing repairs the lattice and activates dopants.

paragraphs.zh: 电阻、电场（耐压）与漏电相互牵制，需要在多重目标间权衡。
paragraphs.en: Resistance, electric field (voltage withstand) and leakage are coupled and require trade-offs.

paragraphs.zh: 按区域职责选择掺杂路线。离子注入控制剂量与区域，但需处理损伤；热扩散依赖源与热历程，要关注横向扩散；原位掺杂外延在生长中形成掺杂层，要控制生长与界面。
paragraphs.en: Select the doping route for each region’s role. Implantation controls dose and location but requires damage treatment. Thermal diffusion depends on the source and thermal history and requires attention to lateral diffusion. In-situ doped epitaxy forms a doped layer during growth and requires growth/interface control.

records.text:
浓度定义：轻重不等于N型P型
Concentration: light/heavy is distinct from N/P type
分清导电类型、化学浓度与有效掺杂
Distinguish conductivity type, chemical concentration and effective doping
轻重掺杂
FEOL 器件 Device 离子注入 Ion implantation 激活 Activation 载流子 Carrier
核心判断与晶格示意
Core distinction and lattice diagrams
N/P与轻/重是两个维度。N型或P型描述导电类型（施主或受主）；轻掺杂或重掺杂描述掺杂浓度相对高低。n⁺、p⁺通常表示重掺杂区。图示N型轻掺杂、N型重掺杂、P型轻掺杂与P型重掺杂；灰色为Si原子，紫色为施主杂质（如P类），橙色为受主杂质（如B类）。粒子密度仅为示意，杂质原子数量远少于硅原子。
N/P and light/heavy are separate dimensions. N/P describes conductivity type (donor or acceptor); light/heavy describes relative doping concentration. n⁺ and p⁺ usually denote heavily doped regions. The diagrams show all four combinations. Gray denotes Si, purple donor impurities such as P, and orange acceptors such as B. Densities are illustrative; dopant atoms are far fewer than silicon atoms.
从需求到验证
From requirements to verification
1. 区域职责：按器件功能确定N/P型及掺杂强度。2. 施主或受主：施主形成N型、提供额外电子；受主形成P型、产生空穴。3. 目标分布：设定化学浓度及表面峰值、结深、横向范围等空间分布。4. 形成掺杂区：注入或扩散引入杂质，经退火激活。5. 电学验证：确认导电类型与掺杂强度符合设计。
1. Define the region’s function, N/P type and doping strength. 2. Select donors (N-type, extra electrons) or acceptors (P-type, holes). 3. Set chemical concentration and spatial profile, including surface peak, junction depth and lateral extent. 4. Introduce dopants by implantation/diffusion and activate them by annealing. 5. Electrically verify conductivity type and doping strength against the design.
关键控制与耦合风险
Controls and coupled risks
控制杂质种类、化学浓度、净有效掺杂和空间分布。杂质种类决定导电类型并影响激活；化学浓度是工艺引入的杂质总量分布；净有效掺杂考虑激活与补偿后的电学有效浓度。净有效掺杂 = 施主贡献 − 受主贡献。
Control impurity species, chemical concentration, net effective doping and spatial profile. Species determines type and affects activation; chemical concentration describes total introduced dopants; net effective doping accounts for activation and compensation. Net effective doping = donor contribution − acceptor contribution.
施主与受主可相互补偿，使净有效掺杂降低。未激活杂质使化学浓度与电学结果不同。剖面峰值仅反映局部信息，不能代表整个掺杂区平均浓度。
Donors and acceptors can compensate and reduce net effective doping. Inactive dopants cause chemical and electrical results to differ. A profile peak is local information and does not represent the entire region’s average concentration.
量测反馈与边界
Metrology and boundaries
SIMS化学剖面获得化学浓度随深度的分布，验证注入/扩散后的浓度与分布。Hall表征载流子类型、浓度与迁移率，反映电学有效掺杂。适用的电学剖面（如C–V）获得有效掺杂的深度分布。
SIMS measures chemical concentration versus depth to verify implantation/diffusion profiles. Hall measurements characterize carrier type, concentration and mobility and reflect electrically effective doping. Applicable electrical profiling, such as C–V, obtains effective doping versus depth.
掺杂类型、浓度与分布影响区域电阻、结的位置与特性及器件性能。轻重掺杂没有跨材料、器件的统一阈值，需依材料体系与结构定义。异常时先复测排除误差与样品差异，再检查退火激活、施主/受主补偿，结合SIMS、Hall与电学剖面判断。
Doping type, concentration and distribution affect regional resistance, junction location/properties and device performance. No universal light/heavy threshold spans all materials and devices. For anomalies, remeasure to exclude measurement/sample differences; check anneal activation and compensation, then compare SIMS, Hall and electrical profiles.

导电差异：浓度与迁移率一起决定电阻
Conductivity: concentration and mobility jointly determine resistance
载流子数量与运动能力共同作用
Carrier number and transport ability work together
轻重掺杂
FEOL 器件 Device 离子注入 Ion implantation 激活 Activation 载流子 Carrier
核心判断
Core conclusion
重掺杂通常降低电阻率，但增益并非简单线性。σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ)。重掺杂引入更多载流子，载流子浓度通常增加；掺杂引入的杂质散射会影响载流子迁移率。
Heavy doping usually reduces resistivity, but the improvement is not simply linear. σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ). Heavy doping introduces more carriers and generally increases their concentration, while impurity scattering affects carrier mobility.
工艺流程与关键控制
Process flow and controls
流程：电阻目标 → 有效浓度 → 评估迁移率 → 结构电阻 → 量测验证。关键控制为有效载流子浓度、迁移率、层厚和温度。
Flow: resistance target → effective concentration → mobility evaluation → structural resistance → measurement verification. Control effective carrier concentration, mobility, layer thickness and temperature.
耦合与风险
Coupling and risks
浓度升高伴随杂质散射增强；激活不足、厚度偏差或不均匀可导致电阻异常。
Increasing concentration strengthens impurity scattering. Insufficient activation, thickness deviation or nonuniformity can cause resistance anomalies.
量测反馈
Measurement feedback
通过四探针量测片电阻与片内分布，并结合厚度与Hall量测。异常先复测，并检查工艺。
Measure sheet resistance and within-wafer distribution using four-point probing, together with thickness and Hall measurements. Remeasure anomalies and inspect the process.
下游与边界
Downstream effects and boundaries
影响压降、发热和串联电阻。片电阻不等于电阻率，非均匀层不能直接套用均匀层换算。图中标注压降、发热、串联电阻及Hall磁场B。
These factors affect voltage drop, heating and series resistance. Sheet resistance is not resistivity, and uniform-layer conversions cannot be directly applied to nonuniform layers. Diagram labels include voltage drop, heating, series resistance and Hall magnetic field B.

paragraphs.zh: 流程：电阻目标 → 有效浓度 → 评估迁移率 → 结构电阻 → 量测验证。关键控制为有效载流子浓度、迁移率、层厚和温度。
paragraphs.en: Flow: resistance target → effective concentration → mobility evaluation → structural resistance → measurement verification. Control effective carrier concentration, mobility, layer thickness and temperature.

paragraphs.zh: 浓度升高伴随杂质散射增强；激活不足、厚度偏差或不均匀可导致电阻异常。
paragraphs.en: Increasing concentration strengthens impurity scattering. Insufficient activation, thickness deviation or nonuniformity can cause resistance anomalies.

paragraphs.zh: 通过四探针量测片电阻与片内分布，并结合厚度与Hall量测。异常先复测，并检查工艺。
paragraphs.en: Measure sheet resistance and within-wafer distribution using four-point probing, together with thickness and Hall measurements. Remeasure anomalies and inspect the process.

paragraphs.zh: 影响压降、发热和串联电阻。片电阻不等于电阻率，非均匀层不能直接套用均匀层换算。图中标注压降、发热、串联电阻及Hall磁场B。
paragraphs.en: These factors affect voltage drop, heating and series resistance. Sheet resistance is not resistivity, and uniform-layer conversions cannot be directly applied to nonuniform layers. Diagram labels include voltage drop, heating, series resistance and Hall magnetic field B.
