BARC窗口：压反射之后还要打开它
BARC window: reflection control must be followed by opening
膜厚n/k / 固化 / BARC Open / 刻蚀选择比
Thickness and n/k / curing / BARC opening / etch selectivity
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
工艺流程
Process flow
1. 衬底清洁：去有机物与颗粒。2. BARC涂布/沉积并固化：形成连续均匀膜。3. PR涂布/烘烤：均匀胶膜。4. 曝光显影：形成PR图形，在BARC上方形成开口。5. BARC Open：选择性去除开口处BARC。6. 下层图形转移，去PR与残留。图例为紫色PR、橙色BARC、灰色衬底/下层。
1. Clean substrate of organics/particles. 2. Coat/deposit and cure continuous uniform BARC. 3. Coat/bake uniform PR. 4. Expose/develop PR openings above BARC. 5. Selectively remove BARC at openings. 6. Transfer into the lower layer and remove PR/residues. Purple denotes PR, orange BARC and gray substrate/lower material.
四个关键控制
Four key controls
膜厚与n/k匹配以降反射、避免残余站立波，兼顾刻蚀/显影窗口。充分固化提升化学和等离子耐受，避免溶胀、起皮、残留；不足会影响选择比。全片膜厚/n/k均匀性影响成像及CD，要看边缘/中心差异并监控。合适BARC刻蚀速率与PR选择比保证开口干净、减少PR损耗/CD偏差，给下层转移稳定窗口。
Match thickness and n/k to suppress reflection/standing waves while maintaining etch/develop windows. Adequate curing improves chemical/plasma resistance and prevents swelling, peeling and residue; undercure affects selectivity. Across-wafer thickness/n/k uniformity controls imaging/CD, including center-edge variation. Proper BARC rate and PR selectivity enable clean opening with less PR/CD loss and a stable transfer window.
耦合权衡与缺陷
Trade-offs and defects
原图称高耐刻蚀BARC有利于下层转移、减少残留风险和拓宽窗口，但开口可能额外消耗PR、引入CD Bias，过强耐刻蚀加重CD损失。风险对比：膜厚或n/k不佳→残余站立波；显影不全→Scum残渣；刻蚀/显影不当→Footing底脚；开口不全→BARC残留；过开口/侧蚀→CD损失；各向异性不足→侧向刻蚀。
The source states that etch-resistant BARC helps lower-layer transfer, reduces residue risk and broadens the window, but opening can consume additional PR and introduce CD bias; excessive resistance worsens CD loss. Risk mapping: poor thickness/n/k → residual standing waves; incomplete development → scum; unsuitable etch/develop → footing; incomplete opening → BARC residue; over-open/lateral etch → CD loss; insufficient anisotropy → lateral etching.
量测与下游
Metrology and downstream effects
膜厚图检查全片分布；反射率对比有/无BARC；CD-SEM量CD及侧壁；Open截面查清洁和残留；缺陷扫描查残留颗粒。需预留PR厚度应对BARC损耗，开口可产生正/负CD Bias，并影响下层刻蚀均匀性与保真度。
Map thickness; compare reflectance with/without BARC; measure CD/sidewalls by CD-SEM; inspect open cross-sections and residue/particle scans. Budget PR for BARC etch consumption. Opening can produce positive/negative CD bias and affect lower-layer etch uniformity and fidelity.
材料边界
Material boundaries
原图列常规有机BARC通常用氧等离子灰化打开，对显影溶剂较敏感，需控制固化与选择比；无机ARC（SiON等）常用氟基等离子刻蚀，化学稳定、显影不易去除，选择比依下层材料；兼作硬掩膜Underlayer可能需专门开口刻蚀，并综合选择比及图形转移。
The source lists conventional organic BARC opening by oxygen-plasma ashing, sensitivity to developer solvents and the need to control cure/selectivity. Inorganic ARC such as SiON commonly uses fluorine-based plasma, is chemically stable and not easily removed by development, with selectivity depending on underlying materials. Hard-mask underlayers may need dedicated opening etches and integrated selectivity/transfer planning.
耐刻蚀性与残留风险的关系不能仅凭高低概括：原图的优势描述已保留，但也同时明确记载其开口更难及PR/CD损耗的权衡。
Etch resistance alone does not determine residue risk. The source’s benefit claim is retained together with its stated harder-opening and PR/CD-loss trade-offs.

title.zh: TARC窗口：胶面改善不能换来显影缺陷
title.en: TARC window: surface improvement must not cause development defects

records.text:
TARC窗口：胶面改善不能换来显影缺陷
TARC window: surface improvement must not cause development defects
表面反射 / 涂布均匀性 / 可去除性 / 浸没兼容
Surface reflection / coating uniformity / removability / immersion compatibility
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与流程
Core conclusion and flow
TARC改善胶上光学边界，同时须保持PR化学与显影稳定。PR涂布/烘烤获得均匀膜并去溶剂 → TARC涂布/稳定 → 曝光 → 显影/漂洗去TARC（依配方）→ 干燥去残液、稳定形貌 → 外观、CD、缺陷检查。原图显影步骤写“去除未曝光PR，同时去除TARC”。
TARC improves the top optical boundary while preserving PR chemistry and development stability. Coat/bake uniform PR and remove solvent → coat/stabilize TARC → expose → develop/rinse away TARC as formulated → dry residual liquid/stabilize morphology → appearance, CD and defect inspection. The source’s development step says “remove unexposed PR while removing TARC.”
四个关键控制
Four key controls
膜厚与折射率n决定反射控制且须兼顾窗口；全片涂布均匀性影响曝光及CD，需看边缘/中心；可去除/溶解行为须与PR同步或按工艺选择性去除，避免残留、聚集及再沉积；PR/TARC界面须避免互溶/反应，保持清晰与适中附着，关注图形边缘。
Thickness/index n determine reflection control and the window. Coating uniformity affects exposure/CD, including center-edge differences. Removal/dissolution must be synchronized with PR or selectively processed without residue, aggregation or redeposition. Avoid PR/TARC intermixing/reaction; maintain clear interfaces, suitable adhesion and controlled pattern-edge interfaces.
耦合权衡与缺陷
Trade-offs and defects
增强保护/阻隔可降反射、减有害物质扩散、稳胶面、改善边缘，却可能难去除、残留、改变化学及显影速率、引入CD偏差。水印来自干燥不均；TARC残留来自去除不全，可在底部/侧壁；退润湿形成岛/针孔；涂布斑来自厚度不均；PR溶胀来自化学影响；CD漂移来自光学或化学变化。
Stronger protection/barriers can reduce reflection and harmful diffusion, stabilize surfaces and improve edges, but may complicate removal, leave residue, change chemistry/develop rate and shift CD. Watermarks arise from uneven drying; incomplete removal leaves bottom/sidewall TARC; dewetting creates islands/pinholes; thickness variation creates coating marks; chemical effects swell PR; optical/chemical changes shift CD.
量测与下游
Metrology and downstream
检查全片膜厚/反射率、表面和图形缺陷及残留颗粒；适用时测接触角/浸出物，评估表面能；CDU/FEM对比CD均匀性与窗口。目标是显影洁净无残留少聚集、无新缺陷；胶侧壁垂直、线形完整、表面平整低粗糙；转移前掩膜稳定，减少刻蚀异常。
Check wafer thickness/reflectance, surface/pattern defects and residual particles. Where applicable, measure contact angle/leachables and surface energy. Use CDU/FEM to compare CD uniformity/window. Targets are clean development with little aggregation/no added defects, vertical intact resist lines with smooth surfaces, and stable masks before transfer with fewer etch anomalies.
边界说明
Boundaries

paragraphs.zh: TARC改善胶上光学边界，同时须保持PR化学与显影稳定。PR涂布/烘烤获得均匀膜并去溶剂 → TARC涂布/稳定 → 曝光 → 显影/漂洗去TARC（依配方）→ 干燥去残液、稳定形貌 → 外观、CD、缺陷检查。原图显影步骤写“去除未曝光PR，同时去除TARC”。
paragraphs.en: TARC improves the top optical boundary while preserving PR chemistry and development stability. Coat/bake uniform PR and remove solvent → coat/stabilize TARC → expose → develop/rinse away TARC as formulated → dry residual liquid/stabilize morphology → appearance, CD and defect inspection. The source’s development step says “remove unexposed PR while removing TARC.”

paragraphs.zh: 膜厚与折射率n决定反射控制且须兼顾窗口；全片涂布均匀性影响曝光及CD，需看边缘/中心；可去除/溶解行为须与PR同步或按工艺选择性去除，避免残留、聚集及再沉积；PR/TARC界面须避免互溶/反应，保持清晰与适中附着，关注图形边缘。
paragraphs.en: Thickness/index n determine reflection control and the window. Coating uniformity affects exposure/CD, including center-edge differences. Removal/dissolution must be synchronized with PR or selectively processed without residue, aggregation or redeposition. Avoid PR/TARC intermixing/reaction; maintain clear interfaces, suitable adhesion and controlled pattern-edge interfaces.

paragraphs.zh: 增强保护/阻隔可降反射、减有害物质扩散、稳胶面、改善边缘，却可能难去除、残留、改变化学及显影速率、引入CD偏差。水印来自干燥不均；TARC残留来自去除不全，可在底部/侧壁；退润湿形成岛/针孔；涂布斑来自厚度不均；PR溶胀来自化学影响；CD漂移来自光学或化学变化。
paragraphs.en: Stronger protection/barriers can reduce reflection and harmful diffusion, stabilize surfaces and improve edges, but may complicate removal, leave residue, change chemistry/develop rate and shift CD. Watermarks arise from uneven drying; incomplete removal leaves bottom/sidewall TARC; dewetting creates islands/pinholes; thickness variation creates coating marks; chemical effects swell PR; optical/chemical changes shift CD.

paragraphs.zh: 检查全片膜厚/反射率、表面和图形缺陷及残留颗粒；适用时测接触角/浸出物，评估表面能；CDU/FEM对比CD均匀性与窗口。目标是显影洁净无残留少聚集、无新缺陷；胶侧壁垂直、线形完整、表面平整低粗糙；转移前掩膜稳定，减少刻蚀异常。
paragraphs.en: Check wafer thickness/reflectance, surface/pattern defects and residual particles. Where applicable, measure contact angle/leachables and surface energy. Use CDU/FEM to compare CD uniformity/window. Targets are clean development with little aggregation/no added defects, vertical intact resist lines with smooth surfaces, and stable masks before transfer with fewer etch anomalies.

records.text:
显影与刻蚀：两种ARC的退出方式不同
Development and etching: the two ARCs leave differently
显影去除 / BARC Open / 胶厚预算 / CD Bias
Development removal / BARC opening / resist budget / CD bias
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与两条路线
Core conclusion and two routes
TARC常在显影/漂洗中退出；BARC常在显影后保留、需刻蚀打开，依配方膜系而定。TARC路线：PR+TARC曝光 → 显影/漂洗溶解去除TARC → PR图形完成 → 后续刻蚀、离子注入或薄膜沉积。BARC路线：PR+BARC曝光显影 → BARC仍在底部 → BARC Open选择性刻蚀 → 后续图形转移。
TARC commonly leaves during development/rinse; BARC often remains and requires etch opening, depending on formulation/stack. TARC: expose PR+TARC → dissolve/remove during development/rinse → completed PR pattern → etch, implant or deposit. BARC: expose/develop PR+BARC → BARC remains at the bottom → selective BARC open → subsequent transfer.
四个关键控制
Four key controls
TARC去除性：充分去除、与显影液/PR/下层兼容，避免残留水印。BARC选择比：对PR高选择比、均匀且各向异性、减少CD偏差及下层损伤。剩余PR厚度：留足转移预算，兼顾分辨率，防过耗塌陷。残留/侧壁：查ARC/聚合物、侧壁角度，防回缩或不完全刻蚀，保证清洁与后续窗口。
TARC removability: complete removal, developer/PR/lower-layer compatibility, no residue/watermarks. BARC selectivity: high selectivity to PR, uniform anisotropic etch, limited CD shift/lower-layer damage. Remaining PR: enough transfer budget while preserving resolution and preventing collapse. Residue/sidewalls: check ARC/polymer and wall angles to avoid recession/incomplete etch and ensure cleanliness.
耦合权衡与风险
Trade-offs and risks
弱BARC刻蚀可能残留、影响转移、增加缺陷；更强Open可降BARC残留和Scum，但增加PR损耗、可能使CD增长或损伤下层。典型风险为TARC残留/水印干斑、BARC底部Scum、过刻/欠刻CD Bias、PR顶部损耗导致厚度不足或塌陷、侧壁回缩/角度变化降低保真度。
Weak BARC etching can leave residue and harm transfer; stronger opening reduces residue/scum but consumes PR, may enlarge CD or damage lower layers. Risks include TARC residue/watermarks, bottom BARC scum, over-/under-etch CD bias, top PR loss and collapse, and sidewall recession/angle changes that reduce fidelity.
量测、下游与边界
Metrology, downstream and boundaries
显影后缺陷图检查残留水印、密度和稳定性；CD-SEM测尺寸、偏差及侧壁；XSEM查多层结构、ARC残留及整体形貌；残膜检查定位表面异常并验证清洁；刻蚀前后CD对比量化变化和可接受性。下游关注掩膜强度/完整性和耐刻蚀、CD一致性/均匀性及器件良率规则、侧壁保持及偏差累积。可显影BARC、特殊Topcoat和多层胶的退出方式不同，按材料、光学和流程选择验证。
Post-develop maps inspect residue/watermarks, density and stability. CD-SEM measures dimensions/bias/walls; XSEM examines stacks, ARC residue and overall shape. Residual-film inspection locates anomalies; before/after CD quantifies acceptable changes. Downstream concerns are mask integrity/etch endurance, CD uniformity/device/yield rules and sidewall fidelity/cumulative bias. Developable BARC, special topcoats and multilayer resists may use different removal routes requiring material/optical/process-specific validation.

paragraphs.zh: TARC常在显影/漂洗中退出；BARC常在显影后保留、需刻蚀打开，依配方膜系而定。TARC路线：PR+TARC曝光 → 显影/漂洗溶解去除TARC → PR图形完成 → 后续刻蚀、离子注入或薄膜沉积。BARC路线：PR+BARC曝光显影 → BARC仍在底部 → BARC Open选择性刻蚀 → 后续图形转移。
paragraphs.en: TARC commonly leaves during development/rinse; BARC often remains and requires etch opening, depending on formulation/stack. TARC: expose PR+TARC → dissolve/remove during development/rinse → completed PR pattern → etch, implant or deposit. BARC: expose/develop PR+BARC → BARC remains at the bottom → selective BARC open → subsequent transfer.

paragraphs.zh: TARC去除性：充分去除、与显影液/PR/下层兼容，避免残留水印。BARC选择比：对PR高选择比、均匀且各向异性、减少CD偏差及下层损伤。剩余PR厚度：留足转移预算，兼顾分辨率，防过耗塌陷。残留/侧壁：查ARC/聚合物、侧壁角度，防回缩或不完全刻蚀，保证清洁与后续窗口。
paragraphs.en: TARC removability: complete removal, developer/PR/lower-layer compatibility, no residue/watermarks. BARC selectivity: high selectivity to PR, uniform anisotropic etch, limited CD shift/lower-layer damage. Remaining PR: enough transfer budget while preserving resolution and preventing collapse. Residue/sidewalls: check ARC/polymer and wall angles to avoid recession/incomplete etch and ensure cleanliness.

paragraphs.zh: 弱BARC刻蚀可能残留、影响转移、增加缺陷；更强Open可降BARC残留和Scum，但增加PR损耗、可能使CD增长或损伤下层。典型风险为TARC残留/水印干斑、BARC底部Scum、过刻/欠刻CD Bias、PR顶部损耗导致厚度不足或塌陷、侧壁回缩/角度变化降低保真度。
paragraphs.en: Weak BARC etching can leave residue and harm transfer; stronger opening reduces residue/scum but consumes PR, may enlarge CD or damage lower layers. Risks include TARC residue/watermarks, bottom BARC scum, over-/under-etch CD bias, top PR loss and collapse, and sidewall recession/angle changes that reduce fidelity.

paragraphs.zh: 显影后缺陷图检查残留水印、密度和稳定性；CD-SEM测尺寸、偏差及侧壁；XSEM查多层结构、ARC残留及整体形貌；残膜检查定位表面异常并验证清洁；刻蚀前后CD对比量化变化和可接受性。下游关注掩膜强度/完整性和耐刻蚀、CD一致性/均匀性及器件良率规则、侧壁保持及偏差累积。可显影BARC、特殊Topcoat和多层胶的退出方式不同，按材料、光学和流程选择验证。
paragraphs.en: Post-develop maps inspect residue/watermarks, density and stability. CD-SEM measures dimensions/bias/walls; XSEM examines stacks, ARC residue and overall shape. Residual-film inspection locates anomalies; before/after CD quantifies acceptable changes. Downstream concerns are mask integrity/etch endurance, CD uniformity/device/yield rules and sidewall fidelity/cumulative bias. Developable BARC, special topcoats and multilayer resists may use different removal routes requiring material/optical/process-specific validation.

异常诊断：先判断是光学还是材料问题
Diagnosis: distinguish optical from material problems
CD摆动 / 站立波 / 残留 / 水印
CD swing / standing waves / residue / watermarks
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与五种线索
Core conclusion and five clues
相似CD与缺陷症状可能来自光学设计、膜厚均匀性、界面化学或去除工艺。四类候选根因：光学反射/干涉/窗口；膜厚涂布不均/波动；界面去除/漂洗/浸没；显影或BARC Open去除不足。
Similar CD/defect symptoms can come from optical design, thickness uniformity, interface chemistry or removal. Four candidate categories are optical reflection/interference/window, coating/thickness variation, interface removal/rinse/immersion, and incomplete development/BARC opening.
1. 侧壁周期波纹：周期与光波相关，厚胶/高反射结构常见，指向站立波/反射。2. CD随下层膜厚周期变化：峰谷关联干涉，指向光学窗口/下层厚度。3. 中心—边缘CD差：径向或环形，常关联涂布/烘烤/均匀性。4. 水印/圆斑：多见TARC去除/漂洗，可关联浸没界面或干燥。5. 底部残留：槽底PR/BARC未清除而侧壁正常，提示显影或Open不足。
1. Periodic sidewall ripples: wave-related, common in thick/high-reflection stacks, suggesting standing waves/reflection. 2. Periodic CD versus underlayer thickness: interference peaks/valleys, suggesting optics/thickness. 3. Center-edge CD differences: radial/ring patterns linked to coat/bake/uniformity. 4. Watermarks/circular spots: often TARC removal/rinse, immersion or drying. 5. Bottom PR/BARC residue with otherwise normal walls: insufficient development/opening.
系统化诊断流程
Systematic diagnosis
看分布：全片/边缘/局部及周期方向。做膜厚—CD关联：结合椭偏/反射率判断相关性和周期。看PR截面侧壁：找周期波纹、区分光学与材料主导。对照多层光学模型：仿真反射/干涉，与实测对比。检查显影后残留和BARC Open充分性。最后关联PR/BARC材料、涂布烘烤窗口、去除漂洗、设备状态和均匀性，综合验证根因。
Map whole-wafer/edge/local distribution and periodicity/direction. Correlate thickness/CD using ellipsometry/reflectance. Inspect PR sidewall cross-sections for periodic ripples and optical/material dominance. Compare multilayer reflection/interference simulations with measurements. Check development residue and opening completeness. Finally relate PR/BARC materials, coat/bake windows, rinse/removal, equipment state and uniformity to validate root cause.
控制与量测反馈
Controls and measurements
优化膜厚/涂布/烘烤均匀性，准确评估n/k并匹配层次，减少烘烤溶剂残留，优化显影窗口与去除一致性，提升刻蚀均匀性、减少叠加偏差。椭偏/反射率给膜厚及n/k；CD-SEM/XSEM查CD、侧壁、残留缺陷；FEM光场仿真验证反射干涉；缺陷图确认类型分布和周期；模型/实测CD—膜厚对比验证根因合理性。
Optimize thickness/coating/bake uniformity, assess n/k and stack matching, reduce solvent residue, improve development/removal consistency and etch uniformity. Ellipsometry/reflectance gives thickness/n/k; CD-SEM/XSEM checks CD, walls, residue and defects; FEM optical fields test interference; defect maps establish spatial/periodic signatures; measured versus modeled CD–thickness trends test root-cause validity.
避免误判与边界
Avoiding misdiagnosis and boundaries
不要仅凭一张截面锁定根因。相似形貌可由光学、材料或工艺多因素引起，须结合分布、量测和模型。先用空间分布、周期性和工艺前后对比建立证据链，再综合光学常数、膜厚、条件及多界面干涉逐步定位。
Do not identify a root cause from one cross-section alone. Similar shapes can arise from optical, material or process factors. Build evidence from spatial distribution, periodicity and before/after process comparisons, then integrate optical constants, thickness, conditions and interference using measurements and models.

paragraphs.zh: 不要仅凭一张截面锁定根因。相似形貌可由光学、材料或工艺多因素引起，须结合分布、量测和模型。先用空间分布、周期性和工艺前后对比建立证据链，再综合光学常数、膜厚、条件及多界面干涉逐步定位。
paragraphs.en: Do not identify a root cause from one cross-section alone. Similar shapes can arise from optical, material or process factors. Build evidence from spatial distribution, periodicity and before/after process comparisons, then integrate optical constants, thickness, conditions and interference using measurements and models.

records.text:
工艺选择：先找主要反射界面
Process selection: identify the dominant reflecting interface
衬底反射 / 胶面反射 / 浸没保护 / 图形转移
Substrate reflection / resist-surface reflection / immersion protection / transfer
BARC 与 TARC
FEOL BEOL 抗反射 ARC 光刻 Lithography 图形转移 Pattern transfer
核心结论与四路决策
Core conclusion and four-way choice
按主反射来源与集成负担选BARC、TARC、组合或不加ARC。下层复杂膜堆反射强而胶上较弱：优先BARC。胶上表面/浸没界面关键、胶下较弱：优先TARC/Topcoat。上下反射均强、相互干涉显著：组合BARC+TARC。现有膜堆已有效控制反射或新增集成负担大：可不加额外ARC。图中分别标入射光、上下界面反射、浸没液、PR及衬底/下层膜堆。
Choose BARC, TARC, both or no added ARC by dominant reflection and integration burden. Strong lower-stack reflection: prefer BARC. Dominant upper/immersion interface: prefer TARC/topcoat. Strong upper/lower reflection and interference: combine them. Already-controlled reflection or excessive added burden: no extra ARC. Diagrams label incident light, upper/lower reflection, immersion liquid, PR and lower stack/substrate.
工艺选择流程
Selection flow
明确波长与光学条件（i-line、DUV、193i、EUV，干式/浸没，NA与偏振）→ 建立含所有功能层的完整膜堆和窗口 → 分析各界面反射及主干涉源 → 扫描ARC参数并仿真容差 → 检查涂布均匀、显影窗口、刻蚀选择比及后续兼容 → FEM与缺陷验证光学、成像和风险。
Define wavelength/conditions (i-line, DUV, 193i, EUV; dry/immersion; NA/polarization) → build full functional stack/window → analyze reflections/dominant interference → scan ARC parameters/tolerance → check coating, development, selectivity and compatibility → verify optics, imaging and defects using FEM/testing.
四项控制与耦合权衡
Four controls and trade-offs
控制n/k与膜厚窗口、衬底多层反射、PR厚度预算和显影/刻蚀兼容。PR厚度须满足分辨率与成像、匹配Topcoat并避免过厚问题；去除干净、选择比合适、不增新缺陷。新增ARC可扩大窗口与容差，也增加成本、缺陷机会、复杂度和后续耦合。
Control n/k/thickness window, multilayer substrate reflection, PR thickness budget and develop/etch compatibility. PR thickness must satisfy resolution/imaging, match topcoat and avoid excessive-thickness issues. Ensure clean removal, appropriate selectivity and no new defects. Added ARC may improve window/tolerance but adds cost, defects, complexity and downstream coupling.
风险与验证
Risks and verification
主反射界面误判导致方案错、抑制差；仿真实测不符可能是材料参数或工艺波动；BARC难开口导致残留、CD偏差；TARC难去除导致残留污染。用反射率比较方案，膜厚/n/k确认稳定性，FEM分析成像/强度，CDU评估CD与窗口，缺陷图查表面图形，刻蚀后截面验证转移、残留与损伤。
Wrong dominant-interface identification gives poor ARC choice/suppression. Simulation mismatch may reflect material parameters or process variation. Hard BARC opening causes residue/CD shift; hard TARC removal causes contamination. Compare reflectance, verify thickness/n/k stability, analyze FEM imaging/intensity, assess CDU/window, map defects and inspect post-etch transfer/residue/damage.
曝光体系边界：原图概括
Exposure-system boundaries: source overview
原图概括：i-line反射相对易控，通常以BARC为主，可不加TARC；DUV反射更强，常需BARC或TARC并优化胶膜；193i关注浸没界面，常用TARC/Topcoat并组合BARC；多层胶干涉复杂，需考虑各层匹配；EUV反射机理不同，不沿用传统ARC方案，依赖吸收与图形设计。具体策略随波长、胶结构和集成要求变化。
The source summarizes i-line as relatively easier to control, often BARC-led with optional TARC; DUV as stronger-reflection and needing ARC/resist optimization; 193i as immersion-interface-sensitive with topcoat/TARC and BARC combinations; multilayer resist as requiring complex layer matching; and EUV as a different reflection regime that does not simply reuse traditional ARC approaches. Actual strategy depends on wavelength, resist structure and integration.
底部各曝光体系为原图定性概括，并非对所有材料与节点的通用配方；EUV等体系不能直接套用前面的可见/DUV示意堆栈。
The bottom exposure-system comparisons are qualitative source summaries, not universal recipes for all materials/nodes. EUV and other systems must not directly inherit the earlier visible/DUV schematic stacks.

title.zh: 一张图看懂能带、导带与价带
title.en: Energy, conduction and valence bands at a glance

records.text:
一张图看懂能带、导带与价带
Energy, conduction and valence bands at a glance
从原子能级、费米能级到掺杂与能带弯曲
From atomic/Fermi levels to doping and band bending
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
01 能带怎么来
01 How bands arise
原子靠近后，离散能级分裂并汇聚成允许能带。能量E向上；孤立原子离散能级 → 多原子靠近、能级分裂 → 大量能级聚集形成导带、价带，两者之间为带隙E_g。
As atoms approach, discrete levels split and collect into allowed bands. Energy E increases upward. Isolated atomic levels → splitting as atoms approach → many closely spaced levels form conduction/valence bands separated by E_g.
02 导带与价带
02 Conduction and valence bands
两类允许能带承担不同成键与输运角色。导带E_c为电子输运能带，价带E_v为原子成键能带；橙色表示负电电子，空心圆表示正电空穴。
The two allowed bands serve different bonding/transport roles. E_c marks the conduction band for electrons; E_v marks the valence band associated with bonding. Orange denotes negatively charged electrons; hollow circles denote positive holes.
03 带隙与费米能级
03 Band gap and Fermi level
带隙描述允许态间隔，费米能级E_F描述占据倾向。费米–狄拉克分布：f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]；图中E=E_F处电子占据概率为0.5。
The gap describes separation between allowed states; E_F describes occupation tendency. Fermi–Dirac distribution: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]; occupation is 0.5 at E=E_F.
04 电子与空穴
04 Electrons and holes

能带怎么来：晶体把离散能级展开成带
How bands arise: a crystal spreads discrete levels into bands
原子轨道 / 能级分裂 / 周期势场 / 允许态
Atomic orbitals / level splitting / periodic potential / allowed states
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
核心结论与形成过程
Core conclusion and formation
能带不是电子运行轨道，而是晶体中大量允许量子态的能量分布。孤立原子有分立能级（图示n=1、2、3）；两个原子靠近，每个能级分裂；轨道重叠，N个原子形成密集能级；形成晶体能带，分为价带、禁带、导带。图标E_c、E_v和带隙E_g。
Bands are not electron trajectories; they are the energy distribution of many allowed quantum states in a crystal. Isolated atoms have discrete levels (n=1,2,3 shown); approaching atoms split levels; overlapping orbitals in N atoms produce dense levels that form valence/conduction bands separated by a forbidden gap. Labels are E_c, E_v and E_g.
形成机理与关键因素
Mechanism and factors
推理链：孤立原子离散能级 → 原子靠近、相互作用增强 → 轨道/波函数重叠 → 原图以泡利不相容描述每个能级分裂成N个 → 密集能级在宏观尺度呈连续能带。原子种类决定轨道能级与化学性质；晶体结构决定周期势场对称性；原子间距越小通常耦合越强；轨道耦合强度决定分裂大小。
Reasoning chain: discrete atomic levels → stronger interactions as atoms approach → orbital/wavefunction overlap → the source describes N-fold splitting through Pauli exclusion → dense levels appear as continuous bands macroscopically. Atomic species sets orbital energies/chemistry; crystal structure sets periodic-potential symmetry; shorter spacing generally increases coupling; coupling strength sets splitting.
常见误区与验证
Misconceptions and verification
能带不是轨道，电子在晶体中以波的形式运动；晶体能级并非凭空连续，而来自大量能级分裂聚集；缺陷和应变会引入局域态或改变带边。DFT等能带计算给出带隙、有效质量；ARPES直接量测动量空间能量关系；光学吸收边对应价带到导带跃迁，可确定带隙。
Bands are not orbits; electrons propagate as waves. Crystal energies do not become continuous arbitrarily but derive from many split, closely spaced levels. Defects/strain introduce localized states or shift edges. Band calculations such as DFT provide gaps/effective masses; ARPES measures energy versus momentum; optical absorption edges correspond to valence-to-conduction transitions and indicate the gap.
下游意义与边界
Implications and boundaries
带隙E_g影响导电类型与光学性质；有效质量m*影响迁移率和输运；载流子输运影响速度与功耗；材料选择按能带结构匹配需求（金属、半导体、绝缘体）。真实材料并非完全规则：缺陷、杂质、应变、温度、低维量子限域都会改变带边、带隙或引入局域态。不同材料和k空间方向的能带不同，不能用单一模型覆盖全部。
E_g affects conduction classification and optical properties; effective mass m* affects mobility/transport; transport affects speed/power; choose metal, semiconductor or insulator bands for the application. Real materials are not perfectly periodic: defects, impurities, strain, temperature and low-dimensional confinement can shift edges/gaps or introduce localized states. Bands vary by material and k-space direction; one model cannot describe all cases.
“泡利不相容导致能级分裂”为原图的教学简化表述；本页同时保留其原子间相互作用与轨道耦合的前提。
“Pauli exclusion causes level splitting” is the source’s pedagogical simplification; the preceding interaction and orbital-coupling context is retained.

paragraphs.zh: 能带不是电子运行轨道，而是晶体中大量允许量子态的能量分布。孤立原子有分立能级（图示n=1、2、3）；两个原子靠近，每个能级分裂；轨道重叠，N个原子形成密集能级；形成晶体能带，分为价带、禁带、导带。图标E_c、E_v和带隙E_g。
paragraphs.en: Bands are not electron trajectories; they are the energy distribution of many allowed quantum states in a crystal. Isolated atoms have discrete levels (n=1,2,3 shown); approaching atoms split levels; overlapping orbitals in N atoms produce dense levels that form valence/conduction bands separated by a forbidden gap. Labels are E_c, E_v and E_g.

paragraphs.zh: 推理链：孤立原子离散能级 → 原子靠近、相互作用增强 → 轨道/波函数重叠 → 原图以泡利不相容描述每个能级分裂成N个 → 密集能级在宏观尺度呈连续能带。原子种类决定轨道能级与化学性质；晶体结构决定周期势场对称性；原子间距越小通常耦合越强；轨道耦合强度决定分裂大小。
paragraphs.en: Reasoning chain: discrete atomic levels → stronger interactions as atoms approach → orbital/wavefunction overlap → the source describes N-fold splitting through Pauli exclusion → dense levels appear as continuous bands macroscopically. Atomic species sets orbital energies/chemistry; crystal structure sets periodic-potential symmetry; shorter spacing generally increases coupling; coupling strength sets splitting.

paragraphs.zh: 能带不是轨道，电子在晶体中以波的形式运动；晶体能级并非凭空连续，而来自大量能级分裂聚集；缺陷和应变会引入局域态或改变带边。DFT等能带计算给出带隙、有效质量；ARPES直接量测动量空间能量关系；光学吸收边对应价带到导带跃迁，可确定带隙。
paragraphs.en: Bands are not orbits; electrons propagate as waves. Crystal energies do not become continuous arbitrarily but derive from many split, closely spaced levels. Defects/strain introduce localized states or shift edges. Band calculations such as DFT provide gaps/effective masses; ARPES measures energy versus momentum; optical absorption edges correspond to valence-to-conduction transitions and indicate the gap.

paragraphs.zh: 带隙E_g影响导电类型与光学性质；有效质量m*影响迁移率和输运；载流子输运影响速度与功耗；材料选择按能带结构匹配需求（金属、半导体、绝缘体）。真实材料并非完全规则：缺陷、杂质、应变、温度、低维量子限域都会改变带边、带隙或引入局域态。不同材料和k空间方向的能带不同，不能用单一模型覆盖全部。
paragraphs.en: E_g affects conduction classification and optical properties; effective mass m* affects mobility/transport; transport affects speed/power; choose metal, semiconductor or insulator bands for the application. Real materials are not perfectly periodic: defects, impurities, strain, temperature and low-dimensional confinement can shift edges/gaps or introduce localized states. Bands vary by material and k-space direction; one model cannot describe all cases.

Conduction and valence bands: allowed states alone do not ensure conduction
导带底E_c / 价带顶E_v / 可用空态 / 载流子输运
Conduction minimum E_c / valence maximum E_v / empty states / transport
能带物理

核心结论与图示
Core conclusion and diagram
导电既需可移动载流子，也需附近可进入的允许空态。导带电子带负电，价带空穴带正电，E_g=E_c−E_v。图示已占据态与可用空态；电子向右漂移、空穴等效向左漂移。导带输运需附近空态；空穴输运等价于价带电子向相反方向运动，需可被填充空态。
Conduction requires mobile carriers and nearby accessible empty allowed states. Electrons carry negative charge and holes positive charge; E_g=E_c−E_v. The diagram distinguishes occupied/empty states and shows rightward electron versus leftward hole drift. Conduction-band transport needs nearby empty states; hole motion corresponds to opposite valence-electron motion into empty states.
有载流子且有空态可导电；只有空态没有载流子不导电，只有载流子而无可进入空态难以持续导电。
Carriers plus available states enable conduction. Empty states without carriers do not conduct; carriers with no accessible empty states cannot sustain conduction in the illustrated picture.
思考流程与影响因素
Reasoning flow and factors
标出E_v价带顶 → 标出E_c导带底 → 识别E_g → 判断载流子在导带/价带 → 结合空态、浓度和迁移率判断导电。带边位置决定带隙与热激发难易；态密度g(E)决定可用态数量；E_F占据情况决定实际载流子浓度；迁移率μ反映晶格中运动能力。
Mark E_v → mark E_c → identify E_g → locate electrons/holes in bands → assess empty states, concentration and mobility. Band edges set gap/thermal activation; density of states g(E) sets state availability; occupation via E_F determines carrier concentration; mobility μ describes motion through the lattice.
浓度与电导的权衡
Concentration versus conductivity
σ=q(nμₙ+pμₚ)。提高n或p有助于增大电导，但杂质散射、晶格散射或缺陷使μ显著下降时，电导未必高。器件需在浓度、迁移率与其他性能间权衡。价带并非不参与电流，空穴也能导电；导带有电子不保证高导电；理想晶体禁带内几乎没有允许的延展态。
σ=q(nμₙ+pμₚ). Higher n or p helps conductivity, but impurity/lattice scattering or defects can reduce mobility enough to limit it. Balance concentration, mobility and other metrics. Valence holes do carry current; conduction-band electrons do not guarantee high conductivity; ideal crystal gaps have essentially no allowed extended states.
验证与边界
Verification and boundaries
吸收光谱确定带隙；PL分析能带跃迁与缺陷能级；UPS/XPS光电子能谱测带边位置和功函数；电导率、霍尔等输运测试获得浓度和迁移率。缺陷、杂质及界面态可在理想带隙中引入局域态或施主/受主能级，显著影响浓度和导电。
Absorption estimates the gap; PL probes transitions/defect levels; UPS/XPS probes band-edge positions and work function; conductivity/Hall transport measures concentration/mobility. Defects, impurities and interface states can introduce localized or donor/acceptor states in the ideal gap and strongly affect carriers and conduction.

records.text:
带隙与费米能级：一个管允许态，一个管占据率
Band gap and Fermi level: allowed states versus occupation
禁带宽度 / 化学势 / 占据概率 / 平衡状态
Gap width / chemical potential / occupation probability / equilibrium
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
核心结论与能带
Core conclusion and bands
带隙描述允许态之间的间隔；费米能级描述电子占据能态的倾向。本征半导体示意中，E_c以上与E_v以下有允许电子态，禁带无允许态。平衡时E_F在空间平坦，可位于禁带，即便该能量没有允许态。
The band gap describes separation between allowed states; Fermi level describes electron occupation tendency. In the intrinsic schematic, allowed states lie above E_c and below E_v, with none in the gap. At equilibrium E_F is spatially flat and can lie in the gap even without a state at that energy.
分布与推理流程
Distribution and reasoning
f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]。E<E_F时占据概率高、趋近1；E>E_F时低、趋近0；f(E_F)=0.5。E_F是化学势/能量参考，不是电子轨道。画E_c、E_v确定E_g → 标E_F → 叠加f(E)判断n、p → 推断类型：E_F近E_c为n型、近E_v为p型、在禁带中部附近为本征。
f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]. Occupation tends toward 1 below E_F and 0 above it; f(E_F)=0.5. E_F is chemical potential/energy reference, not an orbit. Draw band edges/gap → mark E_F → combine f(E) with n/p → infer n-type near E_c, p-type near E_v and intrinsic near midgap.
影响因素与耦合
Factors and coupling
E_g影响本征浓度和温度敏感性；温度T升高使分布展宽、n_i增加；掺杂使n型E_F向E_c、p型向E_v移动；有效态密度N_c/N_v影响可用态与浓度。非简并形式：n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT]，p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]。温升可明显改变电导；掺杂增加多数载流子，重掺杂须考虑简并，经典近似可能失效。
E_g affects intrinsic concentration/temperature sensitivity; rising T broadens occupation and increases n_i. Doping moves E_F toward E_c for N-type and E_v for P-type. N_c/N_v influence available states and concentration. Nondegenerate forms: n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT], p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]. Temperature can strongly change conductivity; doping increases majority carriers, but heavy doping requires degeneracy treatment.
误区、验证与边界
Misconceptions, verification and boundaries
E_F不是实际轨道、不必处在能带内、通常也不等于E_c；原图说明极端n⁺简并时可能很接近。验证用功函数或光电子、Hall、C–V（图示1/C²–V）、温度依赖电导（lnσ–1/T）。非平衡如光照/偏压，应分别使用电子和空穴准费米能级E_Fn、E_Fp，不能只用单一平衡E_F。
E_F is not an orbit, need not lie inside a band and is generally not E_c; the source mentions close approach under extreme n⁺ degeneracy. Verification includes work-function/photoelectron, Hall, C–V (1/C²–V shown) and temperature-dependent conductivity (lnσ–1/T). Under illumination/bias nonequilibrium, use separate electron/hole quasi-Fermi levels E_Fn/E_Fp rather than one equilibrium E_F.
分布图右侧E<E_F与E>E_F标注的上下位置和能量轴方向有冲突；正文保留正确对应的原图文字与公式，图形仍供对照。
The vertical placement of the distribution panel’s E<E_F/E>E_F annotations conflicts with its energy-axis direction. The text retains the source formula and its correct probability statements while preserving the original for comparison.

paragraphs.zh: 带隙描述允许态之间的间隔；费米能级描述电子占据能态的倾向。本征半导体示意中，E_c以上与E_v以下有允许电子态，禁带无允许态。平衡时E_F在空间平坦，可位于禁带，即便该能量没有允许态。
paragraphs.en: The band gap describes separation between allowed states; Fermi level describes electron occupation tendency. In the intrinsic schematic, allowed states lie above E_c and below E_v, with none in the gap. At equilibrium E_F is spatially flat and can lie in the gap even without a state at that energy.

paragraphs.zh: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]。E<E_F时占据概率高、趋近1；E>E_F时低、趋近0；f(E_F)=0.5。E_F是化学势/能量参考，不是电子轨道。画E_c、E_v确定E_g → 标E_F → 叠加f(E)判断n、p → 推断类型：E_F近E_c为n型、近E_v为p型、在禁带中部附近为本征。
paragraphs.en: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]. Occupation tends toward 1 below E_F and 0 above it; f(E_F)=0.5. E_F is chemical potential/energy reference, not an orbit. Draw band edges/gap → mark E_F → combine f(E) with n/p → infer n-type near E_c, p-type near E_v and intrinsic near midgap.

paragraphs.zh: E_g影响本征浓度和温度敏感性；温度T升高使分布展宽、n_i增加；掺杂使n型E_F向E_c、p型向E_v移动；有效态密度N_c/N_v影响可用态与浓度。非简并形式：n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT]，p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]。温升可明显改变电导；掺杂增加多数载流子，重掺杂须考虑简并，经典近似可能失效。
paragraphs.en: E_g affects intrinsic concentration/temperature sensitivity; rising T broadens occupation and increases n_i. Doping moves E_F toward E_c for N-type and E_v for P-type. N_c/N_v influence available states and concentration. Nondegenerate forms: n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT], p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]. Temperature can strongly change conductivity; doping increases majority carriers, but heavy doping requires degeneracy treatment.

paragraphs.zh: E_F不是实际轨道、不必处在能带内、通常也不等于E_c；原图说明极端n⁺简并时可能很接近。验证用功函数或光电子、Hall、C–V（图示1/C²–V）、温度依赖电导（lnσ–1/T）。非平衡如光照/偏压，应分别使用电子和空穴准费米能级E_Fn、E_Fp，不能只用单一平衡E_F。
paragraphs.en: E_F is not an orbit, need not lie inside a band and is generally not E_c; the source mentions close approach under extreme n⁺ degeneracy. Verification includes work-function/photoelectron, Hall, C–V (1/C²–V shown) and temperature-dependent conductivity (lnσ–1/T). Under illumination/bias nonequilibrium, use separate electron/hole quasi-Fermi levels E_Fn/E_Fp rather than one equilibrium E_F.

Electrons and holes: excitation creates a carrier pair
热激发 / 光激发 / 电子—空穴对 / 产生与复合
Thermal/optical excitation / electron–hole pairs / generation and recombination
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
核心结论与全过程
Core conclusion and full sequence
电子跨越带隙进入导带，价带缺位等效为空穴参与输运。吸收光子hν或热能 → 获得足够能量跨E_g到E_c、在E_v留下空穴 → 电子和空穴在电场下各自导电 → 复合释放光子或声子。晶格示意中蓝色为原子（如Si）、橙色电子、虚线空心圆为空穴。
When an electron crosses the gap into conduction, its valence vacancy acts as a transporting hole. Absorb photon hν or heat → cross E_g to E_c, leaving a hole at E_v → electron/hole transport under a field → recombine, releasing photons or phonons. In the lattice, blue denotes atoms such as Si, orange electrons and dashed hollow circles holes.
关键因素与权衡
Factors and trade-offs
温度越高热激发越强；hν≥E_g时可产生电子—空穴对；带隙越小越易激发、本征浓度越高。缺陷杂质提供非辐射复合通道，影响寿命。更高T或更强光增加载流子，但缺陷增加或高注入可能缩短有效寿命、增强非辐射复合并降低效率。
Higher temperature increases thermal excitation; hν≥E_g can create pairs; smaller gaps ease excitation and raise intrinsic concentration. Defects/impurities provide nonradiative paths and affect lifetime. Higher T or stronger light raises carriers, but defects/high injection may shorten effective lifetime, increase nonradiative recombination and reduce efficiency.
异常与量测
Anomalies and measurements
暗电流过大：无光电流偏高。寿命短：复合中心过多。光响应弱：吸收/收集效率低。高注入效率下降：非辐射复合增强。PL复合发光强度反映辐射效率；TRPL等寿命测试量电子/空穴寿命；暗/光I–V评估本征或缺陷暗电流；lnσ–1/T分析热激发和带隙。
High dark current means elevated unilluminated current; short lifetime suggests many recombination centers; weak photoresponse suggests poor absorption/collection; high-injection efficiency loss suggests stronger nonradiative recombination. PL probes radiative efficiency, TRPL probes lifetime, dark/light I–V evaluates intrinsic/defect dark current and lnσ–1/T probes activation/gap.
应用与边界
Applications and boundaries
光探测器把光生载流子变电信号；太阳能电池分离并收集光生载流子；LED依电子空穴辐射复合发光；产生/复合影响漏电和开关速度。直接带隙如GaAs、InP辐射复合效率较高；间接带隙如Si需要声子参与动量守恒，辐射效率较低，发光及光电表现不同。
Photodetectors convert photocarriers to electrical signals; solar cells separate/collect them; LEDs emit through radiative recombination; generation/recombination affects leakage and switching. Direct-gap GaAs/InP have higher radiative efficiency; indirect-gap Si needs phonons for momentum conservation and has lower radiative efficiency, affecting optoelectronic use.

The source labels both electrons and holes as moving “along the electric field” while drawing opposite arrows. This is a source-direction inconsistency. The text retains field-driven transport without treating those labels as a correct directional law.

Core conclusion and conductors
电导由能带结构、E_F附近允许态、载流子浓度与迁移率共同决定。原图导体（金属）表：能带重叠或部分填充，E_g≈0；E_F附近态密度大；n约10²²–10²³ cm⁻³；迁移率中等、受散射限制；σ约10⁶–10⁸ S/m；温升时电阻通常增加（正温度系数）。
Conductivity depends jointly on band structure, allowed states near E_F, concentration and mobility. Source conductor/metal table: overlapping or partially filled bands, E_g≈0; large DOS near E_F; n≈10²²–10²³ cm⁻³; moderate scattering-limited mobility; σ≈10⁶–10⁸ S/m; resistance usually rises with temperature.
半导体与绝缘体：原图范围
Semiconductors and insulators: source ranges
半导体表：E_g约0.1–3 eV，E_F附近态密度较小；浓度中等，由本征/掺杂决定；晶体质量好时迁移率较高；σ可调约10⁻⁶–10⁴ S/m；温升载流子增多，电导通常增加（本征负温度系数）。
Semiconductor table: E_g≈0.1–3 eV, smaller DOS near E_F; moderate intrinsic/doping-controlled concentration; higher mobility with good crystal quality; tunable σ≈10⁻⁶–10⁴ S/m; rising temperature typically increases intrinsic carriers and conductivity.
绝缘体表：E_g通常>3–5 eV，E_F附近几乎无态；本征浓度很低，迁移率通常较低；σ<10⁻¹⁰ S/m；常温难激发自由载流子，高温电导可能略增。图示E_c、E_v、E_F及态密度D(E)。
Insulator table: E_g typically >3–5 eV, almost no states near E_F; very low intrinsic concentration and usually lower mobility; σ<10⁻¹⁰ S/m; little thermal excitation at room temperature, possibly more conductivity at higher T. Diagrams label E_c, E_v, E_F and D(E).
分析与带隙权衡
Analysis and gap trade-offs
画E_c/E_v/E_g/E_F → 判断E_F附近态 → 确定本征/掺杂/缺陷/注入载流子 → 考虑晶格/杂质散射迁移率 → 推断电导与温度响应。宽带隙本征载流子少、耐高温、低漏电，但注入、掺杂和低阻接触更难；窄带隙易导电、适于高速低压，但高温漏电与热稳定性较差。
Draw edges/gap/E_F → assess states near E_F → determine intrinsic/doped/defect/injected carriers → consider lattice/impurity-limited mobility → infer conductivity/temperature response. Wide gaps reduce intrinsic carriers/leakage and support high temperature, but complicate injection, doping and low-resistance contacts. Narrow gaps ease conduction/high-speed low-voltage use but worsen hot leakage/thermal stability.
量测、应用与误区
Measurements, applications and misconceptions
电阻率—温度曲线比较材料；Hall图示R_H=1/(qn)，测n/p型、浓度与迁移率；吸收边估E_g；击穿I–V得V_br，评高场导电耐压。互连要高电导与热稳定；沟道要可控载流子和高迁移率；栅介质要大带隙低漏电；功率/光电关注宽带隙、耐高压和发光探测。
Compare resistivity–temperature curves; the Hall panel gives R_H=1/(qn) and measures carrier type/concentration/mobility; absorption edges estimate E_g; breakdown I–V gives V_br. Interconnects require conductivity/thermal stability; channels controlled carriers/high mobility; gate dielectrics large gaps/low leakage; power/optoelectronic materials high voltage and emission/detection properties.
不能只看一个E_g值分类，绝缘体也可能有缺陷或表面导电，不能忽略温度、缺陷、杂质和强场。分类还与能带形状、相、样品质量及测试条件有关。
Do not classify by E_g alone. Insulators can exhibit defect/surface conduction. Temperature, defects, impurities and strong fields matter, as do band shape, phase, sample quality and test conditions.
数值范围和迁移率高低是原图的概括，非材料分类的严格阈值；原图Hall式R_H=1/(qn)是简化形式，符号及适用条件需结合载流子类型与测试模型。电阻率示意曲线与表格的金属温度响应并不完全一致，需以文字条件和实际量测为准。
Numerical ranges and mobility rankings are source generalizations, not strict class thresholds. R_H=1/(qn) is simplified; sign/applicability depends on carrier type and model. The schematic metal resistivity curve does not fully agree with the table’s temperature statement; retain conditions and verify with measurement.

records.text:
能带为什么弯：弯的是能量，不是晶圆
Why bands bend: energy bends, not the wafer
空间电势 / 内建电场 / 耗尽区 / 界面电荷
Spatial potential / built-in field / depletion / interface charge
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
核心结论与PN结
Core conclusion and PN junction
空间电势随位置变化，E_c和E_v随之移动；热平衡E_F水平。PN结图标p型受主、n型施主、耗尽区/空间电荷区宽W、离化受主A⁻固定负电荷、离化施主D⁺固定正电荷及x方向。对应能带从p跨耗尽区到n弯曲，E_g示意不变。方向程度取决于材料、掺杂、功函数、偏压与符号约定，不能死记唯一形状。
Spatial potential shifts E_c/E_v with position; equilibrium E_F is flat. The PN diagram labels P acceptors, N donors, depletion/space-charge width W, fixed ionized A⁻ and D⁺ charges, and x. Corresponding bands bend across depletion with unchanged E_g in the schematic. Direction/magnitude depends on material, doping, work function, bias and conventions, not one universal shape.
形成过程与因素
Formation and factors
两侧材料/掺杂差异、原费米能级及浓度不同 → 多数载流子向对侧扩散，留下离化杂质 → 形成耗尽区固定电荷 → 建立由n指向p的内建电场 → 空间电势使带边移动至热平衡。因素为N_A/N_D、正/反偏压、介质固定电荷（如氧化层）、界面态密度/电荷、金属/半导体功函数差及温度。
Different material/doping, initial Fermi levels and concentrations → majority-carrier diffusion leaving ionized dopants → fixed depletion charge → built-in field from N to P → band-edge shifts to equilibrium. Factors include N_A/N_D, bias, dielectric fixed charge, interface-state density/charge, metal/semiconductor work-function difference and temperature.
MOS示意与工程权衡
MOS illustrations and engineering trade-offs
原图以p型MOS列：负V_G积累、表面空穴增加，文字称能带下弯；小正偏耗尽，称上弯；较大正偏反型，称进一步上弯。更强电场可改善静电控制、表面势变化与短沟道抑制，但可能增加隧穿、界面散射、泄漏及可靠性风险。
The source’s P-type MOS panels list negative-V_G accumulation/increased surface holes, labeled downward bending; small-positive-bias depletion, labeled upward bending; and larger-positive-bias inversion, labeled further upward bending. Stronger fields can improve electrostatic/short-channel control but increase tunneling, interface scattering, leakage and reliability risk.
异常、量测与下游
Anomalies, measurements and downstream effects
固定电荷可能使能带整体移动；界面态过多造成E_F钉扎/阈值偏移；势垒异常阻碍注入、增接触电阻；耗尽宽异常提示掺杂或固定电荷问题；非理想接触可致势垒过大、整流或漏电。C–V提掺杂/耗尽宽度，I–V查整流/漏电/击穿，Kelvin测表面电势/功函数，光电子谱看带位/界面态，器件仿真比较电势/能带/载流子。
Fixed charge may shift bands; excessive interface states pin E_F/shift threshold; abnormal barriers impede injection/raise contact resistance; abnormal depletion width suggests doping/fixed-charge issues; nonideal contacts cause barriers, rectification or leakage. C–V extracts doping/depletion width; I–V probes rectification/leakage/breakdown; Kelvin probes surface potential/work function; photoemission probes bands/interfaces; simulation compares potential/bands/carriers.
下游影响MOS阈值、PN整流、金属/半导体接触电阻、LED/激光器/晶体管注入效率和漏电击穿可靠性。
Consequences include MOS threshold, PN rectification, contact resistance, LED/laser/transistor injection efficiency and leakage/breakdown reliability.
原图MOS积累/耗尽/反型图对“上弯/下弯”的文字和常用p型MOS表面约定存在疑点，且横轴表面/体内方向未完整标出。已保留源图说法供核对，不应脱离坐标和偏置约定直接当作通用规律。PN空间图亦将固定电荷画到耗尽区外，是示意而非精确净电荷剖面。
The MOS panels’ up/down-bending descriptions are questionable under conventional P-type surface conventions, and surface-to-bulk direction is incompletely labeled. Source wording is retained for checking, not as a coordinate-independent rule. The PN drawing also places fixed charges outside depletion and is schematic rather than a precise net-charge profile.

The PN diagram labels P acceptors, N donors, depletion/space-charge width W, fixed ionized A⁻ and D⁺ charges, and x. Corresponding bands bend across depletion with unchanged E_g in the schematic. Direction/magnitude depends on material, doping, work function, bias and conventions, not one universal shape.

paragraphs.zh: 两侧材料/掺杂差异、原费米能级及浓度不同 → 多数载流子向对侧扩散，留下离化杂质 → 形成耗尽区固定电荷 → 建立由n指向p的内建电场 → 空间电势使带边移动至热平衡。因素为N_A/N_D、正/反偏压、介质固定电荷（如氧化层）、界面态密度/电荷、金属/半导体功函数差及温度。
paragraphs.en: Different material/doping, initial Fermi levels and concentrations → majority-carrier diffusion leaving ionized dopants → fixed depletion charge → built-in field from N to P → band-edge shifts to equilibrium. Factors include N_A/N_D, bias, dielectric fixed charge, interface-state density/charge, metal/semiconductor work-function difference and temperature.

Stronger fields can improve electrostatic/short-channel control but increase tunneling, interface scattering, leakage and reliability risk.

records.text:
掺杂改能带：总杂质不等于有效载流子
Doping and bands: total impurities are not effective carriers
施主能级 / 受主能级 / 电离激活 / 费米能级移动
Donor/acceptor levels / ionization and activation / Fermi-level shifts
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
核心结论与三类能带
Core conclusion and three band diagrams
掺杂改变载流子统计与E_F，最终电性还取决于电离、激活、补偿和缺陷。能量向上增加；本征n=p=n_i，E_F在禁带中部附近；n型引入E_D近E_c，n≫p，E_F上移；p型引入E_A近E_v，p≫n，E_F下移。图例为导带E_c、价带E_v、红虚线E_F、蓝虚线E_D、紫虚线E_A、蓝电子e⁻和空心空穴h⁺。
Doping changes carrier statistics and E_F, while final electrical behavior also depends on ionization, activation, compensation and defects. Energy rises upward. Intrinsic n=p=n_i with near-midgap E_F; N-type adds E_D near E_c, n≫p and raised E_F; P-type adds E_A near E_v, p≫n and lowered E_F. Legends label bands, red E_F, blue E_D, purple E_A, blue electrons and hollow holes.
从掺杂到电性
From dopants to electrical behavior
在硅晶格替位引入P、As、B等杂质 → 禁带形成施主/受主能级 → 电离与激活（施主供电子，受主产生空穴）→ n型电子或p型空穴多数载流子增加 → E_F相应上/下移。
Introduce substitutional P, As, B and other dopants into silicon → form donor/acceptor gap levels → ionize/activate (donors supply electrons, acceptors generate holes) → increase majority carriers → shift E_F upward/downward.
关键控制与性能权衡
Controls and performance trade-offs
控制掺杂种类（图列P、As、B、Al）、总浓度/激活率、补偿、空间分布。N_active=ηN_total，η≤1；施主受主共存相互补偿、降低有效载流子；均匀/非均匀剖面影响结深电性。增浓度可降片阻、增载流子，但增强杂质散射、降迁移率，并可能产生简并、带隙变窄、结漏电增加。
Control species (P, As, B, Al shown), total concentration/activation, compensation and spatial profile. N_active=ηN_total, η≤1. Coexisting donors/acceptors compensate; profiles affect junction depth/electrical behavior. Higher doping lowers sheet resistance/raises carriers but increases impurity scattering, reduces mobility and may cause degeneracy, gap narrowing and junction leakage.
失效、量测与影响
Failures, measurements and effects
失效为损伤/退火不足导致激活率低、补偿降低有效浓度、剖面偏移/扩散异常、残留位错或非晶层。SIMS量总元素、不区分激活；片阻与Hall反映电阻率、浓度、迁移率和有效输运；SRP/C–V量有效载流子深度分布。影响V_T、结深/结电容、重掺接触区欧姆电阻、反向漏电和击穿。
Failures include low activation from damage/insufficient anneal, compensation, shifted/diffused profiles and residual dislocations/amorphous layers. SIMS measures total elements without activation discrimination; sheet resistance/Hall characterize resistivity, carriers and mobility; SRP/C–V profiles effective carriers. Effects include V_T, junction depth/capacitance, heavily doped contact resistance, reverse leakage and breakdown.
适用范围与边界
Scope and boundaries
浅能级模型适于常见Si浅施主/受主，不通用于深能级、重掺杂及SiC/GaN等宽带隙材料。实际能带可受带隙变窄、杂质带和缺陷态影响。掺杂只是起点，激活、补偿、缺陷和分布共同决定最终电性。
The shallow-level model applies to common shallow donors/acceptors in Si, not universally to deep levels, heavy doping or wide-gap SiC/GaN. Real bands may include gap narrowing, impurity bands and defect states. Activation, compensation, defects and distribution jointly determine final electrical behavior.
原图掺杂种类小框只在四种元素下统一标“受主（p型）”，会混淆P/As与B/Al；正文列出元素但不沿用该统一标签，整体施主/受主流程按原图上方说明保留。
The small species panel places a single “acceptor (P-type)” label beneath all four elements, which can confuse P/As with B/Al. The text lists the species without repeating that combined label; donor/acceptor behavior follows the source’s main explanation.

paragraphs.zh: 掺杂改变载流子统计与E_F，最终电性还取决于电离、激活、补偿和缺陷。能量向上增加；本征n=p=n_i，E_F在禁带中部附近；n型引入E_D近E_c，n≫p，E_F上移；p型引入E_A近E_v，p≫n，E_F下移。图例为导带E_c、价带E_v、红虚线E_F、蓝虚线E_D、紫虚线E_A、蓝电子e⁻和空心空穴h⁺。
paragraphs.en: Doping changes carrier statistics and E_F, while final electrical behavior also depends on ionization, activation, compensation and defects. Energy rises upward. Intrinsic n=p=n_i with near-midgap E_F; N-type adds E_D near E_c, n≫p and raised E_F; P-type adds E_A near E_v, p≫n and lowered E_F. Legends label bands, red E_F, blue E_D, purple E_A, blue electrons and hollow holes.

paragraphs.zh: 在硅晶格替位引入P、As、B等杂质 → 禁带形成施主/受主能级 → 电离与激活（施主供电子，受主产生空穴）→ n型电子或p型空穴多数载流子增加 → E_F相应上/下移。
paragraphs.en: Introduce substitutional P, As, B and other dopants into silicon → form donor/acceptor gap levels → ionize/activate (donors supply electrons, acceptors generate holes) → increase majority carriers → shift E_F upward/downward.

paragraphs.zh: 控制掺杂种类（图列P、As、B、Al）、总浓度/激活率、补偿、空间分布。N_active=ηN_total，η≤1；施主受主共存相互补偿、降低有效载流子；均匀/非均匀剖面影响结深电性。增浓度可降片阻、增载流子，但增强杂质散射、降迁移率，并可能产生简并、带隙变窄、结漏电增加。
paragraphs.en: Control species (P, As, B, Al shown), total concentration/activation, compensation and spatial profile. N_active=ηN_total, η≤1. Coexisting donors/acceptors compensate; profiles affect junction depth/electrical behavior. Higher doping lowers sheet resistance/raises carriers but increases impurity scattering, reduces mobility and may cause degeneracy, gap narrowing and junction leakage.

paragraphs.zh: 失效为损伤/退火不足导致激活率低、补偿降低有效浓度、剖面偏移/扩散异常、残留位错或非晶层。SIMS量总元素、不区分激活；片阻与Hall反映电阻率、浓度、迁移率和有效输运；SRP/C–V量有效载流子深度分布。影响V_T、结深/结电容、重掺接触区欧姆电阻、反向漏电和击穿。
paragraphs.en: Failures include low activation from damage/insufficient anneal, compensation, shifted/diffused profiles and residual dislocations/amorphous layers. SIMS measures total elements without activation discrimination; sheet resistance/Hall characterize resistivity, carriers and mobility; SRP/C–V profiles effective carriers. Effects include V_T, junction depth/capacitance, heavily doped contact resistance, reverse leakage and breakdown.

paragraphs.zh: 浅能级模型适于常见Si浅施主/受主，不通用于深能级、重掺杂及SiC/GaN等宽带隙材料。实际能带可受带隙变窄、杂质带和缺陷态影响。掺杂只是起点，激活、补偿、缺陷和分布共同决定最终电性。
paragraphs.en: The shallow-level model applies to common shallow donors/acceptors in Si, not universally to deep levels, heavy doping or wide-gap SiC/GaN. Real bands may include gap narrowing, impurity bands and defect states. Activation, compensation, defects and distribution jointly determine final electrical behavior.

工艺选择：带隙、掺杂与势垒怎么配
Process selection: matching gap, doping and barriers
材料体系 / 掺杂路线 / 接触界面 / 器件目标
Material system / doping route / contact interface / device goals
能带物理
掺杂 Doping 费米能级 Fermi level 接触 Contact 载流子 Carrier
核心结论与材料带隙
Core conclusion and material gaps
没有单独最好的能带，须匹配电压、温度、速度、漏电和光学目标。原图表：Ge窄带隙约0.7 eV，本征载流子高、漏电倾向大、击穿场低、红外响应；Si中等带隙1.1 eV，载流子适中、漏电/场强中等、可见/近红外；GaN/SiC宽带隙3.2–3.4 eV，本征浓度很低、漏电小、场强高、紫外/可见。宽带隙高温高场更稳，但激活和低阻欧姆接触更难。
No band structure is best alone; match voltage, temperature, speed, leakage and optics. Source table: Ge ~0.7 eV, high intrinsic carriers/leakage, low breakdown field, infrared; Si 1.1 eV, moderate carriers/leakage/field, visible/near-IR; GaN/SiC 3.2–3.4 eV, very low intrinsic carriers/leakage, high field, UV/visible. Wide gaps improve high-temperature/field operation but complicate activation and low-resistance contacts.
掺杂路线比较
Doping-route comparison
原位掺杂在外延生长中引入：轮廓控制好、激活需求低、晶格损伤小、热预算低—中，典型外延层。扩散在高温使杂质向内：轮廓控制较差、激活需求较高、损伤小、热预算高，用深结/均匀掺杂。离子注入后退火：轮廓控制很好、需退火、损伤较大、热预算中—高，用浅结/精准轮廓。浓度影响电阻/阈值，过高增强散射漏电，需权衡激活与损伤。
In-situ epitaxial doping: good profile control, lower activation demand, little damage, low–medium thermal budget, used in epitaxial layers. Thermal diffusion: poorer profile control, higher activation demand as described, little damage, high budget, used for deep/uniform doping. Implantation plus anneal: very good profile control, anneal required, more damage, medium–high budget, used for shallow/precise profiles. Concentration affects resistance/threshold but excessive doping increases scattering/leakage.
接触与界面
Contacts and interfaces
欧姆接触：能带/功函数匹配，势垒薄或可隧穿，低电阻、界面态影响较小，用源漏/电极，挑战是高掺杂/低阻。肖特基：势垒φ_B形成整流，界面态影响可能大，接触电阻中—高，用二极管/传感器，需控势垒高。绝缘界面如栅氧：抑制注入，形成绝缘势垒，电阻很高，界面态决定阈值/可靠性，用MOS栅，需控稳定性。宽带隙低阻接触可通过高掺杂、金属选择或界面工程优化。
Ohmic contacts use alignment and thin/tunnelable barriers for low resistance, often at source/drain/electrodes, with high-doping/low-resistance challenges. Schottky contacts use φ_B for rectification; interface effects may be large and resistance medium–high, for diodes/sensors with barrier-height control. Dielectric interfaces such as gate oxide block injection, have high resistance and interface-dependent threshold/reliability, for MOS gates. Wide-gap contacts may need high doping, suitable metals or interface engineering.
选择流程与考量维度
Selection flow and dimensions
明确电压/速度、温度、波长/漏电、可靠性目标 → 选材料带隙并评击穿光学与工艺可行性 → 定n/p、浓度、结深梯度、阈值电阻 → 选原位/扩散/注入及激活、热预算/损伤控制 → 设计欧姆/肖特基/绝缘界面、功函数与接触 → 电学测量对标并迭代。维度为E_g/临界场/耐温、迁移率/开关频率、掺杂浓度轮廓与激活、界面态/接触稳定性。
Define voltage/speed, temperature, wavelength/leakage and reliability → choose gap/material and assess breakdown/optics/process feasibility → set type, concentration, depth/gradient, threshold/resistance → select doping/activation/budget/damage control → design contacts/interfaces/work function → electrically verify and iterate. Assess gap/critical field/temperature, mobility/switching frequency, profile/activation and interface/contact stability.
权衡、风险、量测与应用
Trade-offs, risks, metrology and applications
宽带隙降漏电增击穿但激活接触难；重掺降阻却增散射、降迁移率、增漏电；低热预算减损伤却可能激活不足；高势垒抑漏电却增接触阻。风险：路线目标不匹配、激活不足或剖面偏移、势垒过高或E_F钉扎、界面态使阈值漂移/可靠性下降。
Wide gaps trade leakage/breakdown against activation/contacts; heavy doping trades resistance against scattering/mobility/leakage; low thermal budget may limit activation; high barriers suppress leakage but raise contact resistance. Risks include route/goal mismatch, poor activation/shifted profiles, excessive barriers/Fermi pinning and interface-induced threshold/reliability issues.
Hall/片阻测浓度、迁移率和片阻；SIMS/SRP查掺杂分布、结深轮廓；C–V查掺杂、界面态与氧化层；I–V查接触、整流和漏电；吸收/发光查带隙、效率与材料质量。逻辑要高速低功耗低漏电；功率要高压高温可靠性；射频要高频低损耗；光电要特定波长吸收/发光；传感要高灵敏低噪。不同器件没有统一材料和工艺方案。
Hall/sheet resistance measures carriers/mobility/resistance; SIMS/SRP checks profiles/depth; C–V checks doping/interfaces/oxide; I–V checks contacts/rectification/leakage; optics checks gap/efficiency/material quality. Logic targets speed/low power/leakage; power targets voltage/temperature/reliability; RF high frequency/low loss; optoelectronics wavelength-specific absorption/emission; sensors sensitivity/low noise. No universal route covers all.
材料表的数值、光谱范围及工艺热预算是原图定性/代表性比较，须按具体材料、结构、温度与实际配方使用，不能视为固定工艺规格。
Material values, spectral ranges and thermal budgets are representative source comparisons, not fixed specifications; apply them with the specific material, structure, temperature and process.

paragraphs.zh: 原位掺杂在外延生长中引入：轮廓控制好、激活需求低、晶格损伤小、热预算低—中，典型外延层。扩散在高温使杂质向内：轮廓控制较差、激活需求较高、损伤小、热预算高，用深结/均匀掺杂。离子注入后退火：轮廓控制很好、需退火、损伤较大、热预算中—高，用浅结/精准轮廓。浓度影响电阻/阈值，过高增强散射漏电，需权衡激活与损伤。
paragraphs.en: In-situ epitaxial doping: good profile control, lower activation demand, little damage, low–medium thermal budget, used in epitaxial layers. Thermal diffusion: poorer profile control, higher activation demand as described, little damage, high budget, used for deep/uniform doping. Implantation plus anneal: very good profile control, anneal required, more damage, medium–high budget, used for shallow/precise profiles. Concentration affects resistance/threshold but excessive doping increases scattering/leakage.

paragraphs.zh: 欧姆接触：能带/功函数匹配，势垒薄或可隧穿，低电阻、界面态影响较小，用源漏/电极，挑战是高掺杂/低阻。肖特基：势垒φ_B形成整流，界面态影响可能大，接触电阻中—高，用二极管/传感器，需控势垒高。绝缘界面如栅氧：抑制注入，形成绝缘势垒，电阻很高，界面态决定阈值/可靠性，用MOS栅，需控稳定性。宽带隙低阻接触可通过高掺杂、金属选择或界面工程优化。
paragraphs.en: Ohmic contacts use alignment and thin/tunnelable barriers for low resistance, often at source/drain/electrodes, with high-doping/low-resistance challenges. Schottky contacts use φ_B for rectification; interface effects may be large and resistance medium–high, for diodes/sensors with barrier-height control. Dielectric interfaces such as gate oxide block injection, have high resistance and interface-dependent threshold/reliability, for MOS gates. Wide-gap contacts may need high doping, suitable metals or interface engineering.

paragraphs.zh: 明确电压/速度、温度、波长/漏电、可靠性目标 → 选材料带隙并评击穿光学与工艺可行性 → 定n/p、浓度、结深梯度、阈值电阻 → 选原位/扩散/注入及激活、热预算/损伤控制 → 设计欧姆/肖特基/绝缘界面、功函数与接触 → 电学测量对标并迭代。维度为E_g/临界场/耐温、迁移率/开关频率、掺杂浓度轮廓与激活、界面态/接触稳定性。
paragraphs.en: Define voltage/speed, temperature, wavelength/leakage and reliability → choose gap/material and assess breakdown/optics/process feasibility → set type, concentration, depth/gradient, threshold/resistance → select doping/activation/budget/damage control → design contacts/interfaces/work function → electrically verify and iterate. Assess gap/critical field/temperature, mobility/switching frequency, profile/activation and interface/contact stability.

paragraphs.zh: 宽带隙降漏电增击穿但激活接触难；重掺降阻却增散射、降迁移率、增漏电；低热预算减损伤却可能激活不足；高势垒抑漏电却增接触阻。风险：路线目标不匹配、激活不足或剖面偏移、势垒过高或E_F钉扎、界面态使阈值漂移/可靠性下降。
paragraphs.en: Wide gaps trade leakage/breakdown against activation/contacts; heavy doping trades resistance against scattering/mobility/leakage; low thermal budget may limit activation; high barriers suppress leakage but raise contact resistance. Risks include route/goal mismatch, poor activation/shifted profiles, excessive barriers/Fermi pinning and interface-induced threshold/reliability issues.

paragraphs.zh: Hall/片阻测浓度、迁移率和片阻；SIMS/SRP查掺杂分布、结深轮廓；C–V查掺杂、界面态与氧化层；I–V查接触、整流和漏电；吸收/发光查带隙、效率与材料质量。逻辑要高速低功耗低漏电；功率要高压高温可靠性；射频要高频低损耗；光电要特定波长吸收/发光；传感要高灵敏低噪。不同器件没有统一材料和工艺方案。
paragraphs.en: Hall/sheet resistance measures carriers/mobility/resistance; SIMS/SRP checks profiles/depth; C–V checks doping/interfaces/oxide; I–V checks contacts/rectification/leakage; optics checks gap/efficiency/material quality. Logic targets speed/low power/leakage; power targets voltage/temperature/reliability; RF high frequency/low loss; optoelectronics wavelength-specific absorption/emission; sensors sensitivity/low noise. No universal route covers all.

records.text:

Defect control: a flat surface may already be damaged
Dishing / Erosion / 划伤/ 颗粒与腐蚀
Dishing / erosion / scratches / particles and corrosion
CMP 平坦化与控制
CMP BEOL FEOL 量测 Metrology
流程与判断
Flow and judgment
平坦度合格，不代表缺陷、电性和可靠性同时合格
Passing planarity does not imply passing defects, electrical performance and reliability
缺陷控制流程；从检测到处置，闭环降低缺陷风险
Defect-control flow Close the loop from detection to action to reduce defect risk
缺陷检测；光学 /电学 /形貌
Defect inspection Optical / electrical / morphology
缺陷分类；形貌与特征识别
Defect classification Identify morphology and features
关联图形与位置；版图/ 密度/ 关键区
Correlate patterns and locations Layout / density / critical regions
对照设备耗材；机台/ 抛光垫/ 浆料
Compare equipment and consumables Tool / pad / slurry
根因验证；试验/ 数据比对
Root-cause validation Experiments / data comparison
控制处置；工艺优化/预防
Control actions Process optimization / prevention
缺陷类型
Defect types
关键缺陷类型与示意；不同缺陷形貌不同，成因不同，影响不同
Key defect types and illustrations Different morphology, causes and effects
Dishing：宽金属区局部凹陷；宽金属线中心被过度去除；形成局部凹陷
Dishing: local depression in a wide-metal region Excessive removal at the center of a wide metal line creates local depression
Erosion：高密度图形区整体介质损失；高密度图形区介质被整体去除；表面整体下沉
Erosion: overall dielectric loss in a dense-pattern region Dielectric is removed across a dense-pattern region and the overall surface subsides
Scratch：硬颗粒或接触异常；形成划伤；由硬颗粒或接触异常；在表面形成线性划伤
Scratch: hard particles or abnormal contact produce scratches Hard particles or abnormal contact create linear surface scratches
颗粒与腐蚀：残留、清洗或；化学失衡；残留颗粒或化学失衡引起；颗粒与腐蚀斑
Particles and corrosion: residues, cleaning or chemical imbalance Residual particles or chemical imbalance create particle and corrosion spots
耦合与边界
Coupling and limits
耦合关系：去除条件与缺陷风险；去除越强，效率越高，但缺陷风险也同步上升
Coupling: removal conditions and defect risk Stronger removal increases efficiency and also increases defect risk
增强去除条件；（更高压力/更激进工艺）
Stronger removal conditions (higher pressure / more aggressive process)
时间可能缩短；（效率提升）
Time may decrease (higher efficiency)
图形凹陷、介质损耗；和机械缺陷风险增加
Higher risk of pattern depression, dielectric loss and mechanical defects
影响边界；Dishing与Erosion；受版图密度、线宽、；材料堆叠和工艺窗口；共同影响
Boundary of impact Dishing and erosion are jointly influenced by pattern density, linewidth, material stack and process window together
量测和下游
Metrology and downstream impact
常见信号 从量测结果中识别典型缺陷表现；宽线凹陷；（Dishing）
Common signals: identify characteristic defects in metrology Wide-line depression (dishing)
密集区下沉；（Erosion）
Dense-region subsidence (erosion)

阻挡与常见情况
Blocking and common cases
核心提示；开放区要注入，保护区要真正挡住
Key point Implant the open region; truly block the protected region
注入离子束；光刻胶/掩膜；表面膜层；硅片；阻挡区；阻挡区；注入区
Incident ion beam Photoresist / mask Surface film Silicon wafer Blocked region Blocked region Implanted region
正确阻挡；掩膜有效阻挡，；仅开放区注入
Correct blocking The mask blocks effectively; implantation is limited to the opening
掩膜穿透；掩膜过薄，离子穿透；造成非选择性注入
Mask penetration An overly thin mask allows ions through, causing nonselective implantation
横向展宽；边缘横向散射，；导致结向侧向扩展
Lateral broadening Lateral scattering at edges extends the junction sideways
阴影欠注入；倾斜注入时，；高侧壁背风侧形成阴影
Shadow-induced under-implantation During tilted implantation, the leeward side of a tall sidewall is shadowed
参数与权衡
Parameters and trade-offs
掩膜阻挡厚度；• 决定阻挡能力；• 过薄可能被穿透；•过厚增加工艺负担
Mask blocking thickness • Determines blocking capability • Too thin may allow penetration • Too thick adds processing burden
材料密度与组成；• 高密度材料阻挡更强；• 不同材料阻挡能力不同
Material density and composition • Denser materials block more strongly • Blocking differs between materials
窗口CD与套刻；• 窗口CD决定注入宽度；• 套刻误差影响选择区位置
Window CD and overlay • Window CD determines implant width • Overlay error shifts the selected region
侧壁高度与注入角度；• 侧壁越高，阴影越明显；• 入射角越大，阴影区；域越大
Sidewall height and implant angle • Taller sidewalls cast stronger shadows • Larger incidence angles produce larger shadowed regions
增厚掩膜：阻挡能力提高 ↔ 光刻、剥离与阴影负担增加
Thicker mask: stronger blocking ↔ greater lithography, stripping and shadowing burden
主要风险；掩膜穿透；横向展宽；光刻胶硬化/残留；阴影欠注入
Main risks Mask penetration Lateral broadening Resist hardening / residue Shadow-induced under-implantation

Damage and activation: anneal to repair without excessive diffusion
晶格损伤 / 再结晶 /电学激活 / 热预算
Lattice damage / recrystallization / electrical activation / thermal budget
离子注入
Doping FEOL Implant Anneal
关键机理
Mechanisms
1 形成注入损伤；高能离子进入硅片；产生晶格损伤和间隙原子。
1 Create implant damage Energetic ions enter silicon causing lattice damage and interstitial atoms
通过受控加热提供
Controlled heating supplies
损伤区域逐步恢复为
The damaged region gradually recovers
部分注入原子进入；晶格替位位置，获得电学活性。
Some implanted atoms occupy substitutional lattice sites and become electrically active
退火同时引起掺杂扩散
Annealing also drives dopant diffusion
通过多种表征确认；測试电学参数；评估工艺结果
Multiple characterization methods confirm Measure electrical parameters and evaluate process results
非晶化区/晶格损伤
Amorphous region / lattice damage
热能驱动原子迁移；与缺陷消除
Thermal energy drives atomic migration and defect removal
晶格修复；缺陷减少
Lattice repair Fewer defects
•硅原子；替位掺杂原子；（电学活性）
Silicon atom Substitutional dopant atom (electrically active)
掺杂向纵深与横向扩散；缺陷持续演化
Dopants diffuse vertically and laterally Defects continue to evolve
注入导入原子，退火把它转化为可用电学掺杂；修复损伤、激活电活性，但必须控制扩散与缺陷
Implantation introduces atoms; annealing converts them into useful electrical doping Repair damage and activate dopants while controlling diffusion and defects
关键参数与权衡
Parameters and trade-offs
峰值温度与时间；决定原子迁移能力与修复程度
Peak temperature and time Determine atomic mobility and repair extent
升降温或脉冲方式；影响激活效率与热损伤控制
Heating/cooling ramp or pulse scheme Affects activation efficiency and thermal-damage control
环境与表面覆盖；影响表面反应与杂质行为
Ambient and surface covering Affect surface reactions and impurity behavior
剂量与损伤状态；决定初始缺陷浓度与激活难度
Dose and damage state Determine initial defect concentration and activation difficulty
修复与激活增强；•晶格损伤减少；• 替位掺杂增加；• 载流子浓度上升；• 片阻降低
Stronger repair and activation • Less lattice damage • More substitutional doping • Higher carrier concentration • Lower sheet resistance
扩散、结深与缺陷；演化加剧；• 掺杂扩散加剧；• 结深增大；•瞬态缺陷增多；• 轮廓变钝；• 器件特性恶化
Diffusion, junction depth and defects evolve more strongly • More dopant diffusion • Deeper junctions • More transient defects • Broader profiles • Degraded device characteristics
需要在激活与扩散之间取得最佳平衡
Find the optimum balance between activation and diffusion
风险
Risks
激活不足/ 片阻偏高；退火能量不足或损伤过重；导致替位率低。
Insufficient activation / high sheet resistance Insufficient anneal energy or excessive damage leads to a low substitutional fraction
瞬态增强扩散；非平衡缺陷促进掺杂；异常扩散，结深超预期。
Transient enhanced diffusion Nonequilibrium defects promote abnormal dopant diffusion and excessive junction depth
残余缺陷；间隙原子、空位团等；未完全消除，影响可靠性。
Residual defects Interstitial atoms and vacancy clusters remain and affect reliability
偏聚或团簇；掺杂原子聚集形成簇，；降低电学活性。
Segregation or clustering Dopant atoms aggregate into clusters, reducing electrical activity

Metrology and feedback

Hall measurement Obtain carrier concentration and mobility

SIMS depth analysis Analyze dopant profile and junction depth
TEM / XRD；观察晶格修复与；缺陷状态
TEM / XRD Observe lattice repair and defect states
漏电特性；评估结质量与器；件可靠性
Leakage characteristics Assess junction quality and device reliability

量测流程
Measurement workflow
从剂量到电性，建立量测闭环，用于验证工艺、定位异常与批次处置，；各量测回答不同问题，不能相互替代。
Build a dose-to-electrical metrology loop to validate processes, locate anomalies and disposition lots Each measurement answers a different question and cannot replace the others
不同的量测口径；协同验证工艺效果
Different measurement definitions jointly verify process results
1 读取束流剂量；通过Faraday杯；积分离子束流，；得到注入剂量。
1 Read beam dose Use a Faraday cup Integrate ion beam current, to obtain implant dose
检查机台状态、；工艺条件与晶圆来料；信息，确保量测可比；与可追溯。
Check tool status, process conditions and incoming-wafer information to ensure comparability and traceability
采用二次离子质谱；总原子浓度深度分布。
Use secondary-ion mass spectrometry total atomic concentration versus depth
4 片阻或Hall测电学；通过片阻或霍尔测试；获取电学参数，反映；迁移率的综合结果。
4 Measure electrical properties by sheet resistance or Hall Use sheet-resistance or Hall tests Obtain electrical parameters reflecting the combined effects of mobility
结合电学与结构量测；评估结深、掺杂轮廓；及器件关键电性。
Combine electrical and structural measurements Evaluate junction depth, dopant profile and key device electrical properties
6 SPC与异常处置；通过统计过程控制；监控关键指标，；识别异常并进行；批次处置。
6 SPC and abnormal-lot disposition Use statistical process control to monitor key metrics, identify abnormalities and disposition lots
口径与控制
Definitions and controls
总浓度与活性口径；• SIMS测的是总原子浓度；• 电学反映活性载流子；•两者物理意义不同
Total concentration versus active carriers • SIMS measures total atomic concentration • Electrical measurements reflect active carriers • Their physical meanings differ
监控片与采样位置；•合理设置监控片；• 明确采样位置与频次；•关注片内与片间差异
Monitor wafers and sampling positions • Choose monitor wafers appropriately • Specify sampling locations and frequency • Track within-wafer and wafer-to-wafer differences
量测校准；• 定期校准与标样比对；• 确认量测线性与重复性；• 不同量测方法需独立校准
Metrology calibration • Calibrate regularly against standards • Confirm linearity and repeatability • Calibrate different methods independently
控制限与批次处置；•建立合理的控制限；• 区分随机波动与异常；• 按流程进行批次评估与处置
Control limits and lot disposition • Establish reasonable control limits • Distinguish random variation from abnormalities • Follow procedures for lot evaluation and disposition
SIMS总原子浓度；电学活性浓度；SIMS给出杂质的“总量”；电学反映其中“有多大比例被激活”；两者不能互相替代；需结合使用，才能全面判断工艺结果。
SIMS total atomic concentration Electrically active concentration SIMS gives the total amount of impurities Electrical measurements reflect the activated proportion Neither replaces the other Use both to assess process results comprehensively
片阻改善也可能伴随扩散和结深增加；提高激活程度可能降低片阻，；但也可能导致杂质进一步扩散，；使结深增加，需综合评估电学、；结构与器件电性。
Lower sheet resistance may accompany diffusion and deeper junctions Greater activation may lower sheet resistance, but may also cause further impurity diffusion, increasing junction depth; assess electrical, structural and device properties together
风险
Risks
剂量正常但深度错误；束流积分正常，但能量或角度异常导致深度偏差。
Correct dose but wrong depth Normal beam integral but abnormal energy or angle produces depth error
SIMS合格但激活不足；总浓度达标，但活性载流子浓度偏低，片阻偏高。
Acceptable SIMS but insufficient activation Total concentration meets target but active-carrier concentration is low and sheet resistance high
平均片阻掩盖不均；仅看平均值可能忽略片内或片间不均匀性。
Average sheet resistance hides nonuniformity An average alone can hide within-wafer or wafer-to-wafer variation
量测机系统偏差；设备漂移、校准不良或量测条件变化导致系统性偏差。
Systematic metrology bias Tool drift, poor calibration or changed measurement conditions cause systematic bias
反馈链路
Feedback chain
量测反馈链路 从物理量到器件表现，逐级验证，定位问题
Metrology feedback chain: verify from physical quantities to device performance and locate problems
Faraday：束流剂量；实际注入的剂量有多少
Faraday: beam dose How much dose was actually implanted?
SIMS：总浓度；杂质在深度方向如何分布
SIMS: total concentration How are impurities distributed with depth?
片阻/Hall：电学响应；有多少载流子被激活
Sheet resistance / Hall: electrical response How many carriers are activated?
器件电性；最终器件性能如何
Device electrical properties How does the final device perform?
多维数据交叉验证；快速定位问题根因；支撑工艺与批次决策；稳定提升产品良率；数据关联•定位异常•持续优化
Cross-validate multidimensional data Locate root causes quickly Support process and lot decisions Improve product yield consistently Correlate data · locate anomalies · continually optimize

paragraphs.en: Check tool status, process conditions and incoming-wafer information to ensure comparability and traceability

paragraphs.zh: 采用二次离子质谱；总原子浓度深度分布。
paragraphs.en: Use secondary-ion mass spectrometry total atomic concentration versus depth

paragraphs.zh: 4 片阻或Hall测电学；通过片阻或霍尔测试；获取电学参数，反映；迁移率的综合结果。
paragraphs.en: 4 Measure electrical properties by sheet resistance or Hall Use sheet-resistance or Hall tests Obtain electrical parameters reflecting the combined effects of mobility

paragraphs.zh: 结合电学与结构量测；评估结深、掺杂轮廓；及器件关键电性。
paragraphs.en: Combine electrical and structural measurements Evaluate junction depth, dopant profile and key device electrical properties

paragraphs.zh: 6 SPC与异常处置；通过统计过程控制；监控关键指标，；识别异常并进行；批次处置。
paragraphs.en: 6 SPC and abnormal-lot disposition Use statistical process control to monitor key metrics, identify abnormalities and disposition lots

paragraphs.zh: 总浓度与活性口径；• SIMS测的是总原子浓度；• 电学反映活性载流子；•两者物理意义不同
paragraphs.en: Total concentration versus active carriers • SIMS measures total atomic concentration • Electrical measurements reflect active carriers • Their physical meanings differ

paragraphs.zh: 监控片与采样位置；•合理设置监控片；• 明确采样位置与频次；•关注片内与片间差异
paragraphs.en: Monitor wafers and sampling positions • Choose monitor wafers appropriately • Specify sampling locations and frequency • Track within-wafer and wafer-to-wafer differences

paragraphs.zh: 量测校准；• 定期校准与标样比对；• 确认量测线性与重复性；• 不同量测方法需独立校准
paragraphs.en: Metrology calibration • Calibrate regularly against standards • Confirm linearity and repeatability • Calibrate different methods independently

paragraphs.zh: 控制限与批次处置；•建立合理的控制限；• 区分随机波动与异常；• 按流程进行批次评估与处置
paragraphs.en: Control limits and lot disposition • Establish reasonable control limits • Distinguish random variation from abnormalities • Follow procedures for lot evaluation and disposition

paragraphs.zh: SIMS总原子浓度；电学活性浓度；SIMS给出杂质的“总量”；电学反映其中“有多大比例被激活”；两者不能互相替代；需结合使用，才能全面判断工艺结果。
paragraphs.en: SIMS total atomic concentration Electrically active concentration SIMS gives the total amount of impurities Electrical measurements reflect the activated proportion Neither replaces the other Use both to assess process results comprehensively

paragraphs.zh: 片阻改善也可能伴随扩散和结深增加；提高激活程度可能降低片阻，；但也可能导致杂质进一步扩散，；使结深增加，需综合评估电学、；结构与器件电性。
paragraphs.en: Lower sheet resistance may accompany diffusion and deeper junctions Greater activation may lower sheet resistance, but may also cause further impurity diffusion, increasing junction depth; assess electrical, structural and device properties together

paragraphs.zh: 剂量正常但深度错误；束流积分正常，但能量或角度异常导致深度偏差。
paragraphs.en: Correct dose but wrong depth Normal beam integral but abnormal energy or angle produces depth error

paragraphs.zh: SIMS合格但激活不足；总浓度达标，但活性载流子浓度偏低，片阻偏高。
paragraphs.en: Acceptable SIMS but insufficient activation Total concentration meets target but active-carrier concentration is low and sheet resistance high

paragraphs.zh: 平均片阻掩盖不均；仅看平均值可能忽略片内或片间不均匀性。
paragraphs.en: Average sheet resistance hides nonuniformity An average alone can hide within-wafer or wafer-to-wafer variation

paragraphs.zh: 量测机系统偏差；设备漂移、校准不良或量测条件变化导致系统性偏差。
paragraphs.en: Systematic metrology bias Tool drift, poor calibration or changed measurement conditions cause systematic bias

paragraphs.zh: 量测反馈链路 从物理量到器件表现，逐级验证，定位问题
paragraphs.en: Metrology feedback chain: verify from physical quantities to device performance and locate problems

paragraphs.zh: Faraday：束流剂量；实际注入的剂量有多少
paragraphs.en: Faraday: beam dose How much dose was actually implanted?

paragraphs.zh: SIMS：总浓度；杂质在深度方向如何分布
paragraphs.en: SIMS: total concentration How are impurities distributed with depth?

paragraphs.zh: 片阻/Hall：电学响应；有多少载流子被激活
paragraphs.en: Sheet resistance / Hall: electrical response How many carriers are activated?

paragraphs.zh: 器件电性；最终器件性能如何
paragraphs.en: Device electrical properties How does the final device perform?

paragraphs.zh: 多维数据交叉验证；快速定位问题根因；支撑工艺与批次决策；稳定提升产品良率；数据关联•定位异常•持续优化
paragraphs.en: Cross-validate multidimensional data Locate root causes quickly Support process and lot decisions Improve product yield consistently Correlate data · locate anomalies · continually optimize

paragraphs.zh: 用量测看见工艺 用数据驱动良率
paragraphs.en: See the process through metrology; drive yield with data

paragraphs.zh: 得到总浓度的深度曲线

paragraphs.en: Cross-sectional structure and device electrical properties

paragraphs.zh: 量测数据反馈，形成闭环
paragraphs.en: Metrology data feedback closes the loop

paragraphs.zh: 不同的量测，看到不同的真相

description.en: Dose / total concentration / active carriers / electrical results

刻蚀均匀性与腔体控制

输运流程
Transport flow
01；配气；多种工艺气体；按比例混合；稳定供给
01 Gas mixing Multiple process gases are mixed in proportion and supplied steadily
02；分区进气；喷淋头多区分布；使气体在径向上；尽量均匀
02 Zoned gas inlet Multiple showerhead zones make radial gas delivery as uniform as possible
03；等离子体解离；气体在等离子体中；碰撞解离，生成；活性物种
03 Plasma dissociation Gas collides and dissociates in the plasma, generating reactive species
04；径向输运；活性物种在气流；与扩散作用下；从中心向边缘输运
04 Radial transport Reactive species are transported by gas flow and diffusion from center to edge
05；表面消耗；活性物种在晶圆表面；发生反应并被消耗；浓度沿径向降低
05 Surface consumption Reactive species at the wafer surface react and are consumed so concentration decreases radially
06；副产物排出；反应生成的副产物；被气流带走；从下方抽气排出
06 Byproduct removal Reaction byproducts are carried by gas flow and exhausted from below

title.zh: 等离子体场：密度与能量分开看
title.en: Plasma fields: distinguish density from energy

records.category: 刻蚀均匀性与腔体控制
records.text:
等离子体场：密度与能量分开看
Plasma fields: distinguish density from energy
离子通量 / 能量/入射角/反应物
Ion flux / energy / incidence angle / reactants
刻蚀均匀性与腔体控制
Etch Plasma SPC FDC
流程
Workflow
01；RF匹配；射频能量耦合；到放电腔体
01 RF matching Couple RF energy into the discharge chamber
02 电离解离；产生等离子体和；活性中性粒子
02 Ionization and dissociation Generate plasma and reactive neutral species
03；粒子扩散；在源区内扩散并；向下输运
03 Particle diffusion Diffuse within the source region and transport downward
04；鞘层建立；晶圆表面形成鞘层；产生强电场
04 Sheath formation A sheath forms at the wafer surface and creates a strong electric field
05；偏压加速；离子在鞘层中加速；获得方向性与能量
05 Bias acceleration Ions accelerate through the sheath and acquire directionality and energy
06；表面去除；化学反应与物理轰击；共同实现刻蚀
06 Surface removal Chemical reaction and physical bombardment jointly produce etching
场与控制
Fields and control
RF源区；射频电源；（源功率）
RF source region RF power supply (source power)
源区；高密度等离子体；产生反应物
Source region High-density plasma generates reactants
离子；电子；中性粒子；（反应物）
Ion Electron Neutral species (reactant)
鞘层；建立电位降；加速离子
Sheath Establish a potential drop to accelerate ions
晶圆；晶圆偏压；（偏压功率或波形）
Wafer Wafer bias (bias power or waveform)
源功率与空间耦合；• 等离子体密度；• 中性粒子浓度；• 气相反应路径；•影响通量分布
Source power and spatial coupling • Plasma density • Neutral-species concentration • Gas-phase reaction pathways • Affects flux distribution
偏压功率或波形；• 离子能量；• 入射角分布；• 表面热负荷；• 潜在损伤

掩膜与停止层结构；不同材料的刻蚀速率；影响选择比与过刻窗口

Wall conditions

Seasoning conditions • Gas species and flow • Time and power settings • Determine initial wall-film properties
累计片数或等离子时间；•随片数膜层逐渐变化；•影响刻蚀速率与均匀性；• 存在漂移趋势

Kit and focus-ring lifetime • Wear / deposits change gaps • Affect gas flow and electric-field distribution • Drift becomes more likely near end of life

title.en: Mechanisms: how material is removed

records.text:
机制区别：材料怎样被去掉
Mechanisms: how material is removed
液相反应、活性物种与离子作用。
Liquid-phase reactions, reactive species and ion action
干法与湿法刻蚀
Etch Selectivity Profile Clean
机制与流程
Mechanisms and process position
核心判断；湿法以液相化学反应去除材料；常见RIE依靠化学反应与离子作用协同。；干法还包含气相化学刻蚀、离子束刻蚀等不同机制。
Core assessment Wet etching removes material through liquid-phase chemistry; typical RIE combines chemical reactions and ion action Dry etching also includes gas-phase chemical etching, ion-beam etching and other mechanisms
流程位置；接收目标膜层及掩膜/暴露区域，完成材料去除，交给后清洗和量测。
Position in the flow Receive the target film and mask/exposed regions, remove material, then pass to post-clean and metrology
湿法刻蚀（液相化学反应）；反应物在液相中与表面发生化学反应，生成可溶性产物。；刻蚀液；（化学反应物）；可溶性产物；随液流带走；掩膜；Si；各向异性湿法示例；（晶向选择性，侧壁向内倾斜）
Wet etching (liquid-phase chemical reaction) Reactants chemically react with the surface in liquid to form soluble products Etchant (chemical reactant) Soluble products carried away by liquid flow Mask Si Example of anisotropic wet etching (crystallographic selectivity; inward-sloping sidewalls)
反应离子刻蚀（RIE，反应性干法）；气相活性物种发生化学反应，离子提供能量辅助去除。；中性活性物种；正离子；（化学反应）；（提供能量）；掩膜；挥发性产物；被抽气带走；Si；各向异性干法示例；（化学反应＋离子作用）
Reactive ion etching (RIE, reactive dry etching) Reactive gas species react chemically while ions supply energy to assist removal Neutral reactive species Positive ions (chemical reaction) (energy supply) Mask Volatile products removed by pumping Si Example of anisotropic dry etching (chemical reaction + ion action)
过程链
Process chain
过程链；该链主要描述湿法与；反应性干法；纯物理；溅射以动量传递去除；材料。
Process chain This chain mainly describes wet and reactive dry etching; pure physical sputtering removes material through momentum transfer
反应物到达表面
Reactants reach the surface
2；吸附或接触
2 Adsorption or contact
3；表面反应/；能量辅助去除
3 Surface reaction / energy-assisted removal
产物离开表面
Products leave the surface
5；产物被液流或；抽气带走
5 Products are carried away by liquid flow or pumping
控制与失效
Controls and failures
关键控制；• 反应物供给；• 表面温度；产物排出；• RIE另需控制离子能量
Key controls • Reactant supply • Surface temperature Product removal • RIE also requires ion-energy control
耦合与失效；加强离子作用可能促进；去除，也可能增加掩膜；损耗和表面损伤；供给；不足或产物排出不畅可；能造成残留与局部刻蚀；不足。
Coupling and failure Stronger ion action can promote removal but may also increase mask loss and surface damage; insufficient supply or poor product evacuation may cause residue and local underetch
量测与下游
Metrology and downstream effects
量测反馈；用膜厚差或台阶深度；估算速率，结合缺陷检；查判断是否去净，支持；复核供给、温控与表面；状态。
Metrology feedback Estimate rate from film-thickness change or step depth, and inspect defects to determine whether removal is complete; use this to review supply, temperature control and surface condition
下游影响与边界；表面残留会影响后续成；膜、接触或附着；干法；不能全部解释为“靠离；子撞击”。
Downstream effects and boundaries Surface residue affects subsequent film growth, contacts or adhesion; dry etching cannot always be explained as ion bombardment alone
