Directional control: what determines the sidewall?
纵向去除、横向去除与晶面差异。
Vertical removal, lateral removal and crystal-plane differences
干法与湿法刻蚀
Etch Selectivity Profile Clean
判断与位置
Assessment and position
核心判断；各向异性描述不同方向刻蚀速率的差别；；“干/湿”分类本身不能决定最终侧壁形状。
Core assessment Anisotropy describes differences in etch rate across directions; the dry/wet classification alone does not determine final sidewall shape
流程位置；把掩膜开口转成目标层轮廓，为后续填充、隔离或结构释放提供几何形状。
Position in the flow Convert mask openings into target-layer profiles for subsequent fill, isolation or structural release
控制流程
Control flow
1；明确目标轮廓；确定所需的沟槽或；通孔形状
1 Define the target profile Define the required trench or via shape
2 检查材料与晶向；确认刻蚀材料；及晶向（如Si（100））
2 Check material and crystal orientation Confirm the etched material and orientation (e.g. Si(100))
3；匹配反应和；方向控制机制；选择合适的刻蚀方法；与反应条件
3 Match the reaction and directional-control mechanism Choose a suitable etch method and reaction conditions
控制刻蚀深度；达到目标；纵向去除量
Control etch depth Achieve the target vertical removal
5；比对顶部/底部；尺寸及侧壁；确认关键尺寸；与侧壁形貌
5 Compare top/bottom dimensions and sidewalls Verify critical dimensions and sidewall profile
侧壁形貌
Sidewall profiles
方向性干法（如 RIE）；近乎直壁；Si；示例：Cl₂ / HBr；等离子体刻蚀硅
Directional dry etch (e.g. RIE) Nearly vertical sidewalls Si Example: Cl₂ / HBr plasma etching of silicon
各向同性刻蚀；侧向同时去除；Si；示例：XeF₂气相；刻蚀硅（干法，各向同性）
Isotropic etching Lateral removal occurs simultaneously Si Example: XeF₂ gas-phase silicon etching (dry, isotropic)
晶面选择性湿法；斜壁（受晶向控制）；（111）；（111）；Si（100）；示例：KOH 溶液；刻单晶硅（湿法，晶面控制）
Crystal-plane-selective wet etching Sloping walls (controlled by orientation) (111) (111) Si(100) Example: KOH solution etching single-crystal silicon (wet, crystal-plane controlled)
控制与边界
Controls and boundaries
关键控制；纵向深度；横向退缩；侧壁角度；θ；掩膜尺寸损失
Key controls Vertical depth Lateral recession Sidewall angle θ Mask dimensional loss
耦合与失效；• 在依赖钝化的方向性干法中，侧壁保护不足会；增加侧蚀，过强可能造成开口收缩或底部难刻。；• 深窄结构还可能出现与宽开口不同的刻蚀深度。
Coupling and failure • In directional dry etching that relies on passivation, insufficient sidewall protection increases lateral etch, while excessive protection can narrow openings or hinder bottom etching • Deep, narrow structures may also etch to different depths from wide openings
下游影响与边界；• 轮廓偏差可能带来填充空洞；或有效尺寸变化。；• XeF₂气相刻硅可各向同性；去除；KOH 刻单晶硅可形成；晶面控制的斜壁，该斜壁；不等同于 RIE的方向性直壁。
Downstream effects and boundaries • Profile deviations may cause fill voids or changes in effective dimensions • XeF₂ gas-phase silicon etching can remove isotropically; KOH etching of single-crystal silicon can form crystal-plane-controlled slopes; these sloped walls are not equivalent to directional RIE vertical walls
量测
Metrology
量测反馈；• 用截面 SEM检查；侧壁与底部。；• 用CD 量测比较；刻前刻后关键尺寸。；• 按开口宽度分组；判断形貌偏差。
Metrology feedback • Use cross-sectional SEM to inspect sidewalls and the bottom • Compare critical dimensions before and after etching by CD metrology • Group by opening width to assess profile deviations
量测结果反馈，优化工艺条件
Feed metrology results back to optimize process conditions

title.zh: 材料选择：刻掉谁，保住谁
title.en: Material selection: what to remove and what to protect

records.text:
材料选择：刻掉谁，保住谁
Material selection: what to remove and what to protect
目标层、掩膜、停止层与暴露材料。
Target layer, mask, stop layer and exposed materials
干法与湿法刻蚀
Etch Selectivity Profile Clean
核心与流程
Core and workflow
核心判断；选择比要写清材料对。S = 目标材料刻蚀速率 ÷ 被保护材料刻蚀速率；；相同条件下，S越大，去除相同目标厚度时，被保护材料通常损失越少。
Core assessment Specify the material pair: S = target-material etch rate ÷ protected-material etch rate Under identical conditions, higher S generally means less protected-material loss for the same target thickness removed
流程位置；在刻蚀前匹配材料堆栈、掩膜和化学体系，保证刻穿目标层后仍有保护余量。
Position in the flow Match the stack, mask and chemistry before etching so protection remains after clearing the target
选材流程；1；列出所有；暴露材料
Material-selection flow 1 List all exposed materials
2；确认目标；去除量
2 Confirm target removal amount
3；分别评估；材料对选择比
3 Evaluate each material-pair selectivity
4；核算掩膜/；停止层损失
4 Calculate mask / stop-layer loss
5；用代表性；结构验证
5 Validate with representative structures
材料与选择比
Materials and selectivity
材料堆栈与选择比示意；刻蚀气体 / 液体；掩膜（如SiO₂）；目标层（如Si）；停止层（如Si₃N₄）；衬底
Material stack and selectivity Etch gas / liquid Mask (e.g. SiO₂) Target layer (e.g. Si) Stop layer (e.g. Si₃N₄) Substrate
刻蚀速率与选择比；对掩膜；S_target/mask；对停止层；S_target/stop；S越大，；被保护材料损失越少。
Etch rate and selectivity Relative to mask S_target/mask Relative to stop layer S_target/stop As S increases, protected-material loss decreases
过刻导致薄弱处穿透（风险示意）；正常刻穿目标层；停止层仍有余量；目标层已去除；停止层未穿透
Overetch penetrates weak locations (risk schematic) Normally clear the target with stop-layer margin remaining Target layer removed Stop layer intact
过刻继续消耗；导致停止层穿透；过刻后停止层变薄；甚至被穿透
Continued consumption during overetch causes stop-layer breakthrough Overetch thins the stop layer and may penetrate it
控制与耦合
Controls and coupling
关键控制；对掩膜选择比；对停止层选择比；其他暴露层损失；过刻余量
Key controls Selectivity to mask Selectivity to stop layer Loss of other exposed layers Overetch margin
耦合与失效；• 为清除最难刻区域而延长过刻，；会继续消耗已暴露的保护层。；•可能造成掩膜耗尽、停止层穿透；或邻近材料被腐蚀。
Coupling and failure • Extending overetch to clear the hardest-to-etch regions continues consuming exposed protective layers • This may exhaust the mask, break through the stop layer or corrode nearby materials
量测与边界
Metrology and boundaries
量测反馈；刻前；刻后；比较刻前刻后；各层厚度，结合；截面检查最薄位置；；据此评估掩膜厚度、；停止方案和过刻安排。；反馈优化选材与工艺

下游影响与边界；• 保护层损失可能影响隔离和可靠性。；• 湿法与干法均可实现高选择性，数值取决于材料对、膜质和工艺条件。；• HF/BOE去氧化硅、热磷酸去氮化硅是常见湿法例子，仍须核对其余材料兼容性。

速率、形貌、选择比与均匀性。
Rate, profile, selectivity and uniformity
干法与湿法刻蚀
Etch Selectivity Profile Clean
判断与流程
Assessment and workflow
核心判断；工艺窗口要让多个指标同时达标；只追求更高刻蚀速率，；可能缩小其他指标的余量。
Core assessment The process window must meet multiple metrics simultaneously; pursuing only a higher etch rate can reduce margins for other metrics
流程位置；在路线确定后，建立配方窗口与日常监控条件。
Position in the flow After selecting the route, establish the recipe window and routine monitoring conditions

2；建立基准；条件

3 设计受控试验

output metrics and window boundaries
输入参数
Input parameters
化学与供给；干法气体组成；；湿法药液组成、；浓度及浴液状态。
Chemistry and supply Dry-etch gas composition; wet-bath composition, concentration and bath condition
能量与温度；干法源功率、基片；偏压和温控；；湿法液温。
Energy and temperature Dry source power, wafer bias and temperature control; wet-bath temperature
输运条件；干法腔压与流量；；湿法流动、润湿；及装载。
Transport conditions Dry chamber pressure and flow; wet flow, wetting and loading
时间与停止；主刻蚀时间、；终点判据和；过刻安排。

Profile (sidewall / bottom)
选择比；（目标层/保护层）
Selectivity (target / protective layer)
均匀性；（片内分布）
Uniformity (within-wafer distribution)
共同；合格窗口
Shared acceptable window
量测反馈；建立速率、形貌、选择比；及片内分布的联合结果表，；找同时满足规格的条件；范围。；反馈优化
Metrology feedback Build a combined results table for rate, profile, selectivity and within-wafer distribution, then find conditions meeting all specifications simultaneously Feedback optimization
耦合与边界
Coupling and boundaries
耦合与失效；提高基片偏压可能改善部分底部去除，也可能增加；损伤和掩膜损耗；湿法温度或药液状态改变，目标层；与保护层速率未必同比变化。；异常可表现为尺寸漂移、残留和片内不均。
Coupling and failure Higher wafer bias may improve some bottom removal but may also increase damage and mask loss; changes in wet-bath temperature or state may not change target-layer and protective-layer rates proportionally Anomalies may appear as dimensional drift, residue or within-wafer nonuniformity

选型逻辑：从结构需求倒推路线
Selection logic: work backward from structural requirements
材料兼容、目标形貌、损伤预算与总成本。
Material compatibility, target profile, damage budget and total cost
干法与湿法刻蚀
Etch Selectivity Profile Clean
决策与约束
Decision and constraints
核心判断：先看技术要求能否满足，再比较整段工艺的成本、产能和稳定性。
Core assessment: meet technical requirements first, then compare total-flow cost, throughput and stability
流程位置：用于工艺整合与路线评估，；决定采用干法、湿法或两者串联。
Position in the flow: process integration and route evaluation to choose dry, wet or a combination
决策流程：列材料堆栈 → 定目标形状与去除量 →；查选择比和损伤限制 → 比较后处理与量产条件 →；用代表性结构验证。
Decision flow: list the material stack → define target shape and removal amount → check selectivity and damage limits → compare post-treatment and production conditions → validate representative structures
关键约束：目标形貌/尺寸、保护层损失预算、；表面及结构耐受性、整段成本与产能。
Key constraints: target profile/dimensions, protective-layer loss budget, surface and structural tolerance, total-flow cost and throughput
耦合与失效：湿法批量处理可能有吞吐优势，仍需计入；药液、漂洗干燥和材料损失；干法也需计入设备、耗材、；维护与后处理。仅按单步时间选择，可能遗漏结构塌陷、；残膜或下游性能劣化。
Coupling and failure: batch wet processing may offer throughput advantages, but include chemicals, rinse/dry and material loss; dry processing must include equipment, consumables, maintenance and post-treatment; selecting only by single-step time may miss structural collapse, residual film or downstream performance degradation
场景
Scenarios
场景判断：；细线图形、深孔、；陡直侧壁：；通常优先评估；方向性干法。；方向性干法；（陡直侧壁）
Scenario assessment Fine patterns, deep holes and steep sidewalls: usually evaluate directional dry etching first Directional dry etch (steep sidewalls)
去除特定暴露膜层：；可评估选择性湿法，；同时核对所有暴露材料。；选择性湿法；（去除特定膜层）
Remove specific exposed films: evaluate selective wet etching while checking all exposed materials Selective wet etch (remove a specific film)
利用单晶硅晶面成形：；可评估KOH等晶面；选择性湿法。；晶面选择性湿法；（如KOH，斜侧壁）
Shape single-crystal silicon by crystal planes: evaluate KOH and other crystal-plane-selective wet methods Crystal-plane-selective wet etch (e.g. KOH, sloped sidewalls)
脆弱结构释放：；结合材料选择性与干燥风险，；评估湿法配合适配干燥，；或气相释放。；湿法配合适配干燥；或气相释放（如XeF₂）
Release fragile structures: combine material selectivity with drying risk; evaluate wet release with suitable drying or vapor-phase release Wet release with suitable drying or vapor-phase release (e.g. XeF₂)
选型步骤
Selection steps
选型；步骤：；1；列材料堆栈
Selection steps 1 List material stack
2；定目标形状；与去除量
2 Define target shape and removal amount
3；查选择比；和损伤限制
3 Check selectivity and damage limits
4；比较后处理；与量产条件
4 Compare post-treatment and production conditions
5；用代表性；结构验证
5 Validate representative structures
串联与量测
Combined routes and metrology
典型串联示例：干法定义结构 → 适配湿法去膜/清洗；1.干法定义结构；（如刻蚀形成图形）；2.适配湿法去膜/清洗；（清洗与刻蚀目的不同，；也可能改变材料厚度）
Typical combined route: dry structural definition → compatible wet stripping/cleaning 1. Define structure by dry etching (e.g. etch a pattern) 2. Compatible wet stripping/cleaning (cleaning and etching serve different purposes, and cleaning may also change film thickness)
量测反馈；比较代表性结构的形貌、；材料损失、缺陷、电性和；批间稳定性，据此确认路线。
Metrology feedback Compare representative profiles, material loss, defects, electrical properties and lot-to-lot stability to confirm the route
形貌；材料损失；缺陷；电性；批间稳定性；反馈优化
Profile Material loss Defects Electrical properties Lot-to-lot stability Feedback optimization
下游影响与边界：；可按需要串联“干法定义；结构 → 适配湿法去膜/清洗”，；但清洗与刻蚀目的不同，；也可能改变材料厚度。；节点名称和“干/湿”标签；都不足以单独完成选型。
Downstream effects and boundaries Combine dry structural definition with suitable wet stripping/cleaning as needed, but cleaning and etching have different purposes and cleaning may change film thickness Node names and dry/wet labels are insufficient on their own for selection

paragraphs.zh: 应力越高，试验越快；但过高可能触发产品实际不会经历的失效机制。
paragraphs.en: Higher stress shortens tests, but excessive stress can trigger mechanisms the product will never experience in use.

paragraphs.zh: 同一个试验名称不代表同样条件，参数必须匹配产品、标准与应用。
paragraphs.en: The same test name does not mean identical conditions; parameters must match the product, standard and application.

title.en: Thin-film engineering: thickness is only the first hurdle

records.text:
薄膜工程：厚度只是第一关
Thin-film engineering: thickness is only the first hurdle
Uniformity、Conformality、Stress、Interface与Particle
Uniformity, conformality, stress, interface and particles
工艺入门与整合思路
FEOL BEOL PIE Process Window Yield
流程
Flow
1；表面预处理；去除有机物/氧化层；活化表面
1 Surface pretreatment Remove organics / oxide and activate the surface
2；成核；物种到达表面；形成成核位点
2 Nucleation Species reach the surface and form nucleation sites
3；薄膜生长；持续供给与反应；薄膜逐步生长
3 Film growth Continuous supply and reaction grow the film progressively
4；Purge/；副产物排出；排出副产物与过量前驱体；准备下一步/稳定生长
4 Purge / byproduct removal Remove byproducts and excess precursor to prepare the next step / stabilize growth
5；后处理与；膜质检查；退火/致密化（可选）；膜质与厚度检查
5 Post-treatment and film-quality inspection Anneal / densify (optional) Inspect film quality and thickness
沉积方法
Deposition methods
PVD：物理输运，方向性较明显；Target；溅射/蒸发等物理输运，直线性路径，；对深孔/高深宽比覆盖受限。
PVD: physical transport with stronger directionality Target Physical transport such as sputtering/evaporation follows line-of-sight paths, limiting coverage in deep holes and high-aspect-ratio features
CVD：气相反应与表面成膜；气体扩散至表面，表面反应生成薄膜，；覆盖性优于PVD，受扩散与反应限制。
CVD: gas-phase reaction and surface film formation Gas diffuses to the surface and reacts to form a film; coverage is better than PVD, limited by diffusion and reaction
ALD：表面自限反应，循环生长；前驱体A；前驱体B；交替脉冲与吹扫，表面自限反应，；原子层级生长，覆盖性最佳。
ALD: self-limiting surface reactions and cyclic growth Precursor A Precursor B Alternating pulses and purges create self-limiting surface reactions, atomic-scale layer growth and best coverage
理想的共形覆盖（高深宽比沟槽）；侧壁与底部厚度一致，无空隙、无缝隙覆盖。
Ideal conformal coverage (high-aspect-ratio trench) Equal sidewall and bottom thickness, without voids or seams
薄膜厚度均匀性（Wafer Map 示例）；Thickness (Å)；1200；1050；900；750；600；良好（±2%）；较差（±8%）
Film-thickness uniformity (wafer-map example) Thickness (Å) 1200 1050 900 750 600 Good (±2%) Poor (±8%)
指标、权衡与失效
Metrics, trade-offs and failures
五个核心指标；Thickness；Uniformity；Conformality；Stress；Interface
Five core metrics Thickness Uniformity Conformality Stress Interface
三组Trade-off；Temperature ↑：膜质可能改善；Thermal Budget ↑
Three trade-offs Temperature ↑: film quality may improve Thermal budget ↑
Conformality ↑：复杂结构；覆盖改善；Throughput/成本压力
Conformality ↑: better coverage of complex structures Throughput / cost pressure
Stress控制：；附着与翘曲之间平衡
Stress control: balance adhesion against warpage
常见失效；Pinhole；Seam；Void；Particle；Delamination；Thickness；Non-uniformity
Common failures Pinhole Seam Void Particle Delamination Thickness nonuniformity
方法边界；PVD、CVD与ALD机理；不同，不能用同一套；固定步骤和优缺点解；释所有薄膜。
Method boundaries PVD, CVD and ALD have different mechanisms, so a single set of fixed steps and advantages/disadvantages cannot explain every film
量测与材料
Metrology and materials
量测反馈：Thickness Map / Stress / Sheet R/ Composition / XSEM；Ellipsometer /；Reflectometry
Metrology feedback: thickness map / stress / sheet R / composition / XSEM Ellipsometer / reflectometry
Wafer Curvature；（Stress）
Wafer curvature (stress)
Four-Point Probe；（Sheet R）
Four-point probe (sheet R)
Composition；（XPS/ EDS）；Counts （a.u.）；Energy (eV)
Composition (XPS / EDS) Counts (a.u.) Energy (eV)
XSEM；（Interface / Thickness）；100nm
XSEM (interface / thickness) 100 nm

paragraphs.zh: PVD：物理输运，方向性较明显；Target；溅射/蒸发等物理输运，直线性路径，；对深孔/高深宽比覆盖受限。
paragraphs.en: PVD: physical transport with stronger directionality Target Physical transport such as sputtering/evaporation follows line-of-sight paths, limiting coverage in deep holes and high-aspect-ratio features

paragraphs.zh: CVD：气相反应与表面成膜；气体扩散至表面，表面反应生成薄膜，；覆盖性优于PVD，受扩散与反应限制。
paragraphs.en: CVD: gas-phase reaction and surface film formation Gas diffuses to the surface and reacts to form a film; coverage is better than PVD, limited by diffusion and reaction

paragraphs.zh: ALD：表面自限反应，循环生长；前驱体A；前驱体B；交替脉冲与吹扫，表面自限反应，；原子层级生长，覆盖性最佳。

注入与激活流程

1 掩膜准备；SiO₂；Si；• 薄膜/光刻形成掩膜；• 开口定义掺杂区域；• 掩膜材料与厚度影响；角度/选择性（Shadowing），
1 Mask preparation SiO₂ Si • Form the mask by thin-film deposition / lithography • Openings define doped regions • Mask material and thickness affect angle / selectivity (shadowing)
2 离子注入；离子源；（B, P, As, BF₂⁺ 等）；质量分析；选择；加速电场；加电场；（Tilt）；旋转；（Rotation）；• 离子经加速后穿过掩膜进入硅中；• Tilt-Rotation 减少沟道效应与不均匀；• 能量决定穿透深度，剂量决定注入量
2 Ion implantation Ion source (B, P, As, BF₂⁺, etc.) Mass analysis Selection Accelerating electric field Applied electric field (Tilt) Rotation (Rotation) • Accelerated ions pass through the mask and enter silicon • Tilt–rotation reduces channeling and nonuniformity • Energy determines penetration depth; dose determines implanted amount
3 去胶/清洗；Rp（投影射程）；深度；Si；• 去除光刻胶与残留物；• 避免有机残留造成缺陷；或污染
3 Strip / clean Rp (projected range) Depth Si • Remove resist and residue • Avoid defects caused by organic residue or contamination
4 退火激活；高温退火（RTA/Spike/炉管等）；掺杂原子（已占位）；硅原子；晶格空位/缺陷；• 修复注入损伤：间隙/空位消除；• 掺杂原子占据替位 → 电学激活；• 同时发生扩散 → 结加深与展宽；并非所有注入的离子都会被电学激活
4 Anneal activation High-temperature anneal (RTA / spike / furnace, etc.) Dopant atom (occupying a site) Silicon atom Lattice vacancy / defect • Repair implantation damage: remove interstitials / vacancies • Dopants occupy substitutional sites → electrical activation • Diffusion occurs simultaneously → deeper, broader junctions Not all implanted ions become electrically active

paragraphs.zh: 1 掩膜准备；SiO₂；Si；• 薄膜/光刻形成掩膜；• 开口定义掺杂区域；• 掩膜材料与厚度影响；角度/选择性（Shadowing），
paragraphs.en: 1 Mask preparation SiO₂ Si • Form the mask by thin-film deposition / lithography • Openings define doped regions • Mask material and thickness affect angle / selectivity (shadowing)

paragraphs.zh: 2 离子注入；离子源；（B, P, As, BF₂⁺ 等）；质量分析；选择；加速电场；加电场；（Tilt）；旋转；（Rotation）；• 离子经加速后穿过掩膜进入硅中；• Tilt-Rotation 减少沟道效应与不均匀；• 能量决定穿透深度，剂量决定注入量
paragraphs.en: 2 Ion implantation Ion source (B, P, As, BF₂⁺, etc.) Mass analysis Selection Accelerating electric field Applied electric field (Tilt) Rotation (Rotation) • Accelerated ions pass through the mask and enter silicon • Tilt–rotation reduces channeling and nonuniformity • Energy determines penetration depth; dose determines implanted amount

paragraphs.zh: 3 去胶/清洗；Rp（投影射程）；深度；Si；• 去除光刻胶与残留物；• 避免有机残留造成缺陷；或污染
paragraphs.en: 3 Strip / clean Rp (projected range) Depth Si • Remove resist and residue • Avoid defects caused by organic residue or contamination

paragraphs.zh: 4 退火激活；高温退火（RTA/Spike/炉管等）；掺杂原子（已占位）；硅原子；晶格空位/缺陷；• 修复注入损伤：间隙/空位消除；• 掺杂原子占据替位 → 电学激活；• 同时发生扩散 → 结加深与展宽；并非所有注入的离子都会被电学激活
paragraphs.en: 4 Anneal activation High-temperature anneal (RTA / spike / furnace, etc.) Dopant atom (occupying a site) Silicon atom Lattice vacancy / defect • Repair implantation damage: remove interstitials / vacancies • Dopants occupy substitutional sites → electrical activation • Diffusion occurs simultaneously → deeper, broader junctions Not all implanted ions become electrically active

paragraphs.zh: • 电学量測评估掺杂效果；•验证片电阻、接触电阻、；结深/结形貌等；• 反馈工艺调整
paragraphs.en: • Assess doping by electrical measurements • Verify sheet resistance, contact resistance, junction depth/profile, etc. • Feed back process adjustments

paragraphs.zh: 2 物理量要分清；Dose → 注入总量
paragraphs.en: 2 Distinguish physical quantities Dose → total implanted amount

paragraphs.zh: Energy → 深度分布；浓度；深度
Activation + Diffusion；→ 最终有效掺杂与结形貌；浓度；---注入后（未退火）；退火后（有效掺杂）；深度
paragraphs.en: Activation + diffusion → final effective doping and junction profile Concentration After implantation (unannealed) After annealing (effective doping) Depth

paragraphs.zh: 3 耦合权衡；更温退火：；Activation与修复 ↑；Diffusion与；Thermal Budget ↑；两者需要平衡
paragraphs.en: 3 Coupled trade-offs Source phrase: warmer annealing Activation and repair ↑ Diffusion and thermal budget ↑ The two must be balanced

paragraphs.zh: 4 常见失效；Channeling（沟道效应）；Shadowing（阴影效应）；注入污染（Contamination）；激活不足（Under-Activation）；Junction Broadening（结展宽）；浓度；深度
paragraphs.en: 4 Common failures Channeling Shadowing Implantation contamination Under-activation Junction broadening Concentration Depth

paragraphs.en: Metrology feedback: Sheet resistance / SIMS / WAT

paragraphs.en: SIMS (depth profiling) Concentration (log scale) Depth • Dopant concentration versus depth (qualitative schematic)

paragraphs.zh: WAT（电学量测）；I-V曲线；C-V曲线；TLM 接触电阻；R_T；• 器件/结构电学特性验证
paragraphs.en: WAT (electrical metrology) I–V curve C–V curve TLM contact resistance R_T • Validate device/structure electrical characteristics

records.text:
量测与良率：让工艺形成闭环
Metrology and yield: close the process loop
Inline Metrology、Defect、SPC、WAT 与 Yield
Inline metrology, defect, SPC, WAT and yield
工艺入门与整合思路
FEOL BEOL PIE Process Window Yield
闭环主线
Main loop
1 完成工艺；工艺执行
1 Complete the process Process execution
2 Inline量测；输出：厚度/ CD / Overlay；Thickness；CD；Overlay
2 Inline metrology Output: thickness / CD / overlay Thickness CD Overlay
3 Defect Inspection；输出：Wafer缺陷图；Critical；Major；Minor；None
3 Defect inspection Output: wafer defect map Critical Major Minor None
4 SPC与风险判断；输出：SPC趋势；UCL；CL；时间
4 SPC and risk assessment Output: SPC trend UCL CL Time
5；Containment/；Root Cause；隔离受影响范围；证据链（数据+样品+日志）；根因分析（人/机/料/法/环）；制定并执行缓解措施
5 Containment / root cause Contain the affected scope Evidence chain (data + samples + logs) Root-cause analysis (people / machine / material / method / environment) Define and execute mitigation actions
6 WAT与Yield验证；输出：电学表现 ＆ Yield趋势；WAT（例：Id-Vg）；Yield趋势（按Lot）；回到工艺窗口（Process Window）
6 WAT and yield validation Output: electrical performance and yield trend WAT (example: Id–Vg) Yield trend (by lot) Return to the process window
采样与控制界限
Sampling and boundaries
1 采样与量测基础；• Sampling；•GRR；•Repeatability；• Reproducibility；重复性；再现性；总变异；目标：量测稳定、可区分过程变化
1 Sampling and metrology fundamentals • Sampling • GRR • Repeatability • Reproducibility Repeatability Reproducibility Total variation Goal: stable metrology that distinguishes process changes
2 控制界限要分清；Control Limit：；过程波动判断；Spec Limit：；产品要求；两者不是同一个概念
2 Distinguish control boundaries Control limit: assess process variation Specification limit: product requirement These are different concepts
3 关键Trade-off；• Sampling密度 ↑：；检出能力 ↑；Cost与；Cycle Time ↑
3 Key trade-offs • Sampling density ↑: detection capability ↑; cost and cycle time ↑

What annealing does: heat is the means; material change is the goal
激活、修复、扩散、相变、致密化与界面钝化
Activation, repair, diffusion, phase change, densification and interface passivation
退火与热预算
RTA RTP Spike Laser Flash FEOL
退火任务
Annealing tasks
退火是多种热处理任务的统称，不同任务需要不同温度轨迹。
Annealing is a collective term for thermal-processing tasks; different tasks require different temperature trajectories.
激活掺杂掺杂原子进入电活性晶格位置
Dopant activation Dopant atoms occupy Electrically active lattice sites
修复晶格原子重排与缺陷复合，恢复周期性
Lattice repair Atomic rearrangement and defect Recombination restore periodicity
控制扩散调控掺杂或杂质的空间分布
Diffusion control Control the spatial distribution Of dopants or impurities
形成新相发生相变或生成新结构相
New-phase formation A phase change occurs or A new structural phase forms
薄膜致密化孔隙减少，原子堆积更致密
Film densification Fewer pores; atoms Pack more densely
界面钝化缺陷与悬键减少，界面态被钝化
Interface passivation Fewer defects and dangling bonds; Interface states are passivated
六步流程
Six-step flow
明确材料初态• 结构/成分/缺陷• 掺杂分布• 既有应力与相态
Establish the initial material state • Structure / composition / defects • Dopant distribution • Existing stress and phase state
确定目标变化• 选择期望的材料变化• 设定关键指标方向• 定义可接受的副作用
Define the target change • Select the desired material change • Define the direction of key metrics • Define acceptable side effects
检查热预算•允许的热负荷上限• 与前道/后道的兼容• 关键层的热稳定性
Check the thermal budget • Upper limit of permissible thermal load • Compatibility with preceding / subsequent processes • Thermal stability of critical layers
选择气氛与加热方式• 气氛类型与纯度• 压力范围• 加热方式选择
Select the ambient and Heating method • Ambient type and purity • Pressure range • Heating-method selection
升温/驻留/冷却•升温阶段•高温驻留阶段•冷却阶段
Heating / dwell / cooling • Heating stage • High-temperature dwell stage • Cooling stage
量测确认• 与目标对比• 判定是否达成• 决定是否迭代
Confirm by metrology • Compare against the target • Determine whether it has been achieved • Decide whether to iterate
关键参数
Key parameters
峰值温度决定可激活能量、扩散驱动力与相变可能性。
Peak temperature Determines available activation energy, Diffusion driving force and the possibility Of phase change.
有效时间影响反应充分性与扩散深度，存在临界与饱和效应。
Effective time Affects reaction completeness and Diffusion depth, with threshold And saturation effects.
升降温速率影响热应力、相变路径与缺陷生成/消除。
Heating and cooling rates Affect thermal stress, Phase-transformation paths and Defect generation / elimination.
气氛与压力影响氧化还原、挥发/沉积平衡与界面化学。
Ambient and pressure Affect redox reactions, Evaporation / deposition equilibrium And interface chemistry.
权衡与风险
Tradeoffs and risks
耦合与权衡（相互制约）激活增强掺杂扩散
Couplings and tradeoffs (mutual constraints) Stronger activation Dopant diffusion
反应充分团聚/ 应力 / 界面反应
Complete reaction Agglomeration / stress / interfacial reaction
说明：局部最优不一定等于整合最优，需在多目标之间权衡。
Note: a local optimum is not necessarily an integration optimum; multiple objectives require tradeoffs.
潜在风险（并非必然发生）激活不足扩散过深残余晶格缺陷薄膜开裂金属团聚
Potential risks (not inevitable) Insufficient activation Excessive diffusion depth Residual lattice defects Film cracking Metal agglomeration
风险水平取决于材料体系、热轨迹与工艺窗口。
Risk depends on the material system, thermal trajectory and process window.

温度时间地图：峰温相同，结果也可能完全不同
Temperature–time map: identical peak temperatures can produce very different results
峰值温度、有效时间、升降温与热穿透共同决定热预算
Peak temperature, effective time, heating / cooling and thermal penetration jointly determine the thermal budget
退火与热预算
RTA RTP Spike Laser Flash FEOL
热预算与温度轨迹
Thermal budget and trajectories
热预算不是简单的“温度×时间”；反应、扩散和缺陷演化对温度通常呈强烈非线性。
The thermal budget is not simply “temperature × time”; reaction, diffusion and defect evolution usually depend strongly and nonlinearly on temperature.
温度-时间工程地图（同一峰温，不同轨迹）
Temperature–time engineering map (same peak, different trajectories)
炉管：缓慢升降温＋长平台
Furnace: Slow heating / cooling + long plateau
RTP Soak：快速升温＋短平台
RTP Soak: Rapid heating + short plateau
Spike：尖峰、近零刻意驻留
Spike: A sharp peak with almost no intentional dwell
Flash：毫秒级窄脉冲
Flash: Millisecond narrow pulse
Laser：局部超快脉冲/扫描
Laser: Local ultrafast pulse / scanning
温度时间
Temperature Time
晶圆深度剖面（相对趋势示意）炉管/Soak→热进入更深、体内更接近平衡
Wafer-depth profiles (relative trends) Furnace / Soak → heat penetrates deeper, And the bulk approaches equilibrium
Flash/Laser→表层瞬态升温、热穿透更浅
Flash / Laser → transient surface heating, With shallower thermal penetration
注意：以上为相对趋势，非固定深度。
Note: these are relative trends, not fixed depths.

Selection flow

Thermal-process selection (six steps)
定义目标反应
Define the Target reaction
设定材料温度上限
Set the material Temperature limit
设定有效驻留区间
Define the effective Dwell interval
检查Ramp Up/Down
Check Ramp Up / Down
评估热扩散深度
Evaluate Thermal-diffusion depth
比较候选方案
Compare Candidate approaches
控制参数
Control parameters
关键可控参数（四张控制卡）
Key controllable parameters (four control cards)
峰值温度决定反应驱动力与部分缺陷活化概率。
Peak temperature Determines the reaction driving force and Some defect-activation probabilities.
阈值以上有效时间直接影响反应量、扩散与缺陷演化。
Effective time above The threshold Directly affects reaction extent, Diffusion and defect evolution.
Ramp与Quench影响热穿透、热应力与尾巴贡献。
Ramp and Quench Affect thermal penetration, Thermal stress and the tail contribution.
吸收率/发射率与热穿透决定能量耦合效率与热在材料中的分布。
Absorptivity / emissivity And thermal penetration Determine energy-coupling efficiency and Heat distribution within the material.
权衡与风险
Tradeoffs and risks
耦合与权衡（趋势判断）
Couplings and tradeoffs (trend assessment)
时间更短→扩散更少，但可能需要更高峰温；
Shorter time → Less diffusion, But a higher peak may be required;
峰温更高→反应更快，但均匀性与材料兼容风险上升。
Higher peak temperature → Faster reaction, But greater uniformity and material- Compatibility risks.
冷却尾巴也会贡献热预算
The cooling tail also contributes to the thermal budget
主要风险点温度量测偏差影响真实热预算的判断。
Principal risks Temperature-measurement bias Affects assessment of the actual Thermal budget.
局部过热引发缺陷、相变或界面异常。
Local overheating Causes defects, phase changes Or interfacial anomalies.
Pattern Loading导致局部温度与反应差异。
Pattern Loading Causes local temperature And reaction differences.
热应力/翘曲影响形稳、CD与良率稳定性。
Thermal stress / warpage Affects shape stability, CD And yield stability.
量测及下游影响
Metrology and downstream effects
量测反馈与闭环优化
Metrology feedback and closed-loop optimization

Thermocouple (process reference)

Pyrometer / Emissivity

Minutes, seconds, milliseconds and nanoseconds are only relative categories; they cannot be used directly as production Recipe windows.

Furnace annealing: slow and deep, suited to batch thermal processing
批量均匀性、深度热处理与总热预算
Batch uniformity, deep thermal processing and total thermal budget
退火与热预算
RTA RTP Spike Laser Flash FEOL
原理
Principle
炉管的优势是批量处理和长时间均温，但持续时间更长，扩散与材料兼容风险也更高。
Furnace advantages are batch processing and prolonged temperature uniformity, but longer duration also increases diffusion and material-compatibility risks.
水平炉管剖面示意（批量晶圆舟）
Horizontal furnace cross-section (batch wafer boat)
前区（预热）中心区（均温）后区（冷却辅助）
Front zone (preheat) Center zone (uniform temperature) Rear zone (assisted cooling)
工艺气体入口尾气排出
Process-gas Inlet Exhaust gas Outlet
•批量处理，多片晶圆同舟
• Batch processing: multiple wafers in one boat
•长时间均温，深度受热与扩散更充分
• Prolonged uniform temperature enables deeper heating and more extensive diffusion
•气氛在不同区段变化，可能引发氧化/ 还原/污染差异
• Ambient differences between zones can cause differences in oxidation / reduction / contamination

Key controls (determine uniformity and repeatability)
炉内温度均匀性• 区间温度一致性• 轴向与径向均匀• 热场校准与验证
Temperature uniformity inside the furnace • Temperature consistency between zones • Axial and radial uniformity • Thermal-field calibration and validation
Ramp/ Soak时间•升温斜率平缓• 保温窗口稳定• 降温受控可重复
Ramp / Soak time • Gentle heating slope • Stable hold window • Controlled and repeatable cooling
气体纯度与流场•气体纯度稳定• 流场均匀覆盖•气氛切换可控
Gas purity and flow field • Stable gas purity • Uniform flow coverage • Controllable ambient switching
舟位与批间匹配• 舟位热差评估•批间匹配一致•装载方式标准化
Boat-position and batch matching • Assess thermal differences by boat position • Consistent batch matching • Standardized loading
权衡与风险
Tradeoffs and risks
耦合与权衡
Couplings and tradeoffs
批量吞吐＋深度均温• 批量处理效率高• 均温时间更充分• 适合深度反应与扩散
Batch throughput + deep temperature equilibration • High batch-processing efficiency • More time for equilibration • Suited to deep reactions and diffusion
更大的扩散、应力和污染累积风险• 扩散与界面反应更充分（可能过深）• 应力累积与翘曲风险上升（视材料）• 污染累积可能性增加（视气氛与材料）
Greater accumulated diffusion, stress and contamination risks • More extensive diffusion and interfacial reaction (potentially too deep) • Greater accumulated stress and warpage risk (material dependent) • Greater potential contamination accumulation (ambient and material dependent)
慢并不等于差；任务若需要长时间反应或批量均温，炉管仍有优势。
Slow does not mean poor; furnaces retain advantages for long reactions or batch temperature equilibration.

Furnace processing is not inherently low-end; suitability depends on reaction depth, diffusion tolerance, the material stack and capacity strategy.

Spike退火：到达峰值后立即降温
Spike annealing: cool immediately after reaching the peak
高激活与低扩散之间的尖锐窗口
A narrow window between high activation and low diffusion
退火与热预算
RTA RTP Spike Laser Flash FEOL
定义与曲线
Definition and curves
Spike是温度轨迹，不是独立热源；通常由RTP平台实现。
Spike describes a temperature trajectory, not a separate heat source; it is usually implemented on an RTP platform.
RTP加热平台
RTP heating platform
SpikeTemperatureProfile
Spike Temperature Profile
温度轨迹比较（示意）
Temperature-trajectory comparison (schematic)
Soak（短平台）
Soak (short plateau)
Spike（尖峰）
Spike (sharp peak)
升温段仍有热预算
The heating stage Still contributes to the thermal budget
峰值附近近零刻意驻留
Near the peak Almost no intentional dwell
冷却尾巴仍有热预算
The cooling tail Still contributes to the thermal budget

Time (relative)

Five-step flow (typical)

Ambient stabilization Ensure stable process ambient and pressure
快速升温受控升温，减少驻留累积
Rapid heating Controlled heating reduces accumulated dwell
接近目标峰温精准到达目标峰值附近
Approach the target peak temperature Precisely reach the vicinity of the target peak
无刻意驻留峰值附近不做额外停留
No intentional dwell No additional hold near the peak
快速Quench +量测迅速冷却并开展计量验证
Rapid Quench + metrology Cool rapidly and perform metrology validation
关键控制
Key controls
四大关键控制
Four key controls
PeakTemperature影响激活与扩散的驱动力与窗口
Peak Temperature Affects the driving forces and process window For activation and diffusion
峰值附近有效时间越短越好，降低扩散与缺陷风险
Effective time Near the peak The shorter the better, reducing Diffusion and defect risks
Ramp/ Quench斜率与对称性决定热预算与缺陷生成
Ramp / Quench Slope and symmetry determine The thermal budget and defect generation
片内均匀性与发射率影响片内温差，进而影响一致性
Within-wafer uniformity And emissivity Affect within-wafer temperature differences And therefore consistency
激活扩散权衡
Activation–diffusion tradeoff
掺杂激活与扩散的耦合平衡
Coupled balance of dopant activation and diffusion
Spike更尖锐有利于压缩扩散
A sharper Spike Helps suppress diffusion
• 峰值附近近零驻留
• Almost zero dwell near the peak
• 缩短热暴露尾部
• Shorter thermal-exposure tail
• 更陡峭的浓度廓线（总掺杂分布更陡）
• Steeper concentration profile (steeper total dopant distribution)
激活（电活化）
Activation (electrical activation)
扩散（总掺杂展宽）
Diffusion (broadening of total dopants)
目标：在可行窗口内取得更好平衡
Goal: a better balance within the feasible window
平衡被打破时的风险
Risks when the balance is lost
•过短/过低：激活不足，残余缺陷或不稳定
• Too short / too low: insufficient activation, Residual defects or instability
•过高/局部热点：扩散增加、漏电上升、材料或界面损伤
• Too high / local hot spots: increased diffusion, Higher leakage and material or interface damage

records.text:
选型与量测：退火结果必须用器件指标闭环
Selection and metrology: close the annealing loop with device metrics
任务、热深度、材料堆叠与量测结果共同决定方案
Task, thermal depth, material stack and metrology results jointly determine the approach
退火与热预算
RTA RTP Spike Laser Flash FEOL
选型逻辑
Selection logic
最快或最高温的方案不一定最好；局部工艺最优也可能损害下游整合与可靠性。
The fastest or hottest approach is not necessarily best; a locally optimal process may harm downstream integration and reliability.
退火要实现什么？
What must the anneal accomplish?
A. 激活/修复要求：扩散容限、晶格缺陷与目标 Rs
A. Activation / repair Requirements: diffusion tolerance, lattice defects And target Rs
B. 相形成/硅化物要求：相组成、接触电阻与团聚窗口
B. Phase formation / silicides Requirements: phase composition, contact resistance And agglomeration window
C. 致密化/应力要求：膜密度、收缩与机械应力
C. Densification / stress Requirements: film density, shrinkage And mechanical stress
D. 界面钝化要求：Dit、漏电、材料与气氛兼容
D. Interface passivation Requirements: Dit, leakage, materials And ambient compatibility
允许总热预算？
Permissible total thermal budget?
需要全厚度还是表层/局部加热？
Is full-depth, surface or local heating required?
膜堆叠是否对光学吸收敏感？
Is the film stack sensitive to optical absorption?
材料可承受什么气氛？
What ambient can the material tolerate?
兼容/ 不兼容
Compatible / incompatible
候选热源（非唯一选项）
Candidate heat sources (not exclusive choices)
炉管退火（Furnace）
Furnace annealing (Furnace)
RTP Soak（常规快速热退火）
RTP Soak (conventional rapid thermal annealing)
Spike（短时高温）
Spike (short high-temperature exposure)
Flash（极短脉冲）
Flash (ultrashort pulse)
Laser（激光局部）
Laser (local laser heating)
组合流程（例如：预退火+SpikeRTA + Laser …）
Combined flow (e.g. pre-anneal + Spike, RTA + Laser …)
必须进行 Split 与DOE，以验证多种组合对目标与整合的影响；数据驱动选择，而非直觉。
Split and DOE are required to validate how combinations affect targets and integration; select using data rather than intuition.
七步闭环
Seven-step loop
七步闭环流程
Seven-step closed-loop Flow
明确目标指标• 器件/电学• 结构/界面• 工艺 /整合
Define target metrics • Device / electrical • Structure / interface • Process / integration
列出热预算与材料限制• 总热预算• 堆叠/厚度• 材料/气氛边界
List the thermal budget and Material constraints • Total thermal budget • Stack / thickness • Material / ambient boundaries
选择热源/轨迹/气氛• 热源与脉冲特征• 温度轨迹（相对）• 气氛与工艺顺序
Select the heat source / Trajectory / ambient • Heat-source and pulse characteristics • Temperature trajectory (relative) • Ambient and process sequence
Split 与 DOE• 因子/水准设定•Split/阻断设计• 数据记录
Split and DOE • Factor / level settings • Split / blocking design • Data recording
Inline 量测• 关键指标监控• 趋势/漂移•异常预警
Inline metrology • Monitor key metrics • Trends / drift • Early warning of anomalies
WAT/可靠性反馈• 结构/电学验证• 应力/缺陷• 可靠性测试
WAT / Reliability feedback • Structural / electrical validation • Stress / defects • Reliability testing
SPC 维持与异常处置• 控制图监控• 异常处置流程• 经验沉淀
SPC maintenance and Exception handling • Control-chart monitoring • Exception-handling procedure • Accumulated experience
闭环回流：反馈驱动迭代，可回到步骤2或3优化方案
Closed-loop return: feedback drives iteration; return to step 2 or 3 to optimize the approach
关键控制
Key controls
四张关键控制卡
Four key Control cards
激活率与结深□ 回片Rs / Hall□ 掺杂活化率□ 结深/侧向扩散□ 缺陷密度
Activation rate and junction depth □ Returned-wafer Rs / Hall □ Dopant activation fraction □ Junction depth / lateral diffusion □ Defect density
相组成与应力□ 相组成（比例/纯度）□ 接触电阻/比接触电阻□ 团聚/粒径分布□ 薄膜应力/弯曲
Phase composition and stress □ Phase composition (fraction / purity) □ Contact resistance / specific contact resistance □ Agglomeration / grain-size distribution □ Film stress / bending
片内/片间均匀性□ Wafer内均匀性□ Wafer间一致性□ 批间漂移趋势□ 边缘/中心差异
Within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer uniformity □ Within-wafer uniformity □ Wafer-to-wafer consistency □ Lot-to-lot drift trend □ Edge / center differences
缺陷与界面电学□ 缺陷类型/密度□ Dit/界面态□ 漏电/击穿特性□ 介质完整性
Defects and interface electrical characteristics □ Defect type / density □ Dit / interface states □ Leakage / breakdown behavior □ Dielectric integrity
权衡风险与异常
Tradeoffs, risks and exceptions
耦合权衡（没有免费午餐）
Coupled tradeoffs (no free lunch)
低Rs可能伴随扩散或漏电
Low Rs May accompany diffusion or leakage
反应充分，可能伴随团聚或应力
Complete reaction may accompany agglomeration or stress
更低Dit，仍需验证材料与长期稳定性
Lower Dit still requires validation of material and long-term stability
常见风险（先识别，后决策）
Common risks (identify before deciding)
只看单一指标，忽略多项耦合
Focusing on one metric and overlooking multiple couplings
温度校准偏差，导致判定失真
Temperature-calibration bias distorts judgment
腔体/光学不匹配，结果不可迁移
Chamber / optical mismatch prevents transferring results
边缘异常未识别，造成大面积风险
Unrecognized edge anomalies create large-area risk
抽样不足，统计意义不足
Insufficient sampling and statistical significance
异常处置原则
Exception-handling principles
排查设备 / 材料/环境因素
Investigate equipment / materials / environmental factors
评估风险并决定是否触发工程变更
Assess risk and decide whether to trigger an engineering change
记录处置与再验证结果
Record corrective actions and revalidation results
量测矩阵
Metrology matrix
量测反馈矩阵
Metrology feedback Matrix
Rs / Hall判断对象：激活程度、载流子浓度迁移率、片内均匀性
Rs / Hall Assesses: Activation, carrier concentration, Mobility and within-wafer uniformity
SIMS / SRP判断对象：掺杂浓度分布、结深、侧向扩散
SIMS / SRP Assesses: Dopant concentration distribution, Junction depth and lateral diffusion
TEM / XRD / Raman判断对象：晶相组成、晶粒尺寸、缺陷与应力
TEM / XRD / Raman Assesses: Crystal-phase composition, grain size, Defects and stress
C-V/I-V判断对象：界面态（Dit）、漏电、击穿与钝化效果
C–V / I–V Assesses: Interface states (Dit), leakage, Breakdown and passivation results
WAT / 可靠性判断对象：器件性能分布、寿命、漂移与稳定性
WAT / reliability Assesses: Device-performance distribution, lifetime, Drift and stability
下游影响
Downstream effects
下游影响
Downstream effects
性能分布影响时序、驱动、噪声、能效与功能窗
Performance distribution Affects timing, drive, noise, Energy efficiency and functional windows
接触良率影响硅化物/接触电阻、导通损耗与可靠性
Contact yield Affects silicidation / contact resistance, Conduction loss and reliability
漏电影响静态功耗、发热、可靠性与寿命
Leakage Affects static power, heat, Reliability and lifetime
可靠性影响 TDDB、NBTI、HTRB等失效率/寿命
Reliability Affects TDDB, NBTI, HTRB and other failure rates / lifetimes
剩余热预算影响后续工艺选择、材料稳定性与整合空间
Remaining thermal budget Affects subsequent process choices, Material stability and integration flexibility
量产流程可能采用预退火+Spike、RTA + Laser等组合；不能假设整片晶圆只能选择一种退火方法。
Production flows may combine pre-anneal + Spike or RTA + Laser; do not assume that an entire wafer must use only one annealing method.

paragraphs.zh: 最快或最高温的方案不一定最好；局部工艺最优也可能损害下游整合与可靠性。
paragraphs.en: The fastest or hottest approach is not necessarily best; a locally optimal process may harm downstream integration and reliability.

paragraphs.zh: A. 激活/修复要求：扩散容限、晶格缺陷与目标 Rs
paragraphs.en: A. Activation / repair Requirements: diffusion tolerance, lattice defects And target Rs

paragraphs.zh: B. 相形成/硅化物要求：相组成、接触电阻与团聚窗口
paragraphs.en: B. Phase formation / silicides Requirements: phase composition, contact resistance And agglomeration window

paragraphs.zh: C. 致密化/应力要求：膜密度、收缩与机械应力
paragraphs.en: C. Densification / stress Requirements: film density, shrinkage And mechanical stress

paragraphs.zh: D. 界面钝化要求：Dit、漏电、材料与气氛兼容
paragraphs.en: D. Interface passivation Requirements: Dit, leakage, materials And ambient compatibility

paragraphs.zh: 需要全厚度还是表层/局部加热？
paragraphs.en: Is full-depth, surface or local heating required?

paragraphs.zh: 膜堆叠是否对光学吸收敏感？
paragraphs.en: Is the film stack sensitive to optical absorption?
What ambient can the material tolerate?

paragraphs.zh: 组合流程（例如：预退火+SpikeRTA + Laser …）
paragraphs.en: Combined flow (e.g. pre-anneal + Spike, RTA + Laser …)

paragraphs.zh: 必须进行 Split 与DOE，以验证多种组合对目标与整合的影响；数据驱动选择，而非直觉。
paragraphs.en: Split and DOE are required to validate how combinations affect targets and integration; select using data rather than intuition.

paragraphs.zh: 明确目标指标• 器件/电学• 结构/界面• 工艺 /整合
paragraphs.en: Define target metrics • Device / electrical • Structure / interface • Process / integration

paragraphs.zh: 列出热预算与材料限制• 总热预算• 堆叠/厚度• 材料/气氛边界
paragraphs.en: List the thermal budget and Material constraints • Total thermal budget • Stack / thickness • Material / ambient boundaries

paragraphs.zh: 选择热源/轨迹/气氛• 热源与脉冲特征• 温度轨迹（相对）• 气氛与工艺顺序
paragraphs.en: Select the heat source / Trajectory / ambient • Heat-source and pulse characteristics • Temperature trajectory (relative) • Ambient and process sequence

paragraphs.zh: Split 与 DOE• 因子/水准设定•Split/阻断设计• 数据记录
paragraphs.en: Split and DOE • Factor / level settings • Split / blocking design • Data recording

paragraphs.zh: Inline 量测• 关键指标监控• 趋势/漂移•异常预警
paragraphs.en: Inline metrology • Monitor key metrics • Trends / drift • Early warning of anomalies

paragraphs.zh: WAT/可靠性反馈• 结构/电学验证• 应力/缺陷• 可靠性测试
paragraphs.en: WAT / Reliability feedback • Structural / electrical validation • Stress / defects • Reliability testing

paragraphs.zh: SPC 维持与异常处置• 控制图监控• 异常处置流程• 经验沉淀
paragraphs.en: SPC maintenance and Exception handling • Control-chart monitoring • Exception-handling procedure • Accumulated experience

paragraphs.zh: 闭环回流：反馈驱动迭代，可回到步骤2或3优化方案
paragraphs.en: Closed-loop return: feedback drives iteration; return to step 2 or 3 to optimize the approach

paragraphs.zh: 激活率与结深□ 回片Rs / Hall□ 掺杂活化率□ 结深/侧向扩散□ 缺陷密度
paragraphs.en: Activation rate and junction depth □ Returned-wafer Rs / Hall □ Dopant activation fraction □ Junction depth / lateral diffusion □ Defect density

paragraphs.zh: 相组成与应力□ 相组成（比例/纯度）□ 接触电阻/比接触电阻□ 团聚/粒径分布□ 薄膜应力/弯曲
paragraphs.en: Phase composition and stress □ Phase composition (fraction / purity) □ Contact resistance / specific contact resistance □ Agglomeration / grain-size distribution □ Film stress / bending

paragraphs.zh: 片内/片间均匀性□ Wafer内均匀性□ Wafer间一致性□ 批间漂移趋势□ 边缘/中心差异
paragraphs.en: Within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer uniformity □ Within-wafer uniformity □ Wafer-to-wafer consistency □ Lot-to-lot drift trend □ Edge / center differences

paragraphs.zh: 缺陷与界面电学□ 缺陷类型/密度□ Dit/界面态□ 漏电/击穿特性□ 介质完整性
paragraphs.en: Defects and interface electrical characteristics □ Defect type / density □ Dit / interface states □ Leakage / breakdown behavior □ Dielectric integrity

paragraphs.zh: 耦合权衡（没有免费午餐）
低Rs可能伴随扩散或漏电
paragraphs.en: Low Rs May accompany diffusion or leakage

paragraphs.zh: 反应充分，可能伴随团聚或应力
paragraphs.en: Complete reaction may accompany agglomeration or stress

paragraphs.zh: 更低Dit，仍需验证材料与长期稳定性
paragraphs.en: Lower Dit still requires validation of material and long-term stability

paragraphs.zh: 常见风险（先识别，后决策）
只看单一指标，忽略多项耦合
paragraphs.en: Focusing on one metric and overlooking multiple couplings

paragraphs.zh: 温度校准偏差，导致判定失真
腔体/光学不匹配，结果不可迁移
paragraphs.en: Chamber / optical mismatch prevents transferring results

paragraphs.zh: 边缘异常未识别，造成大面积风险
paragraphs.en: Unrecognized edge anomalies create large-area risk

paragraphs.zh: 抽样不足，统计意义不足
排查设备 / 材料/环境因素
评估风险并决定是否触发工程变更
paragraphs.en: Assess risk and decide whether to trigger an engineering change

paragraphs.zh: 记录处置与再验证结果
paragraphs.en: Record corrective actions and revalidation results

paragraphs.zh: Rs / Hall判断对象：激活程度、载流子浓度迁移率、片内均匀性
paragraphs.en: Rs / Hall Assesses: Activation, carrier concentration, Mobility and within-wafer uniformity

paragraphs.zh: SIMS / SRP判断对象：掺杂浓度分布、结深、侧向扩散
paragraphs.en: SIMS / SRP Assesses: Dopant concentration distribution, Junction depth and lateral diffusion

paragraphs.zh: TEM / XRD / Raman判断对象：晶相组成、晶粒尺寸、缺陷与应力
paragraphs.en: TEM / XRD / Raman Assesses: Crystal-phase composition, grain size, Defects and stress

paragraphs.zh: C-V/I-V判断对象：界面态（Dit）、漏电、击穿与钝化效果
paragraphs.en: C–V / I–V Assesses: Interface states (Dit), leakage, Breakdown and passivation results

paragraphs.zh: WAT / 可靠性判断对象：器件性能分布、寿命、漂移与稳定性
paragraphs.en: WAT / reliability Assesses: Device-performance distribution, lifetime, Drift and stability

paragraphs.zh: 性能分布影响时序、驱动、噪声、能效与功能窗
paragraphs.en: Performance distribution Affects timing, drive, noise, Energy efficiency and functional windows

paragraphs.zh: 接触良率影响硅化物/接触电阻、导通损耗与可靠性
paragraphs.en: Contact yield Affects silicidation / contact resistance, Conduction loss and reliability

paragraphs.zh: 漏电影响静态功耗、发热、可靠性与寿命
paragraphs.en: Leakage Affects static power, heat, Reliability and lifetime

paragraphs.zh: 可靠性影响 TDDB、NBTI、HTRB等失效率/寿命
paragraphs.en: Reliability Affects TDDB, NBTI, HTRB and other failure rates / lifetimes

paragraphs.zh: 剩余热预算影响后续工艺选择、材料稳定性与整合空间
paragraphs.en: Remaining thermal budget Affects subsequent process choices, Material stability and integration flexibility

paragraphs.zh: 量产流程可能采用预退火+Spike、RTA + Laser等组合；不能假设整片晶圆只能选择一种退火方法。
paragraphs.en: Production flows may combine pre-anneal + Spike or RTA + Laser; do not assume that an entire wafer must use only one annealing method.

paragraphs.zh: 确认量测有效性与校准状态
paragraphs.en: Confirm metrology validity and calibration status

description.zh: 任务、热深度、材料堆叠与量测结果共同决定方案
description.en: Task, thermal depth, material stack and metrology results jointly determine the approach

控制与分工
Controls and roles
1. 四个关键旋钮
1. Four key parameters
Source功率：决定电子加热强度、等离子体密度与解离能力
Source power determines electron-heating intensity, Plasma density and dissociation capability
Bias功率：决定鞘层电压与离子能量（方向性与动能）
Bias power determines sheath voltage and ion Energy (directionality and kinetic energy)
压力与气体：影响碰撞频率、输运、化学反应与IADF
Pressure and gas affect collision frequency, Transport, chemistry and IADF
Match与Pulse：影响功率传输效率、稳定性与瞬时功率耦合
Match and Pulse affect power-transfer efficiency, Stability and instantaneous power coupling
2. 谁主要管什么
2. What mainly controls what
Source：主要影响电子加热、密度与解离
Source mainly affects Electron heating, density and dissociation
Bias： 主要影响鞘层电压与离子能量
Bias mainly affects Sheath voltage and ion energy
压力：影响碰撞、输运与IADF
Pressure affects collisions, Transport and IADF
权衡与风险
Tradeoffs and risks
3. 重要Trade-off
3. Important trade-off
只是部分解耦：改变Source、Bias或压力仍可能同时改变密度、化学与鞘层。
Only partial decoupling: changing Source, Bias or pressure may still simultaneously change Density, chemistry and sheaths.

Definition and responsibilities
“Hard”主要表示相对刻蚀耐受能力，；不代表材料一定具有更高机械硬度。

records.text:
使用场景：为什么要多加一层
Applications: why add another layer?
当光刻胶撑不完整段刻蚀时，需要Hard Mask接力
When photoresist cannot survive the full etch, a Hard Mask takes over
Hard Mask 图形转移
Lithography Etch FEOL BEOL
使用判断
Decision basis
是否使用Hard Mask取决于图形转移预算，；不是制程越先进就一定越复杂。
Whether to use a Hard Mask depends on the pattern-transfer budget,; not on an assumption that a more advanced process must be more complex.
仅Photoresist
Photoresist only
① 薄PR成像
① Thin-PR imaging
开始；Target Etch
Begin; Target Etch
PR逐渐变薄；/顶部圆化
PR becomes thinner; / its top rounds
④ PR提前；耗尽
④ PR is prematurely; exhausted
⑤ Target未刻完；或CD失控
⑤ Target is not fully etched; or CD loses control
风险：PR选择比与刻蚀寿命不足，导致图形转移失败或不稳定。
Risk: insufficient PR selectivity and etch lifetime cause failed or unstable pattern transfer.
Photoresist与Hard Mask
Photoresist and Hard Mask
① 薄PR成像
① Thin-PR imaging
HM Open
HM Open
PR被消耗；或去除
PR is consumed; or removed
④ Hard Mask保护 → ⑤ 完成深刻蚀并保持Profile。
④ Hard Mask protects → ⑤ Deep etch is completed while maintaining the profile.
优势：Hard Mask相对更耐刻蚀，延长图形转移预算，；保护侧壁与维持关键尺寸。
Benefit: the Hard Mask is relatively more etch-resistant, extending the pattern-transfer budget,; protecting sidewalls and maintaining critical dimensions.
四类典型场景
Four typical applications
Thin Resist；薄胶有利于分辨率，；但刻蚀寿命有限
Thin Resist; Thin resist benefits resolution,; but its etch lifetime is limited
High Aspect Ratio；深槽、深孔与高台阶；刻蚀时间长
High Aspect Ratio; Deep trenches, deep holes and tall steps; Long etch time
Difficult Target Etch；目标层厚或刻蚀化学；对PR选择比不足
Difficult Target Etch; A thick target layer or etch chemistry; with insufficient selectivity to PR
Multiple / Self-Aligned；Patterning；需要中间Mask继续完成；图形倍增或转移
Multiple / Self-Aligned; Patterning; An intermediate mask is needed to complete; pattern multiplication or transfer
五步决策流程
Five-step decision flow
评估Target；深度与材料
Assess Target; depth and material
估算PR消耗
Estimate PR consumption
检查CD/；Profile风险
Check CD /; Profile risks
选择HM材料与；厚度预算
Choose HM material and; thickness budget
验证HM Open和；Target Etch窗口
Validate HM Open and; Target Etch windows
四个设计输入
Four design inputs
Mask消耗预算；Target深度/厚度；最小CD；结构Aspect Ratio
Mask-consumption budget; Target depth / thickness; Minimum CD; Structure aspect ratio
关键权衡
Key tradeoffs
加厚PR：刻蚀寿命可能增加；但曝光景深、分辨率和胶形貌；可能变差
Thicker PR: may increase etch lifetime,; but exposure depth of focus, resolution and resist profile; may deteriorate
使用HM：增加步骤与成本，；但改善深刻蚀保护，提升图形；转移的稳定性。
Using an HM: adds steps and cost,; but improves deep-etch protection and; pattern-transfer stability.
常见失败
Common failures
PR提前耗尽；顶部圆化 / Faceting；CD扩大；图形倒塌；Target未刻完
Premature PR exhaustion; Top rounding / Faceting; CD enlargement; Pattern collapse; Incomplete Target etch
量测与反馈
Metrology and feedback
PR初始/剩余厚度；HM剩余量；Litho/HM/Target CD；Cross-section Profile；决定是否需要HM；或调整Stack
Initial / remaining PR thickness; Remaining HM; Litho / HM / Target CD; Cross-section Profile; Decide whether an HM is needed; or adjust the Stack
简单浅刻蚀在PR选择比与Profile窗口足够时，可能不需要独立Hard Mask。
A simple shallow etch may not require a separate Hard Mask when PR selectivity and the Profile window are sufficient.

W Barrier为什么先于W填充？
Why does the W barrier come before W fill?
从洁净底部到低电阻Plug，是连续的界面工程
From a clean bottom to a low-resistance plug: a continuous interface-engineering sequence
W / Cu 阻挡层
MOL BEOL W Cu TiN TaN
六步界面工程
Six interface-engineering steps
Pre-clean；去残留，打开接触底部
Pre-clean Remove residues and expose the contact bottom
2；Ti；附着 / 吸杂/ 接触控制
2 Ti Adhesion / gettering / contact control
3；TiN；抑制WF₆相关反应，提供成核界面
3 TiN Suppress WF₆-related reactions and provide a nucleation interface
4；W成核；先建立薄而连续的起始层
4 W nucleation First establish a thin, continuous starting layer
5；Bulk W；保持覆盖，避免孔口过早闭合
5 Bulk W Maintain coverage and avoid premature opening closure
6；CMP；去除场区W，只留下Plug
6 CMP Remove field W, leaving only the plug
四项检查
Four checks
底部洁净；无残留、无有机物、；无粒子
Clean bottom No residues or organics, and no particles
Step Coverage；侧壁与底部膜厚一致，；无明显变薄
Step coverage Uniform sidewall and bottom film thickness, without obvious thinning
成核连续；无断点、无裸露，；连续成核
Continuous nucleation No breaks or exposed areas; continuous nucleation
CMP终点；场区去除干净，Plug；不凹陷、不残留
CMP endpoint Clean removal from the field; the plug has no recess or residue
顺序约束
Sequence requirement
顺序不能乱：先把界面做对，再谈W能否填满
Keep the sequence: establish the interfaces before asking whether W can fill the opening

records.text:
Ti/TiN不是同一种Barrier
Ti and TiN are not the same kind of barrier
位置相邻，但每一层解决的问题不同
They are adjacent, but each layer solves a different problem
W / Cu 阻挡层
MOL BEOL W Cu TiN TaN
层栈与位置
Stack and layer positions
介质层；Ti（附着层）；TiN（阻挡 / 成核界面）；W成核层；Bulk W（主体填充）；接触底部/ 基底
Dielectric Ti (adhesion layer) TiN (barrier / nucleation interface) W nucleation layer Bulk W (main fill) Contact bottom / substrate
每层各司其职
Distinct layer roles
Ti | 抓住界面；提升附着，吸杂，；并参与接触控制
Ti | secure the interface Improve adhesion and getter impurities, and contribute to contact control
2；TiN |隔开反应；抑制WF₆相关反应，；形成连续阻挡；WF₆等；反应物
2 TiN | isolate reactions Suppress WF₆-related reactions, forming a continuous barrier WF₆ and other reactants
3；W成核|铺好起点；让后续W从连续；表面开始生长
3 W nucleation | establish a starting surface Allow subsequent W growth to begin on a continuous surface
4；Bulk W | 完成填充；占据孔内主体；导电体积
4 Bulk W | complete the fill Occupy the main conductive volume inside the opening
错误与正确理解
Misconception and correct interpretation
错误理解；Ti与 TiN只是两层相同的Barrier；Ti；TiN；把两层当作作用相同、可互换
Misconception Ti and TiN are merely two identical barrier layers Ti TiN Treating both layers as equivalent and interchangeable
正确理解；Ti管附着与接触；TiN管隔离与成核界面
Correct interpretation Ti manages adhesion and contact; TiN manages isolation and the nucleation interface
介质层；Ti（附着层）；提升附着，参与接触控制
Dielectric Ti (adhesion layer) Improve adhesion and contribute to contact control
TiN（阻挡 / 成核界面）；抑制反应，形成连续阻挡
TiN (barrier / nucleation interface) Suppress reactions and form a continuous barrier
W成核层；提供连续表面，启动生长
W nucleation layer Provide a continuous surface to initiate growth
Bulk W（主体填充）；提供导电体积，完成填充
Bulk W (main fill) Provide the conductive volume to complete the fill
接触底部 / 基底
Contact bottom / substrate
看层栈不能只背材料名，要看它夹在哪两个界面之间
Read the stack by the two interfaces each layer lies between, not just material names

title.zh: Cu Barrier、Seed和电镀必须连续衔接
title.en: Cu barrier, seed and electroplating require continuous interfaces

records.text:
Cu Barrier、Seed和电镀必须连续衔接
Cu barrier, seed and electroplating require continuous interfaces
Dual Damascene不是单层沉积，而是一条连续界面链
Dual damascene is a continuous interface chain, not a single deposition
W / Cu 阻挡层
MOL BEOL W Cu TiN TaN
六步连续界面链
Six-step interface chain
Via / Trench；刻蚀形成互连结构；Low-k；介质
Via / trench Etch the interconnect structure Low-k Dielectric
Clean / Pre-clean；去残留，活化底部与侧壁
Clean / pre-clean Remove residues and activate the bottom and sidewalls
TaN / Ta；先阻挡Cu扩散，再衔接Seed界面；TaN；（阻挡层）；Ta；（衔接层）
TaN / Ta Block Cu diffusion first, then prepare the seed interface TaN (barrier layer) Ta (transition layer)
Cu Seed；建立连续导电种子层；Cu Seed；（种子层）
Cu seed Establish a continuous conductive seed layer Cu seed (seed layer)
ECP Cu + Anneal；电镀填充，再稳定晶粒与应力
ECP Cu + anneal Electroplate the fill, then stabilize grains and stress
CMP + Cap；去除场区Cu，并封住互连顶部
CMP + cap Remove field Cu and seal the interconnect top
层栈图例
Stack legend
Low-k介质；TaN（阻挡层）；Ta（衔接层）；Cu Seed（种子层）；ECP Cu（电镀铜）
Low-k dielectric TaN (barrier layer) Ta (transition layer) Cu seed (seed layer) ECP Cu (electroplated Cu)
连续性要求
Continuity requirements
Barrier连续；断层：Cu可能外扩散
Continuous barrier Barrier break: Cu may diffuse outward
Seed连续；断种：局部无法起镀
Continuous seed Seed break: local plating cannot start
ECP可填充；断填：形成Void或Seam
ECP fillability Fill failure: a void or seam forms
任何一环断开，最终都可能表现成高电阻或可靠性失效
A break anywhere in the chain can ultimately cause high resistance or reliability failure

title.en: TaN, Ta and Cu seed have distinct roles

records.text:
TaN、Ta、Cu Seed各司其职
TaN, Ta and Cu seed have distinct roles
同在Cu之前，但阻挡、界面和导电任务不能互换
All precede Cu, but their barrier, interface and conduction tasks are not interchangeable
W / Cu 阻挡层
MOL BEOL W Cu TiN TaN
层栈位置
Stack positions
Low-k / ILD；TaN（扩散阻挡层）；Ta（界面衔接层）；Cu Seed（导电种子层）；ECP Cu（主体填充）
Low-k / ILD TaN (diffusion barrier) Ta (interface transition layer) Cu seed (conductive seed layer) ECP Cu (bulk fill)
四种功能
Four functions
TaN |挡住Cu；阻止Cu向介质扩散，；关键是连续无针孔
TaN | block Cu Prevent Cu diffusion into the dielectric; continuity without pinholes is crucial
2；Ta | 接好界面；改善TaN到Cu Seed；之间的界面衔接
2 Ta | connect interfaces Improve the interface transition between TaN and Cu seed
3；Cu Seed；接通电流；为电镀提供连续；导电与起镀表面
3 Cu seed Connect the current path Provide a continuous conductive surface for electroplating initiation
4；ECP Cu |；完成填充；形成互连的主体；导电体积
4 ECP Cu | Complete the fill Form the main conductive volume of the interconnect
缺陷与后果
Defects and consequences
TaN断层；Cu扩散风险
TaN discontinuity Cu diffusion risk
Ta界面异常；附着 / 接触异常
Ta interface defect Adhesion / contact anomaly
Cu Seed断裂；局部不起镀/Void
Cu seed break Local plating does not start / void
记忆与边界
Mnemonic and limits

GDS is a layout database, not the actual wafer imaging result
控制要点
Control points
结构控制 | Top Cell ．Cell Reference；Top Cell为输出根；Cell以引用方式复用；X/Y变换：平移、旋转、镜像

层次化可减小数据量，但跨平台转换必须正确解析引用关系。
Hierarchy reduces data volume, but cross-platform conversion must parse references correctly

Manufacturing rules turn design data into writable, inspectable mask data
JDV / GDS 光罩数据

七步转换
Seven conversion steps

Original GDS geometry Boolean result Add frame/marks After size correction After OPC correction Fracturing result JDV preview
关键控制
Key controls
1. 关键控制
1. Key controls
Layer Mapping（层映射）；将设计层映射到工艺/掩膜层。
Layer mapping Map design layers to process/mask layers
Boolean逻辑；按制造规则执行并/或/异或等布尔运算。
Boolean logic Apply manufacturing-rule Boolean operations such as AND, OR and XOR
Bias / Shrink（偏置/收缩）；根据制造偏差对关键尺寸进行修正。
Bias / shrink Correct critical dimensions for manufacturing deviations
OPC / Fracture；提升可印性并满足规则，最后进行碎形。
OPC / fracturing Improve printability and satisfy rules, then fracture the data
耦合关系
Coupled effects
2. 耦合关系；OPC提高；可印性；增加Mask图形；复杂度；增加数据量与；写版时间
2. Coupled effects OPC improves printability Increased mask-shape complexity Increased data volume and mask-writing time
更强的OPC改善印刷良率，但会带来复杂度和数据量的代价。
Stronger OPC can improve printing yield at the cost of complexity and data volume
常见风险
Common risks
3. 常见风险
3. Common risks
Boolean错误；布尔运算顺序或逻辑错误导致缺陷或开短路。
Boolean error Wrong operation order or logic can create defects, opens or shorts
Tone反转；正/负片或极性设定错误，导致图形反相。
Tone inversion Wrong positive/negative tone or polarity inverts the pattern
OPC层遗漏；未纳入关键OPC层或修正层，影响可印性。
Missing OPC layers Omitting critical OPC or correction layers affects printability
Fracture异常；碎形缝隙、过大多边形或交叠异常等问题。
Fracturing anomaly Problems include gaps, oversized polygons or abnormal overlaps
反馈验证与边界
Feedback validation and limits
4. 反馈验证
4. Feedback validation
XOR（异或比较）；比较前后结果，检查意外差异。
XOR comparison Compare before and after to detect unintended differences
MRC（制造规则检查）；对MDP数据执行制造规则检查。
MRC (manufacturing-rule check) Run manufacturing-rule checks on MDP data
独立转换检查；使用独立工具链或设置重复转换并比对。
Independent conversion check Repeat conversion with an independent toolchain or settings and compare
关键区域抽样；对关键区域/热点进行重点比对与验证。
Critical-region sampling Focus comparisons and validation on critical areas/hotspots
边界：并非所有层都采用相同的OPC、Bias或多重图形化规则。
Limit: not every layer uses the same OPC, bias or multiple-patterning rules

Lithography Mask GDS OASIS JDV OPC
六阶段预期变化
Expected changes across six stages
Drawn GDS；规则直角；原始图形；设计工具绘制的；原始版图（规则直角）；EXPECTED
Drawn GDS Regular right angles Original pattern Drawn by design tools Original layout (regular right angles) EXPECTED
Boolean；Derived Mask；经过布尔运算的；派生层；合并、相交、去边缘；清理等布尔运算后；的派生图形；EXPECTED

Bias；Adjustment；轮廓均匀；扩张或收缩；按工艺Bias对轮廓；进行均匀扩张或；收缩（正/负Bias）；EXPECTED
Bias adjustment Uniform contour expansion or shrinkage Apply process bias to contours for uniform expansion or shrinkage (positive/negative bias) EXPECTED

Alignment before comparison

Coordinate system Match units, origins and orientations

Scale Tone Match magnification/scaling and positive/negative tone Consistent Consistent
Bias；Bias方向与；数值一致
Bias Match bias direction and value
判断权衡
Judgment trade-off
判断权衡；过度要求逐点相同；会制造假警报；不同阶段图形本就会不同，；XOR大不一定有错
Judgment trade-off Demanding pointwise identity creates false alarms Shapes naturally differ across stages; a large XOR does not necessarily mean an error
盲目信任差异也可能；漏掉真实转换错误；转换逻辑/设置出错时，；差异可能被掩盖
Blindly trusting differences can also miss real conversion errors If conversion logic/settings are wrong, differences can be hidden
四类误判
Four misjudgments
常见误判；把OPC当错误；OPC修改属于预期差异
Common misjudgments Treating OPC as an error OPC changes are expected differences
遗漏图形没发现；未对齐或阈值不当导致漏检
Missing an omitted shape Misalignment or unsuitable thresholds cause missed detection
Pre/Post混合比较；Pre-OPC数据；Post-OPC视图；阶段不同，差异巨大
Mixed pre/post comparison Pre-OPC data Post-OPC view Different stages produce large differences
XOR基准错误；基准层或逻辑反了
Wrong XOR reference Reference layer or logic is reversed
正确反馈与边界
Correct feedback and limits
正确反馈；XOR；同阶段XOR；在同一数据阶段、同一设置下比较XOR
Correct feedback XOR Same-stage XOR Compare XOR at the same data stage and with the same settings
关键结构抽样；对关键结构抽样核查，结合设计意图
Sample critical structures Review sampled critical structures against design intent
尺寸统计；CD/线宽、间距、孔径等分布对比
Dimension statistics Compare distributions of CD/linewidth, spacing and hole diameter
Layer数量与面积统计；Layer数、面积、密度等整体统计
Layer-count and area statistics Overall layer count, area, density and related statistics
边界：合理差异会随工艺节点、Mask Writer和RET策略变化。
Limit: acceptable differences vary with process node, mask writer and RET strategy

paragraphs.en: Align before comparing Data stage Confirm both are pre-OPC or post-OPC

paragraphs.zh: 坐标系；单位、原点、；方向一致
paragraphs.en: Coordinate system Match units, origins and orientations

paragraphs.zh: Scale；Tone；倍率/缩放 正片/负片；一致；一致
paragraphs.en: Scale Tone Match magnification/scaling and positive/negative tone Consistent Consistent
Bias Match bias direction and value

paragraphs.zh: 判断权衡；过度要求逐点相同；会制造假警报；不同阶段图形本就会不同，；XOR大不一定有错
paragraphs.en: Judgment trade-off Demanding pointwise identity creates false alarms Shapes naturally differ across stages; a large XOR does not necessarily mean an error

paragraphs.zh: 盲目信任差异也可能；漏掉真实转换错误；转换逻辑/设置出错时，；差异可能被掩盖
paragraphs.en: Blindly trusting differences can also miss real conversion errors If conversion logic/settings are wrong, differences can be hidden

paragraphs.zh: 常见误判；把OPC当错误；OPC修改属于预期差异
paragraphs.en: Common misjudgments Treating OPC as an error OPC changes are expected differences

paragraphs.zh: 遗漏图形没发现；未对齐或阈值不当导致漏检
paragraphs.en: Missing an omitted shape Misalignment or unsuitable thresholds cause missed detection

paragraphs.zh: Pre/Post混合比较；Pre-OPC数据；Post-OPC视图；阶段不同，差异巨大
paragraphs.en: Mixed pre/post comparison Pre-OPC data Post-OPC view Different stages produce large differences

paragraphs.zh: XOR基准错误；基准层或逻辑反了
paragraphs.en: Wrong XOR reference Reference layer or logic is reversed

paragraphs.zh: 正确反馈；XOR；同阶段XOR；在同一数据阶段、同一设置下比较XOR
paragraphs.en: Correct feedback XOR Same-stage XOR Compare XOR at the same data stage and with the same settings

paragraphs.zh: 关键结构抽样；对关键结构抽样核查，结合设计意图
paragraphs.en: Sample critical structures Review sampled critical structures against design intent

paragraphs.zh: 尺寸统计；CD/线宽、间距、孔径等分布对比
paragraphs.en: Dimension statistics Compare distributions of CD/linewidth, spacing and hole diameter

paragraphs.zh: Layer数量与面积统计；Layer数、面积、密度等整体统计
paragraphs.en: Layer-count and area statistics Overall layer count, area, density and related statistics

paragraphs.zh: 边界：合理差异会随工艺节点、Mask Writer和RET策略变化。
paragraphs.en: Limit: acceptable differences vary with process node, mask writer and RET strategy

title.zh: 从 Wire Bond 到Flip Chip：连接走向芯片表面
title.en: From Wire Bond to Flip Chip: connections move onto the chip surface

records.text:
从 Wire Bond 到Flip Chip：连接走向芯片表面
From Wire Bond to Flip Chip: connections move onto the chip surface
当I/O密度、速度和电流不断提升，连接方式从芯片边缘走向整个芯片表面
As I/O density, speed and current increase, connections move from the chip perimeter to the entire surface
Flip Chip 倒装互连
Packaging Wire bond Flip chip Underfill
Wire Bond
Wire Bond
边缘焊线的时代 Wire Bond
The era of peripheral wire bonding: Wire Bond
芯片引线框架/基板
Chip Lead frame / substrate
•芯片边缘焊盘＋金属线连接
• Peripheral chip pads connected by metal wires
• 工艺成熟，成本和返修经验丰富
• Mature process with extensive cost and rework experience
• 对许多低速、I/O数有限的器件导线长度不是首要矛盾
• For many low-speed devices with limited I/O counts, Wire length is not the primary limitation
•旧路线不是落后，而是曾经正好满足产品的约束
• The earlier route was not obsolete; it met The product constraints of its time
I/O压力
I/O pressure
I/O密度的压力
Pressure from I/O density
端子数量增加（处理器、射频、高性能器件）
More terminals (processors, RF and high-performance devices)
信号边沿变快
Faster signal edges
供电电流上升
Higher supply current
长路径带来的问题
Problems caused by long paths
•导线从芯片边缘绕出，路径更长
• Wires emerge around the chip perimeter, creating longer paths
• 占用封装高度
• Consume package height
• 更大的电感和电阻
• Greater inductance and resistance
• 电源噪声与信号完整性开始限制系统
• Power noise and signal integrity Begin to constrain the system
面阵连接
Area-array interconnection
面阵连接的转向 Flip Chip
The shift to area arrays: Flip Chip
芯片（翻转）基板
Chip (flipped) Substrate
• 凸点直接分布在芯片表面和基板之间
• Bumps lie directly between the chip surface and substrate
• 连接不再只发生在四周，整个表面都可以布置I/O
• Connections are no longer confined to the perimeter; I/O Can be placed over the entire surface
• 路径明显缩短
• Significantly shorter paths
•低电感、高布线密度、取消焊线环高
• Low inductance, high routing density and no wire-loop height
•这正是面阵互连进入高性能封装的原因
• This is why area-array interconnects entered high-performance packaging
制造代价
Manufacturing costs
新工艺的代价
The cost of a new process
芯片底填凸点 基板
Chip Underfill Bumps; substrate
•需要晶圆级凸点、对准、回流或热压装配
• Requires wafer-level bumps, alignment, And reflow or thermocompression assembly
• 芯片底部常需要底填
• Underfill is often needed beneath the chip
• 连接变短并不等于制造更简单
• Shorter connections do not mean simpler manufacturing
• 细间距带来共面性、空洞、翘曲和可靠性问题
• Fine pitch brings coplanarity, void, warpage And reliability issues
路线选择
Route selection
路线并没有消失
The routes have not disappeared
Wire Bond适合• 成本更重要•功耗更重要• I/O规模较小• 低速器件
Wire Bond Suited to • Greater emphasis on cost • Greater emphasis on power consumption • Smaller I/O scale • Low-speed devices
Flip Chip更有优势• 高密度I/O•高速路径•更好信号完整性• 适合高性能器件
Flip Chip Advantages in • High-density I/O • High-speed paths • Better signal integrity • High-performance devices
封装路线不是按先进程度排队而是由信号、供电、面积、热和成本共同筛选
Packaging routes are not ranked simply by technological advancement They are selected by signal, power supply, area, heat and cost together
更高密度更好性能面向多样的产品需求
Higher density Better performance For diverse product requirements

Materials and testing

Reorganization of the testing and materials chain

title.zh: 细间距装配的共面性
title.en: Coplanarity in fine-pitch assembly

records.text:
细间距装配的共面性
Coplanarity in fine-pitch assembly
凸点、对准、装配与底填
Bumps, alignment, assembly and underfill
Flip Chip 倒装互连
Packaging Wire bond Flip chip Underfill
装配流程
Assembly sequence
凸点阵列需要晶圆级凸点、对准、回流或热压装配，芯片底部还常需要底填。图示顺序为：晶圆级凸点及凸点阵列 → 对准 → 回流或热压装配 → 底填。
Bump arrays require wafer-level bumping, alignment, and reflow or thermocompression assembly; underfill is often also needed beneath the die. The illustrated sequence is wafer-level bumping and the bump array → alignment → reflow or thermocompression assembly → underfill.
剖面与局部放大
Cross-section and enlarged details
主剖面标出了芯片、底填与凸点。局部图分别展示对准剖面、共面性边界和底填空洞。对准图以左右箭头与虚线标示相对位置；共面性图以虚线和上下箭头标示边界；空洞图标出底填中的空洞。
The main cross-section labels the die, underfill and bumps. Enlarged views show alignment, coplanarity limits and underfill voids. Opposing arrows and dashed lines indicate relative alignment; a dashed line and vertical arrows indicate the coplanarity limit; the void illustration identifies voids in the underfill.
细间距的制造代价
Manufacturing costs of finer pitch
共面性要求更高 → 更易产生空洞 → 更容易翘曲 → 可靠性风险上升。翘曲与可靠性示意展示弯曲的芯片结构和可靠性问题。
Stricter coplanarity requirements → more readily formed voids → greater susceptibility to warpage → increased reliability risk. The warpage and reliability illustration shows a bowed die structure and reliability problems.
细间距使共面性控制更难，底填更易产生空洞，并可能引起翘曲，进而影响可靠性。
Finer pitch makes coplanarity harder to control and promotes underfill voids; it may also cause warpage and thus affect reliability.

paragraphs.zh: 共面性要求更高 → 更易产生空洞 → 更容易翘曲 → 可靠性风险上升。翘曲与可靠性示意展示弯曲的芯片结构和可靠性问题。
paragraphs.en: Stricter coplanarity requirements → more readily formed voids → greater susceptibility to warpage → increased reliability risk. The warpage and reliability illustration shows a bowed die structure and reliability problems.

paragraphs.zh: 细间距使共面性控制更难，底填更易产生空洞，并可能引起翘曲，进而影响可靠性。
paragraphs.en: Finer pitch makes coplanarity harder to control and promotes underfill voids; it may also cause warpage and thus affect reliability.

title.zh: 连接路线的产品约束
title.en: Product constraints on interconnect selection

records.text:
连接路线的产品约束
Product constraints on interconnect selection
由信号、供电、面积、热和成本共同决定
Determined jointly by signal, power delivery, area, thermal requirements and cost
Flip Chip 倒装互连
Packaging Wire bond Flip chip Underfill
产品约束
Product constraints
不同的产品目标决定不同的连接路线。图中产品约束的五个维度为：信号—高速路径；供电—电流传输；面积—封装大小；热—散热能力；成本—制造成本。
Different product objectives determine different interconnect choices. The five illustrated product constraints are signal—high-speed paths; power delivery—current transfer; area—package size; thermal—heat-removal capability; and cost—manufacturing cost.
Wire Bond
Wire Bond
适合成本、功耗和I/O规模更重要的产品。图示金线连接，并列出：成本更低、适合较大I/O规模、功耗友好。
Suitable when cost, power consumption and I/O count are more important. The source illustrates a gold-wire connection and lists lower cost, suitability for a larger I/O count, and power-friendly operation.
Flip Chip
Flip Chip
在高密度和高速路径上更有优势。图示焊球连接，并列出：高密度I/O、支持高速路径、散热更好。
More advantageous for high density and high-speed paths. The source illustrates a solder-ball connection and lists high-density I/O, support for high-speed paths, and better heat removal.
关键变量如何影响选择
How key variables influence selection
信号：高速路径更适合Flip Chip。供电：大电流需求倾向Flip Chip。面积：高密度封装倾向Flip Chip。热：散热要求高倾向Flip Chip。成本：成本敏感更适合Wire Bond。I/O：I/O规模更重要时更适合Wire Bond。
Signal: high-speed paths favor Flip Chip. Power delivery: high-current requirements favor Flip Chip. Area: high-density packaging favors Flip Chip. Thermal: high cooling requirements favor Flip Chip. Cost: cost-sensitive products favor Wire Bond. I/O: when I/O count is more important, Wire Bond is more suitable.
综合权衡
Overall tradeoff
当成本、功耗和I/O规模更重要时，选择Wire Bond；当高密度和高速路径更重要时，选择Flip Chip。
Choose Wire Bond when cost, power consumption and I/O count are more important; choose Flip Chip when high density and high-speed paths are more important.
原图对两种路线给出概括性比较，未提供定量边界或适用产品条件；此处忠实保留原图表述。
The original gives a broad comparison without quantitative limits or specific product conditions; its statements are preserved faithfully here.

title.zh: 封装级联合验证
title.en: Package-level joint validation

records.text:
封装级联合验证
Package-level joint validation
从凸点到板级可靠性，把电、热、力放在同一验证窗口中
From bumps to board-level reliability, evaluate electrical, thermal and mechanical behavior within one validation window
Flip Chip 倒装互连
Packaging Wire bond Flip chip Underfill
联合验证链条
Joint validation chain
封装 → 凸点 → 基板布线 → 装配对准 → 板级可靠性。任何一环失配都会阻断交付。
Packaging → bumps → substrate routing → assembly alignment → board-level reliability. A mismatch in any link blocks delivery.
Wire Bond与I/O
Wire Bond and I/O
依靠芯片边缘焊盘和金属线连接，成熟且灵活。图中标出芯片、Wire Bond与I/O。当I/O数、信号频率和供电电流上升时，导线长度、寄生电感和封装高度开始占用系统余量。
Wire bonding uses die-edge pads and metal wires and is mature and flexible. The illustration labels the die, Wire Bond and I/O. As I/O count, signal frequency and supply current increase, wire length, parasitic inductance and package height begin consuming system margins.
凸点与基板布线
Bumps and substrate routing
凸点连接封装与基板，传递电与热。凸点失配会导致电气或机械失效。
Bumps connect the package and substrate and transfer electricity and heat. Bump mismatch causes electrical or mechanical failure.
基板布线在基板内完成信号与电源分配，影响完整性与热扩散。布线失配会引入信号与供电问题。
Substrate routing distributes signals and power within the substrate and affects integrity and heat spreading. Routing mismatch introduces signal and power-delivery problems.
装配对准与热路径
Assembly alignment and thermal paths
装配对准保证封装与基板的空间对准，建立可靠连接。对准失配会导致连接不良或开路。
Assembly alignment ensures spatial alignment between the package and substrate and establishes reliable connections. Alignment mismatch causes poor connections or opens.
热量从芯片经封装与基板传导，影响整机可靠性。热路径失配会引发过热与长期可靠性风险。
Heat conducts from the die through the package and substrate, affecting system reliability. Thermal-path mismatch causes overheating and long-term reliability risks.
交付条件
Delivery conditions
电气性能、热管理和机械可靠性共同进入验证。任一环节失配 → 阻断交付；目标是系统稳定、整机可靠、成功交付。
Electrical performance, thermal management and mechanical reliability are validated together. Any link mismatches → delivery is blocked. The goals are a stable system, reliable complete system and successful delivery.

title.zh: 什么是芯片的Seal Ring？
title.en: What is a chip’s Seal Ring?

records.text:
什么是芯片的Seal Ring？
What is a chip’s Seal Ring?
一圈不起眼的“隐形城墙”，却守护着每一颗芯片的生死
An inconspicuous “invisible wall” protects the survival of every chip
Seal Ring 芯片密封环
Reliability Chip edge Seal Ring Scribe line
图中结构
Structures in the diagram
Core：核心电路区。IO Ring：压焊块环。Seal Ring：密封环（本环）。Scribe Line：划片槽，即切割下刀的地方。
Core: core circuitry. I/O Ring: bond-pad ring. Seal Ring: the sealing ring discussed here. Scribe Line: the lane where the cutting blade passes.
图中核心电路区位于中心；蓝色IO Ring位于外围；橙色Seal Ring环绕其外；最外侧灰色虚线表示Scribe Line。
The core circuitry is at the center. The blue I/O Ring lies around it, the orange Seal Ring surrounds that, and the outer gray dashed outline represents the Scribe Line.
位置与纵向延伸
Location and vertical extent
Seal Ring位于核心电路与划片槽之间，从衬底一路叠到最顶层金属。
The Seal Ring lies between the core circuitry and the scribe lane and extends from the substrate through the top metal layer.

title.zh: 一圈从衬底叠到顶层金属的“城墙”
title.en: A “wall” stacked from the substrate to the top metal layer

records.text:
一圈从衬底叠到顶层金属的“城墙”
A “wall” stacked from the substrate to the top metal layer
02 · 结构与作用
02 · Structure and functions
Seal Ring 芯片密封环
Reliability Chip edge Seal Ring Scribe line
结构
Structure
Metal 顶层金属（铜）Via 通孔：连续长条相邻层错位排列Contact 接触孔P+ 有源区/硅衬底
Metal: top metal (copper) Via: continuous elongated openings Staggered between adjacent layers Contact P+ active region / silicon substrate
看版图：Diff、Contact、Via、Metal 所有层次叠加成的闭合环，几乎没有缺口。
In layout: Diff, Contact, Via and Metal at all levels Stack into a closed ring with almost no gaps.
看工艺：多层铜金属＋氧化层＋钝化层堆叠，像一圈致密的堤坝。
In the process: stacked copper metal layers, oxide layers and passivation, Like a dense embankment.
看位置：夹在核心电路与划片槽之间，与内部电路保持安全距离。
In location: between the core circuit and the scribe line, maintaining A safe distance from the internal circuitry.
电气上：通常整体接地（VSS），是芯片边缘的等电位环。
Electrically: usually grounded as a whole (VSS), forming an Equipotential ring at the chip edge.
作用
Functions
① 挡住切割裂纹划片刀在环外下刀，应力与微裂纹被这圈“城墙”截停，不再向芯片内部蔓延。
① Stop dicing cracks The saw cuts outside the ring. This “wall” stops stress and microcracks, Preventing them from propagating into the chip.
② 阻挡水汽与污染错位长条孔形成“迷宫”，潮气、离子难以从侧面断口侵入核心电路。
② Block moisture and contamination Staggered elongated vias form a “maze,” making it difficult for moisture and ions to enter The core circuit through the cut sidewall.
③ 泄放静电切割摩擦产生的静电，就近被接地的环导入地网络，分摊对芯片本体的冲击。
③ Discharge static electricity Static charge generated by dicing friction is routed into the ground network by the nearby grounded ring, Distributing the impact on the chip itself.
④ 屏蔽外部干扰整体接地的闭合环如同法拉第笼，衰减外部电磁与噪声对内部的耦合。
④ Shield external interference The fully grounded closed ring acts like a Faraday cage, attenuating external electromagnetic and noise Coupling into the interior.
代价与规则
Cost and rules
代价：多占约5%–8%芯片面积；回报：良率与长期可靠性显著提升。
Cost: about 5%–8% more chip area; return: significantly improved yield and long-term reliability.
Seal Ring结构因工艺节点而异 · 设计须严格遵循Foundry设计规则
Seal Ring structures vary by process node; designs must strictly follow Foundry design rules
原图给出的5%–8%面积代价及屏蔽作用是原文陈述，未附适用器件或工艺条件，不应视为通用设计保证。
The source states a 5%–8% area cost and shielding effects without specifying device or process conditions; these are source claims, not universal design guarantees.

P+ 有源区/硅衬底
① 挡住切割裂纹
划片刀在环外下刀，应力与微裂纹被这圈“城墙”截停，
不再向芯片内部蔓延。
② 阻挡水汽与污染
错位长条孔形成“迷宫”，潮气、离子难以从侧面断口侵
入核心电路。
③ 泄放静电
切割摩擦产生的静电，就近被接地的环导入地网络，分
摊对芯片本体的冲击。
④ 屏蔽外部干扰
整体接地的闭合环如同法拉第笼，衰减外部电磁与噪声
对内部的耦合。
代价：多占约5%–8%芯片面积；回报：良率与长期可靠性显著提升。
Seal Ring结构因工艺节点而异 · 设计须严格遵循Foundry设计规则
02 · Structure and functions
A “wall” stacked from the substrate to the top metal layer
Metal: top metal (copper)
Via: continuous elongated openings
Staggered between adjacent layers
In layout: Diff, Contact, Via and Metal at all levels
Stack into a closed ring with almost no gaps.
In the process: stacked copper metal layers, oxide layers and passivation,
Like a dense embankment.
In location: between the core circuit and the scribe line, maintaining
A safe distance from the internal circuitry.
Electrically: usually grounded as a whole (VSS), forming an
Equipotential ring at the chip edge.
Contact
P+ active region / silicon substrate
① Stop dicing cracks
The saw cuts outside the ring. This “wall” stops stress and microcracks,
Preventing them from propagating into the chip.
② Block moisture and contamination
Staggered elongated vias form a “maze,” making it difficult for moisture and ions to enter
The core circuit through the cut sidewall.
③ Discharge static electricity
Static charge generated by dicing friction is routed into the ground network by the nearby grounded ring,
Distributing the impact on the chip itself.
④ Shield external interference
The fully grounded closed ring acts like a Faraday cage, attenuating external electromagnetic and noise
Coupling into the interior.
Cost: about 5%–8% more chip area; return: significantly improved yield and long-term reliability.
Seal Ring structures vary by process node; designs must strictly follow Foundry design rules

title.zh: 七个频道怎么选：入门、更新与系统学习
title.en: 七个频道怎么选：入门、更新与系统学习

records.text:
七个频道怎么选：入门、更新与系统学习
按入门、追踪更新和系统学习分配阅读时间，选择真正适合任务的材料。
选一个常做的工作，写清目标、背景和输出要求。
我已经读完两张图。这个名单整体合理，但它更像“频道推荐”，还不能直接当学习路线，因为入门、新闻和专业开发内容混在了一起。

我的判断：

- **Jeff Su：最适合你先开始。** 偏普通职场人的实际工作流。建议完整看 [How I’d Learn AI From Scratch in 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=msFxQ7OYPj8)。核心观点是：先熟练掌握一个 AI、提供充分背景资料，再逐步形成固定工作流。这个方向合理，但“总用最强模型”“模型之间差别很小”不能绝对化。
- **Tina Huang：适合建立全局地图。** 她现在更多讲模型、Agent 和工作流，不只是“压缩长课”。[Every AI Model Explained In 20 Minutes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=--8pJvYNcX4) 值得快速看一次，但模型比较会很快过时，而且其中有赞助段落，不应直接当购买建议。
- **Matt Wolfe：适合由我替你过滤。** 更新快，但信息量和标题噪音都比较大。没必要每期亲自看。
- **Dave Ebbelaar：适合想开发 AI 产品的人。** Python、RAG、部署和系统架构含金量不错，但对普通办公使用明显过深。除非你想学编程，否则暂时跳过。
- **AI Explained：适合了解重大趋势。** 通常比工具测评更有分析，但仍属于评论频道，不是原始来源。我会用官方公告和论文核对它的重要判断。
- **Andrej Karpathy：名单里最值得系统精学的人，但不要直接挑战 Zero to Hero。** 先把 [How I Use LLMs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EWvNQjAaOHw) 分成每次约 20 分钟学习；以后若确定想理解神经网络原理，再进入 [Zero to Hero](https://karpathy.ai/zero-to-hero.html)。
- **Google Cloud Tech：官方且可靠，但内容太多、偏 Google 产品。** 只在你需要 Gemini、Vertex AI、Agent 或云端部署时选择性看。
